description: <div class="content-intro"><h3>About Us</h3> <p>At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.</p> <p>At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.</p></div><h3><strong>Location: Lisbon, Portugal</strong></h3> <h3><strong>What You’ll Do</strong></h3> <p>The Customer Experience Manager leads the post-sale customer journey, managing everything from onboarding to long-term retention and contract renewals. Acting as both a trusted business advisor and a commercial owner of the account, you will build strategic relationships with stakeholders to clearly articulate ROI and business value and ultimately successfully close renewals maximizing upsells and minimizing churn. You will collaborate tightly with the Sales team to maintain accurate weekly forecasts and contribute to  critical engagements like Executive Business Reviews. In addition, you will embed AI-driven optimization into your daily workflows—using advanced data analysis to uncover selling opportunities and automating routine tasks to accelerate customer outcomes and maximize operational efficiency.</p> <h3><strong>Key Responsibilities</strong></h3> <h3>Customer Lifecycle & Success</h3> <ul> <li> <p>Manage customer engagement across the entire customer lifecycle, from onboarding through renewal.</p> </li> <li> <p>Be a Trusted Advisor to your customers by helping them adopt the Cloudflare products and services to meet their needs and make them successful</p> </li> <li> <p>Work with your account teams to plan and execute long term Success Plans with our largest customers to facilitate retention and growth via product and new business unit expansion.</p> </li> <li> <p>Maintain a deep understanding of our solutions and present to customers about the most relevant features/functionality for their specific business needs.</p> </li> <li> <p>Own or be an active participant in several customer touch points including: Business Value Justification meetings, Business Reviews, and Renewal Meetings, with a track record of successful planning and execution of Executive Business Reviews.</p> </li> <li> <p>Demonstrate how your customer engagement directly impacts revenue growth and adoption of Cloudflare solutions and services.</p> </li> </ul> <h3>Commercial & Renewals</h3> <ul> <li> <p>You are ultimately responsible for the retention and growth of your book of business. You will own and drive the renewal including maintaining and reporting an accurate weekly forecast.</p> </li> <li> <p>Negotiate and execute renewal contracts in accordance with customer objectives.</p> </li> <li> <p>You will be an expert in deal construction and pricing strategy. You will directly be designing renewals to create a win-win for customers and Cloudflare. </p> </li> <li> <p>Analyze data and leverage tools to identify selling opportunities and business value.</p> </li> <li> <p>Drive strong alignment with the Sales team, contributing to team forecasting, planning, and targets.</p> </li> </ul> <h3>Cross-Functional & Operational Management</h3> <ul> <li> <p>Develop and maintain long-term relationships with stakeholders in your account portfolio.</p> </li> <li> <p>Work cross-functionally with Product, Engineering, Support,Marketing and other teams to resolve customer business issues and work towards each customer’s stated goals.</p> </li> <li> <p>Manage customer feedback and product needs by providing feature requests to internal partner teams.</p> </li> <li> <p>Able to prioritize effectively to handle multiple deals at the same time.</p> </li> </ul> <h3>AI Competencies</h3> <ul> <li> <p>Generative AI: Mastery of LLMs to rapidly draft renewal communications, synthesize quarterly review data, and prepare executive summaries.</p> </li> <li> <p>Data Analysis: Proficiency in leveraging AI analytics tools to parse customer usage metrics and instantly highlight up-sell or cross-sell opportunities.</p> </li> <li> <p>Workflow Automation: Ability to build automations to synchronize CRM data, update weekly forecasts, and trigger lifecycle alerts.</p> </li> <li> <p>AI Problem Solving: The instinct to view AI as a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward.</p> </li> </ul> <h3><strong>Qualifications</strong></h3> <ul> <li> <p>Minimum of 3 years of experience in a Customer Success/Account Management role or Inside or Field sales.</p> </li> <li>Fluency in French AND Spanish or Portuguese</li> <li> <p>2+ years of industry experience, with experience in cloud security and/or performance industries preferred.</p> </li> <li> <p>Bachelor's degree and/or other professional qualifications.</p> </li> <li> <p>Direct experience in commercial sales, negotiation, and deal closure.</p> </li> <li> <p>Strong understanding of or willingness to learn about computer networking and “how the internet works,” with network security a plus.</p> </li> <li> <p>Manage and prioritize competing portfolio demands, aligning internal resources with the highest-impact commercial and retention goals</p> </li> <li> <p>Expertise in SaaS retention and sales process and excellent knowledge of value driven sales.</p> </li> <li> <p>Excellent problem solving skills with the ability to creatively achieve resolutions.</p> </li> </ul> <h3 data-path-to-node="0"><strong data-path-to-node="0" data-index-in-node="0">Compensation</strong></h3> <p data-path-to-node="2">● For Portugal based hires: Estimated annual salary is between €50,000 - €69,000.</p> <ul data-path-to-node="3"> <li> <p data-path-to-node="3,0,0">The final offer will be inclusive of time exemption, in alignment with the applicable law and collective bargaining agreements.</p> </li> </ul> <p id="p-rc_9eda62afa737f98d-28" data-path-to-node="4"><span class="citation-33 citation-end-33">This role is eligible to earn incentive compensation under Cloudflare’s Sales Compensation Plan. The estimated annual salary range includes the on-target incentive compensation that may be attained in this role under the Sales Compensation Plan.</span></p> <h3 data-path-to-node="5"><strong data-path-to-node="5" data-index-in-node="0">Equity</strong></h3> <p data-path-to-node="6">This role is eligible to participate in Cloudflare’s equity plan.</p> <p> </p><div class="content-conclusion"><h3>What Makes Cloudflare Special?</h3> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. We’re a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company with a soul. Fundamental to our mission to help build a better Internet is protecting the free and open Internet.</span></p> <p><a href="https://blog.cloudflare.com/protecting-free-expression-online/"><strong>Project Galileo</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: Since 2014, we've equipped more than 2,400 journalism and civil society organizations in 111 countries with powerful tools to defend themselves against attacks that would otherwise censor their work, technology already used by Cloudflare’s enterprise customers--at no cost.</span></p> <p><strong><a href="https://www.cloudflare.com/athenian/">Athenian Project</a></strong><span style="font-weight: 400;">: In 2017, we created the Athenian Project to ensure that state and local governments have the highest level of protection and reliability for free, so that their constituents have access to election information and voter registration. Since the project, we've provided services to more than 425 local government election websites in 33 states.</span></p> <p><a href="https://1.1.1.1/"><strong>1.1.1.1</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: We released</span><a href="https://1.1.1.1/"> <span style="font-weight: 400;">1.1.1.1</span></a><span style="font-weight: 400;"> to help fix the foundation of the Internet by building a faster, more secure and privacy-centric public DNS resolver. This is available publicly for everyone to use - it is the first consumer-focused service Cloudflare has ever released. Here’s the deal - we don’t store client IP addresses never, ever. We will continue to abide by our</span><a href="https://developers.cloudflare.com/1.1.1.1/privacy/public-dns-resolver"> privacy commitment</a><span style="font-weight: 400;"> and ensure that no user data is sold to advertisers or used to target consumers.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Sound like something you’d like to be a part of? We’d love to hear from you!</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Please note that applicants who progress to the offer stage of the interview process may be asked to attend an in-person interview within one of the Cloudflare Offices or Cloudflare Hubs.  More details about this will be available at that stage of the interview process.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">This position may require access to information protected under U.S. export control laws, including the U.S. Export Administration Regulations. Please note that any offer of employment may be conditioned on your authorization to receive software or technology controlled under these U.S. export laws without sponsorship for an export license.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Cloudflare is pro

title: Senior Backend Engineer, VGo Carrier Technology
description: <div class="content-intro"><h2><strong>Brief info about Vinted </strong></h2> <p data-renderer-start-pos="1"><span data-sheets-root="1">Our mission is to make second-hand the first choice, and we're looking for people who want to help us get there. Every day, we work together to help our members buy and sell pre-loved clothing and lifestyle items, giving each piece a second life – or even a third. <br>The Vinted Group is made up of three business units that support this mission:<br><br><strong><a href="https://careers.vinted.com/marketplace" target="_blank">Vinted Marketplace</a></strong> is Europe’s leading platform for second-hand fashion and a go-to destination for all kinds of pre-loved items, with a growing range of categories. Our platform connects millions of members across 20+ markets, helping great items find a new life.<br><br><a href="https://careers.vinted.com/vintedgo" target="_blank"><strong>Vinted Go</strong></a> enhances the shipping experience with a vast network of over 500,000 pick-up and drop-off points, partnering with more than 60 carriers across Europe, with added services like item verification for peace of mind on high-value pieces.<br><br><a href="https://careers.vinted.com/vintedpay" target="_blank"><strong>Vinted Pay</strong></a> is the newest part of the Vinted Group, dedicated to bringing secure, reliable payments to buyers and sellers across Europe. Seamlessly integrated into the Vinted app, it helps keep every transaction safe, efficient, and easy for our members.<br><br>Founded in 2008 in Lithuania, Vinted began as a way for friends to find new homes for clothes they no longer needed. In 2019, we became Lithuania's first unicorn! Today, our headquarters remain in Vilnius, and we've grown with offices across Europe, supported by a team of over 2,000 people. </span></p></div><h2><strong>Information about the position </strong></h2> <p>As Senior Backend Engineer in the Vinted Go Carrier domain, you will build backend systems that move parcels through Vinted Go's own logistics network, between hubs and through warehouses, quickly, reliably and at scale.</p> <p>You'll join Vinted Go, the logistics arm of Vinted, focused on making shipping more affordable, convenient, and reliable. Your team, <strong>Pacman</strong>, owns mid-mile logistics and warehouse operations automation: how parcels are routed and transported between hubs, and how they are received, labelled, and dispatched.</p> <p>We're looking for a strong engineer who also makes the engineers around them better: someone who leads the team's hardest technical problems and actively shares what they know, so the whole team grows with them.</p> <h2><strong>In this position, you’ll </strong></h2> <ul> <li>Design, build, and maintain scalable backend services and APIs that power mid-mile transport and warehouse operations.</li> <li>Own technical initiatives end to end, from problem framing and system design through delivery, monitoring, and iteration, and lead projects that span the team or the wider domain.</li> <li>Make architecture and trade-off decisions with a 6–12 month horizon, balancing scalability, reliability, maintainability, and tech debt.</li> <li>Help evolve our core service, a large Ruby on Rails modular monolith, towards clearer module boundaries and well-defined APIs.</li> <li>Collaborate with Product, Operations, Decision Science, and neighboring engineering teams to shape discovery, sequencing, and implementation, and align on contracts and dependencies through RFCs and technical discussions.</li> <li>Actively share knowledge: give thoughtful code reviews, pair on hard problems, walk the team through complex changes, and keep documentation useful.</li> <li>Help onboard new team members, mentor engineers informally, and trust others with meaningful work while supporting them to succeed.</li> <li>Work with a backend stack that includes Ruby, Vitess, Kafka, Jenkins, Elastic, and observability tools; you do not need to know all of it upfront.</li> <li>Take ownership of service reliability, alerts, metrics, SLOs, and incident follow-up, including participation in on-call rotations.</li> <li>Take part in hiring by interviewing candidates and helping raise the bar.</li> <li>Use AI tools thoughtfully to improve your development workflow and help the team move faster.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>About you </strong></h2> <ul> <li>5+ years of backend engineering experience, with a track record of building systems and owning work from design through production.</li> <li>Solid experience with Ruby, or the ability and motivation to learn Vinted's backend stack quickly.</li> <li>Good understanding of API design, database-backed systems, observability, and operating services in production.</li> <li>Works independently on problems of diverse scope, and is someone teammates turn to for advice on difficult technical matters.</li> <li>Pragmatic problem solver who balances delivery speed, reliability, and long-term maintainability.</li> <li>Comfortable working with ambiguity and breaking complex product or operational problems into clear technical steps.</li> <li>Genuinely enjoys sharing knowledge and mentoring others, and sees raising the team's engineering standards as part of the job.</li> <li>Gives direct, useful feedback, seeks it in return, and builds alignment across teams.</li> <li>Collaborative and clear communicator who works well with engineers, product managers, operations, and non-technical stakeholders.</li> <li>Excellent written and spoken English.</li> <li>Advantage: experience with logistics, warehouse management, fulfillment, or operational workflows; integrating software with physical devices; or modularizing a large monolith.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>Work perks  </strong></h2> <ul> <li data-stringify-indent="0" data-stringify-border="0">The opportunity to benefit from our share options programme</li> <li data-stringify-indent="0" data-stringify-border="0">25 working days of holiday</li> <li data-stringify-indent="0" data-stringify-border="0">Access to all the tools & tech needed for work</li> <li data-stringify-indent="0" data-stringify-border="0">Home office support: we provide IT workstation equipment and a personal budget of up to €540 for home workplace furniture</li> <li data-stringify-indent="0" data-stringify-border="0">Private health insurance</li> <li data-stringify-indent="0" data-stringify-border="0">Pension plan with flexible contribution options and a matching contribution from Vinted</li> <li data-stringify-indent="0" data-stringify-border="0">Confidential Employee Assistance Program (EAP) for you and your family</li> <li data-stringify-indent="0" data-stringify-border="0">Frequent team-building events</li> <li data-stringify-indent="0" data-stringify-border="0">A personal monthly budget for shopping on Vinted</li> <li data-stringify-indent="0" data-stringify-border="0">A dog-friendly office</li> <li data-stringify-indent="0" data-stringify-border="0">In Vilnius office: Gym & in-house meals at friendly prices</li> <li data-stringify-indent="0" data-stringify-border="0">In Kaunas office: a monthly lunch allowance, and a once-a-week provided in-house lunch and breakfast</li> </ul> <h2><strong>Working at Vinted </strong></h2> <p><strong>Workation policy</strong></p> <p>Better balance holidays with workdays by working remotely! Up to 90 days per year in the EU, of these, 21 days can be spent globally. For non-EU citizens, it's 21 days worldwide. This can be combined with time off for vacation or personal time.</p> <p><strong>Individual learning budget</strong></p> <p>Each year, you’ll be given a learning budget (starting at €3,000), and a total of up to 10 working days over a 2-year period to support your personal and professional development.</p> <p><strong>Hybrid work </strong></p> <p>Our hybrid model, with 2 recommended office days a week, gives you and your team the flexibility to decide if and when you want to work from home, and when to catch up in person.</p> <p><strong>Equal opportunity</strong></p> <p>We welcome applications from everybody, regardless of your background, identity, or life experiences. Job openings come with guides, not checklists. If you’re excited about a role, but don’t identify with every point in the ‘About you’ section, apply anyway – you might still be the perfect match!</p><div class="content-pay-transparency"><div class="pay-input"><div class="title">The annual gross salary range for this position excluding 8% holiday pay is:</div><div class="pay-range"><span>€76.800</span><span class="divider">—</span><span>€104.000 EUR</span></div></div></div> Find Jobs in Netherlands on Arbeitnow

In this role, your mission will be two-fold: </p> <ol> <li><strong>Pivot our frontend setup for bigger efficiency</strong>: we have been operating in mostly the same frontend setup for at least 6 years, and recognize that change is imminent.</li> <li><strong>Drive strategic engineering initiatives</strong>: architect and implement platform-specific changes that enhance modularity, autonomy, resilience, and performance across Android, iOS, and Web. </li> </ol> <p>You will have to balance and prioritize foundational capabilities - such as Design Systems, CI/CD, Modularization, App Releases, Performance, and Global UI quality - to optimize both frontend developer velocity and user satisfaction.</p> <p>You will lead 4 Engineering Managers and 3 Staff Engineers and set and implement the FE strategy, which will impact the roadmaps of 9 Product domains within the Marketplace.</p> <h2><strong>In this position, you will</strong></h2> <p><strong>Strategically:</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>Ensure the most effective frontend setup for the Marketplace.</strong> We have 40+ teams, each with 3 frontend engineers (iOS, Android, and Web) in the Marketplace unit. We know this will look different in two years. Deciding what different means, and getting 9 product domains to fund it, is the job</li> <li><strong>Drive Technology Strategy:</strong> Set and drive the future technology strategy for frontends, establishing a modular, scalable architecture that enables rapid development and strategic growth. Basically - raise the technological bar for all Marketplace unit. </li> <li><strong>Refine the domain's identity: </strong>Take sole ownership of shaping its future, successfully integrating Design Systems and engineering to treat our frontend platforms as a cohesive product.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Tactically</strong>: </p> <ul> <li><strong>Lead frontends:</strong> Lead a horizontal, platform-focused domain containing Android, iOS, Web, and Design System teams.</li> <li><strong>Lead Initiatives:</strong> Oversee Marketplace-wide technical tooling, core libraries, and frameworks. Lead strategic projects, i.e., frontend modularization and modernization (SwiftUI/Jetpack Compose), native automated testing.</li> <li><strong>Elevate global UI quality:</strong> Integrate design systems and accessibility into the frontend ecosystem to consolidate technical, visual and interaction quality standards. Support UI experimentation.</li> <li><strong>Ensure Resilience & Reliability:</strong> Maintain robust release processes, Marketplace frontend quality, and performance monitoring to reduce downtime and ensure a consistent member experience.</li> <li><strong>Innovate & Optimize:</strong> Drive AI-efficiency enablement in frontend development and explore cross-platform frontend development opportunities to increase engineering speed and productivity.</li> </ul> <p><strong>A lot of this work will be influencing without formal authority</strong>: Champion the frontend technical vision among your director peers, influencing the leaders of 9 Product domains to accommodate and prioritize platform-wide changes across 40+ teams.</p> <h2><strong>About you</strong></h2> <p><strong>How much of a technical acumen? </strong>Enough to have in depth conversations with our direct reports. You will have 4 strong technical EMs reporting to you, as well as 3 world-class staff engineers. We don’t think you need to match their technical competencies (that’s a stretch!), but you have to be able to speak their language, understand problems at their essence, and be able to consolidate and multiply their inputs, including being able to disagree objectively.</p> <p><strong>Leadership: </strong>you have a track record of making level change in the organizations that you lead (rather than 20% change). Consolidating your team views and making coherent strategy out of those views is step one. Step two is even more important: being able to implement these changes in your domain, and more so - across other domains in the marketplace - is a foundational ability you carry. In practice, that means you have at least 2 years of experience leading leaders and 5 years of experience influencing without authority. </p> <p><strong>Change horizon:</strong> You are comfortable holding two timeframes at once. We need someone who can say, "Here is what our frontend setup should look like in two years, and here is why" AND name the clear deliverable that has to ship in the first quarter to make that end state reachable. Leaders who only do the second are common. Leaders who only do the first are entertaining. We need both.</p> <p><strong>What this role is not:</strong> This is not a hands-on frontend or release-engineering role. You will not be tuning CI, owning the release train, or reviewing architecture decisions yourself — you’ll have 4 strong EMs and 3 Staff Engineers close to the details, and your job is to turn their technical judgment into direction, alignment, and organizational change. If your strongest work is deep in the mechanics, you'll be underused here. If your strongest work is changing how 40+ teams operate, you'll be busy.</p> <h2><strong>Work perks  </strong></h2> <ul> <li>The opportunity to benefit from our share options programme</li> <li>25 days of paid annual leave</li> <li>Newest MacBook models</li> <li>Digital mental and emotional health support and Employee Assistant Program (EAP)</li> <li>Frequent team-building events</li> <li>Home office support: we provide IT workstation equipment and a personal budget of up to €540 for home workplace furniture</li> <li>A daily lunch allowance</li> <li>ClassPass (Gym Membership subsidy)</li> <li>Pension plan with total contribution of 12%, 8% by the Company and 4% by employee</li> <li>A personal monthly budget for shopping on Vinted</li> <li>An NS mobility card</li> <li>The opportunity to spend up to 90 days per year - 21 of which can be spent working outside of the EU - on workation</li> <li>A dog-friendly office</li> </ul> <h2><strong>Working at Vinted </strong></h2> <p><strong>Individual Learning Budget</strong></p> <p>We invest in your professional growth! As part of our commitment to continuous learning, we offer an annual learning budget to support your personal and career development through courses, certifications, workshops and more.</p> <p><strong>Hybrid Work</strong> </p> <p>We’ve adopted a hybrid workplace model where 2 days in the office are recommended but not enforced. It’s up to you and your team to decide on the exact days you’ll spend working together in person.</p> <p><strong>Equal Opportunity</strong></p> <p>The Vinted Group is committed to building an inclusive workplace where people from all walks of life feel a sense of belonging. We welcome applications from people of all backgrounds, identities and life experiences. At Vinted, all applicants are treated fairly without regard to their race, age, religion or belief, sex, national origin, citizenship, gender identity, sexual orientation, disability, or any other protected characteristic.</p> <p> </p><div class="content-pay-transparency"><div class="pay-input"><div class="title">The annual gross salary range for this position is:</div><div class="pay-range"><span>€108.600</span><span class="divider">—</span><span>€147.000 EUR</span></div></div></div> Find Jobs in Netherlands on Arbeitnow

title: Director of Engineering, Frontend technologies, Marketplace Technologies
description: <div class="content-intro"><h2><strong>Brief info about Vinted </strong></h2> <p data-renderer-start-pos="1"><span data-sheets-root="1">Our mission is to make second-hand the first choice, and we're looking for people who want to help us get there. Every day, we work together to help our members buy and sell pre-loved clothing and lifestyle items, giving each piece a second life – or even a third. <br>The Vinted Group is made up of three business units that support this mission:<br><br><strong><a href="https://careers.vinted.com/marketplace" target="_blank">Vinted Marketplace</a></strong> is Europe’s leading platform for second-hand fashion and a go-to destination for all kinds of pre-loved items, with a growing range of categories. Our platform connects millions of members across 20+ markets, helping great items find a new life.<br><br><a href="https://careers.vinted.com/vintedgo" target="_blank"><strong>Vinted Go</strong></a> enhances the shipping experience with a vast network of over 500,000 pick-up and drop-off points, partnering with more than 60 carriers across Europe, with added services like item verification for peace of mind on high-value pieces.<br><br><a href="https://careers.vinted.com/vintedpay" target="_blank"><strong>Vinted Pay</strong></a> is the newest part of the Vinted Group, dedicated to bringing secure, reliable payments to buyers and sellers across Europe. Seamlessly integrated into the Vinted app, it helps keep every transaction safe, efficient, and easy for our members.<br><br>Founded in 2008 in Lithuania, Vinted began as a way for friends to find new homes for clothes they no longer needed. In 2019, we became Lithuania's first unicorn! Today, our headquarters remain in Vilnius, and we've grown with offices across Europe, supported by a team of over 2,000 people. </span></p></div><h2><strong>About the Role</strong></h2> <p>We are looking for a Director of Engineering to lead the Frontend Technologies domain within Marketplace. In this role, your mission will be two-fold: </p> <ol> <li><strong>Pivot our frontend setup for bigger efficiency</strong>: we have been operating in mostly the same frontend setup for at least 6 years, and recognize that change is imminent.</li> <li><strong>Drive strategic engineering initiatives</strong>: architect and implement platform-specific changes that enhance modularity, autonomy, resilience, and performance across Android, iOS, and Web. </li> </ol> <p>You will have to balance and prioritize foundational capabilities - such as Design Systems, CI/CD, Modularization, App Releases, Performance, and Global UI quality - to optimize both frontend developer velocity and user satisfaction.</p> <p>You will lead 4 Engineering Managers and 3 Staff Engineers and set and implement the FE strategy, which will impact the roadmaps of 9 Product domains within the Marketplace.</p> <h2><strong>In this position, you will</strong></h2> <p><strong>Strategically:</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>Ensure the most effective frontend setup for the Marketplace.</strong> We have 40+ teams, each with 3 frontend engineers (iOS, Android, and Web) in the Marketplace unit. We know this will look different in two years. Deciding what different means, and getting 9 product domains to fund it, is the job</li> <li><strong>Drive Technology Strategy:</strong> Set and drive the future technology strategy for frontends, establishing a modular, scalable architecture that enables rapid development and strategic growth. Basically - raise the technological bar for all Marketplace unit. </li> <li><strong>Refine the domain's identity: </strong>Take sole ownership of shaping its future, successfully integrating Design Systems and engineering to treat our frontend platforms as a cohesive product.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Tactically</strong>: </p> <ul> <li><strong>Lead frontends:</strong> Lead a horizontal, platform-focused domain containing Android, iOS, Web, and Design System teams.</li> <li><strong>Lead Initiatives:</strong> Oversee Marketplace-wide technical tooling, core libraries, and frameworks. Lead strategic projects, i.e., frontend modularization and modernization (SwiftUI/Jetpack Compose), native automated testing.</li> <li><strong>Elevate global UI quality:</strong> Integrate design systems and accessibility into the frontend ecosystem to consolidate technical, visual and interaction quality standards. Support UI experimentation.</li> <li><strong>Ensure Resilience & Reliability:</strong> Maintain robust release processes, Marketplace frontend quality, and performance monitoring to reduce downtime and ensure a consistent member experience.</li> <li><strong>Innovate & Optimize:</strong> Drive AI-efficiency enablement in frontend development and explore cross-platform frontend development opportunities to increase engineering speed and productivity.</li> </ul> <p><strong>A lot of this work will be influencing without formal authority</strong>: Champion the frontend technical vision among your director peers, influencing the leaders of 9 Product domains to accommodate and prioritize platform-wide changes across 40+ teams.</p> <h2><strong>About you</strong></h2> <p><strong>How much of a technical acumen? </strong>Enough to have in depth conversations with our direct reports. You will have 4 strong technical EMs reporting to you, as well as 3 world-class staff engineers. We don’t think you need to match their technical competencies (that’s a stretch!), but you have to be able to speak their language, understand problems at their essence, and be able to consolidate and multiply their inputs, including being able to disagree objectively.</p> <p><strong>Leadership: </strong>you have a track record of making level change in the organizations that you lead (rather than 20% change). Consolidating your team views and making coherent strategy out of those views is step one. Step two is even more important: being able to implement these changes in your domain, and more so - across other domains in the marketplace - is a foundational ability you carry. In practice, that means you have at least 2 years of experience leading leaders and 5 years of experience influencing without authority. </p> <p><strong>Change horizon:</strong> You are comfortable holding two timeframes at once. We need someone who can say, "Here is what our frontend setup should look like in two years, and here is why" AND name the clear deliverable that has to ship in the first quarter to make that end state reachable. Leaders who only do the second are common. Leaders who only do the first are entertaining. We need both.</p> <p><strong>What this role is not:</strong> This is not a hands-on frontend or release-engineering role. You will not be tuning CI, owning the release train, or reviewing architecture decisions yourself — you’ll have 4 strong EMs and 3 Staff Engineers close to the details, and your job is to turn their technical judgment into direction, alignment, and organizational change. If your strongest work is deep in the mechanics, you'll be underused here. If your strongest work is changing how 40+ teams operate, you'll be busy.</p> <h2><strong>Work perks  </strong></h2> <ul> <li>The opportunity to benefit from our share options programme</li> <li>30 days of paid annual leave</li> <li>Newest MacBook models</li> <li>Digital mental and emotional health support and Employee Assistant Program (EAP)</li> <li>Home office support: we provide IT workstation equipment and a personal budget of up to €540 for home workplace furniture</li> <li>A daily lunch allowance</li> <li>Frequent team-building events</li> <li>A personal monthly budget for shopping on Vinted</li> <li>A subsidised gym membership with ClassPass or Urban Sports Club</li> <li>A subsidised pension plan provided by Vinted</li> <li>Hallesche Supplemental health insurance</li> <li>Life and disability insurance provided</li> <li>A subsidised Deutschlandticket</li> <li>The opportunity to spend up to 90 days per year - 21 of which can be spent working outside of the EU - on workation</li> <li>A dog-friendly office</li> </ul> <h2><strong>Working at Vinted </strong></h2> <p><strong>Individual Learning Budget</strong></p> <p>We invest in your professional growth! As part of our commitment to continuous learning, we offer an annual learning budget to support your personal and career development through courses, certifications, workshops and more.</p> <p><strong>Hybrid Work</strong> </p> <p>We’ve adopted a hybrid workplace model where 2 days in the office are recommended but not enforced. It’s up to you and your team to decide on the exact days you’ll spend working together in person.</p> <p><strong>Equal Opportunity</strong></p> <p>The Vinted Group is committed to building an inclusive workplace where people from all walks of life feel a sense of belonging. We welcome applications from people of all backgrounds, identities and life experiences. At Vinted, all applicants are treated fairly without regard to their race, age, religion or belief, sex, national origin, citizenship, gender identity, sexual orientation, disability, or any other protected characteristic.</p><div class="content-pay-transparency"><div class="pay-input"><div class="title">The annual gross salary range for this position is:</div><div class="pay-range"><span>€124.300</span><span class="divider">—</span><span>€168.100 EUR</span></div></div></div> Find more English Speaking Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

You’ll have the ability to run the day-to-day PR activity in already established markets whilst also planning and executing PR launches in brand new markets and supporting in-market leadership profiling. </p> <p>In this role, you will work closely with multiple teams including marketing, social, influencer, product and Monzo’s leadership team. You’ll devise and execute PR strategies that support business goals and showcase the best of Monzo in other markets. You'll need the ability to multitask managing multiple campaigns and market launches at the same time as well as having exceptional stakeholder management and collaboration skills.</p> <p>This role is for a strategic planner and doer, you can see the big picture but are not afraid to get your hands dirty and approach projects in a collaborative manner. </p> <p>You'll report to the Director of Corporate Communications and will manage an EU PR Manager based in Spain.</p> <p><strong>🔑You’ll play a key role by…</strong></p> <ul> <li>Planning and executing all PR activity in already established European markets, Ireland and Spain.</li> <li>Leading and implementing our go-to-market PR strategy for Monzo in all new markets across EU. This includes establishing resources, building a launch plan and running the day-to-day. </li> <li>Finding creative ways to get Monzo regularly into consumer press through big campaigns and smaller reactive, locally relevant news jumps. </li> <li>Balance global campaigns with localised stories to ensure consistency and locally relevant content.</li> <li>Managing spokespeople and acting as a strategic advisor to senior leaders on external communications, media training, engagement, and storytelling.</li> <li>Collaborating cross-functionally with product, commercial, and operations teams to uncover and amplify compelling PR opportunities.</li> <li>Managing current international agencies and team members whilst also resourcing and setting us up for success in new EU markets. </li> <li>Building strong relationships with key media and journalists, while managing incoming press enquiries.</li> <li>Using data and insights to inform and adapt strategy for our international expansion efforts.</li> <li>Establishing new processes and ways of working in new markets. </li> <li>Staying ahead of industry and relevant policy trends and developments to inform strategy and maintain thought leadership.</li> </ul> <p><strong>🤩 We’d love to hear from you if you have…</strong></p> <ul> <li>Proven experience leading both tailored and scalable PR strategies for multiple international title: B2B Sponsorship & Partnerships Executive
description: The Company When it comes to digital communities, The Alliance is leading the way. We connect industry leaders and innovators through unparalleled networking opportunities and renowned brand experiences, including VIP dinners, exclusive breakfasts, and bespoke 1 to 1 meeting packages. Join our dynamic team to drive complex commercial partnerships and fuel our next phase of growth. The Role As a Senior Sponsorship and Partnerships Executive , you will play a pivotal role in securing and scaling high-value commercial partnerships with leading B2B brands. This role centers heavily on managing, nurturing, and strategically extracting deep value from a focused portfolio of major accounts , alongside acquiring new strategic logos. Rather than chasing transactional ad sales, you will own a core account portfolio, acting as a trusted advisor to unlock six-figure potential through consultative, content led sponsorship packages such as custom research reports, multi-channel webinars, and strategic content syndication tailored to our professional leadership ecosystems. You will work closely with cross-functional product, content, and event teams to ensure seamless delivery and execution of every campaign. Key Responsibilities Portfolio Stewardship and Value Extraction: Own and strategically manage an established, high-value account portfolio . Deepen relationships to maximize account lifetime value , retention, and multi-product expansion. Strategic Growth and Acquisition: Balance portfolio farming with targeted hunting , bringing net-new enterprise logos into our community ecosystems. Consultative Sponsorship Sales: Move beyond rate cards and simple media buys. Design bespoke, content led sponsorship solutions that align directly with a partner go-to-market and demand generation goals. Portfolio Upselling: Confidently navigate large accounts with complex deal structures , spotting cross-sell and upsell opportunities across our diverse media, event, and community portfolio. Peer-to-Peer Executive Engagement: Speak credibly and strategically with senior marketing, product, and leadership professionals within SaaS, MarTech, and digital ecosystems. Comfortable owning and growing large accounts with six-figure deal sizes , with the commercial instinct to spot upsell and cross-sell opportunities across a portfolio of products. Equally strong at hunting new business as they are at deepening existing relationships , this role needs someone who can do both, not just one or the other. Able to sell consultative, content led sponsorship packages including webinars, research reports, and content syndication rather than relying on rate cards or simple media buys. Adaptable and commercially curious , someone who keeps pace with shifting market conditions, learns new verticals quickly, and can speak credibly to senior marketing and product leaders . Flexible working hours: our core hours are 10am–4:30pm, with the flexibility to structure your working day between 8am and 8pm around when you work best. Unlimited access to our internal Academy: including courses, learning resources and professional certifications. Community and Inclusion We are committed to creating a workplace that is free from discrimination and bias, and where everyone has equal opportunities to succeed and contribute. title: Engineering Manager, Data Center Operations
description: <div class="content-intro"><h3>About Us</h3> <p>At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.</p> <p>At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.</p></div><h3>About the Department</h3><p>Infrastructure Operations builds and manages the data center infrastructure behind Cloudflare's global network. The organization brings together engineering, operations, hardware and logistics teams that plan, deploy, operate and maintain our footprint in hundreds of cities worldwide. In this role, you'll help extend that footprint with a new generation of data center sites across the United States.</p><h3>About the Role</h3><p>We're looking for an experienced Data Center Operations manager to build and run the team that brings these new sites online and keeps them running around the clock.</p><p>You will build a distributed team of Data Center Engineers from the ground up. You'll own sites across their full lifecycle: delivering greenfield builds through third-party vendors and colocation partners, running them in production, and retiring hardware securely at end of life. You'll be accountable for production hardware availability, 24x7 on-site response, and the operating model that lets this footprint scale.</p><p>The role means balancing competing demands every day: build deadlines against build quality, dependence on partners against high standards, and fast incident response against careful compliance. You need to keep both sides of each in view.</p><p>This role covers the physical layer: hardware, cabling, and Layer 1/Layer 2 connectivity. It works closely with network engineering and server provisioning teams but does not own them.</p><h3>What You'll Do</h3><p>Team Leadership</p><ul><li><p>Hire, develop and manage Data Center Engineers based on-site at data centers across the US. Set clear expectations, career paths and a culture of ownership across a team spread over many sites.</p></li><li><p>Build and take part in a 24x7 on-call rotation with your team. Define coverage models, handover protocols and incident SLAs that hold up as the footprint grows.</p></li><li><p>Serve as the escalation point for on-site incidents. Coordinate engineers, colocation providers and vendors to restore service quickly, and lead root-cause analysis after major incidents so the same problem doesn't happen again.</p></li></ul><p>Site Delivery</p><ul><li><p>Own build timelines from site readiness through hardware delivery, rack-and-stack, cabling, validation and handoff to production.</p></li><li><p>Run greenfield builds as multi-workstream programs. Coordinate third-party integrators, contractors and colocation providers to hit dates without cutting corners.</p></li><li><p>Be on-site during key build phases to oversee vendor work, verify quality and make sure sites are production-ready.</p></li></ul><p>Production Operations</p><ul><li><p>Be accountable for availability targets for production hardware at your sites. Run break/fix, repairs, RMAs and spares strategy so that availability is measured, reported and improving.</p></li><li><p>Manage colocation providers and vendors day to day: escalations, remote-hands quality, power and cooling issues, and performance against contractual commitments.</p></li></ul><p>Documentation and DCIM</p><ul><li><p>Make sure every site is fully documented in DCIM from day one. That covers rack elevations, power and cabling, asset location, and lifecycle status, all recorded as hardware arrives rather than filled in later.</p></li><li><p>Treat infrastructure records as a source of truth that both operations and dependent teams rely on, giving them accurate, current visibility into where hardware is and what state it's in.</p></li><li><p>Partner with tooling teams to bring DCIM online at new sites, and define documentation standards that hold up as the footprint grows.</p></li></ul><p>Decommissioning and Hardware Lifecycle</p><ul><li><p>Own on-site decommissioning end to end: unracking, physical collections, serial number verification, chain of custody, and handoff for secure destruction.</p></li><li><p>Partner with vendor management on IT asset disposition (ITAD) vendors. Make sure destruction certificates and compliance evidence are filed and audit-ready.</p></li></ul><p>Security and Compliance</p><ul><li><p>Make sure your sites and team meet Cloudflare's physical security, access control, chain-of-custody and compliance obligations.</p></li><li><p>Follow established physical access procedures, and work with security and compliance teams to develop new ones where these sites need them.</p></li><li><p>Support audits with accurate, timely evidence. Treat audit readiness as a continuous standard, not something you prepare for once per audit cycle.</p></li></ul><p>Automation and Operational Efficiency</p><ul><li><p>Find manual, repetitive work in build, break/fix, decommissioning and evidence collection. Influence tooling and automation teams to remove it.</p></li><li><p>Evaluate and adopt AI-assisted workflows for incident triage, root-cause analysis, documentation and compliance evidence generation.</p></li><li><p>Scale the operation through tooling, not just headcount.</p></li></ul><p>Business Reporting</p><ul><li><p>Own weekly business reviews and monthly and quarterly reporting on availability, build progress, incidents and operational health to the Director and peer leaders.</p></li><li><p>Partner with network, systems, hardware, supply chain and infrastructure engineering teams to make sure physical operations support what runs on top of them.</p></li></ul><h3>Who You Are</h3><p><strong>A builder who stays to operate.</strong> You've stood up sites and teams, and you take ownership of what happens after go-live. Delivering a build is where your job starts. If it isn't documented, it isn't done.</p><p><strong>A leader of distributed teams.</strong> You've hired and built trust with on-site engineers spread across many locations, most of whom you won't see day to day. You know how to create accountability, consistent standards and a shared culture across sites, both remotely and in person.</p><p><strong>Firm with partners.</strong> You hold colocation providers and vendors to high standards without becoming adversarial. You know the contract, you track performance, and you escalate when it's warranted.</p><p><strong>Compliance-minded without being a compliance specialist.</strong> You understand why access controls and decommissioning chain of custody are audit controls. You treat compliance as part of doing the work well, not as overhead.</p><p><strong>Automation-first.</strong> When something hurts, your first instinct is to fix the process or the tooling, not add people. You can turn an operational pain point into requirements engineering teams can act on.</p><h3>Required Experience</h3><ul><li><p>6+ years in data center operations, including 3+ years directly managing on-site technical teams. At least part of that time should be leading geographically distributed teams.</p></li><li><p>A track record of operating multi-site data center fleets at hyperscale or large-cloud scale.</p></li><li><p>Hands-on experience with IT hardware, including servers, network devices, optics and cabling, not only facilities infrastructure.</p></li><li><p>Enough hands-on depth to coach engineers on technical work and to judge the quality of vendor and contractor work.</p></li><li><p>Experience owning sites across the full lifecycle: delivering greenfield data center or cage builds through third-party vendors, running them in steady state, and decommissioning hardware.</p></li><li><p>Experience managing providers in Tier III+ colocation facilities and holding them accountable to commitments.</p></li><li><p>Experience managing 24x7 on-call operations and incident escalation.</p></li><li><p>Strong Layer 1 and Layer 2 fundamentals: structured cabling, fiber and optics, patching standards, switching basics, and troubleshooting physical connectivity for network and server hardware.</p></li><li><p>Solid knowledge of data center power and cooling, rack design, high-density deployments and hardware lifecycle management.</p></li><li><p>Strong understanding of DCIM and asset management systems. You should have a track record of keeping documentation accurate from day one, including rack, power, cabling and asset records maintained from hardware arrival through decommissioning.</p></li><li><p>Working knowledge of the security and compliance frameworks common in enterprise-grade data centers. You should understand them well enough to run operations under them; auditor-level expertise isn't required.</p></li><li><p>Strong program management skills across multiple vendors, sites and time-bound workstreams.</p></li><li><p>A track record of reducing toil through tooling or process redesign.</p></li><li><p>Excellent written and verbal communication, including regular business reviews and status, risk and availability reporting to leadership.</p></li><li><p>Ability to travel regularly to data center sites. Expect more frequent travel during site builds, shifting to periodic visits as sites reach steady state.</p></li></ul><h3>Preferred Qualifications</h3

title: Gestionnaire Ressources Humaines - 60%
description: À propos de FPP Industries FPP Industries poursuit son développement et souhaite aujourd’hui structurer davantage sa fonction Ressources Humaines. L’enjeu : construire une gestion RH à la fois fiable, structurée et humaine, capable d’accompagner durablement le développement de l’entreprise. Avec le développement de l’entreprise, nous souhaitons désormais franchir une nouvelle étape : fiabiliser l’administration du personnel, structurer nos pratiques RH et offrir aux collaborateurs comme aux managers un interlocuteur clairement identifié. Il s’agit donc d’une création de poste . Vous rejoindrez une fonction qui a déjà un cadre et des responsabilités définis, mais dans laquelle de nombreux processus restent à structurer et à faire évoluer. Votre mission Votre mission sera de structurer, administrer et faire vivre les Ressources Humaines de FPP Industries , en garantissant une gestion fiable du quotidien tout en construisant progressivement les pratiques RH dont l’entreprise aura besoin pour poursuivre son développement. Vous serez le référent RH opérationnel de l’entreprise et travaillerez en lien direct avec la Direction, les managers, les collaborateurs ainsi que les partenaires externes. Vous collectez et contrôlez les variables de paie, établissez les bulletins de salaire et sécurisez leur remise dans les délais. Piloter les recrutements et les intégrations. title: Inbound Sales 🇫🇷
description: Health can’t wait . Not for symptoms to get worse. Not for a six‑month appointment. Not for a system to catch up. But that’s exactly how healthcare works today. You wait, until you can’t. Alan exists to end the wait. Health is a universal right, and we believe this right can only become real when it’s coupled with prevention. We need to stop treating health as something we repair and start treating it as something we build, every day. It’s not solely a question of willpower. It’s the healthcare system itself that needs to work for everyone, in a sustainable way. So we are building the new standard in prevention insurance. Alan is the first company that integrates insurance, prevention, and care into a single, acclaimed user experience. We are on an incredible journey to build a global leading company, with a unique culture . We already partner with 40K+ companies of all sizes, serving more than 1M+ members, and have reached €800M+ in ARR. Prevention as the new norm. That's what we're building with our team of 1000+ people. If it speaks to you: we're hiring across France, Spain, Belgium, and Canada. And beyond. ⚡ The Inbound Sales 🇫🇷 role We're growing our Inbound Sales team in France. Our Inbound Sales team is in charge of closing inbound requests from leads with 1 to 5 employees (Independent workers, very small companies, individuals). You’ll be in charge of the whole sales cycle from qualification to closing by educating prospects and providing inspiring arguments to transform them into convinced customers. At the same time, we expect you to understand, embrace and apply the Alan Smart & Soft selling method . This method stems from the concept that the prospect experience is an inseparable piece of the overall Alan customer experience. You are expected to make this experience pleasant, instructive and delightful by leveraging the most relevant messaging and materials (Smart) and by defining the high-touch strategy that suits best each prospect (Soft). We also expect you to look at the big picture and help us grow and improve as a company. For that, you’ll have to be real team players even beyond your role. You’ll be expected to challenge us to improve our product(s), our methods, and our strategy, and get involved in other projects and initiatives relevant to growing our customer base. What does make this role exciting : You will close deals every single day of the year, which is very stimulating! The Inbound Sales team is quite recent: You will contribute to building a new practice within the Sales Community, getting involved in tooling and process improvements You will help building the playbook of best practices to close deals in one shot You will contribute to making our products even better by sharing feedback and improving the self-serve experience for our members You will become an insurance expert and learn to master our products in order to confidently answer questions & objections from prospects We invest heavily in AI to transform the Sales practice. You'll have the opportunity to become one of the most modern Sales professionals in the market! ⭐ You will be a great fit for this role if you: Have 1-2 years of experience in a Sales role including closing experience Have full working proficiency in French (C2 and above), and advanced level in English Are highly organized with exceptional follow-up skills Show a great balance between Active Listening and Assertiveness when interacting with your prospects Have natural empathy and are passionate about understanding and solving prospects' problems Have a positive attitude and ability to collaborate in a small team Have a desire to learn fast and make an impact from day 1 Are based in (or willing to relocate to) Paris, Bordeaux, Marseille, Lyon, Annecy, Nantes or Biarritz. For this opportunity, we are aiming to hire within the A2-B1 level range . Everything else is a plus. We care about having a diversity of experiences, profiles and backgrounds in our team. 🙌 Perks & Benefits At Alan, we believe that being in good health is a basic need, and it starts with our employees. This is why Alaners are provided with a stimulating environment and perks ensuring they are happy, efficient and spend only high-quality time with co-workers. Therefore, we offer: Fair rewards . Generous equity packages complement your base salary, for permanent contracts only. Flexible office with hybrid setup . Amazing office space at our Paris HQ or sponsored co-working hubs in Bordeaux, Marseille, Lyon, Annecy, Nantes or Biarritz. All the tools you need . Top of the range equipment: Macbook Air, keyboard, laptop stand, monitor, and Bose noise-canceling headphones. Flexible vacation policy and flexible working hours . Organize your time as you wish. Delightful healthcare insurance: Extremely comprehensive health insurance - 100% for you and your children, 90-100% for partners depending on your country (permanent contracts only). Transport . Generous transit benefit Learning & Training opportunities . A highly flexible training policy free books and budget to attend and speak at conferences if the opportunity arises. Personal growth through coaching : At Alan, coaching isn't just a perk - it's core to who we are. Every Alaner is paired with a dedicated coach from day one, who helps maximize their impact, nurture engagement, and navigate Alan's values to develop their full potential. Learn more about our coaching culture . Parental leave . Extended parental leave for all new parents, for permanent contracts only. Important note: we hire people not roles. After reading this job description, if you feel like you don’t have all the necessary prerequisites but that it matches where you are now or what you'd like to grow into in your next position, we encourage you to apply ! Not everybody will enter our recruitment process, but all, no matter how underrepresented, should feel free to apply as it can only bring learnings or success. 🔖 Check out our About Alan and Career pages, as well as our Medium , blog and Glassdoor page for more info. title: Principal Customer Engineer, Start Up AI
description: <div class="content-intro"><h3>About Us</h3> <p>At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.</p> <p>At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.</p></div><h3>Available Locations</h3> <hr> <p>Germany</p> <h3>Responsibilities</h3> <hr> <p>The Customer Engineer (CE) is the core driver of our technical go-to-market strategy: a trusted technical advisor and primary architect of the customer journey. You will bridge the gap between technical strategy and business value. You'll guide startup and AI customers from the first conversation about their AI ambitions through technical validation, production deployment, and long-term adoption and expansion. Sitting within the GTM organization and reporting to a Customer Engineering Leader, you will not hand off your customers once an initial agreement is reached. Instead, you will operate as a quota-carrying technologist, leveraging AI-augmented workflows to eliminate administrative toil so you can focus on high-value architectural design and driving measurable business outcomes across the Startup AI segment.</p> <p><strong>Technical Discovery & Validation:</strong> Partner closely with Account Executives to lead technical deep-dive discovery and uncover what kind of AI problem a customer actually has. It might be building AI products and agents, governing how their people and agents use AI, or protecting internet-facing applications from AI-driven threats and traffic. Turn that into a sequenced plan rather than a feature tour. Capture business requirements and map startup and AI customer infrastructure (DNS, CDN, Zero Trust, Network Security, serverless and edge compute) to fit-for-purpose Cloudflare architectures and bespoke solutions. Define scope, success criteria, and technical evaluation plans for Proofs of Concept (PoCs) and Technical Validations, anchored in measurable quality, latency, and cost targets rather than subjective impressions. Rapidly build working, customer-specific prototypes. Deliver tailored technical presentations, architectural diagrams, and demonstrations that show how Cloudflare solves specific performance, security, reliability, and scale challenges. title: Werkstudent Kundenservice / Kundenbetreuung (m/w/d)
description: Du hast Lust, neben deinem Studium mehr zu bewegen? Wir bei easierLife möchten, dass ältere Menschen so lange wie möglich selbstbestimmt und sicher in ihrem eigenen Zuhause leben können. Deine Aufgaben Du betreust unsere Kundinnen und Kunden telefonisch und schriftlich – freundlich, geduldig und lösungsorientiert. Du unterstützt bei Fragen rund um unsere Notrufsysteme und hilfst bei deren Einrichtung und Nutzung. Du bearbeitest Kundenanliegen eigenständig, findest passende Lösungen und dokumentierst diese in unseren digitalen Systemen. Du bringst deine Erfahrungen, Ideen und Verbesserungsvorschläge ein und gestaltest so unseren Kundenservice aktiv mit. Das bringst du mit Du bist aktuell an einer Hochschule oder Universität eingeschrieben – dein Studiengang ist für uns weniger entscheidend als deine Motivation. Du hast Freude an der Kommunikation mit Menschen und ein gutes Gespür für ihre Anliegen. Du bist sicher im Umgang mit Computern und digitalen Anwendungen und arbeitest dich gerne in neue Programme ein. Du arbeitest strukturiert, eigenverantwortlich und behältst auch bei unterschiedlichen Aufgaben den Überblick. Du bist ein Teamplayer, denkst mit und hast Freude daran, gemeinsam Lösungen zu finden. Du verfügst über sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift, da unsere Kundenkommunikation ausschließlich auf Deutsch stattfindet. Erste Erfahrungen im Kundenservice sind von Vorteil, aber keine Voraussetzung. Auch Quereinsteiger sind bei uns herzlich willkommen! Das bieten wir dir Flexible Arbeitszeiten: Eine Werkstudententätigkeit mit Arbeitszeiten, die sich gut mit deinem Studium vereinbaren lassen. Mit Möglichkeit für ein Hybrid-Modell mit einer Kombination aus Büro und Homeoffice (remote). Die Einsatzzeiten stimmen wir gemeinsam innerhalb unserer Kundenservicezeiten von Montag bis Freitag ab. Ein Team, in dem das Miteinander zählt: Ein kollegiales, hilfsbereites und humorvolles Team, in dem wir uns auf Augenhöhe begegnen – vom Werkstudenten bis zur Geschäftsführung. Fitness und Gesundheit: Wir übernehmen dein Fitnessstudio-Abo direkt über unserem Büro und unterstützen anteilig deinen Zugang zum EGYM Wellpass. Mobilität: JobRad-Leasingangebote sowie die Möglichkeit, das Deutschlandticket oder andere Fahrkarten über die Entgeltumwandlung steuerlich begünstigt zu beziehen, sofern die jeweiligen Voraussetzungen erfüllt sind. Attraktive Mitarbeitervorteile: Vergünstigungen bei zahlreichen Anbietern, z. B. Zalando, Jochen Schweizer und Eventim. Kleine Extras für den Arbeitsalltag: Kostenlose Getränke, frisches Obst im Büro sowie regelmäßige Firmenevents und Teamaktivitäten. Eine Tätigkeit mit Sinn: Mit deiner Arbeit trägst du dazu bei, älteren Menschen mehr Sicherheit und Selbstständigkeit im Alltag zu ermöglichen. Bereit, neben deinem Studium etwas zu bewegen? Dann freuen wir uns darauf, dich kennenzulernen! Egal, ob du bereits erste Erfahrungen im Kundenservice gesammelt hast oder ganz neu in diesen Bereich einsteigen möchtest – bei uns zählen vor allem deine Motivation, deine Persönlichkeit und deine Freude am Umgang mit Menschen. title: Stage - Data Engineer - ML (H/F)
description: Chez Withings, nous développons des appareils de santé connectée : nos balances connectées, montres hybrides, tensiomètres, moniteurs de sommeil et tous les dispositifs de notre gamme sont aujourd'hui utilisés par des millions d'utilisateurs. Notre objectif est de permettre la prévention, le dépistage et l'accompagnement d'un certain nombre de maladies chroniques via des produits et des services innovants afin de révolutionner la manière dont on prend soin de sa santé. Au sein de l'équipe Machine Learning, nous développons des algorithmes pour extraire des informations physiologiques et médicales pour nos utilisateurs tels que le SPO2, la fréquence cardiaque, la présence de diverses pathologies comme la fibrillation atriale, l'apnée du sommeil… Nous recherchons un ou une stagiaire motivé.e par des sujets de santé avec des compétences en traitement du signal, en machine learning et en deep learning pour nous aider à concevoir les algorithmes de demain. Votre mission L'objectif de ce stage est de concevoir, développer et valider des algorithmes capables d'extraire des informations physiologiques et médicales fiables à partir des signaux physiques collectés par nos dispositifs. Pour mener à bien cette mission passionnante, la/le stagiaire aura l'opportunité de : Explorer et analyser des ensembles de données physiologiques réelles issues de nos utilisateurs, à la recherche de marqueurs pertinents. Concevoir et développer des algorithmes combinant des techniques de traitement du signal innovantes, des heuristiques informatiques fines, des approches Machine Learning et Deep Learning (supervisé ou non). Travailler sur l'optimisation algorithmique en vue d'une implémentation embarquée, potentiellement en langage C, sur des systèmes aux ressources contraintes. Participer à la définition des critères de succès et des métriques pour le mesurer, et évaluer la performance des algorithmes sur des jeux de données variés. Ce stage offre une immersion complète dans le développement d'un produit de santé connecté de pointe, avec une application concrète et un impact direct sur la vie des utilisateurs. Vous rejoindrez une équipe multidisciplinaire et dynamique, où votre contribution sera essentielle pour transformer un prototype algorithmique en une fonctionnalité embarquée de nos dispositifs, conforme aux exigences de fiabilité et de performance de l'industrie médicale. Le sujet précis sera discuté avec le stagiaire au plus tard quelques semaines avant le stage. title: (Senior) Programmatic Sales GSA
description: YOUR FUTURE, ON DEMAND The ideal blend of stability and flexibility. A genuinely human employer that cares for people and the planet. This makes you the primary point of contact for agency trading desks in the GSA region regarding preferred deals and PMP strategies. You’ll also help with SSP and header bidding integrations and act as the link between Sales, Tech and AdOps. THE ADS TEAM The Ads Team is a small but highly efficient team that combines technology and marketing to win customers over in the long term. With a presence in two countries (based in Berlin, Hamburg and Zurich) and operations in six countries, the Ads Team is a key driver of growth within Zattoo and has established itself as the market leader in CTV in Switzerland within a year. WHAT YOU’LL DO Acquisition of new customers, advice, support and guide media agencies, trading desks and direct clients through our programmatic possibilities in a way they can understand. Drawing up and negotiating bespoke programme packages, private deals or preferred deals. Maximise inventory revenue, skilfully manage floor prices (minimum prices) and analyse delivery rates and CPMs. Partner with regional sales teams in GSA to consult clients and pitch programmatic solutions. Identify technical errors during delivery, analyse tracking issues and check campaign set-ups: troubleshoot deal delivery, floor pricing, and DSP configuration issues (e.g., SSAI, VAST responses, pod management, DSP/SSP bid stream mismatches). Explain complex technical matters in simple terms to non-technical customers or internal departments. description: <div class="content-intro"><h3>About Us</h3> <p>At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.</p> <p>At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.</p></div><h2>Available Locations</h2> <ul> <li>Washington DC, US</li> </ul> <h2>About the Role</h2> <p>Account Executives, Channel Account Managers, Business Development Representatives, Solution Engineers, Customer Success, and Sales Operations - all working together help our customers adopt Cloudflare and create great Internet-enabled experiences. The sales team at Cloudflare helps customers solve real, technical problems while creating the revenue streams that help the company provide free service to millions in our community.</p> <h2>Responsibilities</h2> <ul> <li>We are looking for a seasoned sales professional to help cover the Federal market for US. The ideal candidate will possess both a sales and technical background that enables them to drive engagement at all levels with technical and non-technical buyers.</li> <li>As an Account Executive, you'll be responsible for developing and executing against a comprehensive account/territory plan as well as driving sales in a defined territory and/or account list to achieve revenue targets. Job level and compensation will be determined based on the candidate's experience and alignment to role expectations.</p> <h3>Equity</h3> <p>This role is eligible to participate in Cloudflare’s equity plan.</p> <h3>Benefits</h3> <p>Cloudflare offers a complete package of benefits and programs to support you and your family.  Our benefits programs can help you pay health care expenses, support caregiving, build capital for the future and make life a little easier and fun!  The below is a description of our benefits for employees in the United States, and benefits may vary for employees based outside the U.S.</p> <h3>Health & Welfare Benefits</h3> <ul> <li>Medical/Rx Insurance</li> <li>Dental Insurance</li> <li>Vision Insurance</li> <li>Flexible Spending Accounts</li> <li>Commuter Spending Accounts</li> <li>Fertility & Family Forming Benefits</li> <li>On-demand mental health support and Employee Assistance Program</li> <li>Global Travel Medical Insurance</li> </ul> <h3>Financial Benefits</h3> <ul> <li>Short and Long Term Disability Insurance</li> <li>Life & Accident Insurance</li> <li>401(k) Retirement Savings Plan</li> <li>Employee Stock Participation Plan</li> </ul> <h3>Time Off</h3> <ul> <li>Flexible paid time off covering vacation and sick leave</li> <li>Leave programs, including parental, pregnancy health, medical, and bereavement leave</li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><h3>What Makes Cloudflare Special?</h3> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. We’re a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company with a soul. Fundamental to our mission to help build a better Internet is protecting the free and open Internet.</span></p> <p><a href="https://blog.cloudflare.com/protecting-free-expression-online/"><strong>Project Galileo</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: Since 2014, we've equipped more than 2,400 journalism and civil society organizations in 111 countries with powerful tools to defend themselves against attacks that would otherwise censor their work, technology already used by Cloudflare’s enterprise customers--at no cost.</span></p> <p><strong><a href="https://www.cloudflare.com/athenian/">Athenian Project</a></strong><span style="font-weight: 400;">: In 2017, we created the Athenian Project to ensure that state and local governments have the highest level of protection and reliability for free, so that their constituents have access to election information and voter registration. Since the project, we've provided services to more than 425 local government election websites in 33 states.</span></p> <p><a href="https://1.1.1.1/"><strong>1.1.1.1</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: We released</span><a href="https://1.1.1.1/"> <span style="font-weight: 400;">1.1.1.1</span></a><span style="font-weight: 400;"> to help fix the foundation of the Internet by building a faster, more secure and privacy-centric public DNS resolver. This is available publicly for everyone to use - it is the first consumer-focused service Cloudflare has ever released. Here’s the deal - we don’t store client IP addresses never, ever. We will continue to abide by our</span><a href="https://developers.cloudflare.com/1.1.1.1/privacy/public-dns-resolver"> privacy commitment</a><span style="font-weight: 400;"> and ensure that no user data is sold to advertisers or used to target consumers.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Sound like something you’d like to be a part of? We’d love to hear from you!</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Please note that applicants who progress to the offer stage of the interview process may be asked to attend an in-person interview within one of the Cloudflare Offices or Cloudflare Hubs.  More details about this will be available at that stage of the interview process.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">This position may require access to information protected under U.S. export control laws, including the U.S. Export Administration Regulations. Please note that any offer of employment may be conditioned on your authorization to receive software or technology controlled under these U.S. export laws without sponsorship for an export license.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Cloudflare is proud to be an equal opportunity employer.  We are committed to providing equal employment opportunity for all people and place great value in both diversity and inclusiveness.  All qualified applicants will be considered for employment without regard to their, or any other person's, perceived or actual</span> <span style="font-weight: 400;">race, color, religion, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, age, physical or mental disability, medical condition, family care status, or any other basis protected by law. </span><span style="font-weight: 400;">We are an AA/Veterans/Disabled Employer.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Cloudflare provides reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities.  Please tell us if you require a reasonable accommodation to apply for a job. Examples of reasonable accommodations include, but are not limited to, changing the application process, providing documents in an alternate format, using a sign language interpreter, or using specialized equipment.  If you require a reasonable accommodation to apply for a job, please contact us via e-mail at </span><span style="font-weight: 400;">hr@cloudflare.com</span><span style="font-weight: 400;"> or via mail at 101 Townsend St. San Francisco, CA 94107.</span></p></div>
