title: Senior Commercial Account Executive, MENA
description: <div class="content-intro"><h3>About Us</h3> <p>At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.</p> <p>At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.</p></div><h2><strong>Available Location</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Dubai, UAE</li> </ul> <h2><strong>About the Role</strong></h2> <p>We are seeking a highly accomplished and strategic Sr. Commercial Account Executive to join our team in Dubai. In this advanced role, you will be pivotal in driving significant growth by leading comprehensive sales cycles within a portfolio of assigned clients, and strategically acquiring new logos. The ideal candidate possesses a deep blend of advanced sales acumen and sophisticated technical understanding, enabling them to lead engagements at all levels, from the C-suite to technical leaders (e.g., Head of/VP of Networking or Security).<br>As a Senior Commercial Account Executive, you will consistently demonstrate advanced proficiency in all sales activities, ensuring highly accurate forecasting, proactive and strategic pipeline management, and consistently exceeding attainment targets. You will be a subject matter expert, speaking fluently about Cloudflare's products, features, benefits, and use cases across diverse customer segments. This role demands the ability to deeply understand complex customer IT Architectures, match them with relevant Cloudflare Reference Architectures, and orchestrate successful, large-scale platform sales. You will be a key driver of digital transformation for our customers, understanding their broader market trends and how Cloudflare uniquely enables their strategic initiatives.<br><strong>Regional Focus: Kuwait, Bahrain, Levant and Iraq</strong><br><br><strong>Responsibilities</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>Strategic Revenue Generation:</strong> Architect and execute advanced territory and account plans to consistently exceed multi-million dollar sales targets and annual quotas, with a strong focus on new business acquisition and expansion within complex enterprise environments.</li> <li><strong>Expert Pipeline & Forecasting:</strong> Lead proactive and strategic pipeline management efforts, demonstrating a sophisticated understanding of sales cycles and customer buying processes. Deliver highly accurate forecasts, providing clear insights and strategic guidance to sales leadership.</li> <li><strong>Deep Customer & IT Architecture Understanding:</strong> Develop a profound understanding of customers' IT architectures, including applications and third-party technologies. Architect and align Cloudflare Reference Architectures to customer environments, driving comprehensive platform solutions.</li> <li><strong>Multi-Engagement Leadership:</strong> Orchestrate and manage multiple complex customer engagements simultaneously across various business units within an organization. Strategically connect disparate needs to strengthen Cloudflare's platform sale, actively involving and influencing technical C-level and minus one executives.</li> <li><strong>Virtual Team Leadership:</strong> Set clear direction and lead a virtual team of in-GEO specialists, Product Managers, Deal Desk, and Legal to collaboratively manage and close complex customer opportunities. Proactively identify and navigate through situations to address colleague and customer needs, escalating as appropriate to drive urgency and efficient delivery.</li> <li><strong>Digital Transformation Authority:</strong> Act as an authority on digital transformation, understanding key drivers (e.g., new offering development, enhanced customer capabilities) and the broader market trends influencing these decisions. Position Cloudflare as a critical enabler of these transformations.</li> <li><strong>Compelling Value Creation:</strong> Articulate highly compelling, strategic value propositions for Cloudflare's services, directly linking them to customer business outcomes and strategic objectives. Lead with a strong focus on the "why," communicating the whole picture to both internal and external stakeholders.</li> <li><strong>Advanced Negotiation & Closure:</strong> Expertly lead and navigate complex contract negotiations, driving win-win scenarios for all parties. Demonstrate advanced closing skills across new business and expansion opportunities.</li> <li><strong>Trusted Advisor & Coach:</strong> Build long-term, executive-level strategic relationships, ensuring deep customer adoption, retention, and expansion. Consistently provide clear, direct, and constructive feedback to team members, coaching them to improve communication, learn from mistakes, and enhance the quality of work. Share learnings proactively to build trust across the organization.</li> <li><strong>Organizational Impact & Leadership:</strong> Consistently focus on the long-term needs of the team and the business, understanding how decisions impact other teams and openly sharing these insights. Leverage company-wide learnings to improve department and team execution. Serve as a leader within Cloudflare, making significant contributions while elevating the work of others by bringing diverse perspectives and strategic long-term thinking.</li> </ul> <p><br><br><strong>Desirable Skills, Knowledge, and Experience</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>Language Skills: Fluency in Arabic and English. French is a plus.</strong></li> <li><strong>10+ years of advanced experience selling complex related technology solutions to the biggest enterprise companies across Emerging Markets (such as Upper Gulf, Levant, Iraq, North Africa)</strong>, with a significant track record of consistently exceeding multi-million dollar quota targets.</li> <li><strong>Deep expertise and fluency in Cloud Networking, Security and Edge Computing technologies</strong>, with an exceptional ability to articulate features, benefits, and use cases across diverse customers within the Commercial sectors.</li> <li><strong>Proven ability to deeply understand complex customer IT architectures</strong> and effectively map them to Cloudflare Reference Architectures for successful platform sales.</li> <li><strong>Demonstrated success leading and influencing virtual cross-functional teams</strong> (e.g., Solution Engineers, Product Managers, Legal) to drive complex deals to closure.</li> <li><strong>Exceptional strategic communication and presentation skills</strong>, with a focus on articulating the "why" and conveying the whole picture to executive leadership and technical decision-makers (C-level minus one).</li> <li><strong>Advanced negotiation skills</strong> with a track record of closing large, complex, six-figure and multi-million dollar deals.</li> <li><strong>Expert-level sales acumen:</strong> unparalleled proficiency in discovery, positioning, competitive selling, negotiation, closing, and expansion strategies within enterprise accounts.</li> <li><strong>Authority on digital transformation trends</strong> and their impact on enterprise customers, with the ability to position Cloudflare as a key enabler of strategic business outcomes.</li> <li><strong>Strong coaching and mentorship abilities</strong>, with a passion for helping colleagues grow and improve.</li> <li><strong>Highly self-motivated, entrepreneurial, and resilient</strong>, thriving in a fast-paced, high-growth environment with a consistent focus on long-term goals.</li> <li><strong>Proficiency in advanced sales and business intelligence platforms</strong> (e.g., Salesforce, Tableau, G-suite, MSFT suite, MEDDPICC framework application).</li> <li><strong>Bachelor's degree required</strong>, with a technical background (e.g., engineering, computer science, MIS) highly preferred.</li> <li><strong>Ability to travel</strong> as required to engage with key customers and internal teams.</li> </ul> <p> </p><div class="content-conclusion"><h3>What Makes Cloudflare Special?</h3> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. We’re a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company with a soul. Fundamental to our mission to help build a better Internet is protecting the free and open Internet.</span></p> <p><a href="https://blog.cloudflare.com/protecting-free-expression-online/"><strong>Project Galileo</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: Since 2014, we've equipped more than 2,400 journalism and civil society organizations in 111 countries with powerful tools to defend themselves against attacks that would otherwise censor their work, technology already used by Cloudflare’s enterprise customers--at no cost.</span></p> <p><strong><a href="https://www.cloudflare.com/athenian/">Athenian Project</a></strong><span style="font-weight: 400;">: In 2017, we created the Athenian Project to ensure that state and local governments have the highest level of protection and reliability for free, so that their constituents have access to election information and voter registration. Since the project, we've provided services to more than 425 local government election websites in 33 states.</span></p> <p><a href="https://1.1.1.1/"><strong>1.1.1.1</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: We released</span><a href="https://1.1.1.1/"> <span style="font-weight: 400;">1.1.1.1</span></a><span style="font-weight: 400;"> to help fix the foundation of the Internet by building a faster, more secure and privacy-centric public DNS resolver. This is available publicly for everyone to use - it is the first consumer-focused service Cloudflare has ever released.

and enterprise sales cycles.</li> <li><strong>Communication:</strong> Exceptional presentation and stakeholder management skills, capable of bridging the gap between deep technical implementation Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.</p> <p>At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.</p></div><h3><strong>Available Location: New York City</strong></h3> <h3><strong>About Us</strong></h3> <p>At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company. </p> <p>We’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.</p> <h3><strong>What you will do as a Customer Engineer</strong></h3> <p>The Customer Engineer (CE) is the core driver of our technical go-to-market strategy: a trusted technical advisor and primary architect of the customer journey. You will bridge the gap between technical strategy and business value—guiding enterprise clients from initial pre-sales technical validation through onboarding, deployment architecture, and full lifecycle expansion. Sitting within the GTM organization and reporting to a Customer Engineering Leader, you will not hand off your customers once an initial agreement is reached. Instead, you will operate as a quota-carrying technologist, leveraging AI-augmented workflows to eliminate administrative toil so you can focus on high-value architectural design and driving measurable business outcomes across the entire customer journey.</p> <p><strong>Key Responsibilities</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>Technical Validation: </strong>Partner closely with Account Executives to lead technical deep-dive discovery, capture business requirements, and map complex customer infrastructure - DNS, CDN, Zero Trust, Network Security, Workers - to fit-for-purpose Cloudflare architectures and bespoke solutions. . Define, scope, success criteria, and technical evaluations plans for Proof of Concepts (PoCs) and Technical Validations. Deliver tailored technical presentations, architectural diagrams, and demonstrations that show how Cloudflare solves specific performance, security, and reliability challenges. Proactively address complex technical objections, security compliance questions, and edge-case architectural requirements during the sales cycle. Take accountability for a suitable solution deployment strategy (Customer, Partner or Cloudflare Professional services) being an integral part of all proposals.</li> <li><strong>Customer Adoption & Value Realization: </strong>Provide oversight to technical onboarding and implementation, but not execute the implementation, serving as the primary executive and engineering contact for the customer. Design structured migration and onboarding blueprints tailored to the customer’s environment (e.g. DNS migrations, Zero Trust rollouts, WAF tuning guidance), and act as the lead consultant for customer engineering teams, walking them step-by-step through configuration best practices.  Partner with Account Executives to own discovery, demos, onboarding, technical health, risk, and expansion strategy. Proactively monitor customer health scores and telemetry to ensure rapid time-to-value, resolve integration bottlenecks, and reduce deployment risk.</li> <li><strong>Commercial Accountability & Expansion: </strong>Carry a variable quota tied directly to new business acquisition and/or ongoing account growth. Be commercially accountable for ensuring deep platform adoption, retaining revenue, and identifying strategic cross-sell and up-sell opportunities based on product usage data. Lead technical Quarterly Business Reviews (QBRs) to translate platform capabilities into return on investment for C-level executives.</li> <li><strong>Trusted Advisory: </strong>Act as a trusted technical advisor throughout the entire customer lifecycle, maintaining a continuous, deep relationship with key stakeholders from initial onboarding through maturity, renewal, and expansion. Provide thought partnership on architecture, AI control layers, security posture, and deployment confidence. Identify potential deployment risks or integration bottlenecks early, and provide remediation strategies to de-risk customer outcomes. </li> <li><strong>AI Orchestration & Workflow Automation: </strong>Leverage AI agents, Large Language Models (LLMs), and internal platforms to automate routine tasks such as RFP/Security Questionnaire responses, sandbox provisioning, basic telemetry monitoring, and internal/external documentation, reclaiming your time for strategic customer advisory.</li> <li><strong>Education & Enablement:</strong> Partner closely with the Enablement Team to design, build, and govern technical resources. Define, document, and educate both internal teams and customers on deliverables such as Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), architectural best practices, and technical guides to continuously raise the technical baseline across the organization.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Minimum Qualifications</strong></p> <ul> <li>Experience: Experience in a customer-facing technical role, such as Solutions Engineering, Customer Engineering, Professional Services,  Sales Engineering, Technical Account Management, or as a Forward Deployed Engineer (years of experience required will vary based on Associate, Senior, Staff, or Principal leveling).</li> <li>Architectural Mindset: Ability to white-board, design, and articulate complex enterprise network and security architectures clearly.</li> <li>Consultative & Advisory Skills: Excellent communication skills with the ability to translate deeply technical concepts into business outcomes for both hands-on engineers and C-level executives.</li> <li>Commercial Mindset: Proven track record of operating in a quota-carrying or revenue-aligned environment, with a strong understanding of SaaS metrics, business value translation, and enterprise sales cycles.</li> <li>Communication: Exceptional presentation and stakeholder management skills, capable of bridging the gap between deep technical implementation details and high-level C-suite business strategy.</li> <li>Technical Breadth: We do not expect every candidate to be an expert in every domain. Qualified candidates will demonstrate depth in at least four of the technical areas below:</li> <ul> <li>Internet fundamentals: Deep understanding of how the Internet works, including OSI Model layers 1–7, BGP, GRE, TCP/UDP, DNS (authoritative and recursive), HTTP(S), and SSL/TLS.</li> <li>Security: Expertise in the security of Internet properties, including WAF, Bot Management, Firewalls, Rate Limiting, (M)TLS, Zero Trust, and SASE concepts.</li> <li>Performance: Expertise in the performance of Internet properties, including speed, latency, caching, video streaming, HTTP/2, and TLS 1.3.</li> <li>AI Proficiency: Familiarity with prompt engineering, AI-assisted scripting and log analysis, LLM utilization, and workflow automation to augment everyday CE workflows.</li> <li>Coding/Scripting: Proficiency in Python, JavaScript, Bash, Lua, Go, or similar languages to write custom integration scripts, API connectors, and edge computing functions.</li> <li>Developer Platform Fluency: Experience designing, building, deploying or scaling applications using RESTful/GraphQL APIs, SDKs, webhooks, and developer tooling in cloud-native environments. Familiarity with infrastructure-as-code (Terraform, Pulumi), CI/CD pipelines, and observability for developer-led deployments.</li> </ul> </ul> <p><strong>Strongly Preferred Qualifications (The "Good-to-Haves")</strong></p> <ul> <li>Technical Enablement: Track record of creating and delivering technical enablement - workshops, code samples, documentation, or developer onboarding - that accelerates customer adoption of complex platforms. </li> <li>Applied AI Knowledge: Experience with LLM orchestration, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) architectures, and model-access controls.</li> <li>Regulatory Knowledge: Understanding of regulatory requirements such as PCI DSS, HIPAA, and SOC 2.</li> <li>Hyperscaler / Digital Native Background: Talent coming out of hyperscalers, digital natives, distributed systems environments, or startups is strongly valued for its deeper cloud fluency and advanced architecture depth.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Education</strong></p> <p>Undergraduate or graduate degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field. </p> <p><strong>Travel</strong></p> <p>This role may require travel up to 20–50% to attend customer meetings, conferences, industry events, and in-person team collaboration.</p> <p><strong>Compensation</strong></p> <p>This ro

Fundamental to our mission to help build a better Internet is protecting the free and open Internet.</span></p> <p><a href="https://blog.cloudflare.com/protecting-free-expression-online/"><strong>Project Galileo</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: Since 2014, we've equipped more than 2,400 journalism and civil society organizations in 111 countries with powerful tools to defend themselves against attacks that would otherwise censor their work, technology already used by Cloudflare’s enterprise customers--at no cost.</span></p> <p><strong><a href="https://www.cloudflare.com/athenian/">Athenian Project</a></strong><span style="font-weight: 400;">: In 2017, we created the Athenian Project to ensure that state and local governments have the highest level of protection and reliability for free, so that their constituents have access to election information and voter registration. We’d love to hear from you!</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Please note that applicants who progress to the offer stage of the interview process may be asked to attend an in-person interview within one of the Cloudflare Offices or Cloudflare Hubs.  More details about this will be available at that stage of the interview process.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">This position may require access to information protected under U.S. export control laws, including the U.S. Export Administration Regulations. title: Senior Customer Engineer, Public Sector Federal
description: <div class="content-intro"><h3>About Us</h3> <p>At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.</p> <p>At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.</p></div><h2>Available Locations: Washington, D.C.</h2> <h2>What you’ll do as a Senior Customer Engineer, Public Sector Federal</h2> <p>You are the technical lynchpin through the entire sales cycle - pre-sales and account technical leadership. You will work closely with our Public Sector prospects and customers to educate, empower, and ensure their success on the Cloudflare platform. Your technical expertise in Cloudflare’s global distributed network and technology will allow you to find best-fit solutions for prospects, to train and onboard new customers via video-conference or in person, create documentation, and to support the long-term technology strategy of the customer. </p> <p>As a Public Sector Federal Solutions Engineer, you will need to have strong technical knowledge of both on premise security and networking implementations and public cloud initiatives common to US Public Sector Federal customers. You are the technical customer advocate within Cloudflare and will work closely with every team at Cloudflare, from Sales and Product, through to Engineering and Customer Support. </p> <p><strong>What we look for in our Solutions Engineers</strong></p> <p>Our Solutions Engineers come from a wide range of backgrounds: engineering, software development, product management, customer support, and project delivery. We're serious about building a diverse team. When hiring we look for diversity of experience combined with genuine curiosity for our technology.</p> <p>Ultimately, you are passionate about technology and have the ability to explain complex technical concepts in easy-to-understand terms. You are naturally curious, and an avid builder who is not afraid to get your hands dirty. You appreciate the diversity of challenges in working with customers, and look forward to helping them realize the full promise of Cloudflare. You are an educator who works with empathy to drive positive outcomes for your customer. On the Solutions Engineering team, you will find a collaborative environment where everyone brings different strengths and jumps in to help each other.</p> <h3>Responsibilities</h3> <ul> <li>As critical members of Cloudflare’s Public Sector Sales team, Solutions Engineers drive technical discussions and implementations to help generate new business, expand existing business, and keep our customers happy.</li> <li>In business generation and expansion, you’ll be tasked with qualification of prospect and customer use cases, technical requirements discovery, leading demonstrations, solution identification and design, and collaborative work on proofs-of-concept (PoCs).</li> <li>For our existing customers, Solutions Engineers are part of a dedicated account team that advises the customer on technical best practices, implementation of Cloudflare products and features, and strategic guidance.</li> <li>The role is focused on emerging Dept. of Defense  & DISA segment within our Federal segment and as such will require some travel, Generally, the role requires 35-45%  travel to attend meetings with prospects or customers, attend conferences and other industry events, and to collaborate with your Cloudflare teammates.</li> </ul> <h3>Requirements</h3> <ul> <li>Demonstrated understanding in internet technologies: OSI Model layers 1-7,Routing TCP/UDP, DNS (authoritative and recursive), HTTP(S), SSL / TLS.</li> <li>Comfortable with SASE frameworks and related technologies such as Secure WEb Gateway, CASB, DLP, SD-WAN, etc.</li> <li>Comfort with on premise infrastructure and networking configurations, including potential legacy systems or methodologies.</li> <li>Minimum 4 years of experience in a customer-facing sales or consulting role supporting the US Federal Government.</li> <li>Technical curiosity and passion: Cloudflare is at the cutting edge of internet technology, and our Solutions Engineers are viewed as subject-matter experts. It’s incumbent on us to stay up to date not only with Cloudflare’s specific products, but with industry trends.</li> <li>A focus on learning, teaching, collaboration, mentorship, and growth, not only personally but also within the team and company.</li> <li>Aside from technical and collaborative skills, we place a high value on project management, relationship building, and EQ.</li> </ul> <h3>Desired</h3> <ul> <li>You're not afraid of command-line interfaces, RESTful APIs, or analyzing HTTP request and response in a browser’s web inspector.</li> <li>An undergraduate degree in Computer Science, Engineering or a related field. Reminder: this is not a strict requirement at all. Candidates from all walks of life are welcome.</li> <li>Experience serving the US Department of Defense or DISA market segment</li> </ul> <h3>Bonus Points</h3> <ul> <li>Graduate-level degrees in Computer Science, Engineering or related fields. Reminder: this is not a strict requirement at all. Candidates from all walks of life are welcome.</li> <li>Certifications: Azure/AWS/GCP Architect, etc.</li> </ul> <h3>More About You</h3> <ul> <li>You can translate technical concepts and jargon for a wide variety of audiences: from systems engineers, to front-end developers, through to IT managers and C-levels in enterprise organizations.</li> <li>You want to be constantly learning new things and teaching what you've learned to the broader team through internal and external blog posts, team demos, and product training sessions.</li> <li>You have a knack for understanding problems and finding creative ways to solve them. We work with Sales, Technical Sales, Services, Finance, and our central Data teams to make sure the people who sell, deploy, and support Cloudflare get consistent, reliable answers to the questions that matter most.</p> <p>We're looking for a Senior GTM Analytics Manager to set and execute the vision for how information scales across Cloudflare's technical customer-facing teams. You'll support Pre- and Post-Sales Operations, Solutions Engineering, Forward Deployed Engineering, and Professional Services.</p> <p>This role is less about building more dashboards or doing one-off deep dives and more about building the foundations to support true self-serve analytics.  You will focus on single source of truth artifacts, strategic alignment of metrics to actions, and the data models, metric definitions, and context layers that let anyone in these organizations get a trustworthy answer that fits their needs. That person might be an executive, a frontline manager, an engineer in the field, or an AI agent working for any of them.</p> <p>You'll be a technical expert and a strategic partner in one. You'll be as comfortable reviewing a dimensional model with Data Engineering as you are agreeing a metric definition with a VP of Professional Services. streamlined handoff workflows.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>Skills, Knowledge, and Experience</strong></h3> <ul> <li><strong>7–10 years of experience</strong> bridging B2B marketing operations with systems We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.</p></div><h3><strong>チームについて</strong></h3> <p>私たちのBDR（Business Development Representative）組織のミッションは非常にシンプルです。 それは、「営業チームに高品質かつ大規模なパイプラインを供給し、Cloudflareの持続的な収益成長を牽引すること」です。</p> <p>そのために私たちは「人材・プロセス・ツール」のすべてにおいて最高水準を追求しています。とりわけ人材の育成とキャリア開発には強いこだわりを持っており、チームワークを尊重し、お互いの成功を称え合うカルチャーを大切にしています。強固なBDR組織の構築こそが、Cloudflareの市場における圧倒的な競合優位性を生み出す源泉であると信じています。</p> <h3><strong>ポジションの概要</strong></h3> <p>本ポジションでは、「ピープルマネジメント（育成・牽引）」「組織ビルディング」「戦略的思考」を兼ね備えたリーダーを募集しています。営業、インサイドセールス、またはBDR/SDR組織におけるチームマネジメントの豊富なご経験をお持ちの方を求めています。</p> <p>BDRチームの運営基盤（Sales Motion）の強化、四半期目標の安定達成、組織拡大に向けた戦略立案、そして協調的なチームカルチャーの醸成を主導していただきます。Cloudflare Japanは今後12ヶ月でさらなる変革と成長を予定しており、次代を担う優秀なリーダー・メンバーの育成と支援も非常に重要なミッションとなります。</p> <h3><strong>主な業務内容</strong></h3> <ul> Computing technologies</strong>, with an exceptional ability to articulate features, benefits, and use cases across diverse customer segments (e.g., SMBs, enterprise, vertical markets).</li> Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.</p> <p>At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. 1.5;">Responsibilities </h3> <ul> <li style="line-height: 2;">Lead cross-functional teams of technical professionals, consultants, FDE’s, partners, vendors, and customer stakeholders to deliver global efficiency and effectiveness of Professional Services delivery.</li> <li style="line-height: 2;">Ensure a seamless and consultative sales-to-delivery transition by validating scope, multi-vendor dependencies, resource constraints, scope changes, and customer operational impact, and implement mitigation strategies to protect customer outcomes.</li> <li style="line-height: 2;">Transform raw project data into clear, data-driven insights and regular status narratives for internal and external leadership regarding project health, risks, decisions, financials, and resource utilization.</li> <li style="line-height: 2;">Proactively leverage AI tools to optimize project workflows and technical delivery, serving as a force multiplier for project teams by streamlining administrative work, improving visibility, and increasing overall project productivity.</li> <li style="line-height: 2;">Collaborate across Account Teams, Customer Engineers, Support, Product, Engineering, Professional Services leadership, and other internal stakeholders to resolve blockers, advocate for customer requirements, and maintain a unified one-team approach to delivery.</li> </ul> management (PPM) principles, with the ability to oversee a high volume of concurrent workstreams while maintaining strategic alignment with customer and business objectives.</li> <li style="line-height: 2;"><strong>Strategic Execution</strong>: Proven ability to manage ambiguity, shifting priorities, and competing stakeholder needs while maintaining disciplined prioritization, stakeholders, including Account Teams, Customer Success Managers, Support, Product, Engineering, and Professional Services leadership, to resolve blockers, advocate for customer requirements, and maintain a unified one-team approach to delivery.</li> </ul> <h3 style="line-height: 1.5;">Experience</h3> <ul> <li style="line-height: 2;">Minimum of 8+ years of experience in professional services, management skills and the ability to manage multiple projects, deadlines, dependencies, and executive stakeholders in a fast-paced environment.</li> <li style="line-height: 2;">Demonstrated track record of leading high-profile, high-impact projects involving third-party partners, consultants, technical delivery teams, and complex multi-vendor ecosystems.</li> <li style="line-height: 2;">Experience managing strategic customer programs from kickoff through closeout, including project charters, governance cadences, risk management, change control, executive reporting, and lessons learned.</li> <li style="line-height: 2;">Sound business judgment, an ownership mindset, strong analytical capability, and a proven ability to influence results across global stakeholders.</li> <li style="line-height: 2;">Expert proficiency with Jira, Salesforce, Professional Services Automation (PSA), or equivalent project / portfolio management tools.</li> <li style="line-height: 2;">Bachelor’s degree in a relevant field, or equivalent practical experience.</li> <li style="line-height: 2;">PMP, PRINCE2, Agile, or related advanced project / program management certification is highly preferred.</li> </ul> <h3 style="line-height: 1.5;"><strong>Compensation</strong> </h3> <p style="line-height: 1.5;">Compensation may be adjusted depending on work location. <span engineering process across Cloudflare</strong> through code reviews, technical mentorship, architectural governance, and candidate evaluation for engineering hiring.</li> </ul> <h3>Desirable Skills, Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.</p></div><h3><strong>Available Locations: Lisbon, or London (Hybrid)</strong></h3> <div class="container"> <div id="model-response-message-contentr_ccb59069932b9a6f" class="markdown markdown-main-panel md-content enable-luminous-fast-follows enable-updated-hr-color stronger tutor-markdown-rendering"> <h3>About the Department</h3> <p>Emerging Technologies & Incubation (ETI) is where new and bold products are built and released within Cloudflare. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.</p></div><p><strong>Available Locations: London</strong></p> <h3><strong>About Engineering at Cloudflare</strong></h3> <p>Cloudflare’s Engineering team is responsible for the software platform that serves millions of HTTP requests per second on average. You’ll experience the full breadth of technologies needed to run one of the world’s largest networks serving the world's largest customers such as Shopify and VISA.</p> <p><strong>About The Team</strong></p> <p>Cloudflare’s Front Line (FL) group is responsible for maintaining and developing the main Cloudflare web server, processing over 150 million HTTP requests per second. In other words, we own the largest web server in the world.</p> <p>The team is responsible for improving efficiency & safety, deployment frequency and automation & observability. The platform is entirely built on Rust, with over 20 teams collaborating on the same codebase.</p> <p><strong>What you'll do</strong></p> <p>You will work with a team of talented engineers to increase the availability, safety & reliability of the edge ecosystem. You will improve the platform, increasing reliability, availability, and security increase at the edge and help to build the best web server in the world. </p> <p>This is a unique opportunity to be at the nexus of Cloudflare edge applications and operations and to collaborate closely with most other product and engineering teams at Cloudflare. </p> <p><strong>Examples of desirable skills, knowledge and experience</strong></p> <ul> <li>Solid competencies in practical computer science, applying the right algorithms, data structures, concurrency control systems to software design, and building large, distributed systems</li> <li>Experience in performance engineering</li> <li>Driving communication and consensus across teams</li> <li>A drive for continuous improvement when it comes to both operations and new product development</li> </ul> <h4><strong>Bonus Points</strong></h4> <p>These are things which the role is likely to require; we’re happy to help you learn on the job, but prior experience is beneficial</p> <ul> <li>Experience of languages: Rust, Go</li> <li>Knowledge of web servers and web protocols</li> <li>Distributed systems</li> <li>Web security issues and industry standards</li> </ul> <p>Most importantly, we are looking for people who want to learn something new. We maintain the largest web server in the world, and we face unique challenges. Fundamental to our mission to help build a better Internet is protecting the free and open Internet.</span></p> <p><a href="https://blog.cloudflare.com/protecting-free-expression-online/"><strong>Project Galileo</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: Since 2014, we've equipped more than 2,400 journalism and civil society organizations in 111 countries with powerful tools to defend themselves against attacks that would otherwise censor their work, technology already used by Cloudflare’s enterprise customers--at no cost.</span></p> <p><strong><a href="https://www.cloudflare.com/athenian/">Athenian Project</a></strong><span style="font-weight: 400;">: In 2017, we created the Athenian Project to ensure that state and local governments have the highest level of protection and reliability for free, so that their constituents have access to election information and voter registration. Since the project, we've provided services to more than 425 local government election websites in 33 states.</span></p> <p><a href="https://1.1.1.1/"><strong>1.1.1.1</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: We released</span><a href="https://1.1.1.1/"> <span style="font-weight: 400;">1.1.1.1</span></a><span style="font-weight: 400;"> to help fix the foundation of the Internet by building a faster, more secure and privacy-centric public DNS resolver. This is available publicly for everyone to use - it is the first consumer-focused service Cloudflare has ever released. Here’s the deal - we don’t store client IP addresses never, ever. We will continue to abide by our</span><a href="https://developers.cloudflare.com/1.1.1.1/privacy/public-dns-resolver"> privacy commitment</a><span style="font-weight: 400;"> and ensure that no user data is sold to advertisers or used to target consumers.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Sound like something you’d like to be a part of? We’d love to hear from you!</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Please note that applicants who progress to the offer stage of the interview process may be asked to attend an in-person interview within one of the Cloudflare Offices or Cloudflare Hubs.  More details about this will be available at that stage of the interview process.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">This position may require access to information protected under U.S. export control laws, including the U.S. Export Administration Regulations. Please note that any offer of employment may be conditioned on your authorization to receive software or technology controlled under these U.S. export laws without sponsorship for an export license.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Cloudflare is proud to be an equal opportunity employer.  We are committed to providing equal employment opportunity for all people and place great value in both diversity and inclusiveness.  All qualified applicants will be considered for employment without regard to their, or any other person's, perceived or actual</span> <span style="font-weight: 400;">race, color, religion, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, age, physical or mental disability, medical condition, family care status, or any other basis protected by law. </span><span style="font-weight: 400;">We are an AA/Veterans/Disabled Employer.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Cloudflare provides reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities.  Please tell us if you require a reasonable accommodation to apply for a job. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.</p> <p>At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.</p></div><p><strong>Job Title </strong></p> <p>Technical Accounting Analyst (Infrastructure)</p> <p><strong>Role Summary</strong></p> <p>As a Technical Accounting Analyst (Infrastructure), you will play a critical role in ensuring the financial integrity of our global infrastructure through robust financial compliance, colocation contract reviews, and SOX controls. Working with an experienced accounting team, you will partner closely with our Infrastructure, FP&A, and AP teams to provide technical accounting guidance and transform complex data into clear, actionable documentation. We are seeking a highly analytical and detail-oriented professional with 3+ years of accounting experience with a strong interest in optimizing or automating financial processes. If you are an agile problem-solver with a strong foundational knowledge of accounting standards looking to make an impact in a fast-growing business, we want to hear from you.</p> <p><strong>Role Responsibilities</strong></p> <ul> <li>Responsible for review of colocation service contracts and accurate reporting for month end close processes and SOX controls</li> <li>Develop and maintain strong relationships with the internal Infrastructure Strategy team and Business Partners to understand business objectives, develop processes and provide accounting guidance and best practice recommendations to drive process improvements</li> <li>Work closely with FP&A and tax teams to ensure compliance with U.S. GAAP and internal policies through effective communications and execution</li> <li>Research and apply accounting guidance to new and ongoing business initiatives in order to ensure accurate reporting</li> <li>Reach conclusions with an adequate level of rationale and documentation for review and then communicate and present the accounting conclusions to the team</li> <li>Own key SOX controls as well as gathering necessary audit documentation for internal and external auditors</li> <li>Understand how systems work to drive improvements and automation</li> <li>Manage multiple tasks under tight deadlines with strong attention to detail and accuracy</li> <li>Prepare and book monthly infrastructure accruals</li> </ul> <p> </p> <p><strong>Role Requirements </strong></p> <p><strong>Must-Have Skills</strong></p> <ul> <li>3+ years of relevant accounting experience</li> <li>Bachelor's degree in Accounting</li> <li>Technical knowledge of U.S. GAAP or IFRS</li> <li>Good working knowledge of Microsoft Excel</li> <li>Attention to detail</li> <li>Ability to manage multiple deliverables and work well under pressure</li> <li>Experience in designing and implementing new processes</li> </ul> <p><strong>Nice-to-Have Skills</strong></p> <ul> <li>Experience working across multiple time zones</li> <li>Experience accounting for infrastructure / data center activities</li> <li>CPA/CA or equivalent qualification</li> <li>Experience with ASC 842 or IFRS 16 accounting</li> <li>Experience working in Oracle</li> <li>Experience utilizing AI as part of process improvement and automation</li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><h3>What Makes Cloudflare Special?</h3> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. We’re a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company with a soul. Fundamental to our mission to help build a better Internet is protecting the free and open Internet.</span></p> <p><a href="https://blog.cloudflare.com/protecting-free-expression-online/"><strong>Project Galileo</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: Since 2014, we've equipped more than 2,400 journalism and civil society organizations in 111 countries with powerful tools to defend themselves against attacks that would otherwise censor their work, technology already used by Cloudflare’s enterprise customers--at no cost.</span></p> <p><strong><a href="https://www.cloudflare.com/athenian/">Athenian Project</a></strong><span style="font-weight: 400;">: In 2017, we created the Athenian Project to ensure that state and local governments have the highest level of protection and reliability for free, so that their constituents have access to election information and voter registration. Since the project, we've provided services to more than 425 local government election websites in 33 states.</span></p> <p><a href="https://1.1.1.1/"><strong>1.1.1.1</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: We released</span><a href="https://1.1.1.1/"> <span style="font-weight: 400;">1.1.1.1</span></a><span style="font-weight: 400;"> to help fix the foundation of the Internet by building a faster, more secure and privacy-centric public DNS resolver. This is available publicly for everyone to use - it is the first consumer-focused service Cloudflare has ever released. Here’s the deal - we don’t store client IP addresses never, ever. We will continue to abide by our</span><a href="https://developers.cloudflare.com/1.1.1.1/privacy/public-dns-resolver"> privacy commitment</a><span style="font-weight: 400;"> and ensure that no user data is sold to advertisers or used to target consumers.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Sound like something you’d like to be a part of? We’d love to hear from you!</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Please note that applicants who progress to the offer stage of the interview process may be asked to attend an in-person interview within one of the Cloudflare Offices or Cloudflare Hubs.  More details about this will be available at that stage of the interview process.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">This position may require access to information protected under U.S. export control laws, including the U.S. Export Administration Regulations. Please note that any offer of employment may be conditioned on your authorization to receive software or technology controlled under these U.S. export laws without sponsorship for an export license.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Cloudflare is proud to be an equal opportunity employer.  We are committed to providing equal employment opportunity for all people and place great value in both diversity and inclusiveness.  All qualified applicants will be considered for employment without regard to their, or any other person's, perceived or actual</span> <span style="font-weight: 400;">race, color, religion, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, age, physical or mental disability, medical condition, family care status, or any other basis protected by law. </span><span style="font-weight: 400;">We are an AA/Veterans/Disabled Employer.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Cloudflare provides reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities.  Please tell us if you require a reasonable accommodation to apply for a job. Examples of reasonable accommodations include, but are not limited to, changing the application process, providing documents in an alternate format, using a sign language interpreter, or using specialized equipment.  If you require a reasonable accommodation to apply for a job, please contact us via e-mail at </span><span style="font-weight: 400;">hr@cloudflare.com</span><span style="font-weight: 400;"> or via mail at 101 Townsend St. San Francisco, CA 94107.</span></p></div>

</ul> <h3>Equity:</h3> <p>This role is eligible to participate in Cloudflare’s equity plan.</p> <p><strong>Benefits</strong></p> <p>Cloudflare offers a complete package of benefits and programs to title: Post-doctorant.e en conception de catalyseurs bimétalliques et multifonctionnels pour la conversion directe du CO2 en carburants liquides (H/F) – CDD 11 mois
description: ENVIRONNEMENT DU POSTE : École du ministère en charge de l'industrie, IMT Mines Albi est une école de l’Institut Mines- Télécom, 1er groupe d’écoles d’ingénieurs et de management de France. À l'avant-garde des enjeux industriels et académiques sur la scène internationale, elle agit comme un moteur scientifique et économique territorial en combinant ses 4 missions - former des ingénieurs en intégrant la dynamique du développement durable, faire de la recherche scientifique, contribuer au développement économique et diffuser la culture des sciences, des techniques et de l'innovation - en un cercle vertueux et porteur d'innovation. Son positionnement en matière de formation et de recherche la place IMT Mines Albi comme école de référence sur trois des quatre thématiques de l’IMT, à savoir l’industrie du futur responsable, l’énergie, économie circulaire et société ainsi que l’ingénierie, santé et bien-être. IMT Mines Albi s‘est dotée en 2023 et pour une période quinquennale, d’un plan stratégique décliné en 7 grandes actions, répondant ainsi aux orientations stratégiques du groupe IMT à laquelle elle appartient. Les activités du centre RAPSODEE sont structurées en deux groupes de recherche dans les domaines de l’énergie, de l’environnement et du génie particulaire avec un accent particulier sur des procédés durables : plus intenses, plus économes en énergie, plus respectueux de l’environnement et plus sûrs. Le poste est ouvert dans le fond propre d’IMT Mines Albi. Une collaboration avec le laboratoire de chimie de coordination (LCC) à Toulouse est prévue. DESCRIPTION DU POSTE : A ce jour, les carburants fossiles sont encore largement utilisés dans les différents secteurs industriels et notamment pour le secteur de transport, qui sont une source importante d’émission de gaz à effet de serre. Pour réduire l’impact environnemental du secteur de transport, les carburants de synthèse jouent un rôle important, en particulier pour le transport aérien de demain. Parmi les voies de R&D étudiées à ce jour pour la production de ces carburants de synthèse, le captage du CO2 et l’hydrogénation directe de ce CO2 par de l’hydrogène obtenu par l’électrolyse de l’eau avec de l’électricité renouvelable est une voie stratégique. L'un de leurs atouts majeurs réside dans l’optimisation de la production pour minimiser le coût du produit final, et la compatibilité des carburants de synthèse avec les infrastructures et les flottes existantes. Ce projet, qui réunit deux laboratoires (RAPSODEE à Albi, et LCC à Toulouse), vise à produire des carburants alternatifs par hydrogénation directe du CO2 via une synthèse de Fischer-Tropsch à partir de CO2 (CO2-FTS). Ce processus se décompose en deux étapes successives : (i) l'hydrogénation du CO2 en CO (réaction inverse du gaz à l'eau, ou RWGS), suivie (ii) de l'hydrogénation du CO en hydrocarbures (synthèse de Fischer-Tropsch, ou FTS). Ce projet continue la recherche récente entre les deux laboratoires sur le même sujet, en développant des systèmes catalytiques multifonctionnels assurant la conversion, en une seule étape, dans un seul réacteur et à une seule condition de température et de pression, du CO2 et H2 en carburants liquides. Une attention particulière sera accordée à l’ingénierie de la composition, de la structure et de l’environnement des sites actifs, afin d’établir des relations structure-activité et de comprendre le rôle de chaque composant métallique dans les différentes étapes réactionnelles. Cette stratégie vise à dépasser les limitations des catalyseurs conventionnels en améliorant leur activité, sélectivité, stabilité et résistance à la désactivation. Le projet contribuera ainsi au développement d’une nouvelle génération de catalyseurs multifonctionnels pour la valorisation directe et durable du CO2 en carburants et produits chimiques à valeur ajoutée. Les missions sont les suivantes : Etat de l’art : Une étude bibliographique est prévue sur les derniers travaux publiés sur ce sujet, pour compléter le travail réalisé en début de 2026. Synthèse et caractérisation des catalyseurs multifonctionnels : des catalyseurs bimétalliques et multifonctionnels à base de fer et/ou de cobalt pour la conversion directe du CO2 en hydrocarbures par voie Fischer-Tropsch seront développés. L’objectif sera d’obtenir des matériaux présentant une synergie contrôlée entre différentes fonctions catalytiques, permettant de favoriser simultanément l’activation/hydrogénation du CO2, la formation des intermédiaires carbonés et leur transformation sélective en chaînes hydrocarbonées. Les paramètres à étudier sont : la modification des supports catalytiques par des promoteurs efficaces ; le contrôle de la taille, la forme et la composition de la phase active, le contrôle de l’équilibre entre les fonctions pour l’activation du CO2 et de l’hydrogène. Ces matériaux seront caractérisés par différentes méthodes de caractérisation conventionnelles ou avancées. Evaluation des systèmes catalytiques en CO2-FTS : Les catalyseurs synthétisés seront évalués à l’échelle laboratoire. La performance des meilleurs catalyseurs pourra être évaluée à l’échelle pilote. Valorisation des résultats : Les résultats obtenus feront l’objet de la valorisation sous forme de brevet et ensuite communiqués dans les congrès et les journaux scientifiques. CAPACITE ET ATTITUDES : Compétences, connaissances et expériences souhaitables : Des compétences solides en catalyse hétérogène, en particulier pour la conversion du CO2 sont recherchées. Capacités et aptitudes : Des qualités de synthèse, d’organisation et de communication sont également nécessaires pour mener à bien les missions de ce poste. PROFIL RECHERCHE : Vous êtes titulaire d’un doctorat obtenu il y a moins de 3 ans. AU-DELÀ DE L’ENVIRONNEMENT PROFESSIONNEL, POURQUOI NOUS REJOINDRE ? : cadre de travail agréable dans un campus de 22 ha 49 jours de congés par an restauration administrative sur place aide à la mobilité durable pour le transport domicile-travail action sociale (protection sociale complémentaire et aide aux familles) INFORMATIONS COMPLÉMENTAIRES : Des déplacements entre les deux laboratoires sont prévus. Un permis de conduire B est un plus. title: Senior Data Center Operations Engineer H/F
description: 📍 Paris / Île-de-France | Environnement Data Center | CDI | Périmètre multisite Rejoignez mon client au cœur des infrastructures critiques. Dans un contexte de forte croissance et de développement de ses infrastructures, mon client renforce son organisation Operations en France et crée un poste de Chief Engineer . Au sein d'un nouvel pôle d'expertise technique transverse , vous devenez le référent technique des opérations sur plusieurs sites stratégiques en France, avec un périmètre prioritaire couvrant notamment deux sites. Votre mission : apporter votre expertise, sécuriser les opérations et contribuer à faire progresser l'ensemble de l'organisation vers davantage de standardisation, de rigueur opérationnelle et d'excellence technique . Ce poste s'adresse à un profil expérimenté qui souhaite aller au-delà de l'expertise technique pure et jouer un rôle central dans la structuration des opérations d'un acteur Data Center en pleine croissance . Vos missions Votre rôle Le Chief Engineer intervient comme référent technique et opérationnel multisite . Vous êtes à la fois : un expert technique capable de challenger les équipes et les prestataires ; un référent opérationnel garant de la sécurisation des opérations ; un acteur transverse capable de fédérer des équipes aux profils et niveaux d'expérience différents. Vous disposez d'une véritable autorité technique : lorsque les conditions de sécurité ou de maîtrise des risques ne sont pas réunies, vous êtes capable de challenger une opération et, si nécessaire, de prononcer un NO GO sur un mode opératoire ou une intervention. Vous travaillez en étroite collaboration avec les responsables de site, qui conservent la responsabilité opérationnelle de leur périmètre. Vos principales missions 1 - Être le référent technique des infrastructures critiques Vous apportez votre expertise sur l'ensemble des infrastructures techniques du Data Center et êtes capable d'en comprendre les interactions et les impacts opérationnels. Votre périmètre couvre notamment : les infrastructures électriques HT/BT ; les systèmes de secours électrique ; les UPS / onduleurs ; les groupes électrogènes ; les infrastructures CVC / HVAC ; les systèmes de refroidissement ; la protection et la sécurité incendie ; les systèmes de contrôle-commande et infrastructures associées. Vous intervenez comme référent technique auprès des responsables de site et des équipes Operations , et êtes capable de challenger les différents interlocuteurs internes ou externes sur leurs choix et leurs pratiques. 2 - Sécuriser les opérations L'une de vos responsabilités majeures sera de garantir que les opérations réalisées sur les infrastructures critiques sont préparées et exécutées dans les meilleures conditions de sécurité et de maîtrise des risques. À ce titre, vous : challengez les modes opératoires (MOP) ; vérifiez la cohérence et l'exhaustivité des procédures ; identifiez les risques et leurs impacts potentiels ; sécurisez les opérations avant leur réalisation ; challengez les premières analyses et propositions d'intervention ; pouvez émettre un NO GO lorsqu'une opération ne présente pas les garanties nécessaires ; accompagnez les responsables de site dans la prise de décision technique ; contribuez à la mise en place de mécanismes de double vérification. Vous êtes en quelque sorte le garde-fou technique de l'organisation , avec pour objectif de sécuriser les opérations sans perdre de vue les impératifs de continuité de service. 3- Structurer et harmoniser les pratiques L'un des enjeux majeurs du poste est de contribuer à l'harmonisation des pratiques entre les différents sites. Aujourd'hui, les niveaux de maturité et les pratiques peuvent varier d'un site à l'autre. Votre rôle sera de contribuer à construire un socle commun de méthodes et de standards opérationnels . Vous serez notamment amené(e) à : structurer les processus d'exploitation ; définir et harmoniser les standards techniques ; rédiger et améliorer les procédures et modes opératoires ; mettre en place des workflows opérationnels ; contrôler leur bonne application ; identifier les écarts entre les sites ; proposer et suivre les plans d'amélioration ; partager les bonnes pratiques ; réaliser des REX multisites ; accompagner les équipes dans l'adoption des nouveaux standards. La capacité à construire et faire vivre des process sera donc aussi importante que votre expertise technique. 4- Apporter votre expertise lors des incidents critiques En cas d'incident technique complexe, vous intervenez comme référent technique auprès des équipes Facility et Operations. Vous êtes notamment amené(e) à : analyser techniquement l'incident ; identifier les causes et les impacts potentiels ; apporter votre expertise aux responsables de site ; challenger les analyses proposées ; accompagner les équipes internes et les prestataires ; contribuer à la définition des actions correctives ; participer à la résolution de l'incident ; organiser et partager les retours d'expérience à l'échelle des différents sites. Votre capacité à prendre du recul, analyser rapidement une situation complexe et apporter une réponse techniquement robuste sera essentielle. 5 - Développer une culture d'excellence opérationnelle Vous ne vous contentez pas de définir les standards : vous accompagnez les équipes dans leur appropriation. Vous serez ainsi amené(e) à : former et accompagner les équipes ; expliquer les exigences techniques et opérationnelles ; faire progresser les pratiques ; fédérer autour d'objectifs communs ; accompagner la conduite du changement ; favoriser le partage de connaissances entre les sites. Vous disposez d'une forte capacité d'influence et savez faire avancer les sujets sans nécessairement disposer d'un lien hiérarchique direct . 6 - Être l'interlocuteur technique des clients majeurs Vous serez capable de : représenter la société sur les sujets techniques ; expliquer une situation ou un incident complexe ; présenter les actions mises en œuvre ; répondre aux interrogations techniques des clients ; apporter un discours structuré et crédible sur les enjeux d'exploitation et de sécurité des infrastructures. Une organisation en construction Vous rejoindrez un pôle d'expertise technique transverse nouvellement structuré , regroupant différentes compétences destinées à accompagner les opérations et les projets. L'objectif est de créer une véritable communauté d'experts capable d'apporter son expertise à l'ensemble des sites et de faire progresser collectivement les standards d'exploitation. Vous travaillerez au quotidien avec : les responsables de site ; les équipes Facility et Operations ; les équipes projets ; les experts techniques ; les prestataires et partenaires externes ; les fonctions transverses ; les clients majeurs. Le poste est donc particulièrement transverse et nécessite une forte capacité à créer du lien entre les différentes parties prenantes . Vos compétences Votre profil Vous disposez d'une expérience significative dans un environnement Data Center ou infrastructure critique fortement structurée . Vous avez idéalement évolué dans un environnement où les exigences en matière de procédures, de sécurité opérationnelle, de maintenance et de continuité de service sont particulièrement élevées. Une expérience dans un environnement critique comparable serait particulièrement appréciée. Votre expertise technique Vous disposez d'une excellente connaissance des infrastructures critiques et notamment : électricité HT/BT ; systèmes de secours électrique ; UPS / groupes électrogènes ; CVC / HVAC ; refroidissement ; protection incendie ; contrôle-commande ; maintenance des infrastructures critiques. Vous êtes capable de comprendre l'intégralité de l'infrastructure et les interactions entre les différents systèmes , et pas uniquement votre domaine d'expertise initial. Vous savez également analyser une problématique technique complexe, identifier les risques et challenger les solutions proposées. Votre expérience opérationnelle Vous avez déjà évolué dans un environnement où les procédures et les standards opérationnels occupent une place importante. Vous êtes à l'aise avec : les modes opératoires (MOP) ; la gestion des changements ; l'analyse de risques ; la maintenance préventive et corrective ; la gestion d'incidents critiques ; les audits et contrôles opérationnels ; les REX ; la standardisation des pratiques ; la gestion de prestataires techniques. Vous avez surtout envie de faire progresser une organisation , de structurer les pratiques et d'améliorer durablement les opérations. Vos qualités Pour réussir dans ce rôle, nous recherchons une personne : dotée d'une forte expertise technique ; structurée et rigoureuse ; capable d'analyse et de prise de recul ; pédagogue et capable de transmettre son expertise ; à l'aise pour challenger ses interlocuteurs ; capable de prendre des décisions et de défendre une position technique ; dotée d'une forte intelligence relationnelle ; capable de s'adapter à différents profils et différents niveaux de maturité ; fédératrice et à l'aise dans un rôle transverse ; capable d'accompagner la conduite du changement. Votre capacité à adapter votre communication à votre interlocuteur tout en maintenant un haut niveau d'exigence technique sera déterminante. Time to Recharge : Enjoy 30 days of paid vacation, plus an additional day off for every year of service, giving you plenty of time to rest and recharge. Modern Zurich HQ: Located just a five-minute walk from Zurich HB, our centrally located office offers an inspiring work environment with local coffee, a variety of snacks and access to many lunch spots. Unique Event s: Events are our DNA. title: Account Executive (m/w/d)
description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong>Who We Are </strong></p> <p>Verve has created a more efficient and privacy-focused way to buy and monetize advertising. Verve is an ecosystem of demand and supply technologies fusing data, media, and technology together to deliver results and growth to both advertisers and publishers–no matter the screen or location, no matter who, what, or where a customer is. With offices across the globe and with an eye on servicing forward-thinking advertising customers, Verve’s solutions are trusted by more than 90 of the United States’ top 100 advertisers, 4,000 publishers globally, and the world’s top demand-side platforms. Learn more at <a href="https://verve.com/">verve.com</a>.<strong><br></strong></p></div><h2><strong>Über Verve Retail Media</strong></h2> <p>Das größte Problem im stationären Handel für Werbungtreibende ist der fehlende Wirkungsnachweis. Marken investieren Millionen in Werbung am Point of Sale, können aber nicht belegen, ob daraus Käufe generiert wurden.</p> <p>Verve Retail Media (VRM) löst dieses Problem. Wir vermarkten und betreiben digitale Werbe-Screens in mehreren tausend LEH-, Drogerie- und Convenience-Standorten und verbinden sie mit digitalen Coupons und Retargeting im CTV und anderen Offsite-Kanälen. Marken buchen keine isolierten Werbeformate, sondern 360-Grad-Kampagnen, die zu Hause starten und bis zum stationären Kauf gehen: Closed-Loop-Messung auf Basis realer Kassendaten.</p> <p>VRM ist die eigenständige Retail Media Unit der börsennotierten Verve Group SE. title: Responsable commercial B2C & marketing — Voyages à pied et à vélo (H/F)
description: 🌿 D'abord, quelques mots sur nous Chez Nature Occitane, nous avons une conviction : les plus beaux voyages ne sont pas forcément ceux qui nous emmènent le plus loin. Ce sont ceux qui nous invitent à découvrir un territoire autrement, à prendre le temps, à rencontrer ceux qui y vivent et à profiter pleinement de ce que la nature nous offre. C'est autour de cette idée que j'ai créé Nature Occitane en 2012. Aujourd'hui, nous sommes une petite équipe de passionnés qui imagine, conçoit et organise des voyages à pied, à vélo et multiactivités, en liberté ou accompagnés. De la Provence à la Catalogne, du canal du Midi aux Cévennes, nous aimons les beaux tracés, les bonnes adresses, les rencontres authentiques et les expériences dont nos voyageurs se souviennent longtemps. Nous aimons aussi travailler avec des partenaires locaux, défendre un tourisme plus respectueux des territoires et imaginer des voyages qui donnent envie de partir autrement. Nature Occitane a grandi, et nous avons encore beaucoup d'idées pour la suite : de nouvelles destinations, de nouveaux séjours, des voyages bas carbone en Europe et l'envie de devenir une référence du slow tourisme. Pour écrire cette prochaine étape, nous recherchons une personne qui aura envie de s'investir pleinement dans notre aventure. 🚀 Votre fiche de poste 1. Vous serez avant tout sur le terrain commercial. Conseiller nos voyageurs et leur proposer les séjours qui leur correspondent. Construire des devis, assurer les relances et concrétiser les réservations. Piloter notre activité commerciale avec des indicateurs simples : ventes, taux de transformation, chiffre d'affaires et marges. Faire évoluer nos méthodes pour améliorer l'expérience client et notre efficacité. 2. Vous ferez grandir notre petite équipe commerciale. Accompagner et faire progresser une collaboratrice. Organiser les priorités et fluidifier le suivi des demandes. Partager vos bonnes pratiques, encourager les initiatives et cultiver l'entraide. Installer une dynamique à la fois exigeante, positive et tournée vers les résultats. 3. Vous participerez activement à notre développement marketing. Nous lançons un nouveau site internet et souhaitons accélérer notre visibilité. Vous contribuerez notamment à : Développer notre référencement naturel (SEO), avec environ une journée dédiée chaque semaine. Piloter nos campagnes publicitaires Google Ads avec notre prestataire. Améliorer nos pages séjours et notre parcours de réservation. Participer aux newsletters, aux contenus et aux actions de fidélisation. Identifier les meilleures opportunités pour attirer de nouveaux voyageurs. 4. Vous garderez un pied dans la création de voyages. Parce que chez nous, la vente et la production sont intimement liés. Vous pourrez contribuer à améliorer nos séjours, partager les attentes des voyageurs et participer ponctuellement à la création de nouvelles expériences, aux côtés de notre équipe de production. Nous vivons au rythme des saisons. La haute saison privilégie la vente et le suivi des voyageurs ; les périodes plus calmes permettent d'approfondir le marketing et et de contribuer davantage à la production. Les priorités sont définies ensemble, avec une réelle autonomie dans l'organisation du travail. 🌟 Le profil que nous recherchons Nous ne recherchons pas un CV parfait ni une personne qui coche toutes les cases. Nous recherchons surtout une personnalité. Quelqu'un de curieux, enthousiaste, fiable, qui aime les relations humaines, les défis et le travail bien fait. Vous pourriez vous reconnaître dans ces quelques phrases : Vous avez une vraie fibre commerciale. Vous connaissez le monde du voyage et savez conseiller des clients exigeants. Vous avez déjà accompagné ou managé une petite équipe. Vous êtes à l'aise avec les outils numériques, les CRM et les chiffres. Le marketing digital vous intéresse et vous en connaissez les fondamentaux. Vous savez prendre des initiatives, vous organiser et aller au bout de vos projets. Vous aimez la randonnée, le vélo, les voyages ou simplement la découverte de nouveaux territoires. Vous êtes à l'aise en anglais professionnel. Et surtout, vous avez envie de vous engager dans une entreprise à taille humaine, où votre travail aura un impact visible. Nous accordons autant d'importance à votre état d'esprit et à vos valeurs qu'à vos compétences. 🌞 Pourquoi rejoindre Nature Occitane ? ✨ Une équipe à taille humaine , passionnée, bienveillante et engagée. 🏕️ Des voyages qui ont du sens , conçus avec soin, au plus près des territoires et de ceux qui les font vivre. 🌊 Un cadre de travail privilégié , entre mer et montagne, dans les Pyrénées-Orientales. 🌱 Une entreprise indépendante et en croissance , où les idées peuvent rapidement devenir des projets concrets. 💡 Une réelle autonomie , de la confiance et la possibilité de proposer, expérimenter et améliorer nos méthodes. 📍 Conditions du poste Contrat : CDI, 39 heures par semaine. Localisation : Alénya (66), à proximité de Perpignan. Rémunération : selon profil et expérience. Prime : possibilité de bénéficier d'une prime de partage de la valeur (PPV), selon les conditions définies par l'entreprise. Télétravail : 1 jour par semaine, le poste nécessitant un management de proximité. Avantages : titres-restaurant, mutuelle d'entreprise. Prise de poste : à convenir. ✉️ Envie de nous rejoindre ? Si vous vous reconnaissez dans cette annonce, nous serions ravis de faire votre connaissance. Envoyez-nous votre CV, mais surtout quelques mots pour nous expliquer ce qui vous donne envie de rejoindre Nature Occitane. Pas besoin d'une lettre de motivation interminable ou d'un discours formaté. Nous préférons une candidature sincère, qui nous permette de comprendre qui vous êtes, ce qui vous anime et ce que vous aimeriez construire avec nous. Au plaisir de vous rencontrer ! Guilhem Vabre Fondateur de Nature Occitane Find Jobs in France on Arbeitnow
