title: Senior Projectmanager
description: Jouw Missie bij CCS Geen dag is hetzelfde in deze rol. Samen met je collega’s zorg je ervoor dat wij succesvol onze softwareoplossingen bij klanten implementeren en dat onze klanten een excellente dienstverlening krijgen! Voor deze complexe systeemimplementaties en integratieprojecten zoeken we een zeer ervaren projectmanager. Je leert de verzekeringsbranche kennen en klanten helpen. Dat doe je niet alleen: je werkt samen met enthousiaste collega’s in een projectteam. Voordelen voor de sollicitant Als projectmanager krijg je veel verantwoordelijkheid, help je klanten en samen met je projectteam zet je mooie resultaten neer. Je kunt deels thuiswerken, deels op ons kantoor in Woerden en bij verschillende klanten in Nederland. Tijdelijk werken vanuit het buitenland kan ook dankzij onze workation-regeling (maximaal 30 dagen aaneengesloten per jaar). Bij ons draait het om klantgericht werken én werkplezier. Daarom is er volop ruimte voor ontspanning en plezier. Denk aan een levend tafelvoetbaltoernooi, pubquiz en een bier- & wijnproeverij. Ons actieve Fun-team zorgt elke maand weer voor iets leuks. En als je reislust nog niet is gestild met 25 vakantiedagen en een workation, dan kun je zelfs tot 20 extra verlofdagen bijkopen. Genoeg redenen om verder te lezen en te ontdekken of deze functie iets voor jou is, toch? Een voorbeeld van je werkdag Opstarten: Aan het begin van je werkdag heb je een dagstart met zowel collega’s als projectteamleden van de klant. Hierin bespreken jullie de voortgang, resultaten en eventuele hulpvragen. Na de dagstart: Allereerst neem je nog wat tijd met een van de consultants naar aanleiding van de dagstart. Je coacht en begeleidt de consultant en helpt deze met een hulpvraag. Vervolgens ga je aan de slag met het opstellen van de voortgangsrapportage. Hiermee zorg je voor proactieve en transparante rapportage over het project aan de klant. De stuurgroep met de klant is volgende week, vandaag spreek je samen met de delivery manager deze stuurgroep voor. Wat zijn de belangrijkste punten voor de klant en voor CCS en hoe vliegen we die aan. Na de lunch: Je checkt nog een paar tickets qua voortgang op het planboard, waarbij je de samenhang met de planning checkt. Vervolgens ga je naar de werksessie met het CCS projectmanagement guild. Hier werken jullie aan tickets om de CCS Prince2Agile projectmethodiek verder te verbeteren. Hierna heb je nog een afspraak met je collega van sales voor afstemming over een mogelijk vervolgproject bij de klant. Industrialiser l'ingestion de données : collecter les sources via Airbyte (API ou CDC selon les cas), gérer l'évolution des schémas et les tables externes BigQuery. La qualité de la modélisation fait la qualité des réponses. Maîtriser coûts et sécurité : réservations de slots BigQuery en autoscaling, routage dynamique du build dbt, revue FinOps mensuelle, least privilege, gestion des données personnelles et sensibles, sécurisation des accès data par l'IA. 👀 Comment on travaille Daily DE + weekly Data pour partager les avancées et débloquer vite. Décisions d'architecture co-construites et documentées, code review systématique, amélioration continue. Full remote pour les DE — l'équipe est distribuée, on sait travailler ensemble à distance. Une semaine par trimestre à Lyon avec toute l'équipe Data pour les sujets de fond et les moments humains. L'IA est un outil de travail quotidien : Claude Code, consignes par repo, marketplace interne de skills. La relecture humaine reste obligatoire — on utilise l'IA avec exigence. SQL confirmé + modèles dbt complexes (matérialisation incrémentale, snapshots, macros) que tu sais debugger (doublons, données tardives, suppressions, changement de schéma) et optimiser (durée, coût). Expérience solide en ingestion et orchestration de pipelines : debugging, dérive de schéma, reprise, backfill, analyse d'impacts. Python de qualité , testé et maîtrisé — maintenabilité et fiabilité au cœur de ta pratique. Infrastructure as Code et CI/CD au quotidien. Tu travailles avec un Coding Agent et tu sais prendre du recul pour vérifier ce qu'il produit. Tu es à l'aise en équipe partiellement full-remote . Anglais B2 minimum . Un gros plus Expérience sur une couche sémantique (dbt Semantic Layer / MetricFlow, LookML), sur le Knowledge Catalog GCP (ex-Dataplex) ou équivalent, ou plus largement sur la gouvernance de données : cataloging, lineage, classification, policy tags, ownership. Traitements en architecture événementielle et leurs spécificités (Pub/Sub, Cloud Run, scaling, rejets, retries). Intégrations dans des outils métier (HubSpot, Gainsight, Intercom). Pipelines data en Change Data Capture . Feedback rapide à chaque étape. Process transparent, pas de piège. title: Technicien Réseaux & Télécom Itinérant (H/F)
description: Poste : Technicien (position 2.1, coefficient 275, convention collective Syntec) · Basé en France · Interventions sur notre infrastructure, partout en France et à l'international Vous aimez le terrain, les sites qui ne se ressemblent pas et le moment où le lien monte enfin. Chez Azurreo, vous installez, raccordez, testez et dépannez notre propre infrastructure réseaux et télécoms, celle qui fait tourner nos activités et nos plateformes à travers le monde. Un poste de terrain, mais avec des horaires fixes du lundi au vendredi, des heures supplémentaires payées et inscrites au contrat, des frais avancés par l'entreprise, et vos habilitations financées si vous ne les avez pas encore. Qui nous sommes Azurreo est la branche télécommunications et technologies de Seelon Holdings, groupe d'investissement international présent sur quatre continents. Nous sommes un acteur de référence du test de performance des réseaux : notre plateforme SignalVerify mesure la qualité de service et la qualité d'expérience des réseaux dans plus de 144 pays. Depuis plus de quinze ans, nous accompagnons opérateurs télécoms, intégrateurs, constructeurs et grandes entreprises dans le déploiement et la maintenance de leurs infrastructures en Europe, au Moyen-Orient et en Afrique : plus de 250 projets livrés dans plus de 25 pays. Pour soutenir cette activité, Azurreo exploite et entretient son propre réseau d'infrastructures techniques en France et à l'international. C'est cette infrastructure que vous aurez en charge : celle qui permet à nos équipes et à nos plateformes de fonctionner, jour après jour, partout où nous sommes présents. À quoi ressemble une semaine Aucune semaine n'est identique : Installation. Montage d'une baie sur l'un de nos sites, raccordement, brassage, étiquetage, tests, mise en service. Dépannage. Une liaison qui ne monte pas depuis trois jours. Le plan de câblage ne correspond pas à l'existant. Vous cherchez, vous mesurez, vous trouvez, et vous écrivez ce que vous avez trouvé. Datacenter. Rack & stack, cross-connects, mise en place d'équipements actifs. Déploiement multi-sites. Plusieurs de nos sites dans la même semaine : bornes Wi-Fi, switches, configuration de base, comptes rendus. Missions à l'international. Certaines semaines vous emmènent sur nos sites hors de France. Journées base arrière. Préparation du matériel, gestion des stocks et de l'outillage, maintenance préventive, mise à jour des tickets. Toutes les semaines ne sont pas des semaines de route. Ce que vous ferez Installation et déploiement. Installation et mise en service d'équipements télécoms et informatiques sur nos sites. Câblage, raccordement et brassage. Déploiement de routeurs, switches, bornes Wi-Fi et équipements de connectivité. Préparation du matériel avant intervention, participation aux migrations et déploiements sur nos infrastructures. Maintenance et support technique. Maintenance préventive et corrective de nos équipements. Diagnostic des incidents et mise en œuvre des dépannages. Remplacement et reconfiguration d'équipements défectueux. Vérification du bon fonctionnement après intervention. Suivi et reporting. Rédaction des comptes rendus d'intervention, mise à jour des outils de suivi et des tickets d'incidents, gestion du matériel confié, participation aux stocks et inventaires, remontée des anomalies aux équipes concernées. Qualité et sécurité. Respect des procédures qualité et sécurité d'Azurreo et des consignes propres à chaque site, usage approprié des équipements et outils mis à disposition. Les technologies que vous rencontrerez Réseaux : TCP/IP, VLAN, DHCP, DNS, VPN, LAN / WAN Constructeurs : Cisco, Huawei, Aruba, Fortinet, Juniper Télécoms : fibre optique, FTTH, FTTO, RJ45, brassage, baies informatiques Datacenter : rack & stack, cross-connect, installation, maintenance Vous ne maîtrisez pas tout cela ? Personne ne le maîtrise entièrement. Nous cherchons de bonnes bases techniques, de la curiosité et de la rigueur. Le reste s'apprend. Parlons des déplacements franchement Les déplacements en France et à l'international font partie intégrante du poste : ce n'est pas occasionnel, c'est une exigence. Le rythme varie réellement selon les projets : certaines semaines sans déplacement, d'autres avec des découchés en France ou à l'étranger. Nous ne garantissons pas de rythme fixe. Le véhicule utilitaire est mis à disposition pour les interventions en France : ce n'est pas un véhicule de fonction et il ne rentre pas chez vous le soir. Les imprévus font partie du métier : matériel non livré, local fermé, câblage existant non conforme au plan. Il y a de la manutention, des faux plafonds et des locaux techniques exigus. En contrepartie : tous les frais professionnels sont pris en charge en amont, les horaires restent fixes, les heures supplémentaires sont payées, et vous ne passez pas vos journées au même bureau à faire la même chose. Le profil que nous cherchons Indispensable Résider en France Permis B en cours de validité Disponible pour des déplacements fréquents, en France et à l'international Formation ou expérience dans les télécommunications, les réseaux ou les infrastructures techniques Connaissances en réseaux informatiques, câblage RJ45 et fibre optique Capacité à diagnostiquer et résoudre des incidents techniques Français courant, anglais niveau A2 minimum (à l'oral et pour lire de la documentation technique) Maîtrise des outils bureautiques courants Autonomie, rigueur, organisation Capacité à travailler en mobilité et à vous adapter à des environnements techniques variés Apprécié, mais pas exigé Anglais au-delà du niveau A2 Expérience sur équipements Cisco, Huawei, Aruba, Fortinet ou Juniper Fibre optique : raccordement, soudure, mesures. Wi-Fi, datacenter Certifications réseau (CCNA ou équivalent) et habilitations à jour : AIPR, habilitation électrique, travail en hauteur, CACES nacelle, SST. Si vous ne les avez pas, nous organisons la formation pour que vous les obteniez. Formation : Bac Pro SN, BTS SIO, BTS CIEL, BTS Télécommunications, BUT/DUT Réseaux & Télécommunications, Licence professionnelle Réseaux, ou expérience équivalente. Ce que vous avez fait compte autant que ce que vous avez étudié. Ce que nous vous offrons Des horaires fixes du lundi au vendredi et pas d'astreinte Des heures supplémentaires payées, majorées et inscrites au contrat Des frais avancés par l'entreprise Vos certifications et habilitations financées si vous ne les avez pas Une formation continue réelle, avec accès direct aux ingénieurs de l'entreprise Des missions variées, en France et à l'international, sur notre propre infrastructure Une entreprise internationale à taille humaine Le processus de recrutement Étude de votre candidature par notre équipe recrutement Entretien RH, en visio (30 à 40 min), avec le recrutement, sur votre parcours, vos attentes et le poste en détail Entretien technique (45 à 60 min) avec votre futur manager, sur la technique, le terrain et votre méthode Entretien final (30 min) avec Adam Anbari, gérant d'Azurreo EURL L'embauche est conditionnée à une visite médicale d'aptitude au poste. Comment candidater Envoyez-nous votre CV. Pas besoin de lettre de motivation ; quelques lignes sur une intervention dont vous êtes fier (ce qu'il y avait à faire, ce qui a coincé, comment vous l'avez réglé) nous parlent davantage. Azurreo étudie toutes les candidatures à compétences égales, sans distinction d'origine, de sexe, d'âge, de situation personnelle ou de handicap. title: Performance Marketing Manager
description: Why we do what we do The mind is our window to the world. It can paint everything outside in grey or in bright colors. Whoever finds access to that window can change their perspective every day, and psychological hurdles can become chances to grow. Happiness spreads from one person to the next and across a whole society, like a quiet revolution, one mind at a time. Who we are Our mission inspires us and challenges us. Our skills, thoughts and ideas go into a product that reaches thousands of people, and that brings responsibility with it. The work asks for passion, integrity and the courage to try things no one has tried before. A team full of people who are crazy enough to think they can change the world they live in. Yes, we are a hardworking team, but not for us alone, not for money or personal fame, but for the people we serve at the center of our efforts: Our team, clients, psychologists on our platform and supporters across the country. Why this role exists Aepsy serves three audiences, each with its own timeline. Clients need support now. Psychologists are building their practice. Employers are deciding whether to unlock access for their whole team. This role leads performance marketing for all three: how people find Aepsy, what actually works, and what the numbers suggest we do next. Marketing at Aepsy is a small, focused team, and every role has a clear place in it. The Creative Marketing Lead owns copy and shapes the campaigns. The Art Director builds the visual language. The Growth Performance Architect owns the measurement architecture. You work closely with all three, bringing campaigns to the right people through the right channels, finding out what worked, and helping the team decide what to keep, change or stop. Performance with principles Our values shape how we advertise. Privacy is non-negotiable. Anyone visiting a mental health platform deserves the highest level of privacy and data security. That means no urgency or fear in our messages, no before-and-after claims, and no targeting or retargeting based on health data or other sensitive personal information. Sometimes this makes a number harder to reach. It also builds trust that lasts, and that trust is why people choose Aepsy. If strong performance combined with strong principles sounds like the challenge you’ve been looking for, we’d love to hear from you. What you’ll do Own performance across all funnels. Clients may decide within days. Employers take longer and involve several people. Together with the colleagues closest to each audience, you define what success means for each one. Run paid media end to end on Meta, Google, TikTok and LinkedIn. That covers structure, bidding, audiences, creative rotation, and both awareness and conversion, plus the judgement to know which of the two you’re working on. Read the numbers and get more out of them. The Growth Performance Architect builds the measurement setup with you. You turn it into insights the team can act on. Turn patterns into decisions. Why do people who considered Aepsy drop off before deciding? Does the response to a creative suggest it should run weekly rather than monthly? Answering questions like these is the core of the role. Shape how people find support. Search is changing fast, and new ways of discovering things are emerging. You’ll help decide how people find Aepsy when they need it most. Help build the team’s marketing rhythm. You’ll set up the flow for campaigns, newsletters and more, from first idea to delivery, so the whole team can rely on it. What you bring Three to four years in performance marketing, including campaigns you’ve run end to end and at least one that didn’t go as planned and taught you something. A data-driven mindset with a real feel for brand and content. Confidence running Meta and Google on your own, and experience with TikTok or LinkedIn for reaching HR leads and psychologists. Bring the channels you’ve found work best. Judgement that weighs data together with values. The field is sensitive, Switzerland is a small multilingual market, and the mission matters. Fluent (Swiss) German and English. Aepsy works in four languages, German is the largest market, and most partners and HR leads communicate in German. A habit of noticing a step that repeats and improving it, using AI in your daily work. Strongly preferred SEO and GEO basics, and curiosity about how AI search engines choose which sources to cite. Lifecycle marketing experience: segmentation, triggers and deliverability. Experience at an organisation with strong convictions, and enjoyment of doing great work within clear principles. What we offer Work that matters. Every campaign you improve helps someone find support a little sooner. Your skills serve something bigger than a conversion rate. A team that has your back. The Creative Marketing Lead, Art Director, Growth Performance Architect and Head of Marketing are each strong in their field. You’ll never have to face a number alone. A strong foundation. You’ll build on a product people trust, a network of qualified psychologists, partnerships with employers and insurers, and values clear enough to make hard decisions easier. Room to shape things. There are three audiences, several funnels, a content area being rebuilt, and a search landscape that AI is changing. Your ideas will have impact, and you’ll see it. A short line to decisions. You’ll report directly to the Head of Marketing and have access to leadership strategy. Modern tools , including AI, and the freedom to use them well. Time to recharge : five weeks of holiday and a mental health benefit (of course). Together with us We’re a young, ambitious team with diverse backgrounds and beliefs. We love conversations about the big picture and about the small details. We believe in what we do and work hard for a slightly better world. We’re also friends, parents, partners, stand-up comedians, yoga beginners and Zen monks who enjoy life. Sleep on it. Read it again. Then take a deep breath and send us: Your CV and a personal cover letter . We read every letter carefully, so tell us what motivates you, why this mission matters to you, and why this role, right now. Whatever shows your thinking best . A short note is enough. One campaign you can explain well is worth more than a full portfolio. In our conversation we’ll be curious about two things: a number that proved you wrong, and something you decided to stop doing. PS: Please skip the generic, AI-generated cover letter. A few honest lines in your own words mean much more to us. The time you save is better spent in the sun, on a walk in the forest or with a friend. title: Flight Test Instrumentation & Data Engineer
description: The Flight Test Instrumentation (FTI) & Data Engineer will be responsible for the end-to-end handling, quality assurance, accessibility, and long-term management of all flight data. The primary objective is to ensure that full-aircraft data, from the onboard sensors and DAQ systems to the final processing tools, is available to every engineering team through a reliable, efficient, and standardized workflow. Tasks Flight Test Instrumentation (FTI) & DAQ Pipeline Manage the data pipeline from the physical sensor and Data Acquisition (DAQ) level for the full aircraft, ensuring seamless and accurate transmission into the telemetry and storage systems. Maintain sensor configuration, calibration records, and metadata to guarantee the accurate translation of raw physical signals into usable engineering units. Collaborate with hardware, software and integration teams to define sensor requirements, DAQ architectures, scaling, and telemetry bandwidth allocations. Troubleshoot and resolve data anomalies at the DAQ and sensor level (e.g., signal noise, dropouts, faulty scaling) before they propagate into downstream databases. Data Infrastructure & Accessibility Maintain reliable extraction of flight data from InfluxDB. Develop and maintain standardized local data structures for analysis, plotting, and visualization. Optimize access to large flight datasets while minimizing CPU and memory usage. Design and maintain an efficient local storage solution for processed flight data. Support future improvements to the flight data architecture as storage requirements, sensor counts, and analysis needs continue to evolve. Data Quality & Analysis Support Maintain derived datasets to ensure common calculations and signals are shared consistently across teams. Ensure strict timing synchronization and timestamp accuracy across all recorded data, from the sensor acquisition point to the database. Monitor data quality, completeness, and integrity throughout the entire pipeline. Provide fast data previews for rapid post-flight reviews. Enable efficient access to high-frequency sensor data for detailed engineering investigations. Support custom querying of processed datasets. Requirements Education & Experience Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Aerospace Engineering, Computer Science, Data Engineering, or a related technical field. 3+ years of professional experience in test instrumentation, data acquisition (DAQ), or sensor-to-database time-series data engineering (aerospace, automotive, or racing/motorsports preferred). Hands-on experience working directly with physical aircraft/vehicle sensor installations, DAQ hardware, and telemetry pipelines. Technical & Domain Expertise 1. Hardware, Sensors & DAQ Architecture Strong understanding of physical sensors (e.g., strain gauges, accelerometers, thermocouples, pressure transducers, RTDs, LVDTs, pitot-static tubes). Demonstrated knowledge of signal conditioning, sampling rate selection, anti-aliasing filtering, scaling, and sensor calibration procedures. 2. Data Infrastructure & Software Development Proficient in Python or MATLAB for data analysis, automated data processing, and visualization library development (e.g., Pandas, NumPy, SciPy). Experience working with time-series databases, specifically InfluxDB (or similar engines), including writing efficient queries (Flux/InfluxQL) and data retrieval pipelines. Solid foundation in data structures and memory/CPU optimization when handling high-memory high-frequency continuous time-series datasets. 3. Data Integrity & Signal Processing Experience with timestamping and clock synchronization protocols across distributed DAQ hardware and storage nodes. Knowledge of basic digital signal processing (DSP) concepts (filtering, FFT, spectral analysis, decimation/resampling). Soft Skills & Work Style Cross-functional communication: Ability to bridge the gap between hardware technicians, flight physics/aerodynamics engineers, and software teams. Detail-oriented mindset: Uncompromising rigor regarding calibration metadata, unit conversions, and data accuracy. Adaptability: Drive to continuously improve data infrastructure as aircraft sensor counts, test frequencies, and analytical needs expand. Preferred / Bonus Qualifications Knowledge of standard FAA / EASA flight test instrumentation requirements or military flight test standards (e.g. IRIG 106). Familiarity with dashboarding tools (e.g., Grafana) for rapid post-flight previews and real-time telemetry display. Experience with version control systems (Git) and CI/CD pipelines for internal engineering tool distribution. Direct experience with DAQ systems and digital bus protocols (CAN bus, ARINC 429, MIL-STD-1553, Ethernet/UDP, PCM). Familiarity with binary flight data formats (e.g., IRIG 106 Chapter 10/11, MDF/MF4, HDF5, Parquet, or custom binary loggers). Experience with performing on-aircraft hardware troubleshooting (e.g., tracking down ground loops, signal noise, dropouts, or faulty scaling). Find Jobs in Switzerland on Arbeitnow

title: Founding lead Product Designer
description: Raison is on a mission to provide humans with better skills so they can feel confident and have more opportunities in the AI era. We help companies make sure 100% their teams master AI, directly in the flow of work (Teams, Slack) so that AI knowledge spreads across the organization instead of pooling in a handful of champions. We are passionate entrepreneurs believing that the ongoing AI revolution should be shared by all employees; and that the future of corporate interactions should not be restricted to private human-machine chats. Raison is capturing what champions create with AI, turning it into shared, governed skills, and propagating them so everyone feels capable and empowered; acting as a powerful lever to accelerate the AI transformation of corporates. We recently raised €2m from a top French VC + BPI and a selection of high-profile business angels who believe AI mastery is the highest-leverage application of AI inside companies. Tasks User Research & Discovery Own field research: contextual inquiry, user interviews, and observation of how teams actually work with AI and where it breaks. Build and maintain a deep understanding of our core users — individual contributors, champions, managers, and corporate buyers — and the context they operate in. Synthesize messy field data into sharp, actionable insight: jobs-to-be-done, adoption blockers, and the conditions under which a skill transfers between people. Establish a continuous discovery habit so research is a foundational reflex, and champion the user's perspective in every product decision. Product & Experience Design What our experts do by hand today is the spec for what the product must automate tomorrow. Your job is to watch that closely enough to design it. Design the surfaces: the client dashboard execs present to their board, the internal console our experts use to run a dozen live communities at once, and the conversations themselves. Most of our product lives inside someone else's client. You are designing in Teams and Slack, not screens we control — no onboarding, no landing page, no second chance. A four-minute message to an accountant who has never opened Copilot is the hardest design problem we have. Work mostly on enterprise, and partly on higher education, where we also have live deployments. Two audiences, two vocabularies, one product: part of your job is deciding what stays shared and what has to differ, so we build one coherent system rather than two half-products. Work hand-in-hand with our AI product engineers so your field learnings ship as features, then get re-tested at the next pilot. Own the design system: components, tokens, patterns, and the copy that goes with them. Requirements 4–8 years in product design, UX design, or a hybrid design-research role, ideally on complex, multi-user B2B products. A strong portfolio that shows both craft and thinking: we want to see how you operated, not just what shipped. A skilled researcher who can design a study, run it in the wild, and turn qualitative chaos into clear direction. Experience designing inside environments you don't control - a messaging client, an extension, an embedded product - or a clear appetite for it. Comfortable designing for AI-driven and adaptive experiences, where the interface has to handle uncertainty, personalization, and non-linear workflows. Excellent visual and interaction design skills: typography, spacing, motion, and the small details that build trust. Autonomous and opinionated, but you hold your opinions loosely when the evidence says otherwise. Genuine curiosity about AI and how people actually learn at work. Fluent in French and English, spoken and written. Spanish is a plus. You want the ownership, equity, and career-defining challenge that only comes from being early. Bonus: deeply passionate about something outside of work. Benefits A founding role with equity and direct influence on company strategy. Competitive salary, benchmarked to the Paris startup ecosystem. Flexibility: remote-friendly with regular in-person collaboration in Paris and an office in Montmartre with a beautiful Sacré-Coeur view. A front-row seat to one of the most important shifts in how humans learn. A small, sharp team that ships fast and trusts each other to figure things out. If you care deeply about making powerful tools feel human and want to shape a product from the very beginning, this is your role. Apply now and help us build the future of learning. Raison is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome applicants of all backgrounds and are committed to building a diverse, inclusive team. Find Jobs in France on Arbeitnow

Our wedge isn't one more training session. It's making AI stick across every team, and showing what actually changed. You'll need to tell that story in two sentences, on the phone and in writing. As a founding commercial hire, you'll work hand-in-hand with the CEO, our AE and the founding GTM/Ops. What you hear in the field will shape who we target and how we talk to them. Qualify every conversation against what actually predicts a deal: has the company already started acting on this before talking to us? Who is asking for results, and by when? Fluent in French and English. You want to grow into an AE role as the company scales. Benefits A founding role with equity and direct influence on company strategy. title: Responsable Accompagnement Clients - Transition énergétique des bâtiments
description: Chez Lowit, nous avons une ambition : accélérer et massifier la transition énergétique des bâtiments tertiaires. Face à la hausse des coûts de l'énergie, aux enjeux climatiques et aux évolutions réglementaires, les gestionnaires de patrimoine ont besoin d'outils fiables, mais aussi d'un accompagnement de qualité pour passer à l'action. C'est pourquoi nous avons développé une plateforme SaaS qui permet de créer le jumeau numérique des bâtiments, de piloter les consommations énergétiques et de construire des trajectoires d'investissement réalistes, chiffrées et adaptées aux enjeux de chaque organisation. Aujourd'hui, nous accompagnons plusieurs centaines de collectivités et d'entreprises partout en France dans leurs projets de transition énergétique. PME lyonnaise en forte croissance, nous recherchons des collaborateurs qui souhaitent avoir un impact concret, prendre des responsabilités et contribuer à une aventure collective porteuse de sens. Vos missions Chez Lowit, nous accompagnons chaque jour des collectivités, des entreprises et des établissements publics dans la gestion et la transition énergétique de leur patrimoine immobilier. Notre plateforme leur permet de mieux connaître leurs bâtiments, de piloter leurs consommations, d'anticiper les obligations réglementaires et de construire des trajectoires d'investissement cohérentes. Parce qu'une plateforme ne crée de valeur que lorsqu'elle est pleinement appropriée par ses utilisateurs, nous accordons une place essentielle à l'accompagnement de nos clients. C'est précisément la mission de notre équipe Accompagnement Clients. Pour accompagner notre croissance, nous recherchons aujourd'hui un(e) Responsable Accompagnement Clients . Vous deviendrez l'interlocuteur privilégié d'un portefeuille de collectivités, d'entreprises et d'établissements publics. Votre mission sera de construire une relation de confiance durable avec vos clients, de comprendre leurs enjeux et de les accompagner dans l'utilisation de nos solutions afin qu'ils en tirent le meilleur parti. Concrètement, vous serez amené à : Accompagner vos clients tout au long de leur parcours chez Lowit au travers d'échanges réguliers (téléphone, visioconférences, réunions et e-mails). Développer une compréhension approfondie de leurs enjeux afin de leur apporter un accompagnement pertinent et personnalisé. Les conseiller sur les sujets liés à la transition énergétique des bâtiments : réglementation, stratégie patrimoniale, performance énergétique, dispositifs d'aides, mécanismes de financement... en vous appuyant sur les experts internes lorsque cela est nécessaire. Réaliser ponctuellement des missions de conseil directement chez les clients afin de fiabiliser leur patrimoine, mettre à jour leurs données, construire des scénarios personnalisés et restituer des plans d'action auprès de leurs équipes de direction ou de leurs élus. Identifier les besoins émergents, détecter les opportunités d'accompagnement complémentaires et remonter les signaux business aux équipes concernées. Animer des webinaires, partager les bonnes pratiques et contribuer au développement de la communauté d'utilisateurs Lowit. Faire remonter les retours clients et les besoins fonctionnels afin de contribuer à l'amélioration continue de notre plateforme et de nos services. Vous travaillerez en étroite collaboration avec les équipes Projets, Produit, Commerce et nos experts techniques afin de garantir un accompagnement de grande qualité. Ce poste est avant tout un métier de relation client, de conseil et d'accompagnement . Vous ne serez pas seul face aux problématiques techniques : vous pourrez vous appuyer sur les expertises présentes chez Lowit. En revanche, votre capacité à écouter, comprendre les enjeux de vos clients et construire avec eux une relation de confiance sera déterminante dans leur réussite… et dans la nôtre. Vos compétences Nous recherchons avant tout une personne qui aime construire des relations de confiance dans la durée. Ingénieur(e) de formation ou diplômé(e) d'un Bac+5 dans les domaines de l'énergie, du bâtiment, de la thermique ou de l'immobilier, vous souhaitez mettre votre expertise au service de l'accompagnement client. Vous aimez comprendre les problématiques de vos interlocuteurs, les accompagner dans leurs projets et leur apporter des conseils concrets. Curieux(se), à l'écoute et pédagogue, vous appréciez autant les échanges humains que les sujets techniques. Une première expérience dans le conseil, la gestion de projet, le Customer Success ou l'accompagnement client constitue un véritable atout. Au-delà de votre parcours, nous serons particulièrement attentifs à votre capacité à : Créer une relation de confiance avec vos clients et communiquer avec aisance, aussi bien à l'oral qu'à l'écrit. Comprendre les enjeux techniques, réglementaires et patrimoniaux liés à la transition énergétique des bâtiments, ou avoir l'envie de développer rapidement cette expertise. Faire preuve de curiosité et d'une réelle envie d'apprendre dans un secteur en constante évolution. Organiser votre activité et prioriser efficacement les sollicitations d'un portefeuille clients. Travailler en équipe et mobiliser les bonnes expertises internes lorsque la situation l'exige. Être à l'aise avec les outils numériques et les environnements SaaS. Une connaissance des secteurs de l'énergie, du bâtiment, de l'immobilier ou des collectivités territoriales sera appréciée. Enfin, si vous aimez décrocher votre téléphone pour échanger avec vos clients, créer une relation durable et les accompagner bien au-delà de la simple utilisation d'un logiciel, vous vous sentirez probablement à votre place chez Lowit. title: Clinical Data Manager 50%
description: Join HEMEX, A European Contract Research Organization based in Liestal, Switzerland, dedicated to advancing global healthcare through innovative biotechnology research. As a Medical Monitor specializing in Pharmacovigilance and Medical Device Safety, you'll play a crucial role in ensuring the safety and efficacy of groundbreaking pharmaceutical, biotech, and medtech solutions. With our comprehensive clinical development services, including regulatory support and quality assurance, you'll have the opportunity to work on multinational clinical trials and contribute to the translation of novel concepts into market-ready solutions. Tasks The Clinical Data Manager is responsible for the planning, setup, conduct, cleaning, reconciliation, and closeout of clinical trial databases. The role ensures that clinical trial data are complete, consistent, accurate, traceable, and ready for statistical analysis and database lock. The Clinical Data Manager works closely with Clinical Operations, CRAs, Medical Monitors, Pharmacovigilance, Biostatistics, investigators, and sponsors throughout the study lifecycle. Functional Responsabilities: 1. Study Setup and Database Build Translate clinical trial protocols and endpoints into electronic Case Report Forms (eCRFs). Develop eCRF specifications in alignment with applicable CDISC (CDASH and SDTM) standards where required. Develop and maintain the Data Management Plan (DMP), the Data Validation Plan, and the eCRF Completion Guidelines. Define data handling, data transfer, reconciliation, and data security processes in compliance with applicable data protection requirements (e.g., GDPR and the Swiss FADP). Develop Edit Check Specifications and automated validation rules. Support database configuration and testing. Lead or coordinate User Acceptance Testing (UAT) of the Electronic Data Capture (EDC) system. Ensure database readiness and documented approval prior to study go-live. Train investigators and site staff on eCRF completion and EDC use, and support kick-off and investigator meetings as required. 2. Study Conduct and Data Cleaning Monitor incoming clinical trial data for completeness, consistency, and quality. Review data listings and identify missing, inconsistent, or implausible data. Generate, review, and track data queries to clinical trial sites. Use R programming to support data cleaning, validation, and preparation of clean datasets for Biostatistics, preferably following SDTM standards (ADaM derivations remain with Biostatistics), with appropriate documentation and quality control. Monitor query resolution and ensure that outstanding discrepancies are appropriately addressed. Maintain accurate documentation of data cleaning activities. Prepare data management status and metrics reports (e.g., query rates, data-entry timelines) for the project team and sponsors, and support risk-based quality management. 3. External Data Reconciliation Coordinate integration and reconciliation of external data sources with the clinical database. Define and agree data transfer agreements and specifications with external data vendors. Reconcile central laboratory data, ePRO/eCOA data, IRT data, imaging data, and other external datasets where applicable. Ensure that data transfers are complete, accurate, documented, and appropriately version-controlled. 4. Medical Coding Coordinate or perform medical coding of: Adverse events using MedDRA. Medical history using MedDRA. Concomitant medications using WHODrug or applicable standards. Ensure coding is consistent and appropriately reviewed, and that dictionary versions are documented and upgrades are managed in a controlled manner. Resolve coding discrepancies according to predefined procedures. 5. SAE and Safety Data Reconciliation Reconcile serious adverse events between the clinical database (EDC) and the pharmacovigilance/safety database at agreed intervals and prior to interim analyses and database lock. Work closely with Medical Monitors and Pharmacovigilance personnel to investigate discrepancies. Ensure that safety data are complete and consistent across relevant systems. 6. Database Lock and Study Closeout Coordinate the Lock Readiness Review. Confirm that critical data fields are complete. Ensure outstanding queries are closed or appropriately justified. Ensure protocol deviations and relevant data issues are appropriately documented. Coordinate final clean-file review with CRAs, Medical Monitors, Biostatisticians, and other relevant stakeholders. Execute or coordinate database lock according to approved procedures. Prepare data cuts and transfers for interim analyses and DSMB/DMC reviews as required. Ensure appropriate documentation of database lock activities. Support archiving and audit readiness, including metadata and audit trail documentation, and filing of data management documents in the Trial Master File (TMF). Keep documentation and handover notes up to date so that the named backup can cover planned and unplanned absences. Requirements Bachelor's or Master's degree in Life Sciences, Clinical Data Management, Pharmacy, Biostatistics, Computer Science, or a related discipline. At least 2 years of experience in clinical data management within a CRO, pharmaceutical, biotechnology, or medical device environment. Experience with EDC systems and clinical trial databases. Knowledge of clinical data management processes and database lifecycle management. Experience with eCRF development, edit checks, data cleaning, query management, and database lock. Wir sind über 200 Technikexpert:innen mit einer gemeinsamen Leidenschaft für SAP-Technologie, SAP Security und Platform Engineering – und das seit unserer Gründung im Jahr 2012. Wir sehen uns als kreative Köpfe und strategische Wegbereiter:innen, als Umsetzer:innen und Optimierer:innen, immer mit einer gehörigen Portion Spirit und Begeisterung. Genau diese Mischung macht uns aus! Wir kennen die digitalen Herausforderungen unserer Kundschaft und liefern die passenden Lösungen. Dank unseres tiefen Fachwissens und unserem ausgeprägten technischem Weitblick gelingt es uns, die IT-Landschaften unserer Kunden kontinuierlich an die komplexen und sich ständig verändernden Anforderungen anzupassen. Wir möchten dir da schon etwas mehr bieten: Flexibles Jahresarbeitszeitmodell : Bye, 9-to-5! Deine Arbeitszeit kannst du dir bei uns frei einteilen. Weiterbildung : Bleibe immer up to date – mit bis zu zwei Wochen bezahlter Weiterbildung kein Problem Zukunftsorientierung : Als globale Tech-Company leben wir am Puls der Zeit und blicken stets in die Zukunft. Tools : Digitale Werkzeuge – die Essentials deiner Karriere. Bei uns kannst du Laptop und Smartphone aber auch privat nutzen. Teamspirit : Teambuildings oder Grillabende – wir finden immer einen Grund zusammenzukommen. Come as you are! : Bei uns geht es um das, was du draufhast – nicht um das, was du anhast. Lieber Casual, Business oder etwas dazwischen - come as you are! Mehr Ferientage : Die gesetzlich vorgeschriebenen Ferientage sind dir nicht genug? Uns auch nicht, denn mit leeren Batterien arbeitet es sich nicht sehr gut! Workation & Entsendungen : Eigentlich am Schreibtisch aber mental schon wieder an deinem Lieblingsurlaubsort? Durch Workations und Entsendungen hat das Träumen ein Ende. Work-Life-Balance : Schon viel davon gehört aber nie erlebt? Bei uns bestimmst du deine Balance. Was macht es besonders, für uns zu arbeiten? Bei uns gleicht kein Tag dem anderen – Langeweile gibt es nicht. Du und deine Kolleg*innen werdet mit Blick auf eure Stärken individuell gefördert. Wir legen Wert auf Weiterbildungen und fördern den teamübergreifenden Wissenstransfer durch unsere Expertenteams. Zudem sind nahbare Führungskräfte und gezieltes Performance Management wichtige Bestandteile unserer Kultur. Teamwork makes the dream work – ist ja klar, oder? Jedes Teammitglied erfüllt eine wichtige Aufgabe, ohne die im Ganzen etwas fehlen würde. Wir sind uns sicher, dass diese Wertschätzung motiviert. Nicht ohne Grund sind wir alle mit Freude und Leidenschaft bei der Sache und erreichen dadurch Spitzenleistungen. Individualität macht uns aus: Teamwork ist uns wichtig, trotzdem verschwindet hier niemand in der Masse. Arbeiten mit Wohlfühl-Faktor Den itesys-Spirit haben wir ja schon erwähnt. Teamausflüge, gemeinsame Grillabende oder Office Brunch – wir finden immer einen Anlass zusammenzukommen. Bei uns muss niemand zum Lachen in den Keller gehen: in den Pausen herrscht eine lockere ausgelassene Atmosphäre bei dem alle willkommen sind. Beim Arbeiten kannst du jederzeit auf die Hilfsbereitschaft deiner Kolleg*innen zählen und musst dich nicht davor scheuen, Fragen zu stellen. Wir freuen uns darauf dich kennenzulernen! title: Engineering Delivery & Operations Manager
description: Joining Weezevent means working on tangible solutions used at international festivals (Hellfest, Boomtown, Tomorrowland, Lollapalooza, Boom), major sporting events (Formula 1, the Olympic Games, Euro fan zones), and high-volume live experiences. Weezevent builds the technology behind live events: ticketing , cashless payment , CRM , staff solutions and access control . We are about 100 people in the tech team (engineering and product organisation), part of a group that has grown both organically and through acquisitions, so our teams span several countries and cultures. We are at an inflection point. We are opening a focused 12–18 month window to invest heavily in the foundations of our main product, WeezTicket: paying down technical debt, tightening our architecture, and setting ourselves up for the next phase of growth. To run that program, we’re hiring an Engineering Delivery & Operations Manager (M/F, based in Clichy) to own its delivery. Vos missions This is a two-part role, and the first part is where you’ll spend most of your first year. Part one : deliver the program . A board of our most experienced engineers is defining the architectural direction and producing a large backlog of clean-up and improvement work. That work will be delivered by several external squads brought in for the program. You own the delivery layer between them: getting squads stood up and productive on time, tracking each one’s pace and quality, and keeping the whole program on schedule. Stand up and onboard external squads, around 20 developers across 5 to 6 squads, on time : access, environments, documentation, and a well-scoped first backlog ready before they start Track the delivery pace of each squad against its commitments, and keep a clear program-level view of what’s on track, slipping, or blocked Hold squads to the quality bar set by the architectural board : tests, reviews, and no new debt introduced while removing old debt Manage cross-squad dependencies so work lands in the right order Track program spend against budget and manage the relationships with the partners supplying the squads Report program status to the CTO and the board on a regular cadence Part two : become the operational backbone of engineering. As the program matures, you’ll take on the people-operations side of the organisation: helping our managers run great 1:1s and reviews, coordinating the performance cycle, keeping an eye on team capacity and wellbeing, and bringing rigour to tooling and budget. This is what makes the role a long-term home rather than a temporary program job. You’ll work closely with the CTO, the architectural board, our 4 Team Leads, and the external partners supplying the squads. You won’t set the technical strategy or write the code, you’ll make sure the right work gets delivered, on time, at the right quality. Help 4 Team Leads and 6 Squad Leads run consistent 1:1s and grow as managers Coordinate the performance review cycle and make sure follow-up actions actually happen Keep visibility on team capacity, absences, and early signals of overload or burnout Bring structure to tech budget tracking and to the governance of our tools and licences Support hiring and internal mobility alongside our recruitment team Vos compétences Must-haves Experience running a multi-squad delivery program end to end: ideally involving external agencies, consultancies, or contract teams A track record of onboarding external teams onto an existing codebase and getting them productive quickly Comfort owning a backlog, a schedule, and a budget across several parallel workstreams at once The ability to track pace and quality per team and raise problems early, with data Genuine tech literacy: you understand what developers do, can navigate a Jira board, and know what technical debt actually means Fluent French and English What makes you a strong long-term fit Some experience coaching or supporting managers, or running a performance cycle in a tech company A background that touched engineering, delivery, project management, or product before moving toward operations Analytical rigour: you’re comfortable with numbers, dashboards, and cost reports Direct, honest communication and real discretion with sensitive information Nice to have A third language (German or Dutch is a real plus given our footprint) Experience working across France, the UK, the Netherlands, or Germany, and an understanding of how management styles differ across them This is not A role that sets architecture or writes code; that’s the board and the squads A pure recruiter or a corporate-HR profile with no delivery or engineering exposure A process-for-process’s-sake job. We want impact, not bureaucracy The recruitment process HR interview - background and soft skills Interview with CTO - technical discussion All our positions are open to people with disabilities. Why it's a good move You’ll run a high-visibility program with the direct backing of the CTO and the most senior engineers in the company, in an organisation that has decided to genuinely invest in its technical foundations rather than just talk about it. And when the program lands, you’ll have built yourself a permanent, central role at the heart of how our engineering organisation runs. Find Jobs in France on Arbeitnow

title: Team Lead Infrastructure (Volunteer) - Startup Nights 2027
description: Start as soon as possible so you can join the current team at Startup Nights 2026 and take over with live context. Benefits Real ownership of a critical festival area and the chance to build its setup at a new venue. Direct access to founders, investors, corporates and other key players in the Swiss startup ecosystem. A driven team with short decision paths and meaningful responsibility. A chance to help shape the Swiss startup ecosystem through a non-profit initiative. This is a volunteer leadership role. title: Responsable Service Technique
description: Rejoignez Deltafluid dans une phase majeure de son développement PME industrielle spécialisée dans la conception et la fabrication d’équipements techniques à forte valeur ajoutée, Deltafluid connaît une forte croissance, portée notamment par son développement dans le secteur nucléaire . Cette croissance s’accompagne d’une transformation importante de notre organisation, de nos moyens industriels et de nos méthodes de travail. Dans ce contexte, nous recrutons notre futur(e) Responsable Service Technique , directement rattaché(e) à la Direction Générale et membre du Comité de Direction. Le poste combine donc management, expertise technique, structuration des méthodes et participation aux décisions de l'entreprise . Ces responsabilités correspondent directement au périmètre défini dans la fiche de fonction. Le profil que nous recherchons De formation technique, vous disposez d'une expérience significative dans un environnement industriel exigeant, idéalement dans les domaines de la mécanique, tuyauterie, chaudronnerie, équipements sous pression ou ingénierie industrielle . Au-delà de votre expertise, nous recherchons une personne capable de : prendre de la hauteur tout en restant proche des problématiques opérationnelles ; structurer et fiabiliser des méthodes et des processus ; manager et fédérer une équipe technique ; arbitrer et prendre des décisions ; travailler en transversal avec les équipes commerciales, projets, production et qualité ; piloter des projets techniques et des démarches d'amélioration continue ; évoluer dans un environnement normatif et réglementaire exigeant ; communiquer en anglais dans un environnement professionnel . La capacité à communiquer, négocier et arbitrer, ainsi que la maîtrise de la gestion de projet et de l'amélioration continue, font partie des compétences attendues dans la définition du poste. Pourquoi rejoindre Deltafluid ? Parce que ce poste intervient à un moment particulièrement structurant pour l'entreprise. Vous ne rejoignez pas un service technique simplement pour en assurer le fonctionnement : vous participez à sa construction et à son évolution . Dans une entreprise à taille humaine, vous disposerez d'un périmètre large, d'une forte proximité avec la Direction Générale et d'une réelle capacité à faire évoluer les méthodes, les compétences et les moyens techniques. title: Responsable Infrastructure et Sécurité des Systèmes d'Information H/F
description: Le Groupe Cybertek est un acteur majeur dans le secteur de la vente de matériel informatique et High-Tech en France. Créé en 1996, son siège social et ses plateformes logistiques se trouvent à Bordeaux. Cybertek possède 28 magasins sous les enseignes Cybertek et Grosbill, ainsi que cinq sites de commerce en ligne. Gouverner les comptes à privilèges : centralisation via un coffre-fort de mots de passe, principe du moindre privilège, journalisation, procédure de bris de glace et revue trimestrielle des accès. Maintenir les procédures de gestion d'incident et organiser un exercice de crise cyber annuel avec la Direction. Reporting et budget : Construire et suivre le budget infrastructure et sécurité ; animer un tableau de bord mensuel. Assurer un reporting régulier à la Direction Générale ainsi qu'un point sécurité semestriel en COMEX. Une bonne maîtrise de UniFi, OVH, Linux, SQL, Hyper-V ou Docker, ainsi qu'une expérience en environnement multi-sites (retail, distribution, logistique), constituent des atouts appréciés. Vous maîtrisez les environnements Microsoft Server, Linux, VMware/Hyper-V et Docker, ainsi qu'un hébergement cloud type OVH et un réseau multi-sites (firewalls, VPN/SD-WAN, Wi-Fi UniFi, téléphonie IP). title: Valve Lead Engineer
description: About Pangea Propulsion: We are a company dedicated to developing advanced propulsion systems for the space industry based on three key principles: high efficiency, sustainability, and reusability. We are revolutionizing the space industry with ground-breaking innovations that allow us to offer the best performance to cost propulsion systems. Our goal is to be the propulsion provider for the next generation of spacecraft, which is essential to meet demands and compete in the booming space market of the next decade. We are a passionate, multicultural, and multidisciplinary team pushing the boundaries of what is possible in space propulsion technology. We have already made history by successfully testing the world's first 3D-printed Methalox Aerospike engine, marking a significant milestone for the space industry. We are looking for talented professionals to join our international teams in Barcelona and Toulouse. We want to be a key player in improving diversity in the Aerospace sector as, in Pangea, we believe that diversity (gender, age, race, sexual orientation, beliefs, disability, culture, etc.) is a key to success. Within Pangea, everyone can grow with the same opportunities. We encourage you to apply. Individually we are different, but together we are an amazing team! We are looking for a Senior Valve Engineer (Technical Authority) based in Toulouse. About the role We are seeking a hands-on valve expert who will serve as Pangea’s company-wide technical authority for valves . The mission is to build the internal capability to specify, design, analyse, source, test, qualify, industrialise, and continuously improve critical valves for our propulsion systems. The first priority will be to assess and internalise selected valves used on Nereus , starting where technically and commercially justified with HTP-compatible valves . The scope can then expand to other valve families and propulsion programmes based on risk, recurring cost, lead time, supply-chain dependence, and strategic value. This is a senior individual-contributor role with strong technical leadership. title: Senior Security Engineer
description: <div class="content-intro"><h2>Our mission</h2> <p>We're making Africa the first cashless continent.</p> <p>In 2017, over half the population in Sub-Saharan Africa had no bank account. That's for good reason—the fees are too high, the closest branch can be miles away, and nobody takes cards. Without access to financial institutions, people are forced to keep their savings under the mattress. Small business owners rely on lenders who charge extortionate rates. Parents spend hours waiting in line to pay school fees in cash.</p> <p>We're solving this by building financial services that just work: no account fees, instantly available, and accepted everywhere. In places where electricity, water and roads don't always work, you can still send money with Wave. In 2017, we launched a mobile app in Senegal for cash deposit, withdrawal, and peer-to-peer and business payments. Now, we have millions of users across 9 countries and are growing fast.</p> <p>Our goal is to make Africa the first cashless continent and that's where you come in...</p></div><h2>How you'll help us achieve it</h2> <p>We’re looking for an experienced security engineer who’s independent, excited about getting things done, and ready to hit the ground running. You'll primarily be responsible for our application security, working with our product teams to work on new systems to enhance our security posture. Our customers trust us with their money, and you’ll be at the forefront of making sure we retain that trust!</p> <p>This broadly scoped role will allow you to get your hands on many different types of security projects, from direct application security to helping our infrastructure team think about security for our databases. </p> <p>As we integrate AI-powered agents into our engineering and operations workflows, you'll help define and enforce the guardrails around how we use them safely. This includes securing agentic tooling against prompt injection, excessive permissions, and data exfiltration — and building the policies and technical controls to govern AI usage across the company.</p> <p>Some experience with common industry certifications like ISO-27001 and PCI-DSS would be beneficial, although you won’t be expected to run or oversee audits.</p> <p>Our to-do list changes constantly, but here are some recent projects:</p> <ul> <li>Design our agentic SIEM/SecOps pipelines to evaluate and tune AI-driven triage, alerting, and response automation</li> <li>Secure our MCP integrations against prompt injection, tool misuse, and credential exposure</li> <li>Tune and maintain code security review agents tailored to Wave's codebase, threat model, and regulatory environment</li> <li>Develop internal AI governance standards covering acceptable use, data handling, and audit requirements for LLM-powered tools</li> <li>Centralise application-level login and permissions enforcement including privileged access management</li> <li> Rework our approach to secrets management with ephemeral secrets and tighter access scopes</li> <li>Security review of our public-facing APIs</li> </ul> <h2><strong>Key details</strong></h2> <ul> <li>You can work remotely from anywhere (between UTC -5 and +4) with reliable internet access.</li> <li>Wave covers travel once per year to one of our operating countries in Africa, as well as a yearly stipend of $1200 to meet with coworkers.</li> <li>Our salaries are competitive and are calculated using a transparent formula. For this role, depending on your level of experience, we offer a salary of up to $185,800 USD (or local equivalent), plus a generous equity.</li> <li>We run performance reviews twice a year and award bonuses or promotions to strong performers who have been with the company for more than six months</li> <li>Major benefits:</li> <ul> <li>Subsidized health insurance for you and your dependents and retirement contributions (both vary from country-to-country).</li> <li>6 months fully paid parental leave and subsidized fertility assistance.</li> <li>Flexible vacation, with most folks taking between 30-40 days per year.</li> <li>$10,000 annual charitable donation matching.</li> <li>Yearly travel to one of our African operating countries.</li> </ul> </ul> <h2><strong>Requirements</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Minimum of 7-8 years of professional experience with a minimum of 3-5 years of it spent in a security-related role</li> <li>Strong Experience with Python.</li> <li>Fluent English.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>You might be a good fit if you</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Are excited about finding the right balance between security and velocity. </li> <li>Have opinions on how to secure agentic AI systems and want to put them into practice</li> <li>Enjoy helping other engineers understand and implement secure patterns.</li> <li>Are not afraid to take on complicated systems.</li> <li>Are excited to work on lots of different security-related work, from audits to code refactors. </li> <li>Work to make things easier for the next engineer who will touch your code.</li> <li>Always try to improve as a programmer and colleague.</li> <li>Are interested in building governance frameworks for AI usage in a regulated financial services environment</li> <li>Have experimented with LLM-based security tooling and understand both the promise and the failure modes</li> <li>Push through hard problems without giving up.</li> <li>Have experience remediating non-conformities.</li> <li>Are interested in security-focused source code review and penetration testing.</li> <li>Have an interest in growing and mentoring a team.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>About Engineering at Wave</strong></h2> <p>You'll report to the Security Team Lead and work closely with the CISO, as part of a small 4 person security team, likely rotating with many of our Product and Platform teams, depending on the project you’re working on. Each team is led by a product manager and mentored by a technical lead on the team.</p> <p>You’ll be responsible for your own security projects as well as supporting the engineering organisation on security through advice and design review. We organize things to give you as much ownership as possible, so you'll typically be in charge of your projects from planning to delivery.</p> <p>Our stack (you only need prior experience with python and cloud technologies, if you need to work with anything else, we’ll train you):</p> <ul> <li>backend: Python 3 (+ mypy)</li> <li>API layer: GraphQL</li> <li>Android frontend: Kotlin/Jetpack</li> <li>iOS frontend: Swift/SwiftUI</li> <li>web frontend: TypeScript/React</li> <li>database: Postgres</li> <li>infrastructure: GCP / Terraform</li> <li>orchestration: Kubernetes</li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><h2>Our team</h2> <ul> <li data-stringify-indent="0" data-stringify-border="0">We have a rapidly growing in-country team in Senegal, Côte d'Ivoire, Mali, Burkina Faso, The Gambia, Uganda, Niger, Sierra Leone, and Cameroon plus remote team members spread across the world.</li> <li data-stringify-indent="0" data-stringify-border="0">We're deeply passionate about our mission of bringing radically affordable financial services to the people who need them most.</li> <li data-stringify-indent="0" data-stringify-border="0">We foster autonomy for our employees. title: Senior Information Security Officer

This transformation is commercially driven, enabling us to scale, deepen client relationships and support increasingly complex and digital markets.</p> <p>As Senior Information Security Officer, you will own ACT’s enterprise information security strategy and governance at Group level, spanning our core operations, emerging digital businesses and client-facing technology platforms. You will define the security risk appetite, lead our response to an evolving threat landscape, and ensure security and resilience are embedded by design as our technology landscape develops.</p> <p>Working across business and technology leadership, you will translate commercial ambition into a pragmatic and scalable security posture that protects our systems and data while maintaining the trust of clients, counterparties and regulators. In essence, your role involves:</p> <p><strong>Strategy & Governance</strong></p> <ul> <li>Own the Group-wide information security strategy and roadmap across ACT’s core market-making business and digital and client-facing platforms, aligned with business goals and industry frameworks such as ISO 27001 and NIST CSF. as ACT expands its use of AI.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Compliance & Leadership</strong></p> <ul> <li>Ensure regulatory and compliance alignment, including GDPR, DORA and relevant sector obligations, raising security awareness, and acting as ACT’s primary authority and trusted advisor on cyber security to executives and business leaders, working alongside existing teams and capabilities.</li> </ul> <p data-start="665" data-end="786" data-is-last-node=""> </p> <p> </p> <p><em> </em></p> <h2><strong>Your Expertise: </strong></h2> <p>To be successful in this role, we are looking for A relevant Master’s degree is an advantage.</li> <li>10–15 years of progressive experience in information security and cybersecurity, including at least 5 years in a senior security role, with ownership of enterprise security strategy, governance and risk management.</li> <li>Broad security leadership experience across incident response, cloud and infrastructure security, product/application security and regulatory compliance. title: Global Talent Acquisition Partner (f/m/d)
description: At Moss, we give finance professionals the power to automate their day-to-day and make forward-thinking decisions. Our culture is what makes that possible: we play to win, we obsess over quality, and we win as One Moss, and it works. Moss closed a €35 million Series C in August 2026, crossing a €1 billion valuation, and became one of Europe's fintech unicorns. Join us for what's next. Our Talent Acquisition team is searching for a Talent Acquisition Partner. You will play a pivotal role in helping Moss attract and hire the right talent for our our teams across Europe, mostly across our Commercial, Marketing and Operations departments . Reporting to the TA Director, you will join a team of five Talent Acquisition Partners across Berlin and London, covering every market and every role up to C-suite. Your responsibilities Sourcing, screening & managing candidates - identify, attract and engage with talent by using different sourcing techniques and channels. Manage the entire candidate journey from initial contact, coordinating interviews to offer management, ensuring a high quality candidate experience. Business Partnering - Own full-cycle hiring for your vertical end to end, from sourcing through offer, across Germany, the UK and the Netherlands. Work directly with the leadership and hiring managers on all their hiring needs. Develop deep understanding of the businesses you support to help them make better hiring decisions, not just fill vacancies. Process improvement - Identify opportunities to reduce friction points across the interview process and the candidate journey, and implement experiments and improvements. Share sourcing techniques and hiring intelligence with the wider TA team across verticals and markets. AI & Tooling - Contribute to making us more efficient and faster by leveraging existing AI workflows and helping us build new ones (Claude, chatGPT, n8n). About you We think you’ll need the following experience and qualifications to succeed in the role: Track record sourcing and closing high-calibre and hard-to-reach candidates, including through sourcing and direct outreach. Proven experience as a full-cycle recruiter, ideally hiring across multiple functions/locales. Demonstrated use of AI tools across daily recruiting workflow (a big plus if you're the one building them). Fluent in English (C1 minimum). Other languages, esp. German, a plus. In addition, here are the skills and attributes we are looking for: Inquisitive mindset - you ask sharp, insightful questions to really understand stakeholders and candidates Good judgement - you weigh information and observations to make sound judgement calls in ambiguous situations. Trustworthy and credible - you manage expectations, and build relationships based on a desire to help and support. Adaptive communication - you bring structure and clarity to how you present information, and this enables you to guide, advise, and influence those you engage with. The interview process will include an online assessment as an initial step, followed by an Intro Call, Hiring Manager Call, a Live Case Study and a Final In-person Interview in one of our offices. About Moss Moss is the Finance AI platform for Europe's mid-sized businesses, giving companies real-time visibility and full control over their spend. By automating card issuing, invoice management and expenses, Moss simplifies financial workflows and frees finance and accounting teams from manual, administrative work. Founded in Berlin and used by more than 10,000 businesses including Flink, Schufa, n8n and Auto1, Moss has raised €220+ million to date and operates in Germany, the Netherlands, the UK and further EU markets. In August 2026, Moss closed a €35 million Series C led by Portage, crossing a €1 billion valuation and becoming one of Europe's newest fintech unicorns. Moss is backed by investors including Valar Ventures, Tiger Global, Global Founders Capital, Cherry Ventures, A-Star. We're a team of 300+ people from 50+ nationalities across 5 offices in Europe and we hire, reward, and grow people based on Moss DNA : playing to win, obsessing over quality, winning as One Moss. If that's how you want to work, we want to hear from you. - here's what else to expect: Top-of-market compensation package, including equity. Our vibrant offices are at the heart of our culture, where in-person time fuels collaboration and connection over weekly breakfasts and Friday demos. Additional benefits include: 20 days “work from abroad”, 600EUR/GBP Learning & Development Budget, and other local benefits. Unless stated otherwise, benefits apply to full-time positions (interns and working students receive a tailored package). title: (Senior) Data Engineer - Tracking Infrastructure (m/f/d)
description: At Statista , we’re all about facts and data, for we are the world's leading business data platform. By providing reliable and easy-to-use data as well as various data analytics products and services, we empower people worldwide to make fact-based decisions. Founded in Hamburg in 2007, we have quickly grown into a global company with offices in major cities such as London, New York, Berlin and Tokyo. And we still have a lot of plans. Our constant growth does not only prove our success, but also keeps creating new development and career opportunities for our employees. We value and celebrate our diverse culture. You are welcome here for who you are, no matter where you come from, what you look like, or whether you prefer bar graphs to pie charts. Your story matters – keep writing it as part of our team. Are you ready to join us? About the role Join a growing data team and take ownership of our tracking data infrastructure, which captures millions of user events across our web platform every day. You will focus on operating, improving, and scaling existing data systems, ensuring data is reliable, cost-efficient, and accessible for analytics teams. This is a hands-on role with strong ownership and visibility across engineering and analytics. What you’ll do Own and manage tracking data pipelines and infrastructure (event data, web tracking) Ensure data quality, governance, and cost control (e.g. retention, storage optimization) Build and optimize ELT pipelines using Python and SQL Improve data ingestion and orchestration (Airflow, Prefect, APIs, S3, Iceberg, databases) Support the shift toward streaming and modern analytics use cases Collaborate with engineering teams (data producers) and analytics teams (data consumers) Enable internal users by making data reliable, well-documented, and easy to use Your profile Experience in data engineering within cloud environments (AWS preferred) Strong skills in Python and SQL Hands-on experience with data pipelines, orchestration tools (Airflow, Prefect), and APIs Familiarity with large-scale data systems and event-based data (tracking, logs, or similar) Experience with Snowflake (or similar DWH) Knowledge of infrastructure as code (Terraform) and CI/CD (GitHub Actions) Understanding of data architecture, testing, and best practices Bonus: experience with DBT, streaming tools, or BI tools What success looks like You take ownership of a high-volume data domain and keep it stable and scalable You improve data reliability, usability, and cost efficiency You collaborate effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders You bring structure to evolving systems while staying flexible in a dynamic environment What we offer In addition to our great team, culture, and our shared goal of empowering people with data, there are many other things that make Statista a great place to work! title: iOS Software Engineer
description: About ActAI There are over 5 billion users using basic applications today such email, notes, tasks, calendar and they're not AI-native. Our mission is to build proactive applications for anyone in the world, who are not used to complex prompting. We aim to bring intelligence to conversations, errands, organising and workflows, with minimal to no prompting. Our product focuses on achieving high reliability for long-running workflows, persistent context, and real-world task completion. We believe products will greatly reduce hallucinations. Our objective is to organise anyone's life, allowing us all to spend time on valuable and meaningful things. Role As an iOS Software Engineer, you own the iOS client experience, how AI feels, responds, and performs in users’ hands. This is not a thin integration role. You will build a production-grade iOS application where AI interactions are central to product experience, and performance, reliability, and user trust are critical. Focus Build and maintain iOS applications using Swift and SwiftUI. Integrate AI-powered features through backend APIs. Design UX patterns for AI interactions, including loading states, streaming responses, retries, and fallbacks. Optimize performance, memory usage, and battery efficiency.
