title: Senior software developer (C# / .NET, Data Analysis)
description: Senior software developer (C# / .NET, Data Analysis) Build the software that turns ultrasonic inspection data into safety-critical pipeline decisions worldwide, and lift the team around you. Location: Utrecht region (head office in Tricht, Gelderland) About Intero Integrity Intero Integrity is an internationally operating specialist in the inspection, maintenance and emission monitoring of pipelines and industrial assets. We develop our inspection technology entirely in-house: from ultrasonic measurement systems and FPGA signal processing to the software our analysts use to interpret hundreds of kilometres of pipeline data. The inspection results our software produces are used for safety-critical decisions about the integrity of pipelines and industrial installations such as heat exchangers. Reliability and correctness are therefore not a nice-to-have, but an absolute requirement. We operate across Europe, North America and the Middle East. Our software products sit at the heart of that work: they are used every day by our data analysis organisation around the world. Whatever you build here has a direct, global impact. The opportunity This is a role for a senior engineer who enjoys both sides of the craft: building excellent software, and helping people around you get better. You will work hands-on on the C#/.NET software behind our data analysis, turning large volumes of ultrasonic inspection data into reliable insights that our organisation uses worldwide. What makes it attractive is the mix. You mentor and guide our internal developers, setting an example in how we design, review and test. At the same time you work side by side with our external development partners. Learning from them, challenging them and making sure the work meets a high bar. You'll grow as an engineer and as a mentor, often in the same week. Because our data is used for safety-critical decisions, a strong sense of software quality runs through the role: it shapes how you design, how you review and where you set the standard for the team. If you value knowledge transfer and a healthy engineering culture as much as writing good code, you will feel at home here. What you will do Hands-on software development • You design, build and maintain C# applications for the analysis and reporting of inspection data • You work with large volumes of ultrasonic signal data and binary data streams • You build web applications and REST APIs on the ASP.NET platform • You contribute to bringing machine learning / Human-in-the-Loop capabilities into the data analysis workflow • You work with cloud-native services, preferably on Azure • You contribute to test strategies at functional, integration and system level, with an eye for the safety-critical use of the software • You work closely with hardware engineers, test engineers and domain specialists (UT inspection) Mentorship & working with partners • You mentor and coach our internal developers and help them grow their technical skills • You lead by example in code reviews, pairing and knowledge sharing • You work side by side with external development partners, challenging their choices and making sure the work meets a high standard • You help establish and document engineering standards: coding guidelines, review processes, testing strategies and release policy • You make sure design decisions and domain knowledge are documented and transferable, so the team can operate independently • You help shape a development culture where quality and continuous improvement are the norm What you bring Technical expertise • Extensive experience with C# and the .NET platform • Solid knowledge of software architecture, design principles and design patterns • Experience building web applications and REST APIs (ASP.NET) • Experience writing maintainable, testable, high-quality software • Experience with automated testing and CI/CD • The ability to mentor others and lift the level of a team • Good communication skills and the ability to clearly substantiate technical choices A plus • Experience with cloud development, preferably Azure • Experience with machine learning and/or image recognition, and operationalising ML in production • Affinity with signal processing, measurement data and data streams, preferably in an industrial or technical context • Experience with WPF and complex desktop applications • Experience in a domain where software quality and reliability have direct impact (industrial automation, medical software, measurement & inspection or similar) When do we see you as a senior? For us, seniority goes beyond years of experience or technical skill. We are looking for someone who understands that technical choices affect the product, the organisation and our customers, and who actively takes responsibility for that. You: • Form an independent view on architecture and technology • Think critically about requirements, assumptions and existing ways of working • Take responsibility for quality, also outside your own code, and recognise that in a safety-critical domain the bar is higher • Consciously build team knowledge: you document, explain and help colleagues grow • Are comfortable in an environment where not everything is fixed yet, and know how to bring structure to it • Actively contribute to knowledge sharing and continuous improvement within the team What we offer A senior role with real influence on our software products and how we build them, the chance to mentor and grow a team, and the variety of working alongside experienced external partners, in a domain where technology genuinely matters. Salary & terms of employment • Gross monthly salary between € 5.328,- and € 6.715,- based on a 40-hour week, depending on knowledge and experience • Year-end bonus, dependent on company results • 25 holiday days per year • Hybrid working (3 days per week at the office in Tricht as standard) and flexible working hours • Collective pension scheme, with Intero contributing 50% of the premium • Laptop and phone provided Working environment • Technically challenging problems at the intersection of software, hardware and data • Collaboration with experienced specialists across a range of technical disciplines • Free fruit at work, access to the Intero Gym, company fitness options and a bike leasing scheme • An international, technically driven working environment with plenty of room for ownership and initiative Ready to build with us? Do you want to write excellent software, help a team grow around you and work alongside strong external partners? Then we would like to meet you. Send your application and CV or LinkedIn profile to Questions about this vacancy? Get in touch with our Corporate Recruiter Veroniek Smits at the same address. Please note that for this role we do not work with recruitment agencies, and we're unable to accept unsolicited candidate submissions or related fees. Find Jobs in Netherlands on Arbeitnow

title: Teamleider Warehouse GEODIS Venlo

Over GEODIS GEODIS is één van de grootste Supply Chain organisaties in de wereld. Als onderdeel van SNCF Logistics, is Geodis nr. 1 in Frankrijk en nr. 4 in Europa. Met meer dan 40.000 professionals zijn wij aanwezig in 67 landen en hebben we een global netwerk in 120 landen. Met 5 business lines, Supply Chain Optimization, Freight Forwarding, Contract Logistics, Distribution & Express en Road Transport, managen wij dagelijks vol passie en commitment de supply chain van onze klanten. Onze missie: ‘we help our clients succeed by overcoming logistical constraints’. https://youtu.be/ncR_ijaWwqs Bij GEODIS hechten wij waarde aan gender equality, diversiteit en inclusie. Middels deze informatie willen wij u attenderen om te solliciteren op een functie waar uw interesse naar uit gaat en aansluit op de gestelde functie eisen. MBO-niveau verkregen door opleiding of ervaring. Kennis van en ervaring in de logistieke sector. Gedegen kennis van warehouse management systemen. Kennis van office applicaties. Medewerker luchtvracht / security awareness Certificaat ten behoeve van de relevante interne transportmiddelen (bv hef- en/of reachtruck, combitruck (TSP) is een pré. title: Projekt & Operations Manager (m/w/d)
description: Du möchtest nicht nur einzelne Projekte koordinieren, sondern die operativen Abläufe eines innovativen Technologieunternehmens ganzheitlich mitgestalten? Du behältst auch bei mehreren parallelen Projekten den Überblick, erkennst Handlungsbedarf frühzeitig und entwickelst eigenständig Lösungen? Dann könnte diese Position genau das Richtige für dich sein. Unser Kunde entwickelt und fertigt autonome Drohnensysteme, Einsatzsoftware und spezialisierte Lösungen für Industrie, Netzbetreiber, Behörden und maritime Anwendungen. Dabei entstehen hochspezialisierte Systeme, die Hardware, Software und autonome Technologien miteinander verbinden und bereits bei namhaften Kunden zum Einsatz kommen. Für die weitere Entwicklung des Unternehmens wird eine erfahrene Persönlichkeit gesucht, die das operative Tagesgeschäft übernimmt, Projekte und Ressourcen koordiniert und gemeinsam mit dem Geschäftsführer Strukturen für weiteres Wachstum schafft. Deine Benefits Attraktive Vergütung: Ein leistungsgerechtes Fixgehalt, das deiner Erfahrung und Qualifikation entspricht. Gestaltungsspielraum: Übernimm eine zentrale Rolle beim Aufbau und der Weiterentwicklung der operativen Strukturen und Prozesse. Verantwortung: Direkte Verantwortung für die operative Organisation und die Koordination zahlreicher Unternehmensbereiche mit 15 Mitarbeitern. Entwicklungsperspektive: Die Position bietet langfristig die Möglichkeit, sich zu einer zentralen Führungsrolle im Bereich Operations weiterzuentwickeln. Direkte Zusammenarbeit: Kurze Entscheidungswege und enger Austausch mit dem Geschäftsführer. Technologieumfeld: Arbeite an innovativen Drohnensystemen und autonomen Technologien mit anspruchsvollen Anwendungen. Unternehmenskultur: Flache Strukturen, offene Kommunikation und ein motiviertes Team mit hoher Technikaffinität. Mobiles Arbeiten: Homeoffice ist nach Absprache möglich, sofern es die jeweiligen Aufgaben und die operative Situation erlauben. Arbeitsumfeld: Moderne Ausstattung mit aktueller Hard und Software sowie kurze Wege zwischen Entwicklung, Produktion und Projektmanagement. Teamspirit: Regelmäßige gemeinsame Aktivitäten und Teamevents sorgen für ein persönliches und unkompliziertes Miteinander. Individuelle Benefits: Persönliche Wünsche und Vorschläge sind willkommen. Gemeinsam werden individuelle Benefits erarbeitet. Deine Aufgaben Als Projekt & Operations Managerübernimmst du eine zentrale Rolle im operativen Tagesgeschäft und sorgst dafür, dass Projekte, Ressourcen und interne Abläufe zuverlässig ineinandergreifen. Operative Steuerung: Koordination des täglichen Geschäftsbetriebs über die Bereiche Werkstatt, Produktion, Entwicklung, Projektkoordination, Beschaffung und Flugbetrieb hinweg. Projektkoordination: Steuerung mehrerer paralleler Entwicklungs-, Liefer- und Forschungsprojekte hinsichtlich Terminen, Ressourcen, Qualität und Budgets. Priorisierung: Wöchentliche Abstimmung der Projektprioritäten, Kapazitäten und Ressourcen sowie eigenständige Lösung entstehender Konflikte. Produktion: Koordination von Produktion, Ausgangsprüfung und Auslieferung der Drohnensysteme. Prozesse: Aufbau und Weiterentwicklung effizienter operativer Abläufe in Bereichen wie Projektplanung, Aufgabensteuerung, Einkauf, Lager und Qualitätsmanagement. Schnittstellenmanagement: Enge Abstimmung mit den Verantwortlichen aus Entwicklung, Produktion, Projektmanagement und weiteren internen Bereichen. Projektmanagement: Unterstützung und Koordination bei Kundenprojekten, Lieferungen, Abnahmen und weiteren operativen Vorhaben. Compliance: Koordination relevanter Themen rund um Exportkontrolle, Zoll und erforderliche Dokumentationen. Geschäftsführung: Entlastung des Geschäftsführers im operativen Tagesgeschäft, damit dieser sich stärker auf Strategie, Technologie und Schlüsselkunden konzentrieren kann. Weiterentwicklung: Erkennen von Verbesserungspotenzialen und eigenständiges Vorantreiben von Maßnahmen zur Skalierung und Automatisierung der operativen Abläufe. Dein Profil als Projekt & Operations Manager Mindestens fünf Jahre Erfahrung im Projektmanagement, Operations Management oder in einer vergleichbaren verantwortungsvollen Position mit technischen Produkten. Ein abgeschlossenes technisches Studium, beispielsweise in Maschinenbau, Elektrotechnik, Mechatronik, Luft- und Raumfahrttechnik oder Wirtschaftsingenieurwesen, oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation. Erfahrung mit technischen Produkten, die Entwicklung und Fertigung verbinden, idealerweise in einem Umfeld mit eigener Produktion. Mindestens zwei Jahre Erfahrung in einer verantwortungsvollen Rolle mit Führungsbezug oder der Steuerung von Teams und Projekten. Erfahrung in der Koordination mehrerer paralleler Projekte sowie ein gutes Verständnis für Termine, Ressourcen, Budgets und Prioritäten. Technisches Verständnis für mechatronische Systeme und die Fähigkeit, sich auf Augenhöhe mit Konstruktion, Elektronik und Software auszutauschen. Eine ausgeprägte Eigeninitiative und die Fähigkeit, Probleme frühzeitig zu erkennen, selbstständig Lösungen zu entwickeln und Themen ohne lange Abstimmungswege voranzutreiben. Eine ausgeprägte Hands on Mentalität und die Bereitschaft, in einem kleinen Unternehmen ohne große Stabstrukturen selbst Verantwortung zu übernehmen. Fließende Deutschkenntnisse und gute Englischkenntnisse. Bereitschaft zur Arbeit vor Ort sowie gelegentliche Reisebereitschaft für Kunden, Testkampagnen, Übungen und Messen. Diese Einsätze halten sich in der Regel in Grenzen und finden maximal etwa einmal pro Monat statt. Nice to have Erfahrung im Verteidigungs-, Marine-, Luftfahrt- oder Behördenumfeld. Kenntnisse im Bereich Drohnen oder unbemannte Systeme. Erfahrung mit Exportkontrolle, BAFA oder Zoll. Erfahrung mit Kleinserienfertigung. Kenntnisse in Jira oder vergleichbaren Projektmanagementsystemen. Kaufmännisches Verständnis für Kalkulation, Projektcontrolling oder Liquiditätsplanung. Erfahrung beim Aufbau operativer Strukturen in einem Wachstumsunternehmen oder Start-Up. Projektmanagement Zertifizierung wie PMP, IPMA oder PRINCE2. Deine Perspektive als Projekt & Operations Manager Die Position bietet die Möglichkeit, sich langfristig zu einer zentralen Führungsrolle im Unternehmen zu entwickeln. Du arbeitest direkt mit dem Geschäftsführer zusammen, hast einen umfassenden Einblick in die verschiedenen Unternehmensbereiche und kannst die operativen Strukturen maßgeblich mitgestalten. Klingt nach deiner nächsten Herausforderung? Wenn du technische Projekte nicht nur verwalten, sondern die operativen Abläufe eines innovativen Technologieunternehmens aktiv mitgestalten möchtest, freuen wir uns auf deinen Lebenslauf. In einem kurzen, unverbindlichen Telefonat geben wir dir anschließend alle weiteren Informationen zur Position und zum Unternehmen. Find more English Speaking Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

Hier geht es nicht um reine Produktpräsentation. Private Markets Fund Investing, inkl. Fondsselektion, Manager‑Due‑Diligence und Bewertung. Nachweisliche Erfahrung im institutionellen Fondsmonitoring, in der Portfoliokonstruktion und in der Erstellung von Investmentempfehlungen. Solides Business‑Development‑ und Strategie‑Profil im Finanzumfeld, inkl. erfolgreicher Zusammenarbeit mit Investoren, Unternehmen und Senior Stakeholdern. Sehr gute Kommunikations‑, Präsentations‑ und Verhandlungsfähigkeiten. Abgeschlossene Bankausbildung (vorzugsweise Sparkasse/Genossenschaft) oder wirtschaftswissenschaftliches Studium. Sehr gutes Deutsch (C1) und gutes Englisch (B2). Bereitschaft zu regelmäßigen bundesweiten Dienstreisen und Präsenz in Bad Homburg (ca. 3 Tage/Woche). Was hier nicht funktioniert Job‑Hopper – häufige Wechsel sind ein Dealbreaker. Fehlende Erfahrung im Private‑Credit‑ oder Private‑Markets‑Umfeld – kein Fit. Keine nachweisbare Fondsselektion, Manager‑Due‑Diligence oder Bewertung von Fondsmanagern – keine Basis für Erfolg. Unzureichende Deutschkenntnisse – Kommunikation auf Verhandlungs‑Level unmöglich. „Lone Wolf“ – nicht kompatibel mit teamorientierter Kultur. Benefits Attraktives Vergütungspaket: 75–110 k € Fixum + Bonus, Firmenwagen‑/E‑Auto‑Budget. Monatliche Shopping‑Card im Wert von 50 €. 30 Urlaubstage und flexible Vertrauensarbeitszeit. 2 Home‑Office‑Tage pro Woche (Hybrid‑Modell). Weiterbildungs‑ und Karriereprogramme (Inhouse, extern, Leadership, High‑Potential). Kita‑Zuschuss, Deutschlandticket, Dienstrad‑Leasing, Gesundheits‑ & Sportangebote. Was diese Rolle besonders macht Du bist verantwortlich für den bundesweiten Ausbau des Vertriebskanals – sichtbarer Impact von Tag 1. Du arbeitest in einem kleinen, hochspezialisierten Fund‑Solutions‑Team mit direktem Zugang zur Geschäftsführung. Du profitierst von einem unabhängigen Multi‑Asset‑Manager mit 65 Mrd. € AUM und erstklassigen Produktlösungen. Viel Verantwortung, viel Gestaltung, wenig Ausreden. Für manche ein Albtraum. Für die Richtigen: genau das, was sie suchen. Bereit? Dann bewirb dich jetzt als Sales Manager – Wholesale Fund Sales (w/m/d). Entscheidend ist, ob du über 3–8 Jahre nachweisliche Wholesale‑Fund‑Vertriebserfahrung und ein starkes Netzwerk zu Sparkassen/Genossenschaftsbanken verfügst. title: Senior Engineering Manager, Grafana Frontend | Germany | Remote
description: <div class="content-intro"><p>Grafana Labs is the company behind Grafana Cloud, the fully managed observability platform trusted by more than 10,000 organizations to ensure reliability, resolve incidents faster, and optimize telemetry at scale. Built on open source and open standards and designed for interoperability across any stack, Grafana Cloud brings AI to observability and observability to AI, giving teams (and their agents) unified visibility so they can see, understand, and act on all their disparate data, wherever it lives, and move at the speed of their ambitions. Customers, including Anthropic, Bloomberg, NVIDIA, Microsoft, and Salesforce, rely on Grafana Labs. We are a 100% remote company with team members across 40+ countries, backed by leading investors including Lightspeed Venture Partners, Sequoia Capital, GIC, Coatue, J.P. Morgan, CapitalG, and Lead Edge Capital. Learn more at <u><span><a href="http://grafana.com" target="_blank">grafana.com</a></span></u> and follow us on <u><span><a href="https://www.linkedin.com/company/grafana-labs/" target="_blank">LinkedIn</a></span></u> and <u><span><a href="https://twitter.com/grafana" target="_blank">X</a></span></u><u>.</u></p> <p>We’re scaling fast and staying true to what makes us different: an open-source legacy, a global collaborative culture, and a passion for meaningful work. Our team thrives in an innovation-driven environment where transparency, autonomy, and trust fuel everything we do.</p> <p>You may not meet every requirement, and that’s okay. If this role excites you, we’d love you to raise your hand for what could be a truly career-defining opportunity.</p></div><h2><strong>Senior Engineering Manager, Grafana Frontend </strong></h2> <h4><strong>The Opportunity: </strong></h4> <p>Grafana is an open-source observability product and a platform that teams and plugin developers build on. The Frontend group shapes its user experience (from dashboards and visualisation to navigation, search and sharing) and the foundations that support engineering teams and community contributors across the Grafana ecosystem.</p> <p>As Senior Engineering Manager, you’ll lead the Frontend Platform and Navigation squads, owning their performance, delivery and customer outcomes. Frontend Platform enables teams to build reliable, high-quality experiences; Navigation helps users find and organise resources and move confidently through Grafana.<br><br>You’ll develop senior engineers, partner with Product and Design, and improve how teams work, including through AI and automation. We use Cloud-first rollout and experimentation to learn quickly, bringing relevant improvements to OSS and Enterprise.</p> <p>AI Notice: We invest heavily in developer productivity. You can use modern AI coding assistants as part of your daily workflow (your choice of tools, within security guidelines), backed by a company-funded usage budget so you can iterate quickly without unnecessary friction. We encourage pragmatic AI-assisted development: faster prototyping, test generation, refactors, documentation, and incident follow-ups—always with strong code review and quality standards. You'll also have access to the latest frontier models from OpenAI, Anthropic, and Google.</p> <p><strong>What You’ll Be Doing:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Be accountable for the performance of <strong>two</strong> distributed engineering squads: set clear expectations, delegate effectively, coach and develop each team member, give timely feedback, address performance gaps and build a culture of trust and accountability.</li> <li>Own hiring and team planning across both squads, aligning team capacity and skills with product priorities and longer-term needs.</li> <li>Lead discovery with your squads: engage directly with customers, community members and internal users, combine their feedback with research and usage evidence, and use those insights to shape roadmaps and priorities.</li> <li>Partner with Product, Design and engineering leaders to set priorities, resolve dependencies and make trade-offs between customer needs, long-term investments and operational demands.</li> <li>Own delivery across both squads from discovery through rollout and measurement: set milestones, surface risks early and intervene when commitments are at risk.</li> <li>Use AI regularly in your management work to synthesise research and feedback, inform roadmap and resourcing decisions, and streamline coordination, reporting and follow-through.</li> <li>Improve how the squads plan, make decisions and deliver. Lead the adoption of AI and automation across engineering and operational workflows, evaluating their impact on delivery speed, quality and time spent on repetitive work.</li> <li>Set engineering direction with senior engineers for the frontend foundations owned by your squads, including developer experience, accessibility, architecture, tooling, reliability and multitenant capabilities.</li> <li>Set engineering direction for navigation, search and resource organisation, including where AI-assisted discovery can help users find what they need.</li> <li>Set and uphold engineering standards for quality, security and operability, including how teams evaluate and validate AI-assisted work.</li> <li>Lead improvements across Grafana and R&D that increase engineering productivity and improve business outcomes.</li> <li>Participate in the engineering management on-call rota, coordinate responses and drive improvements that reduce recurring disruption. Regularly use Grafana’s AI capabilities for observability, incident investigation and management, bringing that experience into product feedback and roadmap decisions.</li> </ul> <p><strong>What Makes You a Great Fit</strong></p> <ul> <li>Significant experience managing senior engineers, building healthy teams and developing technical leaders. You give clear feedback and address performance gaps directly and fairly.</li> <li>A strong technical foundation in modern web or frontend systems, enabling you to evaluate technical trade-offs and shape architectural and engineering-quality decisions with senior engineers.</li> <li>A track record of turning ambiguous, cross-team problems into clear priorities and measurable results, managing delivery risks and operational demands.</li> <li>Strong product and customer judgement, with the ability to connect engineering investments to user, developer and business outcomes.</li> <li>Clear, concise written communication and the ability to work effectively in a remote, globally distributed organisation.</li> <li>An appreciation for open-source development and the judgement to balance Cloud-first delivery with the needs of customers, community members and internal teams.</li> <li>Practical experience using AI and automation in your own leadership work, and leading teams to adopt them effectively. </li> </ul> <h4><strong>Bonus Points For</strong></h4> <ul> <li>Experience with React, TypeScript or comparable large-scale frontend ecosystems.</li> <li>Experience leading a developer platform team, including support for plugins or extensions.</li> <li>Experience with navigation, search, information architecture or resource-management products.</li> <li>Experience delivering multitenant SaaS or major platform migrations.</li> <li>Experience working on a widely adopted open-source product.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Compensation & Rewards:</strong></p> <p>In Germany, the Base compensation range for this role is EUR <span data-sheets-root="1">124,571</span><span data-sheets-root="1"> </span>- EUR <span data-sheets-root="1">149,485</span>. Actual compensation may vary based on level, experience, and skillset as assessed in the interview process. </p> <p>All of our roles include Restricted Stock Units (RSUs), giving every team member ownership in Grafana Labs' success. We believe in shared outcomes—RSUs help us stay aligned and invested as we scale globally.</p><div class="content-conclusion"><div> <p><em data-stringify-type="italic">*Compensation ranges are country specific. If you are applying for this role from a different location than listed above, your recruiter will discuss your specific market’s defined pay range & benefits at the beginning of the process.</em></p> <p><strong>Why You’ll Thrive at Grafana Labs:</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong data-stringify-type="bold">100% Remote, Global Culture - </strong>As a remote-only company, we bring together talent from around the world, united by a culture of collaboration and shared purpose.</li> <li><strong>Scaling Organization</strong> – Tackle meaningful work in a high-growth, ever-evolving environment.</li> <li><strong>Transparent Communication</strong> – Expect open decision-making and regular company-wide updates.</li> <li><strong>Innovation-Driven</strong> – Autonomy and support to ship great work and try new things.</li> <li><strong>Open Source Roots</strong> – Built on community-driven values that shape how we work.</li> <li><strong>Empowered Teams</strong> – High trust, low ego culture that values outcomes over optics.</li> <li><strong>Career Growth Pathways</strong> – Defined opportunities to grow and develop your career.</li> <li><strong>Approachable Leadership</strong> – Transparent execs who are involved, visible, and human.</li> <li><strong>Passionate People</strong> – Join a team of smart, supportive folks who care deeply about what they do.</li> <li><strong>In-Person onboarding </strong>- We want you to thrive from day 1 with your fellow new ‘Grafanistas’ to learn all about what we do and how we do it. </li> <li><strong>Balance is Key</strong> - We operate a global annual leave policy of 30 days per annum. 3 days of your annual leave entitlement are reserved for Grafana Shutdown Days to allow the team to really disconnect. <em>*We will comply with local legislation where applicable.</em></li> </ul> <p><strong>Equal Opportunity Employer:</strong> <em>Grafana Labs is an equal opportunities employer. We welcome applications from everyone regardless of race, colour, nationality, origin, caste, sex, gender reassignment identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, religion or belief, disability, veteran status, genetic information, pregnancy, maternity, marital, family or carer status, or any other characteristic which is protected by local law. We believe that equality and diversity build a strong organisation, and we work hard to ensure that is the foundation of our organisation as we grow.</em></p> <p><em data-stringify-type="italic">Grafana Labs may utilize AI tools in its recruitment process to assist in matching information provided in CVs to job postings. The recruitment team will continue to review inbound CVs manually to identify alignment with current openings.</em></p> <p>#LI-

Regularly use Grafana’s AI capabilities for observability, incident investigation and management, bringing that experience into product feedback and roadmap decisions.</li> </ul> <p><strong>What Makes You a Great Fit</strong></p> <ul> <li>Significant experience managing senior engineers, building healthy teams and developing technical leaders. You give clear feedback and address performance gaps directly and fairly.</li> <li>A strong technical foundation in modern web or frontend systems, enabling you to evaluate technical trade-offs and shape architectural and engineering-quality decisions with senior engineers.</li> <li>A track record of turning ambiguous, cross-team problems into clear priorities and measurable results, managing delivery risks and operational demands.</li> <li>Strong product and customer judgement, with the ability to connect engineering investments to user, developer and business outcomes.</li> <li>Clear, concise written communication and the ability to work effectively in a remote, globally distributed organisation.</li> <li>An appreciation for open-source development and the judgement to balance Cloud-first delivery with the needs of customers, community members and internal teams.</li> <li>Practical experience using AI and automation in your own leadership work, and leading teams to adopt them effectively. </li> </ul> <h4><strong>Bonus Points For</strong></h4> <ul> <li>Experience with React, TypeScript or comparable large-scale frontend ecosystems.</li> <li>Experience leading a developer platform team, including support for plugins or extensions.</li> <li>Experience with navigation, search, information architecture or resource-management products.</li> <li>Experience delivering multitenant SaaS or major platform migrations.</li> <li>Experience working on a widely adopted open-source product.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Compensation & Rewards:</strong></p> <p>In the United Kingdom, the Base compensation range for this role is GBP <span data-sheets-root="1">117,949</span><span data-sheets-root="1"> </span>- GBP <span data-sheets-root="1">141,539</span>. Actual compensation may vary based on level, experience, and skillset as assessed in the interview process.  </p> <p>All of our roles include Restricted Stock Units (RSUs), giving every team member ownership in Grafana Labs' success. We believe in shared outcomes—RSUs help us stay aligned and invested as we scale globally.</p><div class="content-conclusion"><div> <p><em data-stringify-type="italic">*Compensation ranges are country specific. If you are applying for this role from a different location than listed above, your recruiter will discuss your specific market’s defined pay range & benefits at the beginning of the process.</em></p> <p><strong>Why You’ll Thrive at Grafana Labs:</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong data-stringify-type="bold">100% Remote, Global Culture - </strong>As a remote-only company, we bring together talent from around the world, united by a culture of collaboration and shared purpose.</li> <li><strong>Scaling Organization</strong> – Tackle meaningful work in a high-growth, ever-evolving environment.</li> <li><strong>Transparent Communication</strong> – Expect open decision-making and regular company-wide updates.</li> <li><strong>Innovation-Driven</strong> – Autonomy and support to ship great work and try new things.</li> <li><strong>Open Source Roots</strong> – Built on community-driven values that shape how we work.</li> <li><strong>Empowered Teams</strong> – High trust, low ego culture that values outcomes over optics.</li> <li><strong>Career Growth Pathways</strong> – Defined opportunities to grow and develop your career.</li> <li><strong>Approachable Leadership</strong> – Transparent execs who are involved, visible, and human.</li> <li><strong>Passionate People</strong> – Join a team of smart, supportive folks who care deeply about what they do.</li> <li><strong>In-Person onboarding </strong>- We want you to thrive from day 1 with your fellow new ‘Grafanistas’ to learn all about what we do and how we do it. </li> <li><strong>Balance is Key</strong> - We operate a global annual leave policy of 30 days per annum. 3 days of your annual leave entitlement are reserved for Grafana Shutdown Days to allow the team to really disconnect. <em>*We will comply with local legislation where applicable.</em></li> </ul> <p><strong>Equal Opportunity Employer:</strong> <em>Grafana Labs is an equal opportunities employer. title: Director, European Government Operations
description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong>ABOUT ROCKET LAB</strong></p> <p>Rocket Lab is the end-to-end space company building rockets, spacecraft, and critical subsystems that keep the world connected, protected, expand humanity’s reach to the Moon, Mars, and beyond. We move fast, build real hardware for meaningful missions, and make the impossible routine. Come shape the future with us.</p></div><p><strong>DIRECTOR – EUROPEAN GOVERNMENT OPERATIONS</strong></p> <p>As the Director – European Government Operations, based in <strong>Munich/ Berlin, </strong>Germany, you will lead Rocket Lab’s government affairs strategy across Germany and the broader European region. You will play a critical role in advancing Rocket Lab’s business objectives by shaping policy environments, building strategic government relationships, and ensuring alignment between Government Affairs and Business Development. In this role, you will work at the intersection of aerospace innovation, national security, and European public-sector engagement. To be successful, you must be results‑oriented, proactive, politically astute, and deeply comfortable operating in complex, fast‑moving environments. Join a driven team of pioneers relentlessly tackling challenging projects, delivering on the impossible, and making an impact on the future of space.</p> <p><strong>WHAT YOU’LL GET TO DO</strong></p> <ul> <li>Build and lead Rocket Lab’s in‑house European Government Operations function, delivering the same level of strategic support and government engagement the company receives in the U.S. market</li> <li>Develop and lead Rocket Lab’s government affairs strategy in Germany and across Europe, ensuring alignment with corporate priorities and business development objectives</li> <li>Build and maintain high‑impact relationships with key German federal stakeholders, including the Bundestag, DLR, Ministry of Defense, and relevant regulatory and executive agencies</li> <li>Establish and grow Rocket Lab’s presence with government entities and innovation ecosystems in Munich and other strategic European hubs</li> <li>Partner closely with the Business Development team to support market expansion, customer engagement, and pursuit of government‑funded programs</li> <li>Shape and influence policy discussions related to space, defense, launch, and emerging technologies, ensuring Rocket Lab’s interests are represented and understood</li> <li>Provide strategic guidance on political, regulatory, and industrial‑policy developments across Europe, identifying opportunities and risks for business</li> <li>Represent Rocket Lab in industry associations, working groups, and public‑sector forums to strengthen the company’s visibility and credibility</li> <li>Drive measurable business outcomes through targeted government engagement not only monitoring policy trends but actively shaping them</li> <li>Serve as a trusted advisor to senior leadership on European political dynamics, defense priorities, and government procurement pathways</li> </ul> <p><strong>YOU’LL BRING THESE QUALIFICATIONS</strong></p> <ul> <li>Bachelor’s degree in political science, international relations, public policy, law, economics, engineering, or a related field</li> <li>12+ years of experience in government affairs, public policy, defense, aerospace, or related strategic roles within Germany or Europe</li> <li>Professional fluency in German and English</li> <li>Demonstrated success building and managing relationships with senior government officials, policymakers, and public‑sector institutions</li> <li>Proven ability to drive business‑aligned outcomes through government engagement, not solely policy monitoring</li> <li>Strong understanding of European political structures, defense priorities, and government procurement processes</li> <li>Ability to operate autonomously, set strategy, and execute in a fast‑paced, high‑growth environment</li> <li>Exceptional communication, negotiation, and stakeholder‑management skills</li> </ul> <p><strong>THESE QUALIFICATIONS WOULD BE NICE TO HAVE</strong></p> <ul> <li>Background in space, aerospace, defense, or dual‑use technology sectors</li> <li>Experience working with or within institutions such as DLR, MOD, Bundestag committees, EU defense bodies, or national innovation agencies</li> <li>Prior roles in business development, defense industrial policy, or public‑sector consulting</li> <li>Experience working in Munich’s government, defense, or technology ecosystem</li> <li>Familiarity with NATO, EU defense initiatives, and cross‑border industrial‑cooperation frameworks</li> </ul> <p><em><u>This position may require prolonged periods of sitting, standing, walking, computer work, and occasional exposure to moderate levels of noise, dust, and fumes in production areas</u></em>.</p> <p> </p><div class="content-conclusion"><p><strong><span data-contrast="auto">WHAT TO EXPECT</span></strong><span data-ccp-props="{"134233117":false,"134233118":false,"201341983":0,"335551550":1,"335551620":1,"335559685":0,"335559737":0,"335559738":0,"335559739":0,"335559740":240}"> </span></p> <p><span data-contrast="auto">We’re on a mission to unlock the potential of space to improve life on Earth, but that’s not an easy task. It takes hard work, determination, relentless innovation, teamwork, grit, and an unwavering commitment to achieving what others often deem impossible. Our people out-think, out-work, and out-pace. We pride ourselves on having each other’s backs, checking our egos at the door, and rolling up our sleeves on all tasks big and small. We thrive under pressure, work to tight deadlines, and our focus is always on how we can deliver, rather than dwelling on the challenges that stand in the way.  </span><span data-ccp-props="{"201341983":0,"335559739":0,"335559740":240}"> </span></p> <p>Important information:</p> <p><span style="text-decoration: underline;"><strong>FOR CANDIDATES SEEKING TO WORK IN US OFFICES ONLY:</strong></span></p> <p><em>To conform to U.S. Government space technology export regulations, including the International Traffic in Arms Regulations (ITAR), Rocket Lab Employees must be a U.S. citizen, lawful U.S. permanent resident (i.e., current Green Card holder), or lawfully admitted into the U.S. as a refugee or granted asylum, or be eligible to obtain the required authorizations from the U.S. Department of State and/or the U.S. Department of Commerce, as applicable. Learn more about ITAR <a href="https://urldefense.us/v2/url?u=https-3A__www.pmddtc.state.gov_-3Fid-3Dddtc-5Fkb-5Farticle-5Fpage-26sys-5Fid-3D24d528fddbfc930044f9ff621f961987&d=DwMFog&c=N_fLK0KxmM34zjMadXHMx_SQYmXWO3FX0MRVr1hBcn4&r=prjnch9sxomG2ahCicblmM3m-FuPObepspoR1qvWq2I&m=ExC44mBPk2emo4Fr0xPSGZN0UraQ1ZtkDTxwR7iWw5rixcFQb-Wjlv7lJcecLldz&s=0lfm4LyRtFwK220WHBK11DGHWSVvVhQEcfa5G_2Nf18&e=">here</a>.</em></p> <p><em>Rocket Lab provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local laws. This policy applies to all terms and conditions of employment at Rocket Lab, including recruiting, hiring, placement, promotion, termination, layoff, recall, transfer, leaves of absence, compensation, and training.</em></p> <p><em>Applicants requiring a reasonable accommodation for the application/interview process for a job in the United States should contact Giulia Johnson at <a ---------- dedicated resource is intended solely to assist job seekers with disabilities whose disability prevents them from being able to apply/interview. Only messages left for this purpose will be considered. A response to your request may take up to two business days.</em></p> <p><span style="text-decoration: underline;"><strong>FOR CANDIDATES SEEKING TO WORK IN NEW ZEALAND OFFICES ONLY:</strong></span></p> <p><em>For security reasons, background checks will be undertaken prior to any employment offers being made to an applicant.  These checks will include nationality checks as it is a requirement of this position that you be eligible to access equipment and data regulated by the United States' International Traffic in Arms Regulations. </em></p> <p><em>Under these Regulations, you may be ineligible for this role if you do not hold citizenship of Australia, Japan, New Zealand, Switzerland, the European Union, or a country that is part of NATO, or if you hold ineligible dual citizenship or nationality.  For more information on these Regulations, click here <a class="fui-Link ___m14voj0 f3rmtva f1ern45e f1deefiw f1n71otn f1q5o8ev f1h8hb77 f1vxd6vx f1ewtqcl fyind8e f1k6fduh f1w7gpdv fk6fouc fjoy568 figsok6 f1hu3pq6 f11qmguv f19f4twv f1tyq0we f1g0x7ka fhxju0i f1qch9an f1cnd47f fqv5qza f1vmzxwi f1o700av f13mvf36 f9n3di6 f1ids18y fygtlnl f1deo86v f12x56k7 f1iescvh ftqa4ok f50u1b5 fs3pq8b f1hghxdh f1tymzes f1x7u7e9 f1cmlufx f10aw75t fsle3fq" href="https://www.federalregister.gov/documents/2020/01/23/2020-00574/international-traffic-in-arms-regulations-us-munitions-list-categories-i-ii-and-iii" target="_blank">ITAR Regulations.</a></em></p></div> Find Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

title: Group Digital Director
description: <div class="content-intro"><p>GumGum is The Mindset Company™ transforming advertising. We’re an advertising technology company delivering results by matching brands with people in the right mindset in the moments that matter. Our platform is powered by the Mindset Graph™, our AI-driven data engine that processes billions of real-time contextual, creative, environmental, and historical signals to match every ad with the most receptive audience. The result is advertising that drives meaningful outcomes for advertisers and publishers, and is more relevant for consumers.</p> <p>We were founded in 2008 and are headquartered in Santa Monica, California, operating in over 19 markets across North America, Europe, Japan, and Australia.</p> <p>Our principles guide our work every day and are as follows:</p> <ul> <li><strong>Customer-Obsessed:</strong> We’re focused on advertising solutions that solve needs and drive success for clients and partners.</li> <li><strong>Make it Happen:</strong> We have a bias for action and take ownership to deliver results.</li> <li><strong>Always Innovate:</strong> We push boundaries with creativity and technology.</li> <li><strong>Foster Belonging:</strong> We ensure colleagues feel included, supported, and empowered to thrive.</li> </ul> <p>To be a part of The Mindset Company™ transforming advertising, please visit <a href="http://www.gumgum.com/careers">www.gumgum.com/careers</a>.</p></div><p><strong>Overview</strong></p> <p>Based in Düsseldorf, the Group Digital Director, Germany is an experienced player/coach who leads a local sales team of two while remaining personally active in the market to drive revenue targets across the Düsseldorf agency ecosystem. Serving as the key regional leader, this role leverages senior holding-company relationships across major media agencies to open doors, negotiate trading deals, and secure agency development opportunities. Operating in close alignment with the Hamburg team and broader EU stakeholders, the Director establishes strategic patch goals, accurate financial forecasting, and seller development while representing GumGum at industry events.</p> <p><strong>What You'll Achieve</strong></p> <ul> <li>Own and exceed the Düsseldorf revenue target while leading and coaching a team of two sellers.</li> <li>Serve as a player/coach in-market, maintaining senior holding-company relationships, joining key pitches, and unblocking deals.</li> <li>Negotiate, renew, and grow Düsseldorf agency trading deals and commercial agreements to ensure profitability and scale.</li> <li>Execute annual/quarterly planning, set sales strategies, manage pipeline coverage, and deliver accurate financial forecasts.</li> <li>Lead, motivate, and develop the Düsseldorf sales team through regular operating cadences and performance reviews.</li> <li>Partner closely with the Hamburg sales leadership and wider EU teams to drive national agency development and product adoption.</li> <li>Represent GumGum at German industry events and collaborate cross-functionally with AdOps, Client Success, and Marketing.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Skills You'll Bring</strong></p> <ul> <li>8+ years of experience in digital media, ad tech, or advertising sales, with significant time in the German market.</li> <li>Native or near-native German fluency and professional fluency in English.</li> <li>Established, trusted relationships across the Düsseldorf agency ecosystem (especially holding companies and key independents).</li> <li>Proven sales management experience, with a track record of developing sellers and leading distributed or split-location teams.</li> <li>Deep understanding of programmatic buying, ad serving, and the German digital ad landscape (knowledge of attention/contextual solutions is a plus).</li> <li>Demonstrated experience negotiating agency trading deals and holding firm on commercial terms.</li> <li>Strong organizational skills and proficiency with PowerPoint, Excel, and CRM tooling.</li> </ul> <p><strong>What We Offer<br></strong></p> <ul> <li>Learn about our benefits & perks package at <a href="https://gumgum.com/benefits">gumgum.com/benefits</a>. If you'd like additional information, your recruiter can share more specifics during the hiring process!</li> <li>Note: GumGum fosters a flexible work environment, offering GumGummers the ability to work either in-office or remotely/from home. However, for occasional in-person collaboration, we kindly ask that this position be located within a 'commutable' distance to our office.</li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><p><strong>Awards</strong></p> <ul> <li>2025 & 2026 Digiday Media Awards Europe Best Contextual Targeting Offering</li> <li>2025 AdExchanger Awards AI Innovators, Technology & Service Provider, Finalist</li> <li>2025 MARKETECH APAC Marketing Technology Awards Silver Winner for Best Contextual Advertising Tech Platform</li> </ul> <p>We're always learning and evolving as a company, and we continue to take thoughtful steps to support our people and strengthen our culture.</p> <p><strong>Follow Us on Social</strong></p> <ul> <li>Instagram: @gumgum</li> <li>LinkedIn: <a href="https://www.linkedin.com/company/gumgum/">https://www.linkedin.com/company/gumgum/</a></li> <li>YouTube: @GumGumInc</li> <li>TikTok: @itsgumgum<br><br><strong>Beware of recruitment scams.</strong> GumGum recruits only for active roles on our careers page, accepts applications through Greenhouse, and communicates only via LinkedIn or ----- / ----- email addresses. We never use chat apps, ask you to register on other recruiting sites, or request financial information, payments or purchases. <a href="https://gumgum.com/contact">Verify suspicious outreach</a> before sharing personal information.</li> </ul></div> Find more English Speaking Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

title: Sales Director, ITS, Europe
description: <div class="content-intro"><p><span style="text-decoration: underline;"><strong>Who is Seyond?</strong></span></p> <p>Seyond™ is a global leader in high fidelity LiDAR solutions, powering the future of mobility across ADAS, ITS, Robotics, Stationary and Off-Road industries. Seyond delivers a dynamic portfolio of robust, high resolution LiDAR sensors, perception software, and the Seyond ITS Management Platform (SIMPL). Founded in Silicon Valley with a global footprint, Seyond is dedicated to the highest quality engineering and manufacturing, and unwavering commitment to our customers.</p></div><p><strong>About Seyond ITS</strong></p> <p>Drawing on deep expertise in precision sensing and edge intelligence, Seyond offers a robust portfolio of LiDAR sensors, perception software, and transportation analytics solutions designed to improve roadway safety, traffic operations, and multimodal mobility.</p> <p>This portfolio includes the SIMPL™ ITS Management Platform, Seyond’s LiDAR-based detection solution for smart intersections and highways. SIMPL operates as a distinct business unit with dedicated pricing and go-to-market authority across two verticals: urban intersection management and interurban highway, tunnel, and tolling detection.</p> <p><strong>Sales Director, ITS, Europe</strong></p> <p><strong>Location: </strong>Remote, Europe</p> <p><strong>Team: </strong>Seyond ITS — SIMPL, our LiDAR-based smart intersection and highway detection platform</p> <p><strong>Employment type: </strong>Full-time</p> <h2><strong>About Seyond SIMPL</strong></h2> <p>SIMPL is scaling its international footprint across Europe, APAC, and emerging markets, and is building out dedicated regional sales leadership to match the growth already underway in the Americas.</p> <h2><strong>The Role</strong></h2> <p>We are looking for a Sales Director, ITS, Europe to build and lead SIMPL’s sales function across Europe — a role modeled on the regional sales leadership Seyond has already established in the Americas. You will sit above SIMPL’s country-level sales representatives across Europe, giving the region a single accountable sales leader for the first time.</p> <p>This is a player-coach role. We need someone who has personally carried and exceeded a sales quota — not a candidate whose background is purely sales operations or account management — and who can also recruit, coach, and manage a small, distributed team of regional reps as the European organization scales.</p> <h2><strong>What You'll Do</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Build and lead SIMPL’s European sales organization, recruiting, onboarding, and coaching country and regional sales representatives.</li> <li>Personally own and close strategic opportunities while the regional team is being built out, transitioning toward a team-quota model as the organization scales.</li> <li>Develop and execute go-to-market strategy across both SIMPL verticals: urban intersection management and inter-urban highway/tunnel/tolling detection.</li> <li>Manage and grow relationships with European distributors, system integrators, and OEM partners, alongside direct engagement with end-user agencies and pilot customers.</li> <li>Own the European sales pipeline and forecast in HubSpot, maintaining accurate deal ownership, stage progression, and close-date discipline.</li> <li>Represent SIMPL at European trade shows, industry events, and customer meetings.</li> <li>Partner with SIMPL’s European engineering team on technical qualification and solution scoping for major opportunities.</li> <li>Collaborate with the Head of Global ITS Business and BU leadership on regional pricing, deal structuring, and strategic account planning.</li> <li>Establish clear rep-level KPIs that balance new-business generation with existing-account growth, supported by weekly activity tracking.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>What We're Looking For</strong></h2> <ul> <li>8+ years of B2B sales experience, ideally in ITS, smart infrastructure, industrial IoT/sensors, or another technical, tender-driven market.</li> <li>A proven personal quota-carrying track record as an individual contributor — a genuine “hunter,” not primarily an account manager or sales-ops leader.</li> <li>Experience building or leading a distributed regional sales team, ideally spanning multiple European countries.</li> <li>Comfort managing both channel relationships (distributors, OEMs, system integrators) and direct end-user/agency sales cycles.</li> <li>Experience navigating public-sector or government tender processes is a strong plus.</li> <li>Fluent English required; German or another major European language is a plus.</li> <li>Willingness to travel extensively across Europe.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>Nice to Have</strong></h2> <ul> <li>An existing network in European traffic management, tolling, or highway agencies.</li> <li>Experience selling LiDAR, radar, or other sensor-based detection technologies.</li> <li>Familiarity with HubSpot or a comparable CRM.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>Compensation</strong></h2> <p><em>Competitive base and incentive package, benchmarked to Director-level sales leadership roles in the European technology/industrial sector. Final compensation band to be confirmed following market benchmarking.     </em></p> Find Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

title: Sr. Principal Engineer, MEMS Development
description: <p><strong>About SiTime</strong></p> <p>SiTime is the Precision Timing company.</p> <p>Timing is the heartbeat of all electronics, ensuring performance, resilience and scalability. For decades, quartz devices, non-silicon technology, have kept systems in sync, but they struggle in harsher, more demanding environments. MEMS-based Precision Timing delivers greater accuracy, smaller size and resilience. Today, MEMS timing powers over 400 applications, including high-growth ones in AI datacenters, automated driving, industrial and humanoid robots, wearables and IoT.</p> <p>Our semiconductor MEMS programmable solutions offer a rich feature set that enables customers to differentiate their products with higher performance, smaller size, lower power, and better reliability. With more than 4 billion devices shipped, SiTime is changing the timing industry. You keep returning to it, pursue ideas without waiting for instructions, and care deeply about finding an answer that works.</li> <li class="code-line" data-line="47"><strong>Initiative and follow-through</strong>. title: Senior Finance Manager, Germany (m/w/d)
description: <p></p> <div><strong data-olk-copy-source="MessageBody">Location:</strong> Hamburg, Germany<br><strong>Working pattern:</strong> Full-time, on-site<br><strong>Focus:</strong> German BESS portfolio, across construction, operations, transactions and financial reporting</div> <div> </div> <div><strong>About BW ESS</strong></div> <div>BW ESS is a global energy storage owner-operator, moving with speed to develop, deliver and operate market-leading projects. The business is active in the UK, Australia, Italy, Germany, Spain and Sweden, with more than 540MWh of operating Battery Energy Storage Systems, approximately 12GWh under construction and a development pipeline of several gigawatts.</div> <div> </div> <div>Part of BW Group, BW ESS builds on decades of global infrastructure experience, takes a long-term view of projects and partnerships, and focuses on unlocking value throughout the energy storage asset lifecycle.</div> <div> </div> <div>To find out more, visit: <a href="https://bw-ess.com/">https://bw-ess.com/</a></div> <div> </div> <div><strong>How We Work</strong></div> <div>Our culture rests on a few clear foundations: talent density over team size, flexible people over fixed structures, context over control, results over processes, and transparent, clear feedback. We move fast, give people real ownership early, and expect strong judgement and accountability in return.</div> <div> </div> <div><strong>The Role</strong></div> <div>BW ESS is seeking a Senior Finance Manager, Germany to take finance ownership of its German BESS portfolio across construction, operations, transactions and financial reporting.</div> <div> </div> <div>This is a broad, hands-on role combining strong financial control with commercial finance, portfolio management and transaction support. You will act as the principal finance partner to the German business, working closely with Development, Construction, Asset Management, Strategic Finance, Treasury and Tax, as well as JV partners, lenders and external advisers.</div> <div> </div> <div><strong>What You’ll Do</strong></div> <div> <ul> <li><strong>Construction finance.</strong> Take finance ownership of projects through the construction phase, including oversight of project budgets, expenditure, cash requirements and capital drawdowns. You will ensure project costs are properly tracked, allocated and reported, with clear visibility of performance against budget and investment case.</li> <li><strong>Investment and project support.</strong> Support project teams and Strategic Finance with FID materials, financial analysis and other investment decision-making. You will also help track construction-stage VAT, supplier payment terms, capex classification and cash-flow timing for German SPVs.</li> <li><strong>German portfolio operations.</strong> Take finance ownership of the operating German portfolio, including portfolio management, FP&A and management reporting. You will monitor financial and operational performance against budgets, forecasts and investment cases, providing clear analysis to management and JV partners.</li> <li><strong>Lender and stakeholder reporting.</strong> Manage lender and stakeholder reporting, including covenant monitoring, debt-service metrics, distributions and other project-finance requirements.</li> <li><strong>Transactions.</strong> Support project financings, refinancings, equity transactions and other strategic transactions across the German portfolio. This includes financial analysis, modelling, due diligence and transaction support, working with Strategic Finance, Treasury and external advisers.</li> <li><strong>Financial reporting and control.</strong> Take responsibility for the integrity and accuracy of financial reporting across the German portfolio, including German GAAP/HGB, German tax compliance, local statutory accounts, audits and VAT. You will oversee outsourced accounting providers and ensure high-quality monthly, quarterly and annual reporting, statutory accounts, audit and tax compliance.</li> <li><strong>Governance and systems.</strong> Maintain appropriate financial controls, governance and reporting processes across German SPVs and joint ventures, while supporting the implementation and continuous improvement of finance systems, processes and reporting infrastructure.</li> </ul> </div> <div> </div> <div><strong>What You’ll Bring</strong></div> <ul> <li> <div>10 years’ relevant finance experience, ideally in energy, renewables, infrastructure, utilities, oil and gas or another asset-intensive environment</div> </li> <li> <div>Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, Business Administration or a related discipline</div> </li> <li> <div>Professional accounting qualification such as ACA, ACCA, CIMA, CPA or a German equivalent is preferred; title: Test Engineer

Working closely with Design, Product Engineering, Reliability, and external manufacturing partners, you will contribute to digital and memory test development activities, product characterization, yield improvement, and production support. Key Responsibilities Support the development, validation, and release of production test solutions for Qualinx products. Support in developing and debugging ATE test programs for wafer sort and final test. Support silicon characterization, correlation, and production qualification activities. Analyze test results and production data to identify issues and opportunities for yield improvement. Work with Design and Product Engineering teams to investigate test failures and support root cause analysis. Contribute to test time optimization and test coverage improvements. Support OSAT and manufacturing partners during product bring-up and production ramp. Assist in implementing and validating digital test methodologies, including SCAN, MBIST, JTAG, and Flash testing. Develop automation scripts and tools to improve test efficiency and data analysis. Maintain test documentation and support continuous improvement of test processes. Requirements Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Electronics Engineering, Semiconductor Engineering, or a related field. Minimum five years of experience in semiconductor test engineering, product engineering, or a related role. Semiconductor test development and production test flow experience. Experience with semiconductor testing at wafer sort and/or package level. Experience with embedded digital interfaces such as SPI, I2C, UART, SWD, and JTAG. Understanding of digital test methodologies, including SCAN, MBIST, JTAG/Boundary Scan, IDDQ and Flash Memory Testing Experience with ATE platforms or test development environments such as NI and Teradyne IG-XL. Programming or scripting experience in Python, C/C++, MATLAB, or similar languages. Understanding of electronics fundamentals and digital circuit operation. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills. Good communication skills and the ability to work effectively in a diverse cross-functional team. Experience with NI PXIe, Teradyne J750HD, or UltraFLEX platforms. Preferred Experience Familiarity with data analysis tools (e.g MATLAB, JMP, or equivalent). Experience working with OSATs in NPI and high-volume manufacturing environments. Exposure to WLCSP products, wafer sort, and wafer-level development and testing methodologies. title: Senior Engineer Elektrotechniek
description: Ben jij een ervaren Senior Engineer Elektrotechniek die impact wil maken in uitdagende Life Sciences-projecten? Jij vertaalt klantwensen naar betrouwbare, duurzame en toekomstbestendige elektrotechnische installaties, van energievoorziening tot communicatie- en beveiligingssystemen. Vanaf de conceptfase denk je mee over technische oplossingen die voldoen aan de strengste normen. Je werkt nauw samen met andere disciplines in multidisciplinaire projectteams en bewaakt de kwaliteit en samenhang binnen het ontwerp. Dankzij jouw ervaring stuur je waar nodig bij en ondersteun je collega’s in hun ontwikkeling. In de rol van Senior Engineer neem je bovendien de volledige ontwerpverantwoordelijkheid op je en fungeer je als aanspreekpunt voor zowel klant als ontwerpteam Tot je verantwoordelijkheden behoren: Meedenken in de vroege ontwerp- en conceptfase van projecten, zoals laboratoria of productiefaciliteiten. Uitwerken van elektrotechnische installaties op het gebied van o.a. energievoorziening, verlichting, brandveiligheid, zwakstroom-, beveiligings- en communicatievoorzieningen. Opstellen van kabel- en lichtberekeningen met behulp van gespecialiseerde software. Afstemmen en coördineren van ontwerpwerkzaamheden met de ontwerpleider en andere disciplines. Ondersteunen van de ontwerpleider en projectmanager in de communicatie met klanten en partners. Hier is waar We hebben gewerkt aan de ontwikkeling en het ontwerp van een duurzaam en modern gebouw voor het Nederlands Instituut voor Ruimteonderzoek (SRON), dat meetinstrumenten voor satellieten ontwikkelt. SRON verhuisde naar het Leiden BioScience Park en stelde hoge eisen aan het nieuwe gebouw op het gebied van duurzaamheid, cleanrooms en installatietechniek. Als onderzoeksinstituut gewijd aan het bestuderen van de aardatmosfeer vond SRON het belangrijk om de impact op natuur en milieu te minimaliseren. Daarom koos Deerns in het ontwerp voor warmtepompen voor verwarming en koeling van het gebouw en werden er zonnepanelen op het dak geïnstalleerd. Bovendien kreeg het gebouw het BREEAM-NL certificaat Excellent. We hebben gewerkt aan de ontwikkeling van het nieuwe, duurzame DSM Lab 6 in Delft, waar Deerns alle technische installaties, elektrische systemen, IT-infrastructuur, beveiliging, mechanische systemen, HVAC (verwarming, ventilatie en airconditioning), transport- en utiliteitssystemen verzorgde. Tijdens de ontwerpfase werden ook de technische en financiële haalbaarheid grondig gecontroleerd. Op basis van de inval van zonlicht in het gebouw, de energieprestatie-eisen en de strenge eisen voor de binnentemperatuur ontwierp Deerns een gevel die voor 25% gesloten is. Dit zorgt voor een natuurlijk koel binnenklimaat, waardoor energie wordt bespaard op verwarmings-, ventilatie- en airconditioningsystemen. Dit ben jij Jij hebt minimaal een afgeronde bachelor (Hbo/ Wo) in Electrical engineering of een andere technische opleiding. Jij hebt al enige ervaring opgedaan als Engineer Elektrotechniek en bent klaar voor de volgende stap in je carrière. Jij hebt ervaring met werken in projecten en bent een uitstekende teamspeler. Je hebt uitstekende kennis van de Nederlandse en Engelse taal (zowel geschreven als gesproken). MS Office, Revit, BIM360 en andere berekeningsprogramma’s hebben geen geheimen voor jou. Dit bieden wij Een functie van 32-40 uur per week met een bijpassend salaris. Uitdagende projecten voor toonaangevende opdrachtgevers in Nederland en internationaal. Een werkomgeving waarin innovatie en duurzaamheid dagelijks in de praktijk worden gebracht. Aandacht voor jouw eigen ontwikkeling en vitaliteit met ruime opleidings- en ontwikkelingsmogelijkheden, fiets- en sportregelingen, flexibele werkuren, 33 vakantiedagen en mogelijkheid tot aankopen van extra dagen. Hybride werken, waarbij je de mogelijkheid hebt om afwisselend thuis en op kantoor in Den Haag te werken. Een team waar samenwerking en collegialiteit voorop staan en waar we informeel met elkaar omgaan. Duurzaamheid zit in onze genen. Dit uit zich bijvoorbeeld in een mobiliteitsbeleid waar gezondheid en duurzaamheid voorop staan. Veel van onze kantoren liggen bij OV-knooppunten, fietsen wordt aangemoedigd en je reiskosten worden 100% vergoed op basis van OV. Onze expertises dragen bij aan duurzame, intelligente en toekomstbestendige gebouwen die de processen van onze opdrachtgevers optimaal ondersteunen. We zijn verantwoordelijk voor het ontwerp van de installaties en het realiseren van een goed comfort en een prettig klimaat in de meest uiteenlopende gebouwen; van kantoren, tot luchthavens en van ziekenhuizen tot datacenters. title: Senior Mechanical Engineer
description: Ben jij een Senior Mechanical Engineer die impact wil maken in één van de meest kritische technische omgevingen? Binnen onze unit Airports werk je aan hoogwaardige projecten die direct bijdragen aan veilige, betrouwbare en duurzame luchthaveninfrastructuur. Je combineert technische diepgang met overzicht en neemt een sleutelrol in complexe projecten. De uitdaging In deze rol ben jij de inhoudelijke werktuigbouwkundige spil binnen complexe luchthavenprojecten, zowel nationaal als internationaal. Je opereert midden in de luchthavenoperatie, waar veiligheid, continuïteit en kwaliteit leidend zijn. Je neemt het voortouw in het ontwikkelen van slimme, integrale installatietechnische oplossingen en adviseert opdrachtgevers op strategisch en conceptueel niveau. Werken in een 24uurs luchthavenomgeving maakt deze rol bijzonder dynamisch en uitdagend. De complexiteit van zowel de klant als de situatie vraagt om flexibiliteit, snel schakelen en creatief denken. Juist deze afwisseling zorgt ervoor dat geen dag hetzelfde is. Samen met multidisciplinaire projectteams geef je richting aan ontwerp en realisatie, met directe invloed op de dagelijkse operatie én de toekomstbestendigheid van luchthavens. Met jouw expertise en leiderschap til je niet alleen projecten, maar ook collega’s naar een hoger niveau. Tot je verantwoordelijkheden behoren: Je ontwerpt en adviseert zelfstandig over complexe werktuigbouwkundige installaties binnen luchthavenprojecten en vertaalt ontwerpen van schets tot technische uitwerking in AutoCAD en BIM. Je zet BIM‑structuren op en begeleidt en corrigeert junior collega’s. Het inhoudelijk bijdragen aan conceptontwikkeling en het vertalen van ontwerpuitgangspunten naar haalbare en integrale oplossingen. Het uitvoeren en controleren van berekeningen en het beoordelen van het werk van engineers en technici. Het afstemmen met projectleiders, ontwerpers, andere disciplines en externe partijen over technische keuzes en randvoorwaarden. Het signaleren van risico’s en afwijkingen in kwaliteit, planning en budget en hierover proactief schakelen binnen het projectteam. Het begeleiden, coachen en inhoudelijk ondersteunen van junior engineers binnen projecten. Het leveren van input voor rapportages, adviezen en offertes. Het actief bijdragen aan kennisdeling en kwaliteitsverbetering binnen de afdeling Airports. De projecten waar je trots op kunt zijn We werken aan het verduurzamen van Terminal 1 & 2 van Schiphol, zo’n 40% van de gehele terminal: De huidige installaties die zorgen voor een aangenaam binnenklimaat, maken gebruik van fossiele brandstoffen. Wij werken aan het ontwerp van de nieuwe installatie, die warmte en koude opslag combineert met warmtepompen zodat Schiphol energieneutraal de toekomst tegemoet kan. De uitdaging van dit project zit met name in het toepassen van nieuwe techniek in een bestaand gebouw waar ruimte moet worden gecreëerd om alle apparatuur en leidingen goed onder te brengen en te zorgen dat elke ruimte wordt voorzien van voldoende verwarming en koeling. Dit moet zorgen voor een aangename passagiersbeleving maar ook voor het aanbieden van een prettig werkklimaat voor de medewerkers op Schiphol, rekening houdend met hun dagelijkse activiteiten. We werken aan het nieuwe operationele gebouw van DC ANSP, de luchtverkeersleiding van het Nederlandse luchtruim in de Cariben. Dit is een faciliteit voor de luchtverkeersleiders die verantwoordelijk zijn voor area control, waarbij de operations room en de ruimte waar de apparatuur staat opgesteld aan strenge bouwfysische en klimaateisen moeten voldoen met een hoge mate van redundantie. De omgeving vraagt daarnaast om een robuust ontwerp dat bestand is tegen orkanen en aardbevingen. We werken op Schiphol aan diverse grote en kleine projecten waarin klimaatbeheersing een grote rol speelt door intensiever gebruik van diverse ruimtes en toename van de apparatuur. Schiphol is een unieke klant om voor te werken, vanwege de omvang van de luchthaven, de continue operationele eisen en de aanwezigheid van verschillende beveiligingszones. title: Product Engineer
description: Bij Salland Engineering zoeken we een Product Engineer die een belangrijke rol speelt in het goed functioneren van onze pilot line en in de ondersteuning van het productieteam. In deze functie ben je de verbindende schakel tussen productie, engineering en klant. Het team Product Engineering, onderdeel van de Semitest Group, wordt steeds belangrijker binnen Salland Engineering. Binnen deze omgeving ben je verantwoordelijk voor het vrijgeven van testoplossingen voor kwalificatie, karakterisatie en productie test. Daarnaast begeleid je kwalificatieruns in samenwerking met de klant, de planner en onze reliability partner. Je werkt continu aan verbeteringen en streeft samen met je team naar efficiëntere processen en tooling. Storingen zie je niet als obstakel, maar als uitdaging. Je schakelt snel, denkt analytisch én praktisch en zorgt ervoor dat we optimaal blijven presteren. Je bent zichtbaar op de werkvloer en hebt veel contact met operators, teamleiders, engineeringcollega’s en de planner. Een greep uit je werkzaamheden Je begeleidt nieuwe productintroducties (NPI) in productieomgevingen; Je beheert en evalueert kwalificatie- en betrouwbaarheidstesten, zoals HTOL, HAST en Temp Cycle; Je analyseert testdata om prestaties, yield en betrouwbaarheid te beoordelen; Je troubleshoot op device-, hardware- en softwareniveau en voert root cause analyses uit bij testafwijkingen, yield drops en product failures; Je verleent technische ondersteuning aan productie- en testteams bij productissues en analyseert en lost device-, test- en procesafwijkingen op; Je borgt soepele overgangen naar high volume manufacturing (HVM); Je treedt op als technisch aanspreekpunt voor klanten en stemt technische verbeteringen af met leveranciers en externe testpartners; Je coördineert technische projecten gericht op testoptimalisatie, yieldverbetering en productinnovatie en stelt product release reports, karakterisatieverslagen en yieldanalyses op. Waar ga je werken Aangenaam, wij zijn Salland Engineering uit Zwolle! Al meer dan 30 jaar ontwikkelen wij oplossingen en leveren wij diensten voor het testen van chips. Onze technologie vind je terug in alledaagse producten zoals smartphones, tablets en auto's. Samen met zo’n 95 collega’s werken we dagelijks aan innovatieve projecten en bedienen we 's werelds grootste fabrikanten van chips en meetinstrumenten. Wat krijg je van ons Een uitdagende baan in een hightech-omgeving. We waarderen het nemen van initiatief en verantwoordelijkheid dragen, maar er is meer! title: Flight Software Architect
description: Here at The Exploration Company, we are building spacecrafts for humanity. The Flight Software Architect plays a key role in defining and maintaining the software architecture for our spacecraft flight software. The role ensures that the flight software architecture meets mission needs, system-level requirements, and safety and reliability objectives, while remaining scalable, maintainable, and suitable for the evolving needs of our spacecraft platforms. Working closely with Flight Software, Systems Engineering, Avionics, GNC, Mission Operations, and other functional disciplines, the Flight Software Architect drives architectural decisions, technical consistency, and the integration of software across the spacecraft. Key Responsibilities In your capacity as Flight Software Architect, your role will be continuously evolving, but day to day your duties will include: What we would love to see from you Software architecture & design — Define, develop, and maintain the overall flight software architecture, including software components, interfaces, data flows, and execution models, ensuring alignment with spacecraft system architecture and mission objectives. Technical leadership & architectural decisions — Drive key architectural decisions and establish design principles, technical standards, and best practices for flight software development. Provide technical guidance to software engineers and ensure consistency across software components and development activities. System integration & interfaces — Define and coordinate software interfaces with avionics, onboard computers, sensors, actuators, GNC, communication systems, and other spacecraft subsystems. Ensure robust integration across functional disciplines and support the resolution of cross-system technical challenges. Requirements & traceability — Translate mission and system-level requirements into software architectural requirements, design constraints, and interface specifications. Ensure traceability between requirements, architecture, implementation, and verification, working closely with Systems Engineering and functional chain owners. Reliability, safety & performance — Ensure that architectural decisions address fault tolerance, robustness, timing constraints, resource utilization, failure detection and recovery, and overall spacecraft reliability. Contribute to safety analyses, failure management strategies, and the definition of appropriate software verification and validation approaches. Verification, validation & technical risk management — Identify and mitigate architectural risks, assess technical trade-offs, and support design reviews, integration campaigns, and verification activities. Ensure that the architecture is validated against mission requirements and that critical technical assumptions are verified early in the development lifecycle. Cross-functional collaboration & technical communication — Act as a technical reference for flight software architecture, facilitating alignment between Flight Software, Systems Engineering, Avionics, GNC, Mission Operations, and external partners, including ESA where applicable. Communicate architectural decisions, constraints, and trade-offs clearly to both technical teams and project stakeholders. In the role of Flight Software Architect, ideally, you will have the following: 10–15 years of professional experience in software engineering, including substantial experience in flight software, embedded software, or safety- and mission-critical systems. Proven experience defining and evolving software architectures for complex critical software systems , ideally for spacecraft, launch vehicles, satellites, or other aerospace applications. Strong knowledge of real-time embedded software , operating systems, hardware–software interfaces, resource-constrained computing, and distributed or fault-tolerant systems. Experience translating system-level requirements into software architectures, interface specifications, and verification strategies. A solid understanding of software integration, testing, verification and validation, and configuration and change management in a complex engineering environment. Experience with architectural trade-off analysis, technical risk management, and making sound engineering decisions under performance, reliability, schedule, and resource constraints. The ability to work effectively across multiple engineering disciplines and align stakeholders around clear technical solutions. Strong structured thinking, analytical skills, and the ability to simplify complex technical challenges into robust and maintainable architectures. Excellent technical communication skills, with the ability to explain architectural decisions, document design rationale, and provide technical guidance to multidisciplinary teams. A strong ownership mindset, a pragmatic approach to problem-solving, and a passion for developing reliable software that enables humanity’s exploration of space. Why you should join us!
