description: About this role We are looking for a Senior Engineer to join our Agentic SOC team. At Eye, we organise engineering around streams: mission-driven groups with a clear outcome to drive, not a product area or a section of the codebase. This team's mission is to build LLM-powered agents that augment our security analysts, taking on repetitive investigation and triage work so humans can focus on the judgment-heavy parts of the job. You will work in a small, full-stack team of 2 to 3 engineers contributing to your stream's goal, working across whatever systems and layers are needed to deliver it. This is a role for someone who wants real ownership, not a queue of tickets, and who is excited about shipping agents into a real production SOC where correctness, latency, and cost all matter. In this role Own features end-to-end as Feature Lead: scope the problem, coordinate work within your team, make day-to-day technical decisions, and ship it to production. You are trusted to take a high-level goal and turn it into a plan without close supervision. Lead the design and delivery of LLM agents that plug into our SOC workflows, including tool design, prompt and context engineering, evals, and guardrails. Make sound tradeoffs on accuracy, cost, latency, and how much autonomy to give the agent versus keeping a human in the loop. Drive technical design discussions in your stream and, where the work calls for it, influence architecture and standards beyond it. Set the bar for code quality, testing, and documentation on your team. Ground engineering decisions in outcomes. Push back when the "why" is unclear, propose simpler or faster paths to the business result, and stay close to the security analysts and customers your agents are meant to serve. Mentor engineers on your team and across the stream through pairing, code review, and design feedback. Act as a multiplier, not just a strong individual contributor. Participate in hiring: interview candidates, help shape the bar, and support onboarding. Contribute to a psychologically safe and outcome-oriented team culture. Lead by example in incidents and high-pressure moments. The role is remote in the Netherlands or in Berlin, with a commitment to travel to the office (The Hague or Berlin) twice per week. What you will need 5+ years of development experience, including meaningful full-stack exposure. You are comfortable working across backend and frontend layers and you pick up new technologies independently. Depth in at least one technical area and broad competence across the stack. You have designed and shipped systems where performance, security, reliability, and maintainability all mattered, and you can explain the tradeoffs you made. Experience with strongly typed languages (Typescript, Java, dotnet, PHP, or similar). We operate in Go and React, and we back ourselves to get a seasoned engineer with strongly typed experience up to speed in our stack quickly. Hands-on experience building LLM agents, with evidence they were useful. You have built and shipped at least one non-trivial LLM-powered agent or agentic workflow, in production or as a side project with real users. You can speak concretely about the design choices you made around tool use, context and state, evals, failure handling, autonomy, cost, and latency and, just as importantly, what the agent changed for the people using it. Comfortable using AI coding tools as part of your daily development workflow. A track record of raising the level of engineers around you through mentoring, code review, and design feedback. Strong communication skills. You can translate technical tradeoffs for engineers, product managers, and leadership, and you write designs and decisions in a way others can build on. Knowledge of secure coding practices and secure development principles to build safe, trusted systems. Fluency in English is a must. What we offer Work on genuinely hard problems in a complex domain: XDR, security data at scale, and tooling that empowers security analysts to protect hundreds of customers across Europe. Real ownership in a small, autonomous team where every engineer is close to the work, close to the decision-making, and close to the impact. A deliberate bet on AI-augmented engineering and AI-augmented security operations: we are building toward small teams that punch well above their weight through smart AI adoption, and you will be part of shaping how that works in practice for both how we build and how our SOC operates. Be at the forefront of innovation, shaping the future of our technology infrastructure. Enjoy a competitive compensation package and comprehensive benefits. Join a young and thriving scale-up which is on its way to becoming the category leader in Europe. We are a great place to work, filled with people who enjoy working together. About Eye Security Eye Security is an international scale-up providing cyber security with embedded cyber insurance to SMBs in Europe. Our cyber security innovations, state-of-the-art automation and platforms are being built and maintained by our Product and Engineering Teams. Our engineers and product managers collaborate closely with cyber security experts to ensure that their hacker's mindset is embedded into our platform. Our platform is a proprietary Open XDR (eXtended Detection Response) system that brings in security data from several market leading cyber security products into our centralised repository. From here cyber security experts can work their magic. This makes sure that our hundreds of customers experience the same value via automated systems, allowing us to scale in Europe. We are a rapidly growing company and believe in investing in our people. If you're a highly motivated and results-oriented engineer with a passion for building secure, scalable technologies, we encourage you to apply! title: Senior AI Engineer
description: Legal AI is only as good as the knowledge behind it. At Lefebvre Sdu, we’ve been building that knowledge for 200 years. Day in, day out. Law by law. Word by word. Other legal AI tools run on our data and software. As the Dutch heart of Lefebvre Group, the European leader in legal and tax knowledge, we’re also developing our own platform: GenIA-L, where lawyers and tax professionals don’t just get an answer, but an answer they’re willing to put their name to. More than 75,000 professionals use it every day, accounting for over €100 million ARR across Europe. We’re looking for a Senior AI Engineer to help shape how the intelligent core of that platform evolves. HOW YOU'LL MOVE US FORWARD GenIA-L is a research platform for legal professionals. A user asks a question. The platform searches our trusted sources and turns them into a usable answer. This is done with agents: specialised AI components that each take on part of the question and work together. In the legal domain, an answer can’t just sound convincing. It has to be correct, and you need to be able to see which source it comes from. This isn’t a pilot: the platform is in production and used heavily every day. As a senior, you build alongside the team, but you also keep the bigger picture in view. You know the different parts of the platform and how they affect one another. You help prioritise, spot obstacles early and make sure we’re heading in the right direction, both in how we work and technically. You look ahead: where could we go, and what do we need to know to get there? And you help medior colleagues grow by seeing exactly where they’re stuck, without taking the work off their hands. You give direction to the agent architecture of GenIA-L: which specialised agents are needed and how they work together. You break down legal processes and translate them into technical solutions. You decide how the components are best connected. You make sure our knowledge packages and the pipelines behind them can scale and stay up to date. A knowledge package is an expert-reviewed set of commentary, case law, legislative history and practical guidance for each article of law. You build the way we measure quality. Using evaluation sets, observability and metrics, you show that answers, source attribution and reliability are genuinely improving. Not based on gut feeling, but on evidence. You help prioritise the team’s work and flag technical or process risks early. You explore new developments, test ideas in practice and turn them into proposals that make the product sharper or faster. You coach medior engineers and work directly with editors and subject-matter experts. WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR You have a realistic view of LLMs. You see what they can do, but you also know their weak spots. You follow new AI developments closely, but you don’t just follow the herd: you stay critical and aren’t afraid to say so. You can break a complex problem down into smaller pieces and keep oversight of a system with many moving parts. You take ownership, show initiative when things aren’t yet clear and think from the customer’s problem. You enjoy helping others move forward without taking over. And you like working with lawyers and editors, because they know what a good answer looks like. Extensive experience in software or ML engineering, around 5 years or more. Depth in recent projects counts for more than the number of years. In-depth knowledge of Python and experience with relevant machine learning libraries. You’ve built LLM applications and run them in production. Solid experience with agent frameworks such as LangGraph and LangChain, tool calling, MCP or similar orchestration. Our entire product is built around this. Experience with only a simple search-and-answer setup (RAG) isn’t enough. You’ve made the quality of LLM systems measurable with evaluation sets and observability, and can give concrete examples. Experience with tools like MLflow and LiteLLM is a plus. Strong backend experience, including REST APIs and Postgres databases. Experience with Kubernetes. Experience in the legal, tax or another knowledge-intensive domain is a plus. WHAT YOU'RE SIGNING UP FOR On Tuesdays and Thursdays, the team works together at the office. What colleagues value most here: mutual trust, room to experiment, and a team that helps each other out when someone gets stuck. A place where you have influence from day one: on the approach, the processes, and the direction. Colleagues who deliberately chose Lefebvre Sdu over big tech jobs because here, they're building something that doesn't exist yet. Base salary between €5,500 and €6,450 per month, based on a 36-hour week, since that's full-time for us. Plus a lot of extra allowances (see below). A bonus tied to company performance: a fixed year-end bonus of 4% and profit sharing of up to 6%. 23 vacation days and a personal choice budget of 12%, of which 8% is holiday pay and 4% is freely allocable. Want more vacation? Just buy it. A bonus of up to 10% of your salary, based on company performance and individual performance. A solid pension plan through PGB, including supplementary partner insurance. Collective insurance plans. A travel allowance of €0.25 per kilometer or a public transport reimbursement, plus an attractive bike plan. For employees with a commute of less than 10 km or more than 60 km, we have an adjusted arrangement. Two days a week in the office in The Hague, within walking distance of Voorburg station. The rest of the week, wherever you work best. Room to grow: in your craft, in your role, in the organization. Want to know more? We’d love to tell you all about the team and the role. Send us your CV and you’ll hear from us within 5 working days. Any questions first? Message or call Nadine on 06 28556265. title: Data Scientist (m/f/d)
description: Shape the Future of Data-Driven Decision Making as our Data Scientist (m/f/d) At Limehome, data is one of our biggest competitive advantages. As a Data Scientist, you'll turn complex business challenges into scalable statistical and machine learning solutions that help us make smarter decisions across pricing, operations, product, and beyond. Working closely with Revenue Management, Product, Engineering, Business Intelligence, and other stakeholders, you'll combine advanced statistical thinking with commercial acumen to create measurable business impact while continuously raising the bar for data-driven decision-making. How you’ll be hosting with heart: Design, develop, and continuously improve our core pricing algorithms—our highest-impact analytical products—to maximize revenue, occupancy, and long-term profitability. Design, develop, and evaluate advanced statistical models and machine learning algorithms to solve complex business challenges and enable smarter decision-making. Apply rigorous statistical methodologies to quantify uncertainty, estimate business impact, and generate reliable recommendations for decision-making. Design experiments and define evaluation frameworks to measure the effectiveness of new products, pricing strategies, and business initiatives. Analyze large and complex datasets to uncover opportunities for growth, operational improvements, and enhanced customer experience. Partner with Revenue Management, Product, Engineering, and BI to translate business questions into scalable analytical solutions and collaborate with Data Engineering to productionize, deploy, and monitor machine learning models. Stay at the forefront of AI, ML, and decision science to elevate our analytical capabilities, while clearly communicating complex findings to both technical and non-technical audiences. What you need to shoot for the stars: Degree in Data Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Computer Science, or a quantitative field combined with 3+ years of hands-on experience applying machine learning/statistics to real-world business problems. Strong foundation in probability theory, statistical inference, regression analysis, Bayesian statistics, experimentation, causal inference, and predictive modelling. Proven experience developing, validating, and improving machine learning models in business environments. Strong programming and modelling skills in Python and experience with modern data science libraries. Excellent SQL skills and experience working with large analytical datasets. Experience designing experiments and evaluating business initiatives, balancing statistical rigor with pragmatic decision-making to deliver simple, high-value solutions over unnecessary complexity. Strong commercial mindset with a passion for exploring new analytical methods/AI tech and translating complex findings into measurable business recommendations. Fluency in English with excellent communication and stakeholder management skills alongside the ability to explain complex concepts to audiences with varying technical backgrounds. We're designed to stay because: Hybrid Office Model: We offer a flexible and empowering work environment - you can choose to work 100% from our office or partially from home and the office. Visa & Language Support: We’ll support you during your visa process and with learning German on every language level after passing your probation period. Relocation Support : We'll financially support your move to Munich if you live further away than 300km from our office. Oneteam: We are #oneteam with a transparent company culture by staying up to date with each other through team stand-ups, regular All-Hands and suite events (Summer, Wiesn, Christmas). Growth and Development: We make sure that you keep growing - through constant feedback, peer reviews and exchanges with focus on your development. Limitless learning : We offer you the possibility to choose an external development format that will help you in reaching your full potential without any limits in budget. Workation: You have the chance to work twice per year for a duration of up to 4 weeks from a different country in the European Union. Our Limehomies love traveling so we want to give them the chance to work from inspiring new locations regularly. Sabbatical: After your 1.5 years with Limehome we offer the possibility for a 3-month sabbatical. You can use it for whatever you want: may it be traveling, spending time with your besties or volunteering. Everything for our Limehomies : We focus on your physical wellbeing (Urban Sports Club), to your mental wellbeing (Nilo.health), or even staycations in one of our beautiful Limehomes, and many more suite benefits. Join us and find out! 😉 Who we are: Limehome is a leading tech-enabled operator in the hospitality industry offering functional, design accommodations across Europe. Using proprietary technology, Limehome delivers comfortable and convenient stays with a seamless digital guest experience for business and leisure travellers. Our vision is to be the first choice in travel for everyone, everywhere. By now, our portfolio consists of more than 10,000 apartments and hotel rooms under contract across 150 cities in 13 European countries. Find more English Speaking Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

title: Head of Growth Europa (m/w/d)
description: 10ML ist ein europäischer Parfum-Händler, und die Parfum-Abfüllungen und Proben von 10ML in 3 ml, 10 ml und 30 ml sind ein einfacher Weg, Designer- und Nischendüfte zu entdecken. description: <div class="content-intro"><h2>About Vercel:</h2> <p><span data-sheets-root="1">Vercel is the agentic infrastructure company, freeing people and agents to ship what's next. title: Director of Financial Risk
description: <div class="content-intro"><h3><strong>A</strong><strong>BOUT TIDE</strong></h3> <p>At Tide, we help SMEs save time and money in the running of their businesses by not only offering business accounts and related banking services, but also a comprehensive set of highly usable and connected administrative solutions, from invoicing to accounting.</p> <p>Tide is transforming the small business banking market and now supports over 2 million members globally across the UK, India, Germany and France.</p> <p>Using advanced technology, all solutions are designed with SMEs in mind. With quick onboarding, low fees and innovative features, we thrive on making data driven decisions to serve our mission: to help SMEs save time and money so they can get back to doing what they love.</p> <p><strong>Tide facts:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Tide is available for UK, Indian, German and French SMEs</li> <li>Over 2 million members globally and rapidly growing</li> <li>Over $300 million raised in funding</li> <li>3,000 Tideans globally</li> <li>Recognised with Great Place to Work certification three years in a row, and among India’s Top 50 Best Workplaces in Banking, Financial Services, and Insurance in 2026</li> <li>We have offices in Central London, with a member support and technology centre in Sofia, Bulgaria, technology centres in Serbia, Romania, Lithuania and Hyderabad and offices in Gurugram, New Delhi, Berlin, Paris and Luxembourg</li> </ul></div><h3>ABOUT THE ROLE: </h3> <p>At Tide, we're building the leading financial platform for small businesses. As we continue to grow across multiple markets, strong financial risk management is essential to helping us scale safely, responsibly and sustainably.</p> <p>As our <strong>Director of Financial Risk</strong>, you'll lead our global 2LOD Financial Risk team and shape how we identify, assess and oversee financial risks across the business. You'll own our financial risk framework while providing independent oversight, challenge and trusted advice to 1LOD teams across:</p> <ul> <li>Financial Reporting & Control (statutory & regulatory accounting), </li> <li>FP&A (management accounting & commercial finance), </li> <li>Finance Operations (including account operations, reconciliations, AP & AR, payroll)</li> <li>Treasury</li> <li>Finance Product (systems support for Finance).</li> <li>Corporate Development (for any CorDev working impacting FinRisk)</li> </ul> <p>As well as the Regional Heads/Directors of Finance that coordinate these functions for their region (UK, EU, India).</p> <p>This is a highly visible leadership role, and you’ll be at the forefront of scaling in new markets, working on new licences, and new products. We are looking for not just a deep subject matter expert, but a trusted leader to help us scale whilst managing our financial risks.  You will need to be a strong collaborator, as you'll work closely with a variety of stakeholders, from senior leadership and executives to auditors and banking partners, to ensure Tide remains financially resilient while continuing to innovate for our members.</p> <p> </p> <h3>WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING</h3> <p>This is a global role in which you will:</p> <ul> <li>Own and evolve Tide's Financial Risk Management Framework, ensuring it grows with the business as we expand into new markets, launch new products and operate under new licences.</li> <li>Provide independent oversight and challenge of 1LOD activities relating to financial risks, working mostly with Finance and Treasury. You need to be deeply familiar with how a global Treasury function works, to be able to identify and manage risks arising. </li> <li>Ensure alignment of financial risk governance across all regulated entities and jurisdictions.</li> <li>Maintain and enhance financial risk appetite metrics, limits, triggers, and escalation protocols.</li> <li>Deliver clear and independent reporting to Group and entity-level Risk & Compliance Committees and Boards.</li> <li>Monitor capital adequacy, liquidity, concentration risks, and financial resilience.</li> <li>Support regulatory engagements, audits, thematic reviews, and licence applications.</li> <li>Independently oversee treasury and liquidity management activities.</li> <li>Review and challenge liquidity forecasting methodologies and stress assumptions.</li> <li>Maintain existing risk policies and frameworks, and develop new ones as required.</li> <li>Lead financial risk assessments for new products, partnerships, and market launches.</li> <li>Partner with other Risk & Compliance teams, various Finance teams, Legal and Internal Audit teams to ensure integrated risk management.</li> <li>Present concise and insightful risk reporting to Risk & Compliance Committees, and lead on the Financial Risk Working Groups</li> <li>Lead a high-performing and experienced global financial risk team.</li> </ul> <p> </p> <h3>WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR:</h3> <p>We're looking for someone who combines deep technical expertise with excellent judgement and the ability to influence across the organisation.</p> <p>You'll likely have:</p> <ul> <li>Significant experience leading Financial Risk within fintech, payments, e-money, banking or another regulated financial services environment.</li> <li>Experience operating in a 2LOD leadership role.</li> <li>Strong knowledge of financial risk frameworks within payment institutions, e-money institutions or digital banking.</li> <li>Deep expertise across treasury, liquidity, solvability, capital, solvency, statutory reporting and tax risk.  </li> <li>Accounting expertise; ideally with an accounting qualification.</li> <li>Experience working across multiple regulatory jurisdictions and engaging directly with regulators and auditors.</li> <li>The ability to balance strong risk management with commercial ambition in a fast-moving business.</li> <li>Excellent communication skills, with the confidence to influence senior stakeholders and provide independent challenge when it matters.</li> <li>A collaborative leadership style, with experience building and developing high-performing teams.</li> </ul> <p>Most importantly, you'll enjoy working in a fast-paced environment, be comfortable navigating change, and care about helping Tide build a resilient business that continues to deliver for our members.</p> <h3> </h3> <h3>WHAT YOU’LL GET IN RETURN:</h3> <ul> <li>Competitive Compensation -  competitive salary and share options</li> <li>Time Off – Generous annual leave on top of bank holidays.</li> <li>Parental Leave – Paid maternity, paternity, and adoption leave to support your family journey</li> <li>Sabbatical – Extended unpaid and paid leave options after completing milestone years with Tide</li> <li>Access to salary sacrifice benefits – like Nursery (could save up to 47% on fees!) and Cycle to Work discounts</li> <li>Health Insurance – Comprehensive Private family insurance plan</li> <li>Life & Accident Cover – Comprehensive accidental and life insurance protection</li> <li>Mental Wellbeing – Access to therapy sessions, courses, meditations, and workshops</li> <li>Retirement Planning – Build your retirement fund faster with Tide’s pension scheme on eligible earnings</li> <li>Volunteering & Development Days – Paid days annually for volunteering or personal growth</li> <li>Learning & Development – Annual budget for books, courses, coaching, and more</li> <li>WOO (Work Outside the Office) – Work from abroad for up to 90 days annually</li> <li>Home Office Setup – Contribution towards setting up your home office</li> <li>Laptop Ownership – Keep your old laptop and get a new one when it’s time for a replacement</li> <li>Snacks & Meals – Daily breakfast spread with all-day coffee, tea, and juices</li> </ul> <p> </p> <h3>TIDEAN WAYS OF WORKING</h3> <p>At Tide, we champion a <strong>flexible workplace </strong>model that<strong> </strong>supports both in-person and remote work to cater to the specific needs of our different teams. </p> <p>While remote work is supported, we believe in the power of face-to-face interactions to foster team spirit and collaboration. Our offices are designed as hubs for innovation and team-building, where we encourage regular in-person gatherings to foster a strong sense of community.</p><div class="content-conclusion"><h3>TIDE IS A PLACE FOR EVERYONE</h3> <p>At Tide, we believe that we can only succeed if we let our differences enrich our culture. Our Tideans come from a variety of backgrounds and experience levels. We consider everyone irrespective of their ethnicity, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, family or parental status, national origin, veteran, neurodiversity or differently-abled status. We celebrate diversity in our workforce as a cornerstone of our success. Our commitment to a broad spectrum of ideas and backgrounds is what enables us to build products that resonate with our members’ diverse needs and lives. </p> <p>We are One Team and foster a transparent and inclusive environment, where everyone’s voice is heard.</p> <p> </p> <p><em>At Tide, we thrive on diversity, embracing various backgrounds and experiences. We welcome all individuals regardless of ethnicity, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, or disability. Our inclusive culture is key to our success, helping us build products that meet our members' diverse needs. We are One Team, committed to transparency and ensuring everyone’s voice is heard.</em></p> <div class="p-rich_text_section"> </div> <div class="p-rich_text_section"><strong>Disclaimer</strong></div> <div class="p-rich_text_section"> </div> <div class="p-rich_text_section"><em>It has come to our attention that individuals or agencies are falsely claiming to represent Tide and are reaching out to candidates regarding job opportunities. title: Senior Customer Success Engineer
description: <div class="content-intro"><p>Join the company that’s building the telemetry infrastructure for the AI era. At Cribl, we partner with IT and Security teams at many of the world’s biggest enterprises, including half of the Fortune 100, to bridge the gap between AI ambition and infrastructure reality. As the AI Platform for Telemetry, we give customers the choice, control, and flexibility to manage and analyze telemetry for both humans and agents, so they can build what’s next.</p> <p>We’re one of the fastest‑growing private companies and a leading player in a massive, fast‑moving market. With a global workforce, we’re remote‑first and grounded in a simple idea: software is a people business. Cribl is the place where curious, collaborative people can do their best work, grow fast, and bring their full selves to the herd.</p></div><p><strong>Why You’ll Love This Role</strong></p> <p>We're looking for a technically skilled and customer-focused <strong>Scaled Customer Success Engineer (CSE)</strong> to join our team. In this role, you'll be instrumental in driving product adoption and ensuring the success of our customers through a combination of tailored 1:1 engagements and scalable 1:many initiatives. You'll leverage your technical expertise to guide customers through their journey, provide best practice guidance, and contribute to the evolution of our digital enablement programs.</p> <p><strong><br>As An Active Member Of Our Team, You Will…</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>Drive Customer Adoption & Enablement:</strong> <strong>Drive Customer Adoption & Enablement: </strong>Develop and deliver impactful enablement materials that boost product adoption and deliver quantifiable business results for our customers.</li> <li><strong>Provide Technical Expertise & Guidance:</strong> Act as a trusted technical advisor, offering in-depth product knowledge and troubleshooting assistance to resolve complex customer issues.</li> <li><strong>Contribute to 1:Many Initiatives:</strong> Collaborate with Customer Advocacy and CX Operations teams to contribute to and participate in 1:many content, including webinars, workshops, and educational materials, to drive broad customer understanding and adoption.</li> <li><strong>Strategic Customer Engagement:</strong> Engage with customers on a strategic level, identifying their business needs and aligning them with our product capabilities to drive successful outcomes.</li> <li><strong>Customer Advocacy & Feedback:</strong> Serve as a vital feedback loop, collaborating with internal teams (Product, Engineering, Sales, Marketing, CX Operations) to champion customer needs, influence product enhancements, and contribute to our digital program's content strategy.</li> <li><strong>Data Analysis & Optimization:</strong> Utilize data to understand customer behavior, identify common pain points, and contribute insights to optimize both 1:1 and 1:many engagement strategies.</li> <li><strong>Churn Mitigation & Growth:</strong> Proactively identify churn risks and develop strategies to retain and grow the customer base by demonstrating ongoing value.</li> <li><strong>Process Improvement & Automation:</strong> Identify opportunities to leverage automation and other digital tools to enhance efficiency and personalize the scaled customer experience.</li> <li><strong>Measure & Report:</strong> Track key metrics related to customer health, adoption, and engagement, reporting on the effectiveness of your efforts and continuously seeking improvements.</li> <li>We are a remote-first company and work happens across many time-zones – you may be required to occasionally perform duties outside your standard working hours</li> </ul> <p><br><strong>If You’ve Got It - We Applied Intuition services the automotive, defense, trucking, construction, mining and agriculture industries in three core areas: tools and infrastructure, operating systems, and autonomy. title: Senior Product Manager – Digital Clients: Growth & Expansion
description: Your Role As Senior Product Manager – Digital Clients (f/m/d) you own the complete growth loop for LIQID's digitally-led clients: from a newly created lead to the first investment, and from there to the next top-up, the second portfolio and the next product. Acquisition and expansion sit in one team with one mandate, so you build a single growth system instead of handing clients over at the funnel's end. LIQID is hybrid by design: for this segment the experience is digital-first, and you decide precisely where a human touch from our advisors accelerates conversion or growth – and where it doesn't. What you'll do End-to-End Segment Ownership: Own the digital client lifecycle from Lead → Signup → Checkout → First Investment → Activation → Expansion. You define the segment's North Star and KPI tree across conversion and expansion – lead-to-funded conversion, time to fund, time to first top-up, multi-product rate, share of wallet – and you are accountable for net new money from the segment, not for a single funnel stage. Lead Conversion & Onboarding Experience: Design and optimize the journeys that turn leads into funded clients – lead nurturing, signup, onboarding and checkout – together with Product Design, Marketing and Sales. You shape the first-product strategy – which entry offer converts which persona – and make sure the brand promise and premium positioning carry through every step that builds trust and drives conversion. Digital Up- & Cross-Sell: Turn first-time investors into multi-product clients: top-ups and savings plans, second portfolios, additional account types and access to new asset classes such as private markets. You find natural product sequences through path and cohort analysis, build the in-product moments and lifecycle campaigns that convert them, and prove impact with causal measurement rather than correlation stories. Hybrid Where It Pays Off: Define when a human touch turns a hesitant prospect into a client or a single-product client into a long-term relationship – callback offers at checkout drop-off, advisor triggers at wealth thresholds, and a clean handover to our Private Wealth team as clients grow. Every human touchpoint is designed, triggered and measured, not left to chance. Thought Leadership with Hands-on Mentality: Act as Product Manager and Product Owner for a cross-functional team of Engineering, Design and Product Ops, working closely with Marketing and Sales. Y ou build on shared onboarding and banking infrastructure owned by our platform teams, prioritize transparently by impact and effort – which also means saying no – and grow into the thought leader for digital wealth growth at LIQID. What you bring Background: 7+ years in Product Management or Growth for digital consumer products, with ownership of both conversion and monetization or expansion outcomes. FinTech, WealthTech, banking or subscription businesses are a strong plus. Growth & Analytical Depth: Hands-on with funnel, cohort and LTV analysis. You define metrics before you build, establish baselines, can query data yourself, and know the difference between a significant result and a lucky one. Technical & AI Fluency: Experience working with product analytics and CRM data. You are comfortable discussing architecture and API trade-offs with engineers and use AI tooling to prototype, analyze and ship faster. Domain Curiosity & Client Empathy: Genuine interest in investing and capital markets, and an understanding that converting someone to invest a significant share of their wealth is a trust decision, not an impulse purchase. Communication & Language: Fluent in German and English, able to align Product, Design, Engineering, Marketing and Sales around one growth agenda and to represent your roadmap credibly toward leadership. Drive & Motivation: Comfortable in fast-paced, high-ownership scale-up environments. Y ou want to own outcomes, not backlogs, and you are excited to build the growth engine of a digital-first wealth manager in an AI-native product organization. What we offer Diversity : Flat hierarchies and cultural openness make you an integral part of our diverse team of international talents from day one. Flexibility : We don’t complicate your life. You’ll find the right balance with flexible work models, working hours, and remote work options. 28 days of vacation and two additional days off on December 24 and 31 ensure you have ample time to unwind. Appreciation : You’ll help shape the future of digital wealth management with us in an innovative, multi-award-winning company on a growth trajectory, with high market relevance and plenty of space for your ideas. Development : We support your personal and professional growth with an annual development budget up to €1,500. Additionally, at the start of your tenure at LIQID, you’ll receive high-quality equipment, including a MacBook, headphones, and a display. Smart Money : As a LIQIDian, you'll enjoy attractive terms for our investment strategies, a monthly lunch allowance, and exclusive discounts with various providers. Well-being : Regional organic products keep you fit in the office, and our health initiatives or Health Assistance Program go far beyond that. What happens next An excellent candidate, experience and transparency are our top priorities in the interview process. The different stages help us understand how a potential collaboration could look. Initial Call with our Talent Partner : A casual introduction and discussion to align your expectations with the role. Video Call with Head of Product : You will learn more about the performance expectations and specific role requirements from our leadership team. Take-home Assessment with live Presentation round : A take home task, followed by a 90-minute live session with two team members. In-Person Meeting : You will meet some team members onsite, tour our office and sit down with our Head of Product to discuss final alignments. About us We are LIQID, one of the fastest-growing fintechs in Europe. Our purpose is to provide creators, entrepreneurs, and thinkers shaping our future with access to the same opportunities as the world’s most successful investors while balancing the demands of people, planet, and profit. We offer our clients financial peace of mind through exceptional, curated investment solutions – ranging from the world’s best private equity and venture funds to award-winning wealth management solutions. All delivered via an intuitive digital experience with outstanding personal support. With over €4 billion in assets, we are backed by leading investors from the digital, private equity, and wealth management space, including LGT , Toscafund , HQ Trust , and Project A . LIQID is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will be considered for employment without regard to race, age, religion, gender, ethnicity, national origin, disability, or any other characteristic protected by equal opportunity laws. title: Director Research & Development
description: Purpose of the job The Director Research & Development (R&D) leads the exploration and development of potential business and technology initiatives, from initial ideation through feasibility analysis, testing, validation and proof of concept (POC)/prototyping. For assigned initiatives, the role coordinates the full exploration phase and develops substantiated proposals for consideration and approval by the relevant governance bodies. The role requires a proactive, self-motivated approach, the ability to work independently and to manage multiple subjects concurrently. Initiatives may range from joint venture (JV) model enhancements and artificial intelligence (AI) to customer experience development and new approaches to distribution. KEY RESULT AREAS/ KEY RESPONSIBILITIES Ideation and concept generation Ensure that potential initiatives align with SkyTeam’s strategic goals and assess their purpose, expected value, rationale and the implications of not proceeding. Ask relevant questions and gather appropriate information to support well-founded recommendations and help build consensus among member airlines. Organize and facilitate ideation and brainstorming sessions. Monitor developments in the transport industry and at IATA to identify emerging trends and opportunities or gaps for improving existing legacy systems. Generate, collect and develop ideas and concepts in partnership with member airlines and other contributors for marketable initiatives that could become SkyTeam priorities. Exploration, feasibility and concept development Lead the exploration of assigned initiatives, including relevant research and data analysis, feasibility assessments, business cases, business requirements documents (BRDs) and POCs/prototypes, as appropriate. Analyze business and technical challenges across different airline domains; identify and assess potential solutions and determine the most relevant product concept, design and feasibility approach. Develop evidence-based recommendations, supported by tangible data and analysis, that demonstrate the potential business value of the proposed initiative. Prepare proposals and supporting materials for review and approval by the relevant SkyTeam and member-airline decision-making bodies. Stakeholder engagement and governance Work effectively within SkyTeam’s matrix organization and collaborate with member airlines, internal teams and relevant external contributors. Engage with operational and technical stakeholders, including senior decision-makers, to understand requirements, assess options and build alignment around proposed concepts. Support informed decisions through clear analysis and recommendations. Strategic prioritization and formal initiative approval remain with the Executive Board (EB), Strategy Committee (StratCom) and relevant governance bodies. Transition to implementation Following approval, coordinate with Digital/Delivery to transfer the agreed concept, supporting analysis, business requirements and relevant POC findings for MVP development and implementation. Where assigned, act as project owner or coordinate relevant project activities within the agreed governance arrangements. Accountability for implementation transfers to Digital/Delivery. Budget, resource or external-partner responsibilities may be assigned depending on the approved initiative and are not standing responsibilities of the role. Your profile REQUIRED SKILLS, KNOWLEDGE & EXPERIENCE Strong airline-industry background, with demonstrated experience in core airline businesses such as PRM, distribution, operational research and e-sales. Broad understanding of airline business and technical domains, sufficient to assess a variety of potential initiatives. Good understanding of relevant technical aspects; experience in a Business Analyst role is an advantage. Excellent facilitation skills, with the ability to engage and guide diverse groups towards innovative solutions. Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to explain and present complex concepts and inspire teams. Analytical and critical-thinking skills, including the ability to evaluate complex options and communicate evidence-based recommendations. Ability to work independently on multiple subjects and collaborate effectively in a multicultural matrix organization. Responsibilities and tasks of the position are not limited to the above mentioned, and deviations can occur at any point in time as the position evolves and in concert with the manager. Why us? title: UX Designer
description: Of je jezelf nu UX Designer, Interaction Designer of Product Designer noemt: jij zorgt ervoor dat digitale producten en services logisch werken voor de mensen die ze gebruiken. Je beweegt makkelijk tussen strategie, gebruikersbehoeften, interactie en technologie. Van eerste inzicht en concept tot een uitgewerkt ontwerp dat daadwerkelijk gebouwd en gebruikt wordt. Wat ga je doen als UX Designer bij Norday? Bij Norday werken we aan complexe vraagstukken waarvoor niet altijd meteen duidelijk is wat de juiste oplossing is. Nieuwe technologie, veranderende verwachtingen en maatschappelijke ontwikkelingen vragen organisaties om richting te kiezen én die richting concreet te maken. Als UX Designer help jij daarbij. Je vergroot de verbeeldingskracht van opdrachtgevers met scherpe inzichten en snelle prototypes. Je onderzoekt wat mensen nodig hebben, maakt complexe informatie begrijpelijk en vertaalt strategische keuzes naar digitale producten en services die in de praktijk werken. Je werkt daarbij nauw samen met strategen, service designers, visual designers, developers en projectmanagers. Je werkt aan nieuwe digitale platforms, slimme tools, gepersonaliseerde ervaringen en nieuwe diensten. Soms ligt er al een duidelijke strategie, soms help je die samen met het team verder vormgeven. Je bent gedurende het hele proces betrokken: van het eerste vraagstuk en onderzoek tot concept, ontwerp, validatie en realisatie. Wat je gaat doen: Je duikt in de context van een vraagstuk en brengt gebruikers, behoeften, doelen en knelpunten in kaart; Je vertaalt inzichten en strategie naar een concept, user flows, journeys en prototypes; Je maakt complexe vraagstukken begrijpelijk en helpt klanten en teams om keuzes te maken; Je faciliteert workshops en co-creatiesessies met klanten, gebruikers en collega’s; Je bedenkt en test verschillende oplossingsrichtingen en gebruikt inzichten uit onderzoek om je ontwerp steeds verder aan te scherpen; Je onderzoekt hoe AI kan bijdragen aan nieuwe diensten, betere ervaringen en waarde voor organisaties en de mensen die ze gebruiken; Je zorgt dat interacties, flows en details helder zijn voor visual designers, developers én agents; Je bewaakt de gebruikerservaring tot het product of de service daadwerkelijk werkt; Je werkt samen met strategen en andere disciplines aan oplossingen die niet alleen prettig werken, maar bijdragen aan de richting en waarde van de organisatie. Wie ben jij? Je bent nieuwsgierig naar hoe mensen dingen gebruiken en waarom ze bepaalde keuzes maken. Je kunt goed luisteren, doorvragen en verbanden leggen. Tegelijkertijd ben je niet iemand die eindeloos blijft onderzoeken: je krijgt energie van het concreet maken van inzichten en het samenbrengen van verschillende perspectieven in een heldere oplossing. Je kunt schakelen tussen het grotere verhaal en het detail. Je begrijpt wat een strategische keuze betekent voor een gebruikerservaring en weet wat er nodig is om een idee technisch en organisatorisch haalbaar te maken. Je bent zelfstandig in je werk, zoekt actief de samenwerking op en kunt je ontwerpkeuzes goed uitleggen aan zowel klanten als collega’s. Je hoeft niet overal het antwoord op te hebben. Wel wil je begrijpen wat er speelt en samen tot een oplossing komen die klopt. Onze ideale UX Designer … heeft een aantal jaar ervaring als UX Designer, Interaction Designer of Product Designer; heeft ervaring met complexe digitale vraagstukken en het ontwerpen van digitale producten of services; kan zelfstandig onderzoek, conceptontwikkeling, interaction design en prototyping oppakken; heeft ruime ervaring met Figma en bijvoorbeeld Miro of vergelijkbare tools; vindt het leuk om workshops en co-creatiesessies te begeleiden; kan goed samenwerken met strategen, service designers, visual designers en developers; beheerst de Nederlandse taal goed, vanwege de grote mate van klantcontact, interviews, workshops en samenwerking; heeft een HBO/WO werk- en denkniveau, bijvoorbeeld vanuit CMD, Design for Interaction of een vergelijkbare opleiding; is nieuwsgierig naar de mogelijkheden van AI en experimenteert ermee in eigen processen. Je ziet AI als een nieuwe manier om onderzoek te doen, samen te werken, te ontwerpen en ideeën sneller te verkennen en toetsen. Wat bieden we jou? Een salaris van €3.600 tot €4.700 bruto per maand op basis van 40 uur, afhankelijk van jouw ervaring; Hybride werken vanuit Rotterdam en thuis; Een persoonlijk budget van €750 voor je thuiswerkplek; 25 vakantiedagen; Een goede pensioenregeling en leasefietsregeling; Een NS Business Card; Een persoonlijk leer- en ontwikkelplan en veel ruimte om te leren van collega’s en vakexperts; Afwisselende projecten waarin strategie, design, technologie en domeinkennis samenkomen; Een team van nieuwsgierige en betrokken collega’s die kwaliteit belangrijk vinden; De mogelijkheid om mee te bouwen aan de verdere ontwikkeling van Norday. Norday stimuleert een diverse werkomgeving en is een werkgever die gelijke kansen biedt. We moedigen sollicitanten van alle achtergronden en identiteiten aan om te solliciteren. Daarnaast nemen we sociale en ecologische impact mee in onze besluitvorming en in jouw performance reviews. Vragen? Neem dan contact met ons op via 010 221 46 00 of Norday: Ready to Lead Norday helpt organisaties richting te geven aan verandering en hun veranderkracht te vergroten. We combineren strategie, design, technologie en domeinkennis om complexe vraagstukken concreet te maken en oplossingen te ontwikkelen die in de praktijk werken. Van transformatiestrategie, digitale en datastrategie tot nieuwe producten, diensten en AI-toepassingen: we gidsen organisaties bij waar ze naartoe willen en helpen ze om daar te komen. We werken in multidisciplinaire teams samen met opdrachtgevers in cultuur, zorg en welzijn, educatie, overheden, NGO’s en climate tech aan de grote vraagstukken van deze tijd. Daarbij verbinden we de mogelijkheden van technologie met de context van organisaties en de mensen die ermee werken. Norday is onderdeel van Handpicked en een B Corp. title: Senior Customer Success Manager (all genders)
description: Als VC-backed Foodtech-Startup schaffen wir den Spagat zwischen gesunder Ernährung, Verfügbarkeit und Nachhaltigkeit. Mit unseren Foodjis bringen wir ultrafrische, leckere Gerichte genau dorthin, wo du die meiste Zeit verbringst – denn wir haben uns zum Ziel gesetzt, über 10 Millionen Arbeitnehmern endlich Zugang zu gesunder Ernährung zu ermöglichen und gleichzeitig Foodwaste zu reduzieren. Gestalte das perfekte Foodji-Erlebnis Ein großartiges Produkt allein reicht nicht – echte Kundenzufriedenheit entsteht durch starke Beziehungen und einen klaren Blick auf die Entwicklung des Kundenportfolios. Du machst den konkreten Nutzen und Mehrwert von Foodji sichtbar und schaffst damit die Grundlage für langfristige Partnerschaften. Deine Mission bei Foodji: (Enterprise-) Kund:innen begleitest du von der Testphase über den Vertragsabschluss durch die gesamte Customer Lifetime. Für dein Kundenportfolio übernimmst du Verantwortung und sorgst dafür, dass Kund:innen Foodji erfolgreich nutzen, langfristig bleiben, wachsen und uns weiterempfehlen. Stabile und vertrauensvolle Beziehungen zu zentralen Entscheider:innen und dezentralen Stakeholdern baust du gezielt auf und entwickelst sie weiter. Verantwortung für die Gesundheit und Weiterentwicklung deines Enterprise-Kundenportfolios – von der KPI-basierten Analyse der Account Health bis zur Ableitung gezielter Maßnahmen. Vertragsverlängerungen bereitest du aktiv vor und erkennst Kündigungsrisiken frühzeitig – auch wenn sie zunächst nur an einem einzelnen Standort auftreten. Steuerung von internen und crossfunktionalen Projekten zur Weiterentwicklung des Customer Success Bereichs. DAS BRINGST DU MIT Mindestens drei Jahre Erfahrung im Customer Success Management sowie nachweisbare Erfahrung in der Steuerung von Retention-, Vertragsverlängerungs- und Churn-Kennzahlen über ein Kundenportfolio hinweg. Strukturierte, datengetriebene und eigenständige Arbeitsweise mit einem guten Gespür für Kundenbeziehungen sowie der Fähigkeit, Risiken, Kundenpotenziale und nächste Schritte selbstständig zu priorisieren. Erfahrung im Umgang mit CRM-Systemen, insbesondere Salesforce, sowie sehr gute Excel-Kenntnisse. Kommunikationsstärke auf Entscheider:innenebene – auch in anspruchsvollen Gesprächen – sowie die Fähigkeit, komplexe Multi-Standort-Accounts mit unterschiedlichen Stakeholdern strategisch zu betreuen. Deutschkenntnisse auf muttersprachlichem Niveau sowie fließende Englischkenntnisse. Präsentations- und Argumentationsfähigkeit sowie ausgeprägte Networking-Kompetenzen. Ein „Do-it“-Mindset, Teamfähigkeit, Selbstbewusstsein sowie eine lösungs- und zielorientierte Arbeitsweise. NOCH FRAGEN? Wir freuen uns auf deine Nachricht und helfen dir gerne weiter! DAS BIETEN WIR Office Foodji & Lunchit App: Immer bestens versorgt bei uns im Office oder Remote Uncapped Bonus: Deine Leistung bestimmt dein Gehalt – nach oben gibt es keine Grenze bAV: Mit der Degura Pension Cloud sichern und bezuschussen wir jetzt schon deine Rente Spendit Card: Wir stocken dein Gehalt auf! Mit Spendit stehen dir bis zu fünfzig Euro netto im Monat on top zur freien Verfügung EGYM Wellpass: Mit uns bleibst du fit & wir bringen dich deutschlandweit in die angesagtesten Fitness- und Wellnessstudios JobRad: Spring mit uns aufs Rad und lease dir dein Traumrad oder Pedelec KITA/Kiga Kostenzuschuss: Wir bezuschussen deine Kosten für die Kinderbetreuung, damit deine Kinder immer bestens versorgt sind Mitarbeiterrabatte: Du erhältst attraktive Promotions und Discounts verschiedener Brands Food Tastings: Teste dich mit unserem Foodteam durch unsere Produkte und gestalte unser Sortiment von morgen Development: Deine Weiterentwicklung liegt uns am Herzen und mit regelmäßigen Feedbackgesprächen und Trainings bieten wir dir spannende Entwicklungspfade – z. B. vom SDR zum Account Executive Flexwork: Arbeite 30 Tage im Jahr aus dem EU Ausland Top Office Lage: Genieße eine erstklassige Arbeitsumgebung im Münchener Glockenbachviertel mit der Isar vor der Tür Team Events: Wir sind ein Team - beim Skiday, Frühstück, Culture Week oder Office Party feiern wir gemeinsam! ÜBER UNS Hi, schön, dass du da bist! Wir sind Foodji - ein Team aus Food-Lovern & Tech-Nerds. Unsere Mission ist es, frisches, gesundes und vor allem leckeres Essen überall dort anzubieten, wo Menschen den Großteil ihres Alltags verbringen – in Büros, ganz gleich, ob im Gewerbegebiet oder mitten in der Stadt, während langer Schichten im Krankenhaus oder in den Tiefen einer Produktionshalle, in der rund um die Uhr Menschen arbeiten. Überall bieten wir vollwertige Gerichte, Snacks und Getränke genau dort an, wo und wann du sie brauchst. Proprietäre Technologien, selbstlernende Algorithmen und effiziente Lieferketten helfen uns dabei, das Paradox zwischen frischem Essen, Verfügbarkeit und Nachhaltigkeit aufzulösen. Mit unserer eigens entwickelten Technologieplattform optimieren wir die Mengenplanung und sagen Food Waste den Kampf an. Wir wollen einen positiven Effekt erzielen – auf die Umwelt, den Alltag unserer Kund:innen und unsere Communities. Deshalb spenden wir übrig gebliebene Gerichte an Foodsharing und andere soziale Initiativen direkt vor unserer Haustür. Als Marktführer versorgen wir mit Foodji bereits täglich Tausende Menschen in ganz Deutschland. Zu unseren Kund:innen zählen unter anderem der Münchner Flughafen, Klarna, Enpal und Wingcopter. Und wir fangen gerade erst an: Allein in Deutschland gibt es mehr als 100.000 relevante Standorte für uns. Trage auch du deinen Teil dazu bei und bewirb dich jetzt. title: Afstudeerstage IT
description: Bij BAS, Europa’s grootste dealer in commerciële voertuigen én officieel Volvo en Renault Trucks dealer, krijg jij de kans om je te ontwikkelen binnen IT in de automotive branche. Ben jij op zoek naar een afstudeerstage vanaf januari/ februari 2027? Dan is dit iets voor jou! BAS World groeit hard, en IT speelt daarin een sleutelrol. Binnen ons IT-team liggen verschillende afstudeeropdrachten klaar die elk een echt vraagstuk uit ons IT-landschap aanpakken. Elke opdracht heeft een eigen team dat je dagelijks begeleidt. Zo breng je je kennis in de praktijk en kickstart je samen met ons jouw carrière. Mogelijke afstudeeropdrachten 1. Continuous performance & load testing (Engineering) BAS World wil het aantal voertuigadvertenties online ongeveer 20 keer zo groot maken. In deze opdracht zorg je dat onze websites en systemen die groei aankunnen. Je onderzoekt welke (AI-gedreven) testtools passen bij onze stack. Daarna bouw je samen met het IDP-team een testsuite die dagelijks automatisch draait in de pipeline. Het resultaat is een productieklare testopzet en een advies over knelpunten en capaciteit. Past bij: Software Engineering, DevOps, Infrastructure. 2. Kleine AI-agents voor de business (Data / AI engineering) In deze opdracht werk je als interne consultant binnen één afdeling, bijvoorbeeld Logistiek. Je spreekt gebruikers, brengt hun processen en knelpunten in kaart en bepaalt waar AI het meeste oplevert. Daarna bouw je één of meer kleine AI-agents op basis van de services en data die we al hebben. Je test ze en verbetert ze tot ze echt gebruikt worden in het dagelijkse werk. Past bij: AI, Data Science, Business IT, Software Engineering, als je graag dicht op eindgebruikers werkt. 3. Realtime monitoring & bottleneck-analyse voor Thinkwise-applicaties (Engineering) Verschillende kernapplicaties draaien op het low-code platform Thinkwise. Als gebruikers traagheid melden, kost het nu weken om de oorzaak te vinden. In deze opdracht bouw je monitoring die de performance over de hele stack realtime inzichtelijk maakt: van UI en applicatielaag tot database en netwerk. Die performance komt live op een scherm op de werkvloer van onze developers. Daarnaast ontwikkel je rapportage- en analysetooling waarmee developers bottlenecks precies kunnen aanwijzen en oplossen waar ze ontstaan. Zo vinden we problemen in uren in plaats van weken. Past bij: Software Engineering, Infrastructure, DevOps, met interesse in performance en observability. 4. Problem management & ITSM-procesoptimalisatie (System & Application Management) Onze Servicedesk en het S&AM-team krijgen veel meldingen binnen in Jira. Terugkerende problemen worden nog te weinig bij de bron opgelost. In deze opdracht breng je de ITSM-processen in kaart en leg je ze vast: processtromen, werkinstructies en rollen. Je toetst ze aan good practices zoals ITIL. Daarna ontwerp en implementeer je problem management als een vast proces, zodat terugkerende issues structureel verdwijnen. Past bij: Business IT & Management, IT Service Management of verwant. 5. Datagedreven leadgeneratie met FleetCareXL & BAS World (Product) Via FleetCareXL weten we precies hoe voertuigen onderhouden worden en wat dat kost. De verkoophistorie van BAS World vertelt ons veel over restwaardes. In deze opdracht combineer je deze twee databronnen in een proof of concept. Die berekent het ideale vervangmoment: wanneer onderhoudskosten gaan stijgen terwijl de restwaarde nog hoog is. Dat levert kostenbesparing op voor klanten en leads voor in- en verkoop. De opdracht kan ook andersom worden ingevuld. Dan onderzoek je hoe we FleetGuide selfservice of fullservice actief kunnen aanbieden aan klanten van BAS World. Past bij: Data Science, Business Analytics, Software Engineering, met commerciële interesse. Kortom: veel verantwoordelijkheid, veel samenwerking en een opdracht met echte impact. Wij bieden jou Een stagevergoeding van €500,- bruto per maand voor een fulltime stage én reiskostenvergoeding ; Een inhoudelijke en uitdagende afstudeeropdracht met zichtbare impact; Dagelijkse begeleiding vanuit het team dat jouw opdracht host; De mogelijkheid om onderdeel uit te maken van ons gedreven en enthousiaste IT-team; Bij goede prestaties uitzicht op een vaste functie binnen BAS . Bij BAS zeggen we namelijk niet voor niets: “Bij BAS heb je geen baan maar een carrière!”; Een vaste kruk bij de VrijMiBo en jouw naam op de gastenlijst voor onze bedrijfsuitjes en feestjes. Je volgt een HBO-opleiding richting Software Engineering, DevOps, Data Science, AI, Business IT & Management, IT Service Management of een gerelateerde opleiding; Je bent woonachtig in de omgeving van Veghel. Je vindt het leuk om systemen en processen te verbeteren en oplossingen te bouwen die echt gebruikt worden; Je bent nieuwsgierig en hebt de drive om te leren en jezelf te ontwikkelen. Wij zijn BAS! We zijn actief sinds 1962. Sindsdien vestigden wij onze naam als een betrouwbare kracht in de Automotive. Als familiebedrijf zijn wij wereldwijd actief in kopen, onderhouden en verkopen van vrachtwagens, trekkers, trailers, bouwmachines, bedrijfswagens en landbouwmachines. Al onze kennis en ervaring verwerkten we daarnaast in de ontwikkeling van basworld.com. Hier verbinden we kopers en verkopers met elkaar en helpen we hen om snel, gemakkelijk en veilig te handelen. Onze ambitie voor BAS kent geen grenzen. Rijd jij voorop om BAS naar het volgende niveau te brengen? Samengevat: bij BAS gaan we altijd vol gas en is geen dag hetzelfde. Met meer dan 1.000 collega’s proberen wij onszelf iedere dag een stukje beter te maken voor onze klanten. Daarbij staan Brabantse nuchterheid, passie, teamwork en ondernemerschap voorop. You’ll gain hands-on experience working on ground-breaking projects, collaborate with industry-leading architects, and push the boundaries of design. If you’re passionate about architecture and eager to learn in a dynamic, creative environment, we’d love to hear from you. title: Quality Assurance Specialist

title: Cleanroom Equipment Technician
description: Over ons De halfgeleiderindustrie vraagt om steeds krachtigere chips: meer bandbreedte, minder energieverbruik. Onze technologie levert precies dat. Wij verbinden chips met computernetwerken die enorme hoeveelheden data verwerken, met minimale vertraging. Samen veranderen we de manier waarop de wereld met elkaar verbonden is. In Zoetermeer werkt ons grafeenteam aan de toekomst van de halfgeleiderindustrie, van onderzoek en ontwikkeling tot industrialisatie. Op het snijvlak van materiaalkunde en halfgeleidertechnologie ontwikkelt het team de processen om grafeen te produceren, te karakteriseren en te integreren. Die processen vormen de basis van onze geïntegreerde grafeenfotonica. Het team pioniert met nieuwe procestechnologie en schaalt die op tot productierijpe oplossingen. Zo wordt baanbrekend onderzoek omgezet in de bouwstenen van de chips van morgen. De functie Black Semiconductor is op zoek naar een gemotiveerde Technicus (m/v/x) om ons team op locatie in Zoetermeer, Nederland, te versterken. Je speelt een cruciale rol bij het waarborgen van de betrouwbare werking van alle technische systemen die onze cleanroomomgeving ondersteunen. Je bent verantwoordelijk voor onderhouds-, storingsanalyse- en reparatiewerkzaamheden aan voorzieningen zoals luchtbehandeling, gas-, water- en elektrische systemen. Deze functie is ideaal voor een praktisch ingestelde professional met technisch inzicht die graag zelfstandig werkt, technische uitdagingen oplost en nieuwe vaardigheden ontwikkelt in een sterk gecontroleerde en innovatieve omgeving. Belangrijkste verantwoordelijkheden Zorgdragen voor een veilige en betrouwbare werking van cleanroomvoorzieningen, waaronder HVAC, toevoer- en afvoerlucht, gas-, water- en elektrische infrastructuur. Uitvoeren van preventief onderhoud, storingsanalyse en reparaties aan productie en test apparatuur in de cleanroom en cleanroom systemen en inkomende nutsvoorzieningen. Technische problemen diagnosticeren en oplossen om stilstand tot een minimum te beperken en de operationele continuïteit te waarborgen. Onderhoudswerkzaamheden coördineren en uitvoeren, met inachtneming van normen en veiligheidsvoorschriften. Verantwoordelijkheid nemen voor technische uitdagingen en proactief mogelijkheden identificeren voor systeemverbeteringen en een hogere betrouwbaarheid. Jouw kwalificaties Afgeronde beroepsopleiding in een mechanische, technische of onderhoud gerelateerde richting (bijvoorbeeld automonteur, industrieel monteur, mechatronicatechnicus of vergelijkbaar). Praktische ervaring met mechanische systemen en basiskennis van elektrische, pneumatische, gas- of utiliteitssystemen. Sterke hands-on mentaliteit met het vertrouwen om onbekende technische uitdagingen aan te pakken en nieuwe technologieën te leren. Vermogen om zelfstandig te werken, prioriteiten te stellen en volledige verantwoordelijkheid te nemen voor toegewezen taken. Probleemoplossende instelling, sterke vaardigheden in storingsanalyse en bereidheid om te werken in een cleanroomomgeving met strikte kwaliteits- en veiligheidsnormen. Comfortabel met praktisch werk in cleanroom-, laboratorium- en facilitaire omgevingen, inclusief het gebruik van ladders om verhoogde gebieden te bereiken en het werken in beperkte ruimtes onder de cleanroom wanneer dat nodig is. In staat om fysiek veeleisende onderhouds- en installatiewerkzaamheden veilig uit te voeren, zoals het vervangen van HEPA-filters, het bedienen van afsluiters, het positioneren van gascilinders en het verplaatsen van zware vacuümpompen. Voor zware lasten worden geschikte hulpmiddelen en ondersteuning van collega’s ingezet. Sterke communicatieve vaardigheden in het Engels, bij voorkeur ook in het Nederlands om te kunnen communiceren met externe partijen, management en operators. Ervaring in de halfgeleiderindustrie is niet vereist. Je ontvangt de nodige training en ondersteuning om de apparatuur te leren kennen en je technische vaardigheden verder te ontwikkelen. Hoe succes eruitziet Volledige verantwoordelijkheid nemen voor de cleanroominfrastructuur , en zorgen voor een betrouwbare werking van luchtbehandeling, gas-, water-, afzuig- en elektrische systemen met minimale stilstand. Uitgroeien tot een vertrouwde technische expert binnen het team , door proactief problemen te signaleren, praktische oplossingen te implementeren en bij te dragen aan een veilige en efficiënte werkomgeving. Sterke zelfstandigheid en verantwoordelijkheidsgevoel tonen , door onderhouds- en reparatiewerkzaamheden zelfstandig te beheren en effectief prioriteiten te stellen in een dynamische omgeving. Technische kennis en vaardigheden continu uitbreiden , snel nieuwe systemen en technologieën eigen maken en tegelijkertijd de hoge standaarden handhaven die vereist zijn binnen een cleanroomomgeving. Onze werkcultuur Mensen boven processen. Bij Black Semiconductor is flexibiliteit essentieel — wij zorgen ervoor dat werk zich aanpast aan het leven, en niet andersom. We stimuleren een gezonde balans tussen werk en privé, waarin carrières betekenisvol en verrijkend zijn. Onze processen zijn mensgericht, zodat jij je kunt richten op wat echt belangrijk is. Laten we samen groeien. Jouw potentieel staat bij ons centraal. We bieden de autonomie om blijvende impact te maken en ondersteunen jouw groei met een cultuur van continu leren. We investeren in jouw professionele én persoonlijke ontwikkeling. Jouw gezondheid en toekomst zijn belangrijk. Jouw welzijn heeft de hoogste prioriteit. Daarom bieden wij een uitgebreid arbeidsvoorwaardenpakket met uitstekende verzekeringen, een pensioenregeling en virtuele aandelenopties voor jouw mentale, fysieke en financiële gezondheid. Jouw gemoedsrust staat bij ons centraal — nu én in de toekomst. Wij leven openheid. Samenwerking en inclusiviteit vormen de hoekstenen van onze cultuur. Wij geloven in openheid en bouwen aan vertrouwen en respect. Individualiteit is onze gezamenlijke kracht, die innovatie stimuleert en ons vooruit helpt. Wij verbinden chips – en mensen. Wij moedigen gekwalificeerde kandidaten van iedere achtergrond aan om te solliciteren. We creëren een inclusieve en ondersteunende werkomgeving waarin samenwerking, innovatie en groei centraal staan. Sluit je aan bij ons team en maak deel uit van een organisatie die een verschil maakt in de industrie. Kun jij jezelf zien in deze functie en binnen ons bedrijf? Laten we kennismaken. description: <div class="content-intro"><p><span class="TextRun SCXW142035299 BCX0" lang="EN-US" data-contrast="auto"><span class="NormalTextRun SCXW142035299 BCX0">Resolve to Save Lives (RTSL)</span></span><span data-contrast="none"> is a global health organization that partners locally and globally to create and scale solutions to the world’s deadliest </span><span data-contrast="none">health threats. </span><span data-contrast="none">Millions of people die from preventable health threats. We collaborate to close the gap between proven, life-saving solutions and the people who need them. </span><span data-contrast="none">Since 2017, </span><span data-contrast="none">we’ve</span><span data-contrast="none"> worked with governments and other partners in more than 60 countries to save millions of lives. We work toward a future where people live</span> <span data-contrast="none">longer, healthier lives, communities flourish, and economies thrive. This is an ambitious vision, and it inspires us and our partners to make progress every day.</span><span data-ccp-props="{}"> </span></p></div><p>Resolve to Save Lives' Prevent Epidemics program works closely with Ministries of Health and national public health institutes in Africa to strengthen epidemic preparedness capacity, accelerate disease detection and response, and effectively use data to inform action. In addition to direct partnerships with governments, we also work with implementing partners, including the US CDC, the World Health Organization, the World Bank, and the Global Health Advocacy Incubator, to implement programs, prototype innovations, and ensure sustainability through increased national ownership, including domestic budget allocations.</p> <h3><strong><span data-contrast="none">Position Purpose</span></strong></h3> <p><span data-contrast="auto">The Senior Technical Advisor, Data Use and Decision Science, focuses on bridging the gap between complex epidemiological and contextual data and strategic public health action. The Senior Technical Advisor reports to the Principal Advisor, Data Use for Decision Science, Epidemic Intelligence. </span></p> <p><span data-contrast="auto"><strong>Duration:</strong> This full-time, remote position is for a fixed term of 24 months.</span></p> <h3><strong><span data-contrast="none">Core Duties and Responsibilities</span></strong></h3> <p><span data-contrast="auto">The Senior Technical Advisor, Data Use and Decision Science, collaborates with HQ-based staff and in-country embedded teams on data analytics innovations and delivery.
