title: Talent Acquisition Manager, Talent Acquisition
description: <div class="content-intro"><h2><strong>Brief info about Vinted </strong></h2> <p data-renderer-start-pos="1"><span data-sheets-root="1">Our mission is to make second-hand the first choice, and we're looking for people who want to help us get there. Every day, we work together to help our members buy and sell pre-loved clothing and lifestyle items, giving each piece a second life – or even a third. <br>The Vinted Group is made up of three business units that support this mission:<br><br><strong><a href="https://careers.vinted.com/marketplace" target="_blank">Vinted Marketplace</a></strong> is Europe’s leading platform for second-hand fashion and a go-to destination for all kinds of pre-loved items, with a growing range of categories. Our platform connects millions of members across 20+ markets, helping great items find a new life.<br><br><a href="https://careers.vinted.com/vintedgo" target="_blank"><strong>Vinted Go</strong></a> enhances the shipping experience with a vast network of over 500,000 pick-up and drop-off points, partnering with more than 60 carriers across Europe, with added services like item verification for peace of mind on high-value pieces.<br><br><a href="https://careers.vinted.com/vintedpay" target="_blank"><strong>Vinted Pay</strong></a> is the newest part of the Vinted Group, dedicated to bringing secure, reliable payments to buyers and sellers across Europe. Seamlessly integrated into the Vinted app, it helps keep every transaction safe, efficient, and easy for our members.<br><br>Founded in 2008 in Lithuania, Vinted began as a way for friends to find new homes for clothes they no longer needed. In 2019, we became Lithuania's first unicorn! Today, our headquarters remain in Vilnius, and we've grown with offices across Europe, supported by a team of over 2,000 people. </span></p></div><h2><strong>Information about the position </strong></h2> <p>As Vinted continues to scale and expand its product offerings, acquiring the right talent remains core to our growth, and our Talent Acquisition team is a key driver behind it. Proactive sourcing, designing fair assessment processes, delivering a seamless candidate experience, consulting business stakeholders on hiring decisions, and constant refinement to ensure quality and efficiency is our bread and butter. </p> <p>As a Talent Acquisition Manager, you will join our TA Leadership Team to shape and execute a forward-looking talent acquisition strategy aligned with Vinted’s business ambitions. In this role, you will build and empower a high-performing TA team, cultivating a healthy, collaborative environment grounded in our Leadership Way and core values. Serving as a strategic partner to senior business leaders and the broader People function, you will translate market intelligence and TA analytics into actionable hiring plans, lead high-impact recruitment initiatives, and drive continuous operational excellence.</p> <p>If you are an experienced TA leader passionate about developing people, optimising hiring processes, and scaling impactful talent acquisition initiatives, we would love to meet you.</p> <h2><strong>In this position, you’ll </strong></h2> <ul> <li>Build, lead, and develop a team of TA Specialists, ensuring excellent performance, fostering growth, continuous learning, and a collaborative environment.</li> <li>As part of the Talent Acquisition leadership team, co-create and drive the implementation of TA strategy and roadmap.</li> <li>Partner with senior business leaders and hiring managers to co-create and implement effective functional TA strategy in line with business context. </li> <li>Oversee end-to-end recruitment execution, ensuring quality assessments, efficient processes, and high standards across candidate experience.</li> <li>Act as a trusted advisor to senior leadership on market trends, salary benchmarking, candidate pipelines, and resource allocation.</li> <li>Track, analyze, and report on key TA metrics to continuously optimise recruitment performance, improve process efficiency and quality of hire.</li> <li>Own and contribute to cross-functional TA projects, such as interviewer training, employer branding, hiring framework improvements, and recruiter enablement tools.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>About you </strong></h2> <ul> <li>Demonstrated track record as a Talent Acquisition Manager or TA Team Lead, managing performance, development, and growth.</li> <li>Deep knowledge of modern sourcing strategies, candidate evaluation techniques, and competitive talent markets across Tech functions.</li> <li>Experience using recruitment analytics to evaluate efficiency, identify bottlenecks, and inform decisions for improvement.</li> <li>Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with a proven ability to navigate ambiguity, identify root causes, and implement pragmatic, effective solutions.</li> <li>Exceptional communication skills with the ability to influence, guide, and collaborate with senior business stakeholders, hiring managers, and People team colleagues. </li> <li>Excellent written and verbal English communication skills (English is Vinted’s official working language).</li> </ul> <h2><strong>Work perks  </strong></h2> <ul> <li>The opportunity to benefit from our share options programme</li> <li>25 days of paid annual leave</li> <li>Newest MacBook models</li> <li>Digital mental and emotional health support and Employee Assistant Program (EAP)</li> <li>Frequent team-building events</li> <li>Home office support: we provide IT workstation equipment and a personal budget of up to €540 for home workplace furniture</li> <li>Lunch benefit per working day</li> <li>Company bike leasing scheme</li> <li>Monthly budget for a flexible benefits platform</li> <li>Work from Home allowance</li> <li>A personal monthly budget for shopping on Vinted</li> <li>Collective Defined Contribution Pension plan</li> <li>NS Business Card for your commute to the office by public transport</li> <li>A dog-friendly office</li> </ul> <h2><strong>Working at Vinted </strong></h2> <p><strong>Workation policy</strong></p> <p>Better balance holidays with workdays by working remotely! Up to 90 days per year in the EU, of these, 21 days can be spent globally. For non-EU citizens, it's 21 days worldwide. This can be combined with time off for vacation or personal time.</p> <p><strong>Individual learning budget</strong></p> <p>Each year, you’ll be given a learning budget (starting at €3,000), and a total of up to 10 working days over a 2-year period to support your personal and professional development.</p> <p><strong>Hybrid work</strong></p> <p>Our hybrid model, with 2 recommended office days a week, gives you and your team the flexibility to decide if and when you want to work from home, and when to catch up in person.</p> <p><strong>Equal opportunity</strong></p> <p>We welcome applications from everybody, regardless of your background, identity, or life experiences. Job openings come with guides, not checklists. If you’re excited about a role, but don’t identify with every point in the ‘About you’ section, apply anyway – you might still be the perfect match!</p><div class="content-pay-transparency"><div class="pay-input"><div class="title">The annual gross salary range for this position excluding 8% holiday pay is:</div><div class="pay-range"><span>€78.000</span><span class="divider">—</span><span>€105.000 EUR</span></div></div></div> Find Jobs in Netherlands on Arbeitnow

title: Operations Manager - West Midlands Sort Centre
description: Relay is fundamentally reshaping how goods move in an online era. Backed by Europe’s largest-ever logistics Series A ($35M) led by deep-tech investors Plural, and a recently closed Series B ($95M), Relay is scaling faster than 99% of venture-backed startups. We're assembling the most talent-dense team the logistics industry has ever seen Relay’s Mission is to free commerce from friction . Today, high delivery costs act as a hidden tax on e-commerce, quietly shaping what can be sold online and limiting who can participate. We envision a world where more goods move more freely between more people , making the online shopping experience seamless and accessible to everyone. THE TEAM • ~160 people , around half in engineering, product and data • 45+ advanced degrees across computer science, mathematics and operations research • Thousands of data points captured, calculated, analysed and predicted for every single parcel we handle • An intellectually vibrant culture of first‑principles thinking , tight feedback loops and relentless experimentation The Opportunity You will report to the Site Manager/Head of Site and will run shifts at one of our Hybrid Sort Centres (HSCs), leading 50–100+ operatives through high-volume, time-pressured sortation where minutes matter and small deviations cascade into missed deadlines. Each of our HSCs handle over 40 million parcels annually, with our largest site measuring more than 300,000 sq ft. You will also be accountable for whether the site is measurably better in a month than it is today for each of our key metrics. You are on the floor for your shift, every shift. This is not a project role with occasional site visits and it is not a desk job, the forward work happens along with running the operation. Who will thrive in this role Deliver shift plan end to end people deployment, throughput, quality standards, and health & safety compliance Lead, develop, and performance-manage a frontline team of 50–100+ operatives Build the mechanisms that hold the operation together. Build controls, cadences, metrics, SOPs, change management and own their adoption, not only their design Plan ahead for future shifts; labour, training, and the risks you can see coming before they land Own the end-of-shift handover; what happened, what is at risk, what the next shift needs to know Stay decisive through volume peaks, outages, and labour gaps. Triage, solve the problem at hand quickly, contain the impact, restore flow Present and write clearly whether briefs, escalations, handovers or post-incident reviews. Decisions here get made based off what you wrote Implement changes into a live operation such as introducing robotics, launching new sortation tech or onboarding new clients. We are changing the operations constantly which means you’ll roll change out mid flight and bring your team along the journey. Who you are Scaled something from zero : a site, a market, a process or a program. Managed a physical operation : quick commerce, grocery, e-commerce fulfillment, last mile, 3PL, food production, airport ground handling, rail. Anywhere with a hard cut off and people on the floor. Communicate in both directions and have strong people management skills : you can brief 80 operatives at shift start and take a problem to senior leadership the same day. Built a mechanism that held : a control, a cadence, a metric, a document standard. Something you authored that changed how frontline teams worked. Own numbers rather than report them : you can name a metric you created or redefined, explain why the previous one was wrong, and say what changed afterwards. Understand frontline work : one of these must be true: you have personally led frontline teams; you have worked embedded in and around a frontline population day to day, without the reporting line; or you have been accountable for outcomes delivered by frontline people you did not employ. You do not need to have worked in parcels, fulfilment, or sortation. Several of our most talented people had not. Backgrounds that translate well Program Manager in a logistics or e-commerce business Operations Excellence and Continuous Improvement Strategy & Operations Transformation manager Launch and Expansion Manager Regional operations manager We have hired well from corporate operations, from central operations inside large UK retailers and carriers, and from quick commerce and marketplace operators. Consulting backgrounds work where you implemented, not only recommended; we are keen to understand what you who actually rolled it out. Hiring process Our hiring process is fast. Initial screen (15 min) Hiring Manager conversation (90 min) - 45 min onsite interview immediately followed by a 45 min site tour where you shadow an existing shift manager Final interview (45 min). Decision and offer within 48 hours Who Thrives at Relay? Aim with Precision: You define problems clearly and measure your impact meticulously. Play to Win: You chase bold bets, tackle the hard stuff, and view constraints as fuel, not friction. 1% Better Every Day : You believe that small, consistent improvements lead to exponential growth. You move quickly, deliver results, and learn from every experience. All In, All the Time : You show up and step up. You take ownership from start to finish and do what it takes to deliver when it counts. People-Powered Greatness : You invest in your teammates. You give and receive feedback with care and candour. You build trust through high standards and shared success. Grow the Whole Pie : You seek out win-win solutions for merchants, couriers, and our customers, because when they thrive, so do we. If these resonate, and you combine strong technical fundamentals with entrepreneurial drive, let’s connect. Relay is an equal-opportunity employer committed to diversity, inclusion, and fostering a workplace where everyone thrives. Find more English Speaking Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

title: Sr Software Engineer, Ads Auctions & Marketplace Optimization
description: <div class="content-intro"><h2 style="font-family: GothamBold,Helvetica,Arial,sans-serif; color: #662d91;">Teamwork makes the stream work.</h2> <p> </p> <h3 style="font-family: GothamBold,Helvetica,Arial,sans-serif;"><strong>Roku is changing how the world watches TV</strong></h3> <p>Roku is the #1 TV streaming platform in the U.S., Canada, and Mexico, and we've set our sights on powering every television in the world. Roku pioneered streaming to the TV. Our mission is to be the TV streaming platform that connects the entire TV ecosystem. We connect consumers to the content they love, enable content publishers to build and monetize large audiences, and provide advertisers unique capabilities to engage consumers.</p> <p>From your first day at Roku, you'll make a valuable - and valued - contribution. We're a fast-growing public company where no one is a bystander. We offer you the opportunity to delight millions of TV streamers around the world while gaining meaningful experience across a variety of disciplines.</p> <p> </p></div><h3><strong>What does the team work on?</strong></h3> <p> </p> <p>Roku is the No. 1 TV streaming platform in the US, Canada and Mexico, with more than 100 million active accounts. Every ad impression across that platform has to be cleared and priced in real time — that is what the Ads Auctions and Marketplace Optimization team does. We build the auction mechanics, the pricing and pacing logic, and the low-latency systems that run them, balancing outcomes for advertisers, publishers, viewers, and Roku on every request. We are growing the team in Cambridge, which is becoming its largest hub, alongside colleagues in Amsterdam, Austin, San Jose, Ukraine and Uruguay — so you would be shaping how the UK side of this team works rather than inheriting it.</p> <h3><strong>What is the role?</strong></h3> <p> </p> <p>You will build the systems that apply mathematical and algorithmic rigour to optimise across multiple objectives, deciding which ads get served, in which placements, and when. The work spans auction mechanics, optimisation, the output of predictive ML models, and the real-time infrastructure underneath, mostly in Java on the JVM. It is hands-on and senior in scope: expect to move between whiteboard-level design and production code in the same week, and to own problems from framing through rollout. You will work directly with the hiring manager and a small group of senior engineers, in codebases shared with other ads engineers, on problems where your decisions are visible in revenue. You will optimise for second-order effects in a marketplace where participants react to each other, and to us, in real time. We are looking for people who are enthusiastic about solving these kinds of problems.</p> <h3><strong>How will I use AI at Roku?</strong></h3> <p> </p> <p>At Roku, we don't just use AI, we work with it. AI agents and smart tools help power drafts, analysis, and repetitive workflows, while our people bring direction, judgment, and accountability. We're looking for curious, adaptable builders who can show how they've used AI or automation to move faster, raise the bar, and scale their impact.</p> <p>We value your AI skills if you have built fluency across the agentic engineering toolchain — coding harnesses like Claude Code or Cursor, MCP servers, custom skills, or agent frameworks. And you can describe projects where you shipped real work with these tools. You know how to drive an agent, verify its output, and ramp on an unfamiliar codebase with an agent helping you.</p> <h3><strong>What are the responsibilities of the role?</strong></h3> <p> </p> <ul> <li>Design and build components of Roku's real-time ad auction and marketplace systems</li> <li>Own the multi-objective optimisation at the core of the auction, balancing what advertisers, publishers, viewers, and Roku each want from the same impression</li> <li>Own development work end to end, from framing the problem through production rollout</li> <li>Build and operate JVM services where latency and reliability are product requirements, not stretch goals</li> <li>Use probability, statistics and experimentation to test changes before and after launch</li> <li>Work with AI tooling as a normal part of how you design, build, test and review</li> <li>Explain technical trade-offs clearly to engineering and cross-functional partners</li> </ul> <h3><strong>What experience would help someone be successful in this role at Roku?</strong></h3> <p> </p> <ul> <li>Around six or more years building production software, with strong systems judgement</li> <li>Production experience in Java or another JVM language, or depth in a comparable statically typed language such as C#, C++ or Go, and the appetite to ramp on Java</li> <li>Comfort designing and operating distributed systems at scale and low latency</li> <li>A solid grounding in maths, algorithms, probability and statistics as applied to real systems</li> <li>Demonstrated AI and agentic-tooling fluency, as described above</li> <li>Ad tech, auctions or marketplace experience is preferred, and we move quickly for candidates who have it</li> <li>Comparable experience on mathematically rigorous or optimisation-heavy problems in another domain is an acceptable alternative</li> </ul> <h6>#LI-MS3</h6><div class="content-conclusion"><h3><strong><span style="font-family: GothamBold, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif;">What's Roku's approach to hybrid working?</span></strong></h3> <p>Roku fosters an inclusive and collaborative environment where teams generally work in the office Monday through Thursday. Fridays are generally flexible for remote work, except for employees whose specific roles or assigned office location require five days' a week attendance.</p> <p> </p> <h3 style="font-family: GothamBold,Helvetica,Arial,sans-serif;"><strong>What are some of the benefits?</strong></h3> <p>Roku is committed to offering a diverse range of benefits as part of our compensation package to support our employees and their families. Our comprehensive benefits include global access to mental health and financial wellness support and resources. Local benefits include statutory and voluntary benefits which may include healthcare (medical, dental, and vision), life, accident, disability, commuter, and retirement options (401(k)/pension). Employees are supported in taking time off, in accordance with local leave policies and other personal needs to support their evolving work and life needs. It's important to note that not every benefit is available in all locations or for every role. For details specific to your location, please consult with your recruiter.</p> <p> </p> <h3 style="font-family: GothamBold,Helvetica,Arial,sans-serif;"><strong>Accommodations</strong></h3> <p>Roku welcomes applicants of all backgrounds and provides reasonable accommodations and adjustments in accordance with applicable law. If you require reasonable accommodation at any point in the hiring process, please direct your inquiries to <a ---------- <p> </p> <h3 style="font-family: GothamBold,Helvetica,Arial,sans-serif;"><strong>What should I know about Roku's culture?</strong></h3> <p>Roku is a great place for people who want to work in a fast-paced environment where everyone is focused on the company's success rather than their own. We try to surround ourselves with people who are great at their jobs, who are easy to work with, and who keep their egos in check. We appreciate a sense of humor. We believe a fewer number of very talented folks can do more for less cost than a larger number of less talented teams. We're independent thinkers with big ideas who act boldly, move fast and accomplish extraordinary things through collaboration and trust. In short, at Roku you'll be part of a company that's changing how the world watches TV. </p> <p>We have a unique culture that we are proud of. We think of ourselves primarily as problem-solvers, which itself is a two-part idea. We come up with the solution, but the solution isn't real until it is built and delivered to the customer. title: Assembly and Test Technician
description: LOCATION: CALMSDEN, CIRENCESTER, UK. LIMITED FIELD TRAVEL AS REQUIRED | 5 DAYS ONSITE THE LAST FRONTIER ARD was founded on a paradox. The Arctic is both the next great economic frontier and one of the most hostile environments on Earth. Rich in resources and strategically vital, yet bone-chillingly cold, dark for months, and fundamentally inhospitable to humans. This paradox - an explosion of activity in a place that resists human presence - is why we exist. Our solution is autonomy. We build systems that operate reliably and intelligently in the Arctic, so that humans don't always have to. Founded by record-holding pioneers with decades of polar experience, we take calculated risks on hard problems that matter. If you want to build and deploy ground-up technology with real-world impact, at an inflection point in history that won’t reappear, we’d like to talk. THE ROLE ARD is growing and we’re looking for an Assembly and Test Technician to help us build and test our ruggedized hardware - from field-ready energy and battery systems to the autonomous platforms we deploy in the Arctic. Right now, our biggest constraint isn’t design. It’s the time it takes to assemble and test what we’ve designed. Reporting to our Senior Test Engineer , you’ll join our engineering team, working alongside our mechanical and electrical engineers and across our main hardware workstreams. You’ll take hands-on ownership of assembly and testing, helping with the practical implementation and testing of engineering designs. Within your first 3 months, you’ll have helped to take assembly and test off the critical path on our key projects, and helped put in place the documentation and test processes that let us build and test consistently, unit after unit. CORE RESPONSIBILITIES Assemble mechanical and electrical sub-assemblies, harnesses, PCBAs, and complete units to drawings and build instructions, so they’re ready for test on schedule. Run test phases on assemblies and finished units and record the results accurately, so issues are found and fixed before hardware reaches the field. Help set up repeatable test processes, from test plans and rigs to how results are captured, working closely with our Senior Test Engineer. Write and maintain build instructions, test procedures and records, raising the standard of our engineering documentation as we scale. Spot and report problems found during build and test, giving engineers the detail they need to debug and improve the next design revision. REQUIREMENTS About You You’re a practical, hands-on technician who takes pride in building things properly and getting the details right. You’re methodical, you like a clear process, and you’d rather write something down than rely on memory. You might come from a technician role in engineering, manufacturing or a test lab, an engineering apprenticeship, the armed forces, or a mechanical or electrical engineering degree with plenty of hands-on build experience. * Please note: this role is not eligible for visa sponsorship * Essential An engineering qualification (such as an HNC/HND, apprenticeship or degree in mechanical or electrical engineering), or equivalent hands-on experience. Hands-on experience assembling mechanical or electrical hardware in a workshop, lab or production setting. Experience with basic soldering equipment Ability to work from engineering drawings, schematics and written build instructions. Experience running tests on hardware and recording the results accurately. Confident using common workshop tools and electrical test equipment, such as multimeters and bench power supplies. Comfortable owning your own tasks with guidance from the engineering team, and raising problems early when a build or test doesn’t go to plan. Desirable Experience writing or improving build instructions, test procedures or other technical documentation. Experience with electrical assembly such as wiring looms, crimping or soldering, or working with battery systems. Experience building hardware in small batches or repeat runs, rather than one-off prototypes. Experience with surface-mount PCB assembly Future Security Clearance Requirements As our business scales into the defence and security sectors, the responsibilities of this role are expected to evolve to include projects requiring UK Security Check (SC) clearance . While an active clearance is not required to apply or start in this role, candidates must be willing and eligible to undergo UK Government security vetting in the future should project requirements dictate it. To meet the standard eligibility criteria for UK standard SC vetting, you must typically have resided in the UK for the past 5 continuous years , hold a valid passport, and be capable of passing comprehensive background, financial, and criminal record checks. Why ARD The mission - The Arctic is the fastest-changing region on Earth. You'll build the intelligence layer that helps understand and steward it — an early-warning system for the planet's coldest edge. Early stage, real influence - ARD is at an exciting early stage. You'll join while our products, team and culture are still taking shape, and your ideas will directly influence where we go next. Ownership and accountability - We give people real responsibility from day one. You'll own your work end to end, be trusted to make decisions, and be accountable for delivering results that ship and get used. title: Staff Software Engineer: Applied AI
description: <div class="content-intro"><h2><strong>About Flexport: </strong></h2> <p>At Flexport, we believe global trade can move the human race forward. That’s why it’s our mission to make global commerce so easy there will be more of it. We’re shaping the future of a $10T industry with solutions powered by innovative technology and exceptional people. Today, companies of all sizes—from emerging brands to Fortune 500s—use Flexport technology to move more than $19B of merchandise across 112 countries a year. </p> <p>The recent global supply chain crisis has put Flexport center stage as we continue to play a pivotal role in how goods move around the world. We are proud to have the support of the best investors in the game who believe in our mission, solutions and people. Ready to tackle global challenges that impact business, society, and the environment? Come join us.</p></div><h1>Staff Software Engineer: Applied AI</h1> <p>Every day, thousands of shipments cross borders, change hands, and hit unexpected problems. For decades, fixing those problems meant phone calls, emails, and humans heroically firefighting. We think that's about to change completely.</p> <p>We've been building AI agents that spot trouble before it happens, reroute shipments, and keep goods moving—with our team of experts in the loop where it counts. The early results have been jaw-dropping. We're now going all in on a future where supply chains run themselves, and we're looking for the people who want to build that future with us.</p> <p>This isn't a role where you join a team and pick up tickets. You'll find the highest-leverage problems, design the solutions, and ship them to operators moving freight across 112 countries. If that sounds like your idea of a good time, read on.</p> <h2>What You'll Do</h2> <p>You'll build the cutting-edge agents and AI-powered applications that make Flexport's operations smarter, faster, and increasingly autonomous. That means:</p> <ul> <li>Designing and shipping <strong>end-to-end AI agents</strong> that handle real logistics work—customs compliance, document processing, exception management, and more</li> <li><strong>Crossing organizational boundaries</strong> to understand problems deeply, align stakeholders, and get things done without waiting for permission</li> <li>Moving fast from idea to production, treating every deployment as a learning opportunity</li> <li>Working directly with operators, domain experts, and leadership to turn ambiguous problems into shipped solutions</li> </ul> <h2>You Should Have</h2> <ul> <li><strong>10+ years of software engineering experience</strong>; you've built with LLMs extensively — whether in production, side projects, or just because you couldn't stop yourself</li> <li><strong>Strong product instincts</strong>: you can identify what's worth building, not just execute on a spec</li> <li><strong>LLM fluency</strong>: agent patterns, RAG, prompt engineering, tool use, evaluation. You know what works in production and what looks good in demos</li> <li><strong>Full-stack capability</strong> in TypeScript and Next.js—you can own a feature end to end</li> <li><strong>An entrepreneurial drive</strong>: you thrive in ambiguity, move fast, and don't wait to be told what to do</li> <li><strong>Excellent communication</strong>: you can work across teams and disciplines to get alignment and unblock yourself</li> <li><strong>An audacious appetite for impact</strong>: you're not here to maintain—you're here to change how global trade works</li> </ul> <h2>Nice to Have</h2> <ul> <li>Experience with workflow orchestration (Temporal, etc.)</li> <li>Experience building internal tools or operator-facing applications</li> </ul> <h2>How We Work</h2> <ul> <li>We come to the office 3 times a week to hang out, whiteboard, and ship together</li> <li>We have the latest hardware and software—including frontier AI models on day one</li> <li>We're agile, but not dogmatic. Teams decide how they work best</li> <li><strong>Stack</strong>: Next.js, TypeScript, Postgres, Snowflake. For AI: Anthropic, OpenAI, Google AI APIs</li> </ul> <h2>Why This Role Is Special</h2> <ul> <li><strong>Your work is visible</strong>: This is a small, senior team reporting directly to the VP of Engineering. What you build gets noticed, and your ideas shape the direction</li> <li><strong>Real stakes</strong>: thousands of containers, 112 countries, $19 billion of goods. Your agents will have immediate, measurable impact</li> <li><strong>Full ownership</strong>: from problem definition to production deployment, it's yours</li> <li><strong>You're early</strong>: the playbook for applied AI in enterprise logistics doesn't exist yet—you'll help write it</li> </ul> <p> </p> <h2><strong>What's in it for you: </strong></h2> <ul> <li>An opportunity to contribute to one of the fastest-growing companies, where you’ll have the chance to create a global impact while being a part of a  thriving multinational environment </li> <li>Daily catered lunches incl. vegetarian options, breakfast, snacks and soft drinks available in our office on daily basis </li> <li>Commute expenses: Flexport will cover  home-office commuting costs for employees living outside of Amsterdam</li> <li>25 working days as vacation days based on full time employment.</li> <li>Health insurance: Flexport offers a collective health insurance plan including a basic package and any available additional packages. Your monthly premium is fully paid by Flexport. </li> <li>A defined pension contribution scheme</li> <li>Equity program: every team member becomes a shareholder, aligning our success with yours. As a private company in a multi-trillion dollar industry, you have a direct stake in our collective growth and success.</li> <li>Employee Assistance Program through Aetna Resources for Living: Flexport provides an employer-sponsored program at no cost to you and your household members</li> <li>Parental leave benefit: Flexport is here to support you and your families in one of the most important times in life – the birth of a child! Our parental leave program allows both mothers and partners to take time off from work for pregnancy, childbirth, and to bond with your new child.</li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><div id="1704749847.557549" class="c-virtual_list__item" data-qa="virtual-list-item" data-item-key="1704749847.557549"> <div class="c-message_kit__background p-message_pane_message__message c-message_kit__message" data-qa="message_container" data-qa-unprocessed="false" data-qa-placeholder="false"> <div class="c-message_kit__hover" data-qa-hover="true"> <div class="c-message_kit__actions c-message_kit__actions--default"> <div class="c-message_kit__gutter"> <div class="c-message_kit__gutter__right" data-qa="message_content"> <div class="c-message_kit__blocks c-message_kit__blocks--rich_text"> <div class="c-message__message_blocks c-message__message_blocks--rich_text" data-qa="message-text"> <div class="p-block_kit_renderer" data-qa="block-kit-renderer"> <div class="p-block_kit_renderer__block_wrapper p-block_kit_renderer__block_wrapper--first"> <div class="p-rich_text_block"> <h4>Commitment to Equal Opportunity</h4> <p>At Flexport, our ability to fulfill our mission of making global commerce easy and accessible relies on having a diverse, dedicated and engaged workforce. title: Senior Manager – Data Engineering & Machine Learning
description: <div class="content-intro"><p>At Catawiki, every day brings the extraordinary! Whether it’s <a href="https://www.catawiki.com/en/c/583-sports-memorabilia">Daniel Ricciardo’s Formula 1 Car</a>, a <a href="https://www.catawiki.com/en/c/579-fossils">Woolly Mammoth’s Skeleton</a>, <a href="https://www.catawiki.com/en/l/10035805">Lady Gaga's Jumpsuit</a> or <a href="https://www.catawiki.com/en/c/583-sports-memorabilia">Usain Bolt’s running shoe</a>, we encounter exceptional objects every day.</p> <p>We’re a one-of-a-kind marketplace for buying and selling special objects. As a growing, diverse and sustainable scale-up, we proudly live by three core values. If these values resonate with you, we’d love to explore how you can join us.</p> <ul> <li>Taking ownership and driving impact </li> <li>Being open to change and feedback</li> <li>Being passionate about our mission and our customers. </li> </ul></div><h3>Your mission</h3> <p>As Senior Manager – Data Engineering & Machine Learning, you’ll lead Catawiki’s established team of Data Engineers and Machine Learning specialists. You’ll help the team grow, set its technical direction and build on work already underway across data foundations and production machine learning.</p> <p>The role spans two connected disciplines. You’ll bring deep experience in either Data Engineering or Machine Learning Engineering, and enough breadth to set direction across the other.</p> <p>You’ll partner with Product, Engineering, Analytics and business stakeholders to set priorities and connect the team’s work to outcomes across Catawiki.</p> <h3><strong>What you'll do</strong></h3> <p>You’ll lead the team through platform modernisation and product-facing ML work. Current priorities include modernising the infrastructure for serving production models, introducing a feature store to improve feature management and consistency across model training and serving, and strengthening observability and cost controls. You’ll help set priorities and raise the reliability and impact of this work.</p> <ul> <li><strong>Lead and develop the team:</strong> Set direction, coach experienced specialists and create clear ownership across Data Engineering and Machine Learning.</li> <li><strong>Build dependable data foundations:</strong> Improve the pipelines, integrations and infrastructure the wider Data team relies on for analysis, reporting and machine learning.</li> <li><strong>Strengthen production ML:</strong> Improve deployment, monitoring and operational follow-through for production models, so teams can run them reliably and resolve issues effectively.</li> <li><strong>Advance marketplace models:</strong> Help teams improve recommendation, cancellation and bidder-risk use cases, connecting model performance to meaningful product outcomes.</li> <li><strong>Set direction and priorities:</strong> Work with Product, Engineering, Analytics and business partners to choose high-value problems and balance delivery, reliability and long-term platform health.</li> <li><strong>Shape the technology strategy:</strong> Reporting to the SVP Engineering, you’ll join the Engineering Management team and help shape the direction of the Technology department.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>What you'll bring</strong></h3> <p>You combine strong technical judgement with experienced people leadership. You create clarity in a complex environment, empower specialists and make sound decisions across both disciplines.</p> <p>Your experience will include the following. Familiarity with Catawiki’s current stack is useful, and equivalent experience with other platforms is welcome.</p> <ul> <li><strong>Technical depth in one discipline:</strong> Deep experience designing, building and operating data-intensive systems in Data Engineering or Machine Learning Engineering, with practical knowledge of the other.</li> <li><strong>People leadership:</strong> Experience leading experienced engineers or ML specialists, coaching their growth and setting clear expectations.</li> <li><strong>Architecture and systems thinking:</strong> Ability to evaluate trade-offs and guide architecture for data platforms, distributed systems and production infrastructure.</li> <li><strong>Production ML understanding:</strong> Experience with the deployment, monitoring and operation of machine learning systems in production.</li> <li><strong>Business and product judgement:</strong> Ability to connect technical work to business goals, make priority calls and assess outcomes.</li> <li><strong>Relevant cloud platform experience:</strong> We run on GCP using BigQuery, Vertex AI and Kubernetes. Experience with equivalent AWS services is also relevant.</li> <li><strong>Streaming and integration experience:</strong> Kafka, event-driven systems or modern data integration tools are useful.</li> <li><strong>Clear communication:</strong> Ability to explain technical trade-offs and align technical and non-technical stakeholders.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>How we work</strong></h3> <ul> <li>You’ll lead a team of eight Data Engineers and Machine Learning specialists across Amsterdam and Lisbon.</li> <li>The team works closely with Product, Engineering, Analytics and business stakeholders to connect data and ML capabilities to real needs.</li> <li>Specialists own implementation while you set direction, priorities and clear standards.</li> <li>The team supports production data and ML systems, and has no on-call rotation.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>Where you'll be</strong></h3> <p>This is a <em>hybrid</em> role in Amsterdam. You will work from our Amsterdam HQ a minimum of 2 days per week.</p><div class="content-conclusion"><div class="text text-align-left "> <h3><strong>Why You'll Love Working with Us</strong></h3> <ul> <li><strong>Create a visible impact </strong>by working at scale in a global organisation serving millions of customers across 80+ categories. In our flat structure, every role has a broad scope and directly impacts both our customers and the business.</li> <li><strong>Learn and grow</strong> through our Learning & Development initiatives, including clear development plans and mentorship programmes to support your career progression.</li> <li><strong>A culture of connection defines us</strong>. We’re a passionate, diverse team of 800+ Catawikians representing 60+ nationalities. We foster an inclusive and queer-friendly environment where everyone is encouraged to bring their full self to work.</li> <li><strong>Celebrate life’s moments with us. </strong>You’ll receive a €100 Catavoucher when you join, a €50 Catavoucher on your birthday, and an extra day off each year to “Pursue Your Passion<strong>”</strong>. We also offer additional leave for key work anniversaries and important life events. Benefits may vary by location.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>Our Offices and Way of Working</strong></h3> <p class="p1">Our vibrant offices in Amsterdam and Lisbon are designed to inspire collaboration. Most Catawikians operate in a hybrid setup, combining office-based and remote work, with a minimum of two days per week in the office, unless a role is explicitly stated as fully remote or fully office-based.</p> </div> <h3><strong>Interested?</strong></h3> <p class="p1">Apply with an English CV and Cover Letter. By applying, you agree to <a href="https://www.catawiki.com/conditions/applicant-privacy-policy.pdf">Catawiki’s Applicant Privacy Policy.</a> If you’re excited about this role but don’t meet every requirement, we still encourage you to apply anyway. You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles.<br><br>We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support the review of your application. AI may help us assess how your experience matches the requirements of the role, but hiring decisions are always made by our recruitment team</p></div> Find Jobs in Netherlands on Arbeitnow

title: Real-World Data Associate
description: About myTomorrows myTomorrows is a global health tech company dedicated to breaking down barriers for patients seeking treatment options. title: Total Rewards & People Business Partner
description: People Business Partner & Total Rewards Most People roles ask you to run processes someone else built. This one asks you to build them, and to own one of them outright: how Eye rewards and recognises its people. You’ll do that while partnering the part of the business where cybersecurity actually happens, with managers who are still learning to lead and specialists who know exactly how rare they are. If you need a mature organization around you to do your best work, this isn’t it. If you get energy from building one, keep reading. The role This role has two halves, and you’ll split your time roughly evenly between them. The first half is Total Rewards. You’ll own compensation and benefits at Eye, including salary reviews, benchmarking, levelling, benefits and our equity program. There’s no finished framework waiting for you. You’ll be the People Business Partner for our core business: security operations, incident response, customer support & onboarding, and project management. What you’ll do Own Total Rewards end to end: run the annual salary review, keep our benchmarks honest, and build levelling and salary bands that make sense to managers and employees alike. Prepare Eye for pay transparency: work with Legal and Finance so we’re ready for the EU directive, not scrambling to catch up. Be the trusted partner for leaders in security operations and customer support: coaching, challenging and advising at every level of maturity, up to and including the executive team. Be visible. This is an office where face-to-face matters: you’ll be on the floor in The Hague, listening to what’s actually going on, not partnering from a distance. Professional English. Dutch is a plus, not a requirement. Based in the Netherlands and happy coming into the office: at least 1 day a week in The Hague, ideally 3. Competitive base salary and company equity. MacBook Pro or Dell XPS, plus iPhone or Samsung. mix of on-site in our Taipei office and remote from home.   Global travel to sprints, events, and partner meetings is part of the role.</p> <h2>What your day will look like </h2> <ul> <li>Represent Canonical, its solutions and software to partners.</li> <li>Develop a deep understanding of silicon partner strategies, technologies and roadmaps and identify overlap with Canonical’s current and future products.</li> <li>Work cross-functionally with engineering, product, marketing and sales teams to facilitate new business, leading definition of joint products, solutions and complex programs relying heavily on your communicating and influencing skills.   </li> <li>Ensure that robust project plans are created, tracked, and executed. </li> <li>Develop joint Go To Market strategy and campaigns with silicon partners, manage market messaging, collateral and launch plans across products.</li> <li>Negotiate successful contracts.</li> </ul> <h2>What we are looking for in you</h2> <ul> <li>B.A / B.S / B.E degree in science, technology and/or engineering.</li> <li>Fundamental understanding of the semiconductor industry and ecosystem.</li> <li>Experience in software and system architecture is preferred.</li> <li>Customer-facing experience in business development, technology strategy or similar functions.</li> <li>Excellent communication skills; ability to grasp complex material and synthesize key points.</li> <li>Ability to think and work at both strategic and tactical levels</li> <li>Disciplined and self motivated for a remote-first workplace environment.</li> </ul> <h2>Additional skills that you might also bring</h2> <ul> <li>Experience with open source software and open source business models is preferred.</li> <li>Team leadership or program management experience.</li> </ul> <h2>What we offer you</h2> <p>Your base pay will depend on various factors including your geographical location, level of experience, knowledge and skills. In addition to the benefits above, certain roles are also eligible for additional benefits and rewards including annual bonuses and sales incentives based on revenue or utilisation. Our compensation philosophy is to ensure equity right across our global workforce.  </p> <p>In addition to a competitive base pay, we provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. Please note that additional benefits may apply depending on the work location and, for more information on these, please ask your Talent Partner.</p> <ul> <li>Fully remote working environment - we’ve been working remotely since 2004!</li> <li>Personal learning and development budget of 2,000USD per annum</li> <li>Annual compensation review</li> <li>Recognition rewards</li> <li>Annual holiday leave</li> <li>Parental Leave</li> <li>Employee Assistance Programme</li> <li>Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues at ‘sprints’</li> <li>Priority Pass for travel and travel upgrades for long haul company events</li> </ul> <h2>About Canonical</h2> <p>Canonical is a pioneering tech firm that is at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open source projects and the platform for AI, IoT and the cloud, we are changing the world on a daily basis. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence - in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do.</p> <p>Canonical has been a remote-first company since its inception in 2004.​ Work at Canonical is a step into the future, and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game. Canonical provides a unique window into the world of 21st-century digital business.</p> <h2>Canonical is an equal opportunity employer</h2> <p>We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. <a href="https://canonical.com/careers/diversity/identity">Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.</a></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;"> </span></p> <p>#LI-remote </p>

title: Senior Product Manager, Sovereign & Hybrid Deployments
description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong>Welcome to Planet. We believe in using space to help life on Earth.</strong></p> <p>Planet designs, builds, and operates the largest constellation of imaging satellites in history. This constellation delivers an unprecedented dataset of empirical information via a revolutionary cloud-based platform to authoritative figures in commercial, environmental, and humanitarian sectors. We are both a space company and data company all rolled into one.</p> <p>Customers and users across the globe use Planet's data to develop new technologies, drive revenue, power research, and solve our world’s toughest obstacles.</p> <p>As we control every component of hardware design, manufacturing, data processing, and software engineering, our office is a truly inspiring mix of experts from a variety of domains.</p> <p>We have a people-centric approach toward culture and community and we strive to iterate in a way that puts our team members first and prepares our company for growth. Join Planet and be a part of our mission to change the way people see the world.</p> <p>Planet is a global company with employees working remotely world wide and joining us from offices in San Francisco, Washington DC, Germany, Austria, Slovenia, and The Netherlands.</p></div><p><strong>About the Role:  </strong></p> <p>Planet is expanding its platform capabilities to support customers who require dedicated, in-region, or on-premises instantiations of our core platform. As the Senior Product Manager for Sovereign & Hybrid Deployments, you will drive the productization of our platform for isolated, air-gapped, and hybrid environments.</p> <p>You will serve as the critical bridge between high-touch enterprise customer delivery and scalable core engineering. title: Senior ML Engineer | Kimchi (Inference Stack Optimization)
description: <h4>Why Kimchi?</h4> <p>Great models are raw ingredients. Kimchi is what happens when you ferment them with good engineering. We started inside CAST AI helping companies run LLMs on their own Kubernetes clusters; today we run our own coding harness on any model you pick, and we run the models underneath it ourselves.<br><br><strong>Kimchi Inference</strong></p> <p>One API line and a customer's existing client just works: DeepSeek, GLM, Kimi, MiniMax, Nemotron served serverless from our own GPU fleet (OpenAI- and Anthropic-compatible, pay per token, spend visible per user, team, and key). When control matters, the same models run on the customer's own cluster instead. Behind that one line sits the machinery you'll own: SGLang and vLLM engines, B300 nodes, a shared cluster filesystem that holds every checkpoint exactly once, KV caches riding coding traffic with heavy prefix reuse, and the benchmark harness that gates every change we ship.<br><br></p> <p><em data-prosemirror-content-type="mark" data-prosemirror-mark-name="em"><span id="edb2bdea-40e7-48f0-9485-a0bd7169c7c7" data-mark-type="annotation" data-mark-annotation-type="inlineComment" data-id="edb2bdea-40e7-48f0-9485-a0bd7169c7c7" data-prosemirror-content-type="mark" data-prosemirror-mark-name="annotation">Made by Cast AI — a Miami-headquartered, globally distributed team across 34 countries that hit unicorn status in January 2026 with a $50B+ backed investment pushing its valuation past $1 billion.</span></em></p> <h4>About the role</h4> <p>Throughput. Latency. Cold starts. Cost per token.</p> <p>Move those four numbers in the right direction and two things happen: customers get faster, cheaper inference, and our margins improve. That's the entire thesis of this role. Every loader you tune, every scheduler decision you land, every kernel you stare at shows up in a customer's p99 and on our P&L. Your mandate is the inference stack's optimization, whatever it takes, and the technical direction of how we optimize it is yours to argue with data.</p> <p><strong>The problem:</strong> the checkpoints run 0.3-1.5 TB, and the "right" serving configuration depends on traffic shape, sequence-length distribution, batch dynamics, GPU SKU, memory bandwidth, and quantization tolerance, all variables that shift week to week. Most teams pick a configuration once, over-provision GPUs, and absorb the cost. We don't: we took Kimi-K3 (1.5 TB) from over an hour cold-to-serving to under twelve minutes with a shared filesystem, O_DIRECT weight loaders, and node-local JIT caches, and we're nowhere near done. Prefill/decode disaggregation and tiered KV caches are next.</p> <p><strong>Stack:</strong> Python; SGLang; vLLM; TensorRT-LLM; PyTorch; fastsafetensors; CUDA-adjacent tooling; Kubernetes; virtiofs shared filesystems; ClickHouse; OpenTelemetry; Prometheus; Grafana; GitLab CI.</p> <h4>Requirements</h4> <ul> <li>You've built real ML systems for 5+ years, and your portfolio shows depth in inference or training infrastructure, not just model training notebooks.</li> <li>Your Python is production-grade: services, not scripts.</li> <li>You've run vLLM, SGLang, or TensorRT-LLM for real, and you have a working mental model of why an engine performs the way it does on a given GPU.</li> <li>You've measured quantization regressions, not just compression ratios.</li> <li>Multi-GPU and multi-node setups hold no fear: tensor and expert parallelism, collective communication, and their practical failure modes.</li> <li>You know where the bytes live (page caches, O_DIRECT, network filesystems under terabyte-scale reads) and how fast they move.</li> <li>You instrument before you optimize, and you can tell a real win from a benchmark artifact.</li> <li>A wide mandate excites you more than it unsettles you.</li> </ul> <h4>Nice to haves</h4> <ul> <li>You've worked on LLM routing specifically: RouterBench-class evals, cost/quality/latency Pareto fronts.</li> <li>Calibration, abstention, or conformal methods in production decision systems.</li> <li>You've run online A/B loops with drift monitoring on a model that touches real money.</li> </ul> <h4>Responsibilities</h4> <ul> <li>Push throughput. Continuous batching, chunked prefill, speculative decoding with draft models, CUDA-graph capture, and scheduler tuning across the engine<br> fleet. Find the ceiling on each GPU SKU, then raise it.</li> <li>Cut latency. Attack TTFT and inter-token latency separately; profile to find the actual bottleneck (compute, memory bandwidth, scheduling, storage, or<br> network) and fix it, not the one you assumed.</li> <li>Get more out of the KV cache. Hierarchical and paged attention, prefix caching on heavy-reuse coding traffic, eviction policies, quantized KV. A lot of the<br> unrealized throughput lives here, and you'll own it.</li> <li>Kill cold starts. Weight loaders (O_DIRECT, fastsafetensors-class), JIT and compile caches, shared-filesystem read paths. A 1.5 TB checkpoint has no business<br> taking an hour to reach serving.</li> <li>Quantize without regressing quality. INT8/INT4, FP8/FP4 across weights, activations, and KV, measured on real workloads, not just perplexity benchmarks.</li> <li>Scale across nodes. Distributed inference topologies, network-aware placement, prefill/decode disaggregation, checkpointing strategies that don't bottleneck<br> on storage or interconnect.</li> <li>Set the technical direction. Decide what we benchmark, what we adopt, and what we build ourselves. Bring the team along with strong writeups and reproducible<br> experiments.</li> </ul> <h4>What’s in it for you?</h4> <ul> <li>Competitive salary (depending on the level of experience).</li> <li>Enjoy a flexible, remote-first global environment.</li> <li>Collaborate with a global team of cloud experts and innovators, passionate about pushing the boundaries of Kubernetes technology</li> <li>Equity options.</li> <li>Get quick feedback with a fast-paced workflow. Most feature projects are completed in 1 to 4 weeks.</li> <li>Spend 10% of your work time on personal projects or self-improvement. </li> <li>Learning budget for professional and personal development - including access to international conferences and courses that elevate your skills.</li> <li>Annual hackathon to spark new ideas and strengthen team bonds.</li> <li>Team-building budget and company events to connect with your colleagues.</li> <li>Equipment budget to ensure you have everything you need.</li> <li>Extra days off to help maintain a healthy work-life balance.</li> </ul> <h4>Hiring process</h4> <ul> <li>Screening call with Recruiter</li> <li>Hiring Manager interview</li> <li>Technical interview (system design)</li> <li>Live coding</li> <li>Culture Check interview with an executive</li> </ul> <p><em>As part of our standard hiring process, we would like to inform you that a background check may be conducted at the final stage of recruitment through our third-party provider, Checkr.</em><br><em>Please note that Cast AI </em><u><em>does not</em></u><em> provide any form of visa sponsorship/work permit.</em></p> <p><span style="color: rgb(255, 255, 255);">#LI-Remote</span></p> Find Jobs in Netherlands on Arbeitnow

title: Senior Applied ML Engineer | Kimchi (Model Router)

Frontier-level task success at a fraction of the token cost: that sentence is the product, and it stays true only if the model inside the router keeps getting better. description: <div class="content-intro"><h2><strong>Brief info about Vinted </strong></h2> <p data-renderer-start-pos="1"><span data-sheets-root="1">Our mission is to make second-hand the first choice, and we're looking for people who want to help us get there. Every day, we work together to help our members buy and sell pre-loved clothing and lifestyle items, giving each piece a second life – or even a third. <br>The Vinted Group is made up of three business units that support this mission:<br><br><strong><a href="https://careers.vinted.com/marketplace" target="_blank">Vinted Marketplace</a></strong> is Europe’s leading platform for second-hand fashion and a go-to destination for all kinds of pre-loved items, with a growing range of categories. Our platform connects millions of members across 20+ markets, helping great items find a new life.<br><br><a href="https://careers.vinted.com/vintedgo" target="_blank"><strong>Vinted Go</strong></a> enhances the shipping experience with a vast network of over 500,000 pick-up and drop-off points, partnering with more than 60 carriers across Europe, with added services like item verification for peace of mind on high-value pieces.<br><br><a href="https://careers.vinted.com/vintedpay" target="_blank"><strong>Vinted Pay</strong></a> is the newest part of the Vinted Group, dedicated to bringing secure, reliable payments to buyers and sellers across Europe. Seamlessly integrated into the Vinted app, it helps keep every transaction safe, efficient, and easy for our members.<br><br>Founded in 2008 in Lithuania, Vinted began as a way for friends to find new homes for clothes they no longer needed. In 2019, we became Lithuania's first unicorn! Today, our headquarters remain in Vilnius, and we've grown with offices across Europe, supported by a team of over 2,000 people. </span></p></div><h2><strong>Information about the position </strong></h2> <p>Our team’s mission is to align Vinted’s values, business goals, and Employer Value Proposition with our people’s real work experience. We translate Vinted’s truth into an inspiring story that attracts the right people, helps them grow, and instils them with pride.</p> <p>You’ll take an active role in Employer Branding at Vinted, with a particular focus on attracting engineering and data science talent. You’ll be based in Amsterdam, where our data science team is growing, but your work will reach candidates around the world.</p> <p>Vinted has become an ecosystem with vertically integrated shipping and payments. This requires us to adapt our EVP to three very distinct brands and even more diversified hiring needs. Your job is to turn that into creative campaigns and stories that make specific audiences want to work here.</p> <p>Our next big focus is storytelling. Bringing the skills and challenges our teams face to life! What is a day in the life of a cybersecurity analyst? How does an anti-money laundering expert keep members’ wallets safe? What does it take to build the data science behind a marketplace used by millions? And what stories does each of our locations need?</p> <p>Partnering with Talent Acquisition, engineering and data science leaders, People, Marketing, PR, Internal Comms, and Brand & Design, you’ll make sure those stories are told and that our presence is strong where we hire.</p> <h2><strong>In this position, you’ll </strong></h2> <ul> <li>Be the guardian of Vinted’s employer brand, ensuring consistency and visibility across all platforms, like LinkedIn and Instagram</li> <li>Strong brand-building skills, with a clear vision of global vs local branding differentiation</li> <li>Use your sound understanding of branding and our editorial guidelines to write clear and engaging copy for things such as blogs, advertising campaigns, employer branding assets, email campaigns, event materials, online company profiles, as well as our careers pages.</li> <li>Create bespoke or support partnership events such as meetups, webinars, and networking events</li> <li>Plan and run recruitment advertising, such as targeted LinkedIn campaigns and sponsorships with third-party publications and organisations, aimed at technical audiences.</li> <li>Define where our global employer brand ends and local adaptation begins, so each location can tell its story while staying consistent with Vinted’s.</li> <li>Shape our content calendar around hiring needs and our location strategy.</li> <li>Track what works, using results to sharpen the next activation, and share learnings with the wider Employer Branding team.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>About you </strong></h2> <ul> <li>Passionate about all things Employer Branding!</li> <li>You love storytelling: finding stories and having a keen eye for telling them in ways that stand out. You can show campaigns or activations you conceived and delivered.</li> <li>Background in building and nurturing online and offline communities, and delivering innovative events and social media campaigns.</li> <li>A clear view of global vs local branding, and experience working across markets.</li> <li>Adept at identifying new talent attraction channels, especially for engineering and data science audiences.</li> <li>Comfortable using data to set goals and judge what worked.</li> <li>Ability to juggle multiple projects with strong stakeholder management, and to work confidently with engineering and data science leaders.</li> <li>Excited by change, a fast pace, and learning new ways of doing things.</li> <li>Excellent knowledge of social media and digital channels, including LinkedIn, Glassdoor, Indeed, and Meta.</li> <li>Excellent written and verbal English communication skills (English is Vinted’s official working language).</li> </ul> <h2><strong>Work perks  </strong></h2> <ul> <li>The opportunity to benefit from our share options programme</li> <li>25 days of paid annual leave</li> <li>Newest MacBook models</li> <li>Digital mental and emotional health support and Employee Assistant Program (EAP)</li> <li>Frequent team-building events</li> <li>Home office support: we provide IT workstation equipment and a personal budget of up to €540 for home workplace furniture</li> <li>Lunch benefit per working day</li> <li>Company bike leasing scheme</li> <li>Monthly budget for a flexible benefits platform</li> <li>Work from Home allowance</li> <li>A personal monthly budget for shopping on Vinted</li> <li>Collective Defined Contribution Pension plan</li> <li>NS Business Card for your commute to the office by public transport</li> <li>A dog-friendly office</li> </ul> <h2><strong>Working at Vinted </strong></h2> <p><strong>Workation policy</strong></p> <p>Better balance holidays with workdays by working remotely! Up to 90 days per year in the EU, of these, 21 days can be spent globally. For non-EU citizens, it's 21 days worldwide. This can be combined with time off for vacation or personal time.</p> <p><strong>Individual learning budget</strong></p> <p>Each year, you’ll be given a learning budget (starting at €3,000), and a total of up to 10 working days over a 2-year period to support your personal and professional development.</p> <p><strong>Hybrid work</strong></p> <p>Our hybrid model, with 2 recommended office days a week, gives you and your team the flexibility to decide if and when you want to work from home, and when to catch up in person.</p> <p><strong>Equal opportunity</strong></p> <p>We welcome applications from everybody, regardless of your background, identity, or life experiences. Job openings come with guides, not checklists. If you’re excited about a role, but don’t identify with every point in the ‘About you’ section, apply anyway – you might still be the perfect match!</p><div class="content-pay-transparency"><div class="pay-input"><div class="title">The annual gross salary range for this position excluding 8% holiday pay is:</div><div class="pay-range"><span>€59.800</span><span class="divider">—</span><span>€81.000 EUR</span></div></div></div> Find more English Speaking Jobs in Netherlands on Arbeitnow

title: B2B Growth Marketer - Benelux
description: About ElevenLabs ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology. We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $22B - multiples of 11, always. We have expanded from voice into three main platforms: ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale. ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages. ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models. Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you. How we work High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy. Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you. AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations. Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models. Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location. What we offer Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible. Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities. Learning & development : ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend. Social travel : We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose. Annual company offsite: Each year, we bring the entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia and Italy. Co-working : If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend. About the role We're looking for a senior B2B Growth Marketer to build and scale demand generation for ElevenLabs in the Benelux Region. This is a hands-on, in-region role focused on generating enterprise pipeline, growing our brand with technical buyers, and creating programs that become benchmarks for B2B marketing in AI. As our first marketing hire in the Benelux Region, your work will shape how Benelux businesses discover, evaluate, and adopt ElevenLabs. The goal is to build repeatable marketing engines that make ElevenLabs the top choice for every enterprise. What you'll do Build integrated B2B marketing campaigns end to end across Benelux priority industries from strategy and messaging through execution and measurement. Localize and execute programs across ABM, content, events, webinars, partner/customer marketing, executive branding, product launches, and outbound - choosing the right channel for the problem rather than owning a single function. Adapt global campaigns and messaging for the the Benelux market, and feed local insights (buyer behavior, competitive dynamics, regulatory context) back to the global team. Partner closely with local sales and the global product marketing, growth, and design teams to keep messaging consistent and execute high-impact campaigns. Own pipeline generation and campaign performance for the market, using data to measure results, run experiments, and continuously improve what works. Requirements 4+ years of experience at a high-growth technology company - you've built and scaled B2B demand generation programs that created measurable enterprise pipeline, and you know what moved the needle. Ownership Pedigree: You have implemented growth and marketing projects from start to finish and held yourself accountable for the ROI. Deep knowledge of the Benelux market: its enterprise buyers, media landscape, and business culture, ideally with an existing network. Work well without much process. This role spans multiple marketing functions and needs someone who sets priorities, spots opportunities, and moves quickly as our first marketer in the market. Relentless commitment to excellence — a high bar for quality, clarity, and impact. Curious about AI, follows the technology ecosystem closely, and has exceptional judgment on what makes marketing stand out. #LI-Remote We are an equal opportunity employer and do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability or other legally protected statuses. title: Benefits Analyst
description: <div class="content-intro"><p>GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.</p> <p>The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. <a href="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=OuZIb5zszQI">Co-create the future with us</a> as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.</p> <p>*<em>Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.</em></p></div><h4><strong>An overview of this role</strong></h4> <p>As a Benefits Analyst on GitLab's Total Rewards team, you'll support global benefits administration and take ownership of day-to-day benefits operations in India, partnering closely with a Senior Benefits Analyst. Your initial priorities will include planning benefits events at the Bangalore hub, streamlining enrollment and benefits onboarding , handling tier 1 benefit questions and escalations, taking over and improving administrative and audit processes, along with routine benefits tasks.You'll build depth in global benefits and manage assigned work with increasing independence, seeking guidance on prioritization, new assignments, and higher-risk issues. This role reports to the Manager, Global Benefits and focuses on benefits programs, not leave administration. You'll need to be based in Bangalore, with periodic office presence for hosting and managing benefits events, and flexibility to collaborate across time zones, including Pacific time.</p> <p><strong>What You’ll Do</strong>  </p> <ul> <li>Support day-to-day administration for assigned benefits programs, including eligibility, enrollment, benefits onboarding, billing, reporting, audits, quality assurance, documentation, and issue resolution, with a particular focus on India.</li> <li>Review benefits and team-member data from multiple sources, research discrepancies and root causes, and recommend next steps for manager or senior team-member review.</li> <li>Work with brokers and vendors on day-to-day benefits operations, and support the Senior Benefits Analyst with renewals, plan changes, implementations, testing, launches, and post-launch improvements. Benefits plan decisions remain with the Senior Benefits Analyst.</li> <li>Plan, host, and manage benefits events at the Bangalore hub, and coordinate assigned benefits activities across selected countries and employment arrangements. Apply documented processes and escalate questions that require deeper local or technical expertise.</li> <li>Partner with Payroll, Finance, People Operations, and People Technology on accurate reporting, billing reconciliation, eligibility data, and compliance-related processes.</li> <li>Support People Operations in resolving team-member benefits inquiries, explain moderately complex benefits topics in accessible language, and escalate cases appropriately.</li> <li>Analyze benefits utilization, cost, survey, and qualitative data to identify trends and prepare summaries, insights, and recommendations that support team priorities.</li> <li>Maintain accurate documentation, process guides, trackers, and communications; support the transition of administrative processes and recommend ways to simplify, standardize, or automate them, including responsible use of artificial intelligence tools. Protect accuracy and team-member experience, communicate progress and risks, and seek guidance on prioritizing improvements.</li> </ul> <p><strong>What You’ll Bring </strong></p> <ul> <li>Experience supporting benefits administration, including enrollment, reporting, and audits, and working with benefits brokers or vendors. Experience supporting benefits in more than one country is required; global technology company experience is preferred. Strategic benefits plan design experience isn't required.</li> <li>Working knowledge of core benefits concepts, such as medical, dental, vision, life, disability, and supplemental benefits.</li> <li>Experience using a human resources information system (HRIS), benefits administration platform, or similar operational tools, with attention to detail in data entry, testing, reconciliation, and quality assurance. Workday experience is preferred.</li> <li>Intermediate or stronger Excel or Google Sheets skills, including VLOOKUPs, filters, pivot tables, and data analysis; macros aren't required. Ability to evaluate multiple sources, identify patterns or discrepancies, and develop evidence-based recommendations with appropriate guidance.</li> <li>Clear written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to explain benefits topics in accessible language and collaborate across functions.</li> <li>Ability to manage assigned work, meet deadlines, communicate when blocked, and distinguish urgent work from work that can be sequenced.</li> <li>A collaborative, learning-oriented approach, willingness to apply feedback, and curiosity about using artificial intelligence tools responsibly to improve benefits work and team processes.</li> <li>Ability to be based in Bangalore and go to our Bangalore hub to host and manage benefits events, with flexibility for collaboration across time zones, including Pacific time.</li> </ul> <p><strong>About the team</strong></p> <p>The Benefits team within Total Rewards supports global benefits programs, working with Payroll, Finance, People Operations, People Technology, Legal, People Business Partners, brokers, and vendors. You'll work closely with the Senior Benefits Analyst and colleagues in India, Europe, the Middle East, Africa, and Pacific time zones to support India's growing benefits needs. The team's tools include Workday, Google Workspace, Slack, and Claude. The role emphasizes accurate administration, team-member support, and practical process improvements, with opportunities to build deeper benefits expertise.</p> <h4><strong>How GitLab will support you</strong></h4> <ul> <li><a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/total-rewards/benefits/general-and-entity-benefits/" target="_blank">Benefits to support your health, finances, and well-being</a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/people-group/paid-time-off/" target="_blank">Flexible Paid Time Off</a> </li> <li><a href="https://about.gitlab.com/company/culture/inclusion/erg-guide/#:~:text=Definition%20of%20the%20TMRG%20%2D%20Team%20Member%20Resource%20Groups,-TMRGs%20are%20voluntary&text=The%20purpose%20for%20this%20type,developing%20the%20sense%20of%20belonging." target="_blank">Team Member Resource Groups</a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/total-rewards/stock-options/" target="_blank">Equity Compensation & Employee Stock Purchase Plan</a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/people-group/learning-and-development/growth-and-development/" target="_blank">Growth and Development Fund</a></li> <li><a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/total-rewards/benefits/general-and-entity-benefits/#parental-leave" target="_blank">Parental leave</a> </li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/finance/expenses/#equipment" target="_blank">Home office</a> support</li> </ul> <p>Please note that we welcome interest from candidates with varying levels of experience; many successful candidates do not meet every single requirement.
