do</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Own outcomes for Git & Gitaly Operations, including hiring and developing the Manager, Git & Gitaly Operations, and holding the function to its reliability bar across Self-Managed, GitLab Dedicated, and SaaS.</li> <li>Own outcomes for Nonlinear Productivity, also known as Friction Elimination, including hiring and developing the Manager, Nonlinear Productivity, and holding the function to measurable metric movement rather than activity.</li> <li>Build and oversee Platform Staff directly as a small, senior team that uses AI-assisted tools as a standard part of its work.</li> <li>Assess, case by case, what Platform Staff picks up, such as a new team that needs bootstrapping, a customer request too specific for any existing team's charter, or a crisis that needs someone in the room immediately.</li> <li>Assess when Platform Staff should hand work off to a permanent team once it's stable.</li> <li>Set the technical bar across all three functions by personally reviewing distributed systems designs, friction-elimination fixes, and crisis management plans with equal depth.</li> <li>Build the operating rhythm and metrics that keep all three functions running predictably, so none of them relies on any one person working unsustainable hours.</li> <li>Represent all three functions to peer engineering stakeholders, and step in front of customers directly when Platform Staff is engaged mid-crisis.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>What you’ll bring</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Working knowledge of GitLab's development workflows and platform capabilities so you can assess productivity friction, operational trade-offs, and team needs in context.</li> <li>Hands-on experience designing and shipping distributed systems personally, not only through teams you've managed.</li> <li>A track record running highly effective engineering operations, including production reliability and incident management, at meaningful scale.</li> <li>A track record driving measurable engineering productivity improvements across more than one team or organization.</li> <li>Experience with AI-assisted development tools, and sound judgment about when they help a small team do work that would otherwise require a larger team.</li> <li>People management experience across multiple managers or functions at once.</li> <li>Ability to context-switch effectively across genuinely different problem types, including infrastructure operations, developer productivity, and ad hoc crisis response, sometimes in the same week.</li> <li>A track record making staffing decisions that keep a high-leverage team intentionally small, and building alignment around those decisions rather than growing the team by default.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>About the team</strong></h2> <p>We work across three connected platform and productivity functions. in a distributed, asynchronous environment.</li> <li>Technical knowledge of metrics systems such as Prometheus and long-term storage, logging platforms such as Elasticsearch or cloud-native services, including incident coordination and balancing operational load with project work.</li> <li>The ability to explain technical tradeoffs to engineering partners and other stakeholders.</li> <li>Experience using AI tools or agents in engineering or management work; you can describe how you would apply them to operational problems such as incident triage.</li> </ul> <div>We welcome different paths into this role, whether through practical experience, formal study, or transferable skills. If they go sideways in production, they affect everything downstream, including continuous integration, code review, and deployments. This role starts with genuine subject matter expertise in Git technologies and extends to reliable operation across GitLab's deployment models: Self-Managed, GitLab Dedicated, and SaaS.</p> <p>You'll build and develop a team with deep platform expertise and strong operational judgment. You'll partner across engineering groups to shape how Git and Gitaly operations evolve as the platform grows.</p> <h2><strong>What you’ll do</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Build and lead a team with deep platform expertise in Git and Gitaly, hiring and developing engineers who can operate this infrastructure layer with strong operational judgment.</li> <li>Own production reliability for Git and Gitaly infrastructure problem.</li> <li>Design and operate Git and Gitaly service models that work across Self-Managed, GitLab Dedicated, and SaaS, with a clear view of which elements are common and which must differ between them.</li> <li>Maintain cloud-agnostic architecture and tooling decisions, avoiding designs that assume a single hyperscaler's primitives.</li> <li>Partner with the teams that own each deployment model so operational practices stay coherent rather than fragmenting into separate playbooks.</li> <li>Apply distributed systems fundamentals, including consistency, replication, and failure domains, to Gitaly's storage and replication model.</li> <li>Own elastic storage and compute strategy for Git repository data, including capacity planning, autoscaling, and consumption-based provisioning for GitLab's largest self-managed and SaaS customers.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>What you’ll bring</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Familiarity with GitLab's product and deployment models, and how Git and Gitaly support repository operations across self-managed, dedicated, and SaaS environments.</li> <li>Hands-on subject matter expertise in Git internals, including how the protocol, object model, and storage layer behave under load and at scale, not only familiarity with Git usage.</li> <li>Strong distributed systems fundamentals, including consistency, replication, failure handling, and horizontal scalability.</li> <li>Experience running production infrastructure across multiple deployment models, such as self-managed, dedicated or single-tenant, and multi-tenant SaaS, or a credible path from adjacent experience to it.</li> <li>Experience with elastic storage and compute, and consumption-based system design for variable, unpredictable load.</li> <li>People management experience, ideally leading site reliability engineering-style or platform operations teams.</li> <li>Direct experience with Gitaly, libgit2, JGit, or another Git implementation's internals is advantageous.</li> Gitaly Operations team to go deep on one of GitLab's most critical platforms. assurance validation, and rollback.</li> <li value="7">Support organization migrations by preparing destination cells and helping with dry runs and production cutovers.</li> <li value="8">Work with product teams to make their services cell-compatible, and write documentation so others can operate Cells with confidence.</li> </ul> <h2>What you'll bring</h2> <ul> <li value="1">Professional experience in another systems language and willingness to work in Go daily.</li> <li value="3">Solid grounding in site reliability engineering (SRE) best practices: SLOs and error budgets, blameless post-incident reviews, reducing toil through automation, capacity planning, and designing for graceful degradation.</li> <li value="4">Experience owning services in production, including on-call, incident response, and monitoring with tools such as Prometheus and Grafana.</li> <li value="5">Practical knowledge of progressive delivery: how to roll changes safely across a fleet and how to roll them back.</li> <li value="6">A strong understanding of distributed-systems fundamentals, such as request routing, proxies, consistency, and failure domains.</li> <li value="7">Experience working effectively in distributed, all-remote teams: you default to asynchronous, written-first communication, document decisions in issues and merge requests, hand off work cleanly across time zones, and decisions asynchronously so team members can build on them across time zones.</li> <li value="5">Review schema migrations from engineers across GitLab for safety, backward compatibility, and reliability.</li> <li value="6">Collaborate with Distribution, Quality Assurance, Database Architecture, Database Automation, and database framework teams to support GitLab.com and self-managed supply-chain problem.</li> <li><strong>Own What You Build in Production:</strong> Take part in on-call and incident response for the systems your teams own, act as a technical escalation point during complex incidents, and turn what you learn into architectural and operational improvements that prevent recurrence.</li> <li><strong>Influence and Partner:</strong> Shape technical direction across teams without formal authority, and partner with Product and Engineering leadership on platform-level roadmap decisions and investment trade-offs.</li> <li><strong>Grow Engineers:</strong> Mentor course-correct agent output.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>What you’ll bring</strong></h2> <ul> <li><strong>Cross-Team Technical Leadership:</strong> A sustained record of technical leadership across more than one team or a broad product area.</li> <li><strong>Deep Architecture Experience:</strong> Deep backend architecture and production experience in complex applications, services, or platforms, including scaling or governing APIs, service platforms, data systems, modular monoliths, or shared backend components.</li> <li><strong>Modularization in Production:</strong> Experience modernizing a monolith or legacy backend architecture in production, and with modular architecture such as bounded contexts, package encapsulation, ports and adapters, service extraction, event-driven boundaries, or an equivalent approach.</li> <li><strong>Influence Without Authority:</strong> A strong ability to create alignment through clear written proposals and decision records, so decisions are documented, understood, and adopted without constant escalation.</li> <li><strong>Product Judgment:</strong> The ability to balance customer outcomes, delivery speed, technical health, reliability, and long-term platform investment.</li> <li><strong>Mentorship:</strong> Experience mentoring engineers and shaping standards through code review, documentation, and example.</li> <li><strong>Agentic AI Leadership:</strong> Production experience with AI-assisted or agentic engineering workflows, including the ability to evaluate and improve how a team adopts them.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>Helpful readiness.</li> <li>Rust adoption or production ownership for systems, security, performance, or platform components.</li> <li>Ruby/Rails modularization and large-monolith modernization.</li> <li>PostgreSQL scaling, data partitioning, queues, messaging, or distributed systems.</li> <li>Security-sensitive product or software supply chain engineering.</li> <li>Experience across SaaS, Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. <a href="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=OuZIb5zszQI">Co-create the future with us</a> as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.</p> <p>*<em>Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.</em></p></div><h2>An overview of this role</h2> <p>The Observability, Monitoring, and Integrations team manages observability, monitoring, and detection for systems that support customer purchasing and use of GitLab. As a Staff Backend Engineer on the Fulfillment Workflow Monitoring (Catch All) team, you'll set the technical direction for the telemetry, detection, and reconciliation tooling that identifies billing, data, and event anomalies across CustomersDot, Salesforce, and Zuora before they can affect revenue or the customer experience.</p> <p>This is a greenfield team. You'll help build it from the ground up, shaping its operating rhythm, incident response model, and quality bar. You'll use telemetry and machine learning to identify issues early and help resolve them. Because Monetization changes can directly affect revenue and often involve confidential or financial information, you'll use strong judgment, careful rollout practices, and a high bar for reliability. This role is opening at the Staff Backend Engineer level (grade 8).</p> <h2>What you’ll do</h2> <ul> <li value="1">Design, build, and operate observability across the Monetization stack, including metrics, logs, and traces, using tools such as Prometheus and Grafana.</li> <li value="2">Implement automated detection for billing, data, and event anomalies, and route alerts to the responsible feature teams.</li> <li value="3">Develop reconciliation and data integrity checks across usage and billing pipelines.</li> <li value="4">Define and track service level objectives and service level indicators, write runbooks, and take part in incident response to measure and improve Monetization system reliability.</li> <li value="5">Explore artificial intelligence and machine learning techniques to predict system anomalies and accelerate resolution.</li> <li value="6">Review and offer feedback on merge requests from other Monetization engineers.</li> <li value="7">Collaborate with Product, Finance, Support, and other partners to turn operational needs into reliable tooling.</li> </ul> <h2>What you’ll bring</h2> <ul> <li value="1">Professional experience with Ruby on Rails, including building and operating applications such as CustomersDot.</li> <li value="2">Experience in site reliability or observability engineering, including monitoring, alerting, service level objectives and indicators, runbooks, and incident response.</li> <li value="3">Experience setting technical direction for observability, reliability, or detection work and bringing other engineers along.</li> <li value="4">Experience building anomaly detection, monitoring, or risk management tooling.</li> <li value="5">Familiarity with observability tools such as Prometheus, Grafana, and OpenTelemetry.</li> <li value="6">Exposure to analytical data stores such as ClickHouse and the change data capture and event-streaming pipelines that feed them, including NATS JetStream.</li> <li value="7">Experience owning projects from concept through production, communicating clearly about complex technical and organizational problems, and proposing iterative solutions.</li> <li value="8">Working knowledge of Python for anomaly detection and data work, or experience with billing, financial, or other business-critical systems, including Zuora or Salesforce, is a plus.</li> </ul> <h2>About the team</h2> <p>The Observability, Monitoring, and Integrations team is part of GitLab's Monetization section, a highly cross-functional group that partners with Sales, Finance, IT, and Support to deliver secure and reliable purchasing, billing, provisioning, and utilization workflows. The Monetization section includes the Purchase, Subscription Lifecycle, Billing Engine, Platform and Infrastructure, Observability, Monitoring, and Integrations, and Compliance teams.</p> <p>This role is on the Fulfillment Workflow Monitoring (Catch All) team and reports to the Engineering Manager, Observability, Monitoring, and Integrations. We work asynchronously, plan and reflect regularly, and share responsibility for deployments, incident management, testing, and safe rollouts. We're increasingly focused on how artificial intelligence and machine learning can improve our Monetization infrastructure and provide predictive insights.</p><div class="content-conclusion"><h4><strong>How GitLab Supports Full-Time Employees</strong></h4> <ul> <li><a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/total-rewards/benefits/general-and-entity-benefits/">Benefits to support your health, finances, and well-being</a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/people-group/time-off-and-absence/time-off-types/#flexible-paid-time-off-pto">Flexible Paid Time Off </a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/company/culture/inclusion/tmrg-tmag/">Team Member Resource Groups</a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/total-rewards/stock-options/">Equity Compensation & Employee Stock Purchase Plan</a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/people-group/learning-and-development/growth-and-development/">Growth and Development Fund</a></li> <li><a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/total-rewards/benefits/general-and-entity-benefits/#parental-leave">Parental Leave</a> </li> </ul> <p>Please note that we welcome interest from candidates with varying levels of experience; many successful candidates do not meet every single requirement. Additionally, studies have shown that people from <a href="https://about.gitlab.com/company/culture/inclusion/#examples-of-select-underrepresented-groups">underrepresented groups</a> are less likely to apply to a job unless they meet every single qualification. If you're excited about this role, please apply and allow our recruiters to assess your application.</p> <hr> <p><strong>Country Hiring Guidelines: </strong>GitLab hires new team members in countries around the world. All of our roles are remote, however some roles may carry specific location-based eligibility requirements. Our Talent Acquisition team can help answer any questions about location after starting the recruiting process.  </p> <p><strong>Privacy Policy: </strong>Please review our <a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/hiring/candidate-faq/recruitment-privacy-policy/" target="_blank">Recruitment Privacy Policy.</a> Your privacy is important to us.</p> <p>GitLab is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. GitLab’s policies and practices relating to recruitment, employment, career development and advancement, promotion, and retirement are based solely on merit, regardless of race, color, religion, ancestry, sex (including pregnancy, lactation, sexual orientation, gender identity, or gender expression), national origin, age, citizenship, marital status, mental or physical disability, genetic information (including family medical history), discharge status from the military, protected veteran status (which includes disabled veterans, recently separated veterans, active duty wartime or campaign badge veterans, and Armed Forces service medal veterans), or any other basis protected by law. GitLab will not tolerate discrimination or harassment based on any of these characteristics. title: Automation Engineer
description: <blockquote><em><span data-contrast="none">Build automation that powers the heart of our customers’ most critical operations</span></em><span data-ccp-props="{}"> </span></blockquote> <p>At Schuberg Philis, we specialize in mission‑critical IT, partnering closely with our customers to keep their most essential systems running smoothly and securely with 100% responsibility. Our impact is driven by engineers who are deeply technical, automate everything, collaborate naturally, stay curious, take full end‑to‑end ownership, and understand the full stack - from application to core infrastructure.</p> <p>We’re looking for engineers who flourish in automation‑first, mission‑critical environments and want to shape the platforms our customers rely on daily. In a self‑steering customer team, you design, build, run, and improve business‑critical systems across the full stack. You automate everything you touch, streamline pipelines, solve issues across the stack, and tune applications for performance. Working in a culture of real ownership, deep collaboration, and zero silos, where teams carry full responsibility for mission‑critical systems.</p> <p><strong><span data-contrast="auto">/ What you will do</span></strong> </p> <p>As a Mission‑Critical Automation Engineer, you design, build, run, and improve platforms. You automate everything you touch, diagnose and resolve issues across the entire stack, collaborate closely with customer teams, and take full end‑to‑end ownership of stability, security, and performance.</p> <p>Your day-to-day includes:</p> <ul> <li>Building automation through scripting and configuration management tooling.</li> <li>Owning the full Plan–Build–Run lifecycle.</li> <li>Solving multi‑layer issues across OS, network, DB, security, and apps.</li> <li>Designing and executing controlled releases with Git and pipelines.</li> <li>Platform‑hardening practices.</li> </ul> <p><strong><span data-contrast="auto"><span data-ccp-parastyle="No Spacing">/ </span><span data-ccp-parastyle="No Spacing">What you bring</span></span></strong></p> <ul> <li>A strong automation mindset, with hands-on experience in advanced scripting and configuration management (e.g. Powershell, Ansible, DSC, Puppet, Chef).</li> <li>Hands-on experience with Git and CI/CD practices.</li> <li>Experience applying security principles in mission-critical environments.</li> <li>Proficient in Infrastructure-as-Code tooling such as Terraform, Bicep, or ARM.</li> <li>An ownership mentality, combined with curiosity and analytical thinking to understand and improve system behaviour end-to-end.</li> <li>Understanding of networking, database fundamentals, release/deployment lifecycles, and applications.</li> </ul> <p>The following would be a plus:</p> <ul> <li>Building and running containerized environments (Docker).</li> <li>Orchestrating platforms using Kubernetes.</li> <li>Operating in public or private cloud environments (Azure, AWS, or similar).</li> </ul> <p><strong><span data-contrast="auto">/ Who are you?</span></strong><span data-ccp-props="{}"> </span></p> <ul> <li>An engineer with strong specialization in a core technical domain, combined with a solid understanding of the broader system landscape.</li> <li>Automation-driven, preferring code over manual work.</li> <li>A pragmatic problem solver who collaborates openly.</li> <li>A self-starter who thrives in a high-trust engineering culture.</li> <li>Motivated by complex systems, customer impact, and continuous improvement.</li> </ul> <p><strong><span data-contrast="auto">/ What can you expect?</span></strong><span data-ccp-props="{}"> </span></p> <ul> <li>Collaborate with highly skilled engineers who focus title: Credit Risk Manager
description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong><em>🚀 We’re on a mission to make money work for everyone.</em></strong></p> <p>We’re waving goodbye to the complicated and confusing ways of traditional banking.</p> <p>After starting as a prepaid card, our product offering has grown a lot in the last 10 years in the UK. As well as <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/personal">personal</a> and <a href="https://monzo.com/business-banking">business</a> bank accounts, we offer <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/joint-account">joint accounts</a>, <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/16-17">accounts for 16-17 year olds</a>, a <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/under-16s">free kids account</a> and <a href="https://monzo.com/flex">credit cards</a> in the UK, with more exciting things to come beyond. Our UK customers can also <a href="https://monzo.com/savings">save</a>, <a href="https://monzo.com/investments">invest </a>and <a href="https://monzo.com/pensions">combine their pensions</a> with us. </p> <p>With our hot coral cards and get-paid-early feature, combined with financial education on social media and our award winning customer service, we have a long history of creating magical moments for our customers!</p> <p>We’re not about selling products - we want to solve problems and change lives through Monzo ❤️</p> <hr> <p> </p></div><p><span style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif; font-size: 12pt;">📍Dublin | 💶 €93,500 - €114,000 + Incentive Awards tied to your performance + benefits | <a href="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=U62l09nB0M4">Hear from the team</a> ✨</span></p> <p><strong>⭐ About the team:</strong></p> <p>Our Borrowing (lending) business is growing rapidly across both existing products and the planned launch of new initiatives. We aim to create a genuine feel-good factor when it comes to personal credit, and are looking for driven, analytical and creative individuals to help us achieve this goal.</p> <p>We’re looking for a Credit Risk Manager to help drive the credit and growth strategy for our consumer lending products as we grow our business in Ireland. Our credit teams are part of our Credit Discipline which drives a strong culture of data-driven decision making across the whole company. We’re great believers in powerful, real-time analytics and empowerment of the wider business. All our data lives in one place and is super easy to use. 90% of day-to-day data-driven decisions are covered by self-serve analytics through Looker which gives analysts the head space to focus on more impactful business questions and analyses.</p> <p>Join a team where your ideas can rapidly transform into reality, leveraging our cutting-edge technology and agile ways of working. Our credit analysts and managers are fully embedded into a product squad alongside Product Managers, Engineers, Designers, Marketers, Customer Researchers, Data Scientists etc. This enables us to solve customer problems in a fast paced and innovative way.</p> <p><strong>🔑 You'll play a key role by:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Working closely with Borrowing squad leadership to develop and execute an ambitious growth strategy </li> <li>Collaborating with people from engineering, marketing, product, risk and control to design and deliver new products and customer journeys</li> <li>Leading the development and maintenance of the NPV models and affordability strategies that underpin the Borrowing underwriting decisions</li> <li>Monthly monitoring and reporting on Borrowing performance to stakeholders up to executive level</li> <li>Collaborating with the Decision Science team to maximise value from our internal and external data through cutting-edge ML models</li> <li>Promoting a culture of proactive, high quality analysis and ensure we have the right credit capabilities, infrastructure and talent in place to scale safely</li> </ul> <p><strong>🤩 You should apply if:</strong></p> <ul> <li>What we’re doing here at Monzo excites you!</li> <li>You have extensive experience in unsecured lending in Ireland</li> <li>You have a deep understanding of lending economics and have experience developing and deploying underwriting strategies and credit models</li> <li>You have strong analytical and data capabilities, backed up by technical coding skills. SQL, Python and Looker experience is a plus</li> <li>You have experience with the development and maintenance of NPV models</li> <li>You have a strong understanding of the regulations that apply to lending in Ireland</li> <li>You thrive in a fast-paced environment and are keen for the chance to improve our products and help ship changes to our customers</li> <li>You are a strong communicator, able to cut through complex problems and articulate decision points, particularly to senior leadership</li> <li>You have experience in project management and coordination across teams</li> <li>You work well collaborating in a team with diverse skill-sets and personality types</li> <li>You are highly motivated and energised by the idea of bringing a positive impact to our customers and Monzo</li> </ul> <p><strong>🙌 What’s in it for you</strong></p> <p>💶 A salary range of €93,500 - €114,000 + Incentive Awards tied to your performance</p> <p>📍This role will have a hybrid working model, based in our Dublin office 3 days a week. You will also travel to Monzo’s head office in London from time to time</p> <p>⏰ We offer flexible working hours and trust you to work enough hours to do your job well, and at times that suit you and your team</p> <p>🏝 Annual Leave - 34 days including public holidays (24 holiday days + 10 public holidays)</p> <p>📚€1,200 learning budget each year to use on books, training courses and conferences</p> <p>🏥 Private healthcare scheme</p> <p>💰Pension scheme: the minimum contribution is 4% and Monzo matches any additional contributions that you make up to a maximum of 6%</p> <p>💛 Wellbeing benefits: financial education, women’s and men’s health support, mental health benefits, including coaching and counselling</p> <p><strong>🌈 The application journey has 3 key steps</strong></p> <ol> <li>An introductory video call with a member of the Monzo Recruitment team</li> <li>An initial video call with the hiring manager</li> <li>A series of role specific, case study & behavioural interviews</li> <li>A final call with senior leadership</li> </ol> <p>This process should take around 4-5 weeks - your schedule is really important to us, so we promise to be as flexible as possible! We have some guidelines on using Artificial Intelligence (AI) to ace an application and interview at Monzo. <a href="https://monzo.com/blog/the-ultimate-guide-on-using-ai-to-ace-an-interview-at-monzo">You can read them here.</a></p> <p>We'll only close this role once we have enough applications for the next stage. Please submit your application as soon as possible to make sure you don't miss out.</p> <p>#LI-MOS1</p><div class="content-conclusion"><hr> <p><strong>Equal opportunities for everyone</strong></p> <p>Diversity and inclusion are a priority for us and we’re making sure we have lots of support for all of our people to grow at Monzo. At Monzo, we’re embracing diversity by fostering an inclusive environment for all people to do the best work of their lives with us. This is integral to our mission of making money work for everyone. You can read more in our <a href="https://monzo.com/blog/diversity-and-inclusion">blog</a>, 2026 <a href="https://monzo.com/blog/our-2026-diversity-and-inclusion-report" target="_blank">Diversity and Inclusion Report</a> and 2025 <a href="https://monzo.com/blog/gender-pay-gap-report-2025">Gender Pay Gap Report.</a></p> <p>We’re an equal opportunity employer. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to age, ethnicity, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, family or parental status, national origin, or veteran, neurodiversity or disability status.</p> <p>If you have a preferred name, please use it to apply. We don't need full or birth names at application stage 😊</p></div>

title: Senior Product Manager - Search & Ranking
description: <div class="content-intro"><p>At Catawiki, every day brings the extraordinary! Whether it’s <a href="https://www.catawiki.com/en/c/583-sports-memorabilia">Daniel Ricciardo’s Formula 1 Car</a>, a <a href="https://www.catawiki.com/en/c/579-fossils">Woolly Mammoth’s Skeleton</a>, <a href="https://www.catawiki.com/en/l/10035805">Lady Gaga's Jumpsuit</a> or <a href="https://www.catawiki.com/en/c/583-sports-memorabilia">Usain Bolt’s running shoe</a>, we encounter exceptional objects every day.</p> <p>We’re a one-of-a-kind marketplace for buying and selling special objects. Each week, more than 100,000 unique items are auctioned, all carefully curated by our passionate in-house experts.</p> <p>Having sold over 25 million unique objects, our mission is to become the world’s most popular destination for special objects. As a growing, diverse and sustainable scale-up, we proudly live by three core values. If these values resonate with you, we’d love to explore how you can join us.</p> <ul> <li>Taking ownership and driving impact </li> <li>Being open to change and feedback</li> <li>Being passionate about our mission and our customers. </li> </ul></div><h3><strong>Your mission</strong></h3> <p>Every Product Manager at Catawiki owns a meaningful part of the customer experience.</p> <p>In Search and Ranking, your mission is to help buyers find the special objects they care about. You will shape how search, ranking and personalisation work across the buyer journey, making discovery more relevant and helping more buyers find objects they love.</p> <p>This is a broad product area. It brings together buyer needs, expert curation, marketplace priorities, search experiences and machine learning. You will identify the most important opportunities, set a clear direction and lead a cross functional team from insight to measurable customer and business impact.</p> <p>The solution is not prescribed. You may improve search relevance, ranking, recommendations or personalisation, or explore new AI enabled ways to help buyers discover objects. What matters is that you solve a meaningful customer problem, measure the impact and scale what works.</p> <p>You will own the strategy, outcomes and execution for this area, working closely with Engineering, Design, Data Science, Marketing and Commercial teams.</p> <h3><strong>What you will do</strong></h3> <ol> <li>Set and communicate a clear product vision, strategy and roadmap for Search and Ranking.</li> <li>Own measurable outcomes across search relevance, discovery, engagement and buyer conversion.</li> <li>Use behavioural data, customer research and commercial insight to identify and prioritise the biggest opportunities.</li> <li>Turn ambiguous customer and business problems into clear hypotheses, prototypes and executable plans.</li> <li>Lead initiatives from early discovery through experimentation, launch and scaling.</li> <li>Define success metrics and build a rigorous experimentation agenda for search, ranking and personalisation.</li> <li>Work with machine learning engineers and data scientists to assess model quality, test new approaches and improve customer outcomes.</li> <li>Improve the relevance of search results and recommendations across the buyer journey.</li> <li>Integrate personalisation into the customer experience in ways that feel useful, coherent and trustworthy.</li> <li>Design, run and evaluate experiments, using positive, negative and inconclusive results to guide decisions.</li> <li>Use AI and rapid prototyping to test ideas early, reduce development risk and accelerate learning.</li> <li>Create clarity, momentum and accountability across teams, including when priorities or incentives differ.</li> <li>Communicate strategy, performance, tradeoffs and recommendations clearly to senior and C level stakeholders.</li> </ol> <h3><strong>Who you are</strong></h3> <p>Three qualities matter most in this role.</p> <h3><em>Outcome ownership</em></h3> <p>You take responsibility for customer and business results, not only for delivering features. You stay with the problem, remove obstacles and change direction when the evidence calls for it.</p> <h3><em>Systems thinking</em></h3> <p>You understand how search, ranking, recommendations, auction dynamics, expert curation and marketplace health influence one another. You make thoughtful decisions across the full buyer journey.</p> <h3><em>Experimental rigour</em></h3> <p>You use data, research, prototypes and controlled experiments to make decisions. You learn from negative results and can distinguish meaningful progress from activity.</p> <p>You will also bring:</p> <ol> <li>At least five years of product management experience, preferably in consumer ecommerce, marketplaces or another digital product at scale.</li> <li>Experience owning a broad product area or customer journey, rather than only individual features.</li> <li>Experience defining product strategy or roadmaps for search, ranking, recommendations, personalisation or other machine learning products.</li> <li>Confidence working with product metrics, experiments and commercial performance.</li> <li>Experience designing, running and analysing A/B tests, including tests involving machine learning products.</li> <li>The ability to turn uncertain opportunities into clear hypotheses, prototypes and plans.</li> <li>A practical understanding of machine learning concepts and how models become useful product experiences.</li> <li>Experience working closely with machine learning engineers and data scientists to develop and improve customer facing features.</li> <li>Comfort using AI tools to prototype quickly and explore customer experiences.</li> <li>The ability to balance immediate commercial opportunities with longer term product and platform investments.</li> <li>Clear communication skills and the ability to influence senior leaders without relying on formal authority.</li> <li>The pace, resilience and judgement to maintain a high standard of execution in an ambiguous environment.</li> </ol> <h3><strong>Where you will be</strong></h3> <p>This role is based in Amsterdam. We offer a relocation package for people currently living outside the Netherlands.</p><div class="content-conclusion"><div class="text text-align-left "> <h3><strong>Why You'll Love Working with Us</strong></h3> <ul> <li><strong>Create a visible impact </strong>by working at scale in a global organisation serving millions of customers across 80+ categories. In our flat structure, every role has a broad scope and directly impacts both our customers and the business.</li> <li><strong>Learn and grow</strong> through our Learning & Development initiatives, including clear development plans and mentorship programmes to support your career progression.</li> <li><strong>A culture of connection defines us</strong>. We’re a passionate, diverse team of 800+ Catawikians representing 60+ nationalities. We foster an inclusive and queer-friendly environment where everyone is encouraged to bring their full self to work.</li> <li><strong>Celebrate life’s moments with us. </strong>You’ll receive a €100 Catavoucher when you join, a €50 Catavoucher on your birthday, and an extra day off each year to “Pursue Your Passion<strong>”</strong>. We also offer additional leave for key work anniversaries and important life events. Benefits may vary by location.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>Our Offices and Way of Working</strong></h3> <p class="p1">Our vibrant offices in Amsterdam and Lisbon are designed to inspire collaboration. Most Catawikians operate in a hybrid setup, combining office-based and remote work, with a minimum of two days per week in the office, unless a role is explicitly stated as fully remote or fully office-based.</p> </div> <h3><strong>Interested?</strong></h3> <p class="p1">Apply with an English CV and Cover Letter. By applying, you agree to <a href="https://www.catawiki.com/conditions/applicant-privacy-policy.pdf">Catawiki’s Applicant Privacy Policy.</a> If you’re excited about this role but don’t meet every requirement, we still encourage you to apply anyway. You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles.<br><br>We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support the review of your application. AI may help us assess how your experience matches the requirements of the role, but hiring decisions are always made by our recruitment team</p></div> Find Jobs in Netherlands on Arbeitnow

title: Manager Operations Planning & Performance
description: Bij Crisp hebben we een missie: eten met meer smaak bereikbaar maken voor iedereen. Daarvoor moet elke schakel in onze operatie, van warehouse tot voordeur, dagelijks naadloos op elkaar aansluiten. Als Manager Operations Planning & Performance ben jij de spil tussen wat de klant bestelt en hoe wij dat logistiek waarmaken. Je brengt alle operationele schakels samen in één strakke, integrale planning en bouwt mee aan een betrouwbare operatie die klaar is om slim door te groeien. Wat je gaat doen Je bent eigenaar van de integrale operationele planning. Je vertaalt verwachte klantvraag naar concrete capaciteit op de weg (hoeveel bezorgers hebben we per dag en per hub nodig?) en bepaalt samen met de Operations Manager de planningsstrategie voor de korte en middellange termijn. Je zorgt voor een strakke planning tussen Delivery, Retentie en Warehouse. Zo werkt iedereen vanuit dezelfde basis en tilt jouw scherpe blik onze processen naar een hoger niveau. Je geeft leiding aan een team van routeplanners (werkstudenten en starters). Samen zorgen jullie dagelijks voor de meest efficiënte bezorgroutes. Jouw team staat in direct contact met de bezorghubs, het warehouse en de growth afdeling om de capaciteit af te stemmen Je werkt nauw samen met teams door de hele organisatie, van Tech en Analytics tot Recruitment. Om te weten wat er speelt, ben je regelmatig te vinden waar het gebeurt: op onze bezorghubs en in het warehouse. Je stuurt op operationele KPI’s (zoals Drops per Hour en Time per Stop ) en beheert belangrijke kostenlijnen. Samen met de Regiomanager en Business Analyst Delivery blijf je ons bezorgnetwerk continu optimaliseren. Je bent eindverantwoordelijk voor de lijn tussen ons warehouse en de hubs. Je onderhoudt de contacten met vrachtwagenvervoerders, stuurt op prestaties ( On Time ) en kosten ( Cost per Drop ) en maximaliseert de vulgraad. title: Project Leider Bouw
description: Monumental automatiseert de bouw met robotica en software. Onze missie is om de bouw software-defined en autonoom te maken – een toekomst waarin mooie gebouwen op maat in één dag verrijzen, met minimale inzet van handwerk. We zijn een groeiend team van engineers, operators en technici, afkomstig van bedrijven als Palantir, Qualcomm, Dyson, Shopify, Tesla, Meta en Google DeepMind. We staan nog aan het begin van het opbouwen van dit bedrijf, en dit is je kans om buitenproportioneel veel impact te maken op een probleem dat écht uitmaakt. Vanaf dag één werk je samen met een ervaren foundingteam, met een Series B van $32M achter ons onder leiding van Khosla Ventures en Plural. Monumental zit in het centrum van Amsterdam, in een prachtig pand met een volledig uitgeruste werkplaats en een eigen testvloer voor robots. We bouwen de hele stack in-house – hardware én software. We zijn uitdrukkelijk geen hybride of remote-first bedrijf: robots en muren bouw je niet vanaf je keukentafel, dus we werken vijf dagen per week op locatie. Lees meer over waarom wij vinden dat je je tijd aan de bouw zou moeten besteden, en over onze visie en ons bedrijf . Misschien vind je ons YouTube-kanaal interessant, de film van Based in Europe over hoe we het Europese woningtekort aanpakken , of deze video van Andreas Klinger over hoe ons kantoor eruitziet. Over de functie De afgelopen jaren is Monumental gegroeid van een werkend product en de eerste proefprojecten naar bouwen op grote schaal. Inmiddels hebben we een vloot van meer dan 150 robots, die metselwerk hebben uitgevoerd voor meer dan 90 woningen, een school, een buurthuis, een hotel en meer dan 150 meter kanaalwand. Elke maand nemen we meer bouwprojecten aan, intern noemen we die ‘deployments’. We werken met meer robots en meer mensen en breiden vanuit Nederland uit naar het Verenigd Koninkrijk en de VS. Als Hub Lead zet je onze eerste vestiging buiten het hoofdkantoor op, in het noorden van Nederland. Je begint met ons grootste bouwproject tot nu toe. Naarmate er meer projecten bijkomen, bouw je het team en de operatie verder uit. We zoeken mensen die breed inzetbaar zijn en een bouwproject willen leiden alsof het hun eigen bedrijf is. Achter elk project staat een Deployment Manager die van begin tot eind verantwoordelijk is. In de praktijk vervul je vijf rollen tegelijk: uitvoerder, operationeel manager, accountmanager, analist en projectmanager. Je maakt het bouwplan, voert het met je team als onderaannemer uit, onderhoudt het contact met de aannemer en zorgt dat we goed metselwerk op tijd opleveren. Dat doe je in de bouw, waar plannen voortdurend veranderen. Uiteindelijk leid je meerdere projecten tegelijk, waaronder complexe projecten waarbij veel op het spel staat. De ene dag sta je bij zonsopgang op en ga je naar de bouwplaats. Je zaagt stenen, bewaakt de planning, stemt af met de hoofdaannemer en ziet je bouwplan steen voor steen werkelijkheid worden. De volgende dag zit je op onze vestiging, analyseer je de winst- en verliesrekening van je project en werk je aan systemen waarmee je bij het volgende project een betere marge haalt. Je bent verantwoordelijk voor de oplevering en geeft knelpunten die je op de bouwplaats tegenkomt door aan ons R&D-team. Dit is intensief, praktisch werk op locatie, waar je veel voldoening uit kunt halen. Robots gaan kapot, het weer slaat om en de aannemer verandert het plan. Jij zorgt dat de bouw doorgaat. Je krijgt veel vrijheid en verantwoordelijkheid. De rol past goed bij je als je eerder een bedrijf hebt opgericht, of als je een ondernemende functie zoekt waarin je veel invloed hebt op het resultaat. Wat je gaat doen De logistiek van een bouwproject plannen. Je bepaalt hoeveel en welke robots en mensen nodig zijn, stemt af met andere onderaannemers en maakt de dagelijkse planning. Tegelijk houd je het grotere geheel in het oog en begrijp je wat jouw keuzes betekenen voor de kosten en opbrengsten per project. Op de bouwplaats het team aansturen, begeleiden en motiveren. Je onderhoudt het contact met hoofdaannemers en andere betrokkenen, vertegenwoordigt Monumental en legt uit wat we doen. Je schakelt net zo makkelijk met steigerbouwers als met de CEO’s van de grootste hoofdaannemers en onze engineers. Operationele systemen opzetten waarmee elk project beter verloopt dan het vorige. Je ziet waar tijd en middelen verloren gaan, past processen aan en verbetert de marge. Samenwerken met bestaande klanten en zorgen dat daar nieuwe bouwprojecten uit voortkomen. In de toekomst doe je dat ook voor aanverwante productlijnen buiten het metselwerk. Verantwoordelijkheid nemen voor de winst- en verliesrekening van je project en voorstellen doen om de kosten en opbrengsten per project steeds verder te verbeteren. Helpen bij het werven en interviewen van nieuwe robotoperators en deployment operators. Wat we zoeken Minimaal drie jaar ervaring startupervaring, als operator, manager, of founder. Nederlands als moedertaal. De bouwsector is sterk lokaal georganiseerd, dus dit is een vereiste voor de functie. Je communiceert helder en makkelijk met mensen met uiteenlopende achtergronden. Je bent bereid om letterlijk je handen vuil te maken om het werk gedaan te krijgen. Je komt snel in actie, zet door en krijgt dingen voor elkaar. In deze functie draait het vooral om uitvoeren. Je kunt goed omgaan met hoge werkdruk. Op bouwplaatsen gaat regelmatig iets mis en staat er veel op het spel. Daar komt bij dat we nieuwe technologie inzetten waarvan we nog niet alle mogelijke storingen kennen. Je denkt scherp en leert graag. Welke achtergrond je ook hebt, je zult in deze rol veel en snel moeten leren. Het werk kan elke drie tot zes maanden als een nieuwe baan voelen. Je leert veel over de bouw, robotica en werken in een snelgroeiend technologiebedrijf. Je hebt ervaring met het aansturen van een klein team en weet hoe je mensen begeleidt en motiveert. Je bent operationeel en analytisch sterk. Je kunt een helder operationeel plan uitwerken in een spreadsheet, een winst- en verliesrekening presenteren en verschillende scenario’s doorrekenen, inclusief de factoren die het resultaat bepalen. Je bent een sterke projectmanager. Waarom Monumental? Bij Monumental werken betekent vooroplopen in een beweging die de bouwsector wezenlijk wil veranderen. Jouw werk heeft hier niet alleen impact op het bedrijf, maar op de toekomst van hoe we bouwen. Als je gedreven wordt door innovatie, graag complexe uitdagingen aanpakt en klaar bent om echt verschil te maken, horen we graag van je. Voor open sollicitaties (als je geen rol ziet die precies past) kun je ons mailen op: Helaas bieden we op dit moment geen stageplekken aan. Voldoe je niet aan alle eisen hierboven, maar ben je enthousiast over Monumental en denk je dat je ons toch kunt helpen moeilijke problemen op te lossen? Neem dan contact op. We verwelkomen generalisten die op resultaat gericht zijn en graag on the job leren. Find more English Speaking Jobs in Netherlands on Arbeitnow

title: Director, Expanded Access Program Operations
description: About myTomorrows myTomorrows is a global health tech company dedicated to breaking down barriers for patients seeking treatment options. We strive to enable earlier and better treatment access by bridging the gap between those searching for possible options, and the companies who develop them. We work closely with patients, healthcare professionals, trial sites, patient advocacy groups, and BioPharma – connecting key stakeholders in the drug development ecosystem. We’ve developed a cutting-edge AI-powered technology platform that simplifies and streamlines access to drugs in development. To support our users and clients, we have a range of industry-expert specialized teams ready to help. Our services include clinical trial patient recruitment, Expanded Access Program management and Real-World Data collection. With a global footprint spanning 134 countries, to date we’ve supported over 17,000 patients, 3,000 physicians and 350 sites, earning the trust of 60+ BioPharma companies. In October 2025, we closed a €25M investment with Avego Healthcare Capital to fuel our global ambitions and scale the business. Join us in shaping the future of treatment access - making tomorrow’s therapies accessible for people who need them today. The opportunity: Director of EAP Operations (Expanded Access Programs and Site Management) This is a high‑impact leadership role at the heart of how myTomorrows delivers Expanded Access Programs (EAPs) globally—where operational excellence meets commercial acumen. As Director of EAP Operations, you’ll own the end‑to‑end operational delivery of our EAP portfolio, integrating Program Management and Site Management into one scalable, outcome‑driven model. Beyond ensuring quality, compliance, speed, and resilience, you’ll be expected to think like an entrepreneur: spotting opportunities, optimising processes, and driving commercially sound decisions that enable sustainable growth. You’ll be a core member of the Operations Leadership Team and report directly to our COO (Vanessa says hi). This role is perfect for someone who thrives on complexity, builds high‑performing teams, and raises the operational bar—while balancing patient‑first decision‑making with a strong commercial mindset. Geographic Requirement: This role is open to candidates in The Netherlands, United Kingdom, Canada and USA. For candidates in North America , to ensure seamless collaboration with our teams, applicants must reside within the EST or CST time zones . What you'll do in this role: Own the end-to-end operating model for EAP Program + Site Management, ensuring scalable and compliant delivery Translate strategy and portfolio forecasts into capacity planning, org design and hiring priorities Build resilient coverage and escalation models across the portfolio (no single points of failure) Lead the EAP Program Management team to deliver consistent execution across clients and geographies Lead the EAP Site Management team to ensure strong site engagement, workload balance and service performance Drive standardisation and continuous improvement across ways of working, tooling and operational excellence Set and run a strong governance rhythm: KPIs, performance reviews, risk management and quality oversight Act as senior escalation point for complex delivery, regulatory and stakeholder challenges Grow a bar-raising leadership bench through coaching, performance management and succession planning Partner with Finance, People and Operations on budgeting, workforce planning and scale-up decisions What you bring to the table: You have 8–10+ years experience leading and managing expanded access programs. Experience in a market access setting and with multi-country reimbursement strategies is a plus. You understand the EAP business, and have a strong and proven commercial and client service mindset. You have proven experience building and leading high performance teams. You know how to lead managers and scale operational teams in complex settings You have an exceptionally strong understanding of compliance, regulatory frameworks and operational requirements in the context of Expanded Access Programs You have a track record of operational excellence: scaling delivery, managing risk, and raising performance standards You are a strategic thinker with strong execution focus — you simplify complexity and drive outcomes You are a confident stakeholder manager who can align senior leaders and external partners You hold a high bar for quality and accountability, with calm leadership under pressure What success in the first 6 months looks like: Have full grip on the EAP portfolio and delivery realities — and you can clearly articulate the biggest operational opportunities and risks (and have recommendations on how to address them) Create clarity across Program & Site Management: ownership, workflows, escalation paths, and what “great” looks like Have strengthened the operating model to improve consistency, speed and resilience across the portfolio Have managed to deliver on the expected ramp-up of the EAP business both in terms of patients served, and revenue generated. Have implemented a clear KPI rhythm (quality, timelines, compliance, service levels) with transparent performance reporting Have improved capacity planning and coverage, educing single points of failure and enabling predictable delivery Have made at least 1–2 concrete operational improvements (process / tooling / standardisation) that measurably improve delivery outcomes Are seen as a trusted Operations Leadership Team member who raises the bar and builds momentum. Equal opportunities myTomorrows is an Equal Opportunity Employer and, beyond upholding discrimination-free practices, we are committed to cultivating a workplace where difference and diversity are protected and celebrated. You understand how audit teams work, what drives their priorities, and how to connect DataSnipper to the workflows that matter most inside a firm. You are a reliable, independent operator who applies established CS frameworks and uses your audit knowledge to accelerate adoption, build credibility with audit stakeholders, and design enablement that non-audit CSMs cannot replicate. You manage onboarding, QBRs, health monitoring, and renewals with predictability and follow-through and you do it in a language audit professionals trust. You may still be developing the full breadth of CS scope, but your audit domain credibility opens doors and unlocks conversations that are otherwise harder to access at this level. About DataSnipper Audit and finance are still massively manual and we are changing that. DataSnipper is a $1B, bootstrapped unicorn with 600,000+ users across 180+ countries, already embedded in the daily workflows of top audit and accounting firms. Now, we are taking things further with our Excel Agent, bringing AI directly into where the work actually happens. Unlike generic AI tools, we do not sit on the sidelines. title: Team Lead, Data Engineering
description: We are looking for a Data Engineering Team Lead to lead the Data Platform team at DataSnipper. Every decision DataSnipper makes about its products runs through the data platform: which features land, which customers are getting value, what we bill for, what we fix next, and which AI capabilities add the most value. You will lead a team of two data engineers who own the systems that make that possible. That means how usage events get captured across a growing set of products, how they become trustworthy models in Snowflake, and how Customer Success, Product and GTM get to answers without waiting on us. This is a player-coach role in a small, high-ownership team . You are responsible for the people, the roadmap and the technical direction, and you stay hands-on enough to ship alongside the team and make architectural calls credibly. At DataSnipper, Team Lead is our entry point into engineering management: the same people, delivery and product responsibilities as an Engineering Manager, on a smaller team. We take ownership of the full technical lifecycle: from first architecture decision to a production-grade system running inside our partner's infrastructure, long after go-live. The role As Lead AI Engineer, you are the technical owner of client engagements. You architect the solution, ship it to production, and make sure it still performs a year later. Alongside the other Leads, you shape the engineering team and the way we build. In practice: Design AI roadmaps with client leadership and own them through to production Create and implement the AI solution architectures to deliver on those roadmaps Set and uphold Data Platform and MLOps standards across your client portfolio, so systems stay healthy after handover Mentor engineers and weigh in on hiring, team growth, and accounts Push our engineering practice forward, including how we use agentic coding workflows to build faster without compromising reliability. We test, document, and share what works, so the whole team levels up Elevate our product mindset to ensure we build the right things, not just more things Why a Lead role here, not somewhere else You'll work across more stacks, clouds, and frontier frameworks in a year than most engineers see in five, with the collective knowledge of the whole team behind you, not the isolation of freelance work. And because our clients build grid software, energy forecasting, and climate infrastructure, you develop real domain expertise in energy and climate systems on top of production-grade AI engineering. In your first months you'll join a client project alongside an experienced Enjins engineer, supported by a dedicated coach. Within half a year, you own the technical roadmap of at least one engagement, mentor engineers, and have a recognised voice in our Asset strategy. Requirements What matters most: you think in systems, own outcomes end-to-end, and grow the people around you. 5+ years building and scaling data & AI solutions in production environments Strong software engineering fundamentals: you write production-grade code and know your way around infrastructure (Docker, Kubernetes, CI/CD, data pipelines) Mastery of at least one major cloud platform (AWS, Azure, GCP) and experience leading MLOps/LLMOps architectures Proven experience taking LLM-based or agentic systems to production Experience mentoring engineers, overseeing delivery, and managing client accounts You can translate technical complexity into clear decisions for non-technical stakeholders Fluent in English and eligible to work in the Netherlands Benefits We publish our salary ranges and keep terms straightforward. No surprises. Compensation €5,950 - €7,800 gross per month (excl. holiday allowance, pension, bonus, equity, and AI-Leap benefits) Annual performance bonus of 1.5 months' salary Equity participation (VSOP) Growth AI-Leap: our structured development programme with a dedicated certification budget and a specialised track for Leads 1-on-1 mentoring with our founders and external coaching to close your specific gaps Team & culture Office on the Oudegracht in Utrecht (note: not yet fully accessible for individuals with physical disabilities); hybrid setup 28 vacation days, flexible across 3 national holidays Monthly team events and the annual two-day Enjins Summer Summit on AI × Climate OV-First travel policy, fully covered; meat-free catering Apple MacBook Pro and the tools you need Find Jobs in Netherlands on Arbeitnow

title: Director - Power Systems and Grid Transformation
description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong>Company Description:</strong> Systemiq is a system-change company committed to achieving the Sustainable Development Goals and the Paris Agreement by transforming markets and business models across five key systems: nature and food, materials and circularity, energy, urban areas, and sustainable finance.</p> <p>As a certified B Corp, we combine strategic advisory with high-impact, on-the-ground work, partnering with business, finance, policymakers and civil society to deliver system change. With offices across Africa, Asia, Europe and the Americas, we are dedicated exclusively to sustainability-focused work.</p> <p></p> <p> </p></div><p></p> <p><strong>Director, Power Systems & Grid Transformation</strong></p> <p><strong>Location:</strong> Amsterdam ( preferred), or London <br><strong>Reports to:</strong> Eveline Speelman, Global Energy Platform Lead<br><strong>Role type:</strong> Full-time</p> <p><strong>Role Overview</strong></p> <p>Systemiq is seeking a Director with deep expertise in power system transformation, with a particular focus on grids, system planning, flexibility, market design, utility transformation, and the integration of renewables at scale.</p> <p>This role will help clients address some of the most critical bottlenecks in the energy transition: grid constraints, connection queues, system adequacy, flexibility markets, transmission and distribution investment, regulatory reform, and the changing role of utilities and system operators.</p> <p>This is not a generalist energy transition role. We are looking for a senior strategy leader who understands how power systems actually work technically, commercially, and institutionally, and who can help clients unlock the grid, market, and system integration challenges now slowing the transition.</p> <p>This is a senior leadership role combining:</p> <ul> <li>Deep power systems expertise</li> <li>Top-tier strategy problem solving</li> <li>Origination and senior client leadership</li> <li>Delivery of complex, multi-stakeholder programmes</li> <li>Team leadership and platform-building</li> </ul> <p>You will work closely with Eveline Speelman and global partners to build Systemiq’s work on power system transformation, with a particular focus on grids, flexibility, market design, utilities, and system-level decarbonisation.</p> <p><strong>Key Responsibilities</strong></p> <p><strong>Power Systems & Grid Transformation</strong></p> <ul> <li>Lead work on power system transformation, including grid constraints, transmission and distribution investment, system planning, flexibility, renewables integration, and utility transformation.</li> <li>Advise clients on the strategic, regulatory, commercial, and institutional choices needed to accelerate power system decarbonisation.</li> <li>Translate technical power system challenges into clear strategic recommendations for senior decision-makers.</li> <li>Identify the practical barriers slowing power system transformation and shape interventions to overcome them.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Strategic Advisory</strong></p> <ul> <li>Lead high-impact strategy engagements with corporates, governments, investors, utilities, system operators, and other energy system actors.</li> <li>Structure and solve complex, ambiguous problems and translate them into actionable recommendations.</li> <li>Advise senior stakeholders, including C-suite leaders and policymakers, on transition pathways, investment priorities, and market-shaping decisions.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Systems Change & Platform Leadership</strong></p> <ul> <li>Shape and drive system-level interventions beyond individual projects, including coalitions, market-shaping initiatives, and public-private collaboration.</li> <li>Identify structural bottlenecks across policy, infrastructure, regulation, market design, and capital allocation.</li> <li>Work across sectors and stakeholders to unlock system-wide impact beyond project-level outcomes.</li> <li>Contribute to Systemiq’s broader Energy platform strategy and thought leadership.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Origination & Growth</strong></p> <ul> <li>Identify, shape, and win new work across power systems, grids, utilities, flexibility, and energy transition topics.</li> <li>Build trusted relationships with senior clients, partners, and external stakeholders.</li> <li>Contribute to scaling Systemiq’s Energy platform globally.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Team Leadership</strong></p> <ul> <li>Lead and mentor high-performing teams.</li> <li>Coach and develop team members, building capability in power systems, analytical problem solving, and systems-level thinking.</li> <li>Contribute to a collaborative, entrepreneurial, and mission-driven culture.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Candidate Profile</strong></p> <p>We are looking for a high-calibre, strategy-led leader with deep power systems expertise and the ability to operate at the intersection of strategy, policy, regulation, infrastructure, and real-economy delivery.</p> <p><strong>Essential Experience</strong></p> <ul> <li>Deep experience in power systems, ideally including transmission and distribution grids, system operation, power market design, flexibility, renewables integration, storage, demand response, or utility strategy</li> <li>Around 10 to 15+ years’ experience in strategy consulting or energy advisory</li> <li>Experience working with or advising utilities, TSOs, DSOs, regulators, energy ministries, market operators, developers, infrastructure investors, or major energy users.</li> <li>Strong understanding of how grid constraints, interconnection, flexibility, storage, demand response, market reform, and regulation affect decarbonisation pathways.</li> <li>Ability to translate technical power system issues into strategic choices for senior decision-makers.</li> <li>Proven track record leading strategy engagements, complex programmes, and senior client relationships.</li> <li>Demonstrated ability to engage and influence senior stakeholders, including C-suite leaders, policymakers, regulators, and investors.</li> <li>Experience combining advisory work with real-world implementation is strongly valued.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Core Capabilities</strong></p> <ul> <li>Exceptional problem structuring and analytical rigour.</li> <li>Strong commercial judgement and experience in origination and growth.</li> <li>Ability to move between high-level strategy and practical implementation.</li> <li>Strong stakeholder management and influencing skills.</li> <li>Systems thinker focused on practical, scalable, real-world outcomes.</li> <li>Ability to lead complex work across multiple stakeholders, sectors, and geographies.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Desirable Experience</strong></p> <ul> <li>Experience in international energy systems, infrastructure investment, large-scale transition programmes, or power market reform.</li> <li>Experience with digital, AI, or advanced analytical tools that improve insight generation, modelling, or delivery efficiency.</li> <li>Experience building new areas of work, propositions, or client relationships.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Mindset</strong></p> <ul> <li>Entrepreneurial and opportunity-driven.</li> <li>Comfortable with ambiguity and building new areas of work.</li> <li>Collaborative, low ego, and mission-driven.</li> <li>Pragmatic, intellectually rigorous, and focused on real-world impact.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Why This Role Matters</strong></p> <p>Power systems are now one of the central constraints in the energy transition. Renewables, electrification, storage, flexibility, industrial decarbonisation, and clean technology deployment all depend on power systems evolving faster than they are today.</p> <p>This role sits at the centre of that challenge. It will help clients and partners address the grid, market, regulatory, and institutional barriers that determine whether economy-wide decarbonisation can happen at the pace required.</p> <p></p><div class="content-conclusion"><div id="description__body"></div> <p><strong data-start="578" data-end="603">Diversity & Inclusion</strong><br data-start="603" data-end="606">At Systemiq, we absolutely believe diverse perspectives are essential to driving system change. We are committed to creating an inclusive workplace where people feel respected, supported and able to do their best work.</p> <p>Click <a href="https://www.systemiq.earth/privacy-policy/">here</a> to view our Data Policy.</p></div> Find Jobs in Netherlands on Arbeitnow

When you work at Burson, you are part of a global community of lifelong learners who thrive at the edge of innovation.</p> <p>WPP (LSE/NYSE: WPP) is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. title: Senior Technical SEO Specialist
description: <div class="content-intro"><h4><strong>Who We Are</strong></h4> <p>WPP Enterprise Solutions designs, builds, and operates the growth systems that competitive businesses rely on. In a world where Al is reshaping how companies drive growth, we lead clients in business transformation and marketing modernization, connecting strategy directly to execution. Our 12,000 experts in engineering and platforms, commerce, consulting, content transformation, CRM, and CX work within a unified global operating unit across 40+ markets. WPP Enterprise Solutions works alongside best-in-class partners including Adobe, AWS, Braze, Google, Microsoft, Salesforce, and Shopify, as well as innovators in AI, to deliver growth solutions tailored to the needs of our clients’ businesses. VML, part of WPP, supports WPP Enterprise Solutions by helping brands activate transformation through creativity and experience.</p></div><h3><strong>About the role</strong></h3> <p>WPP Enterprise Solutions in Amsterdam is the central hub for SEO and GEO expertise across the WPP network. From our team, we work with major national and international organisations on complex challenges across search, websites, digital platforms and AI-driven discovery.</p> <p>Our team currently consists of ten SEO and GEO specialists and is growing rapidly. We are therefore looking for a <strong>Senior Technical SEO Specialist</strong> to strengthen our technical capabilities.</p> <p>This is explicitly not a traditional SEO role with some technical SEO added on top. We are looking for someone who approaches SEO from a technical perspective. Someone who understands how websites, platforms, JavaScript frameworks, crawlers, rendering, APIs and search engines interact, and who can independently investigate and solve complex technical problems.</p> <p>You are comfortable working with SEO specialists, developers, solution architects, product teams and other technical stakeholders. You are able to go deep into the technology when needed, while also translating complex findings into clear priorities, recommendations and implementations for enterprise clients.</p> <h3><strong>What you will do</strong></h3> <p>As a Senior Technical SEO Specialist, you will be responsible for the technical quality and scalability of our SEO solutions. You will work on complex websites and digital ecosystems where standard SEO checklists are simply not enough.</p> <p><strong>Your responsibilities will include:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Conducting advanced technical SEO audits for large and complex websites, platforms and international domain structures.</li> <li>Analysing crawling, indexing and rendering to identify the root causes of technical SEO and indexation issues.</li> <li>Working with modern JavaScript frameworks and rendering architectures, including SSR, CSR, SSG and hybrid rendering.</li> <li>Analysing HTML, JavaScript, HTTP requests, response headers, status codes, redirects, canonicalisation and robots directives.</li> <li>Investigating and optimising crawl architecture, internal linking and information architecture for websites with hundreds of thousands or millions of URLs.</li> <li>Advising on complex technical challenges involving migrations, replatforming, URL structures, faceted navigation, pagination, internationalisation and hreflang.</li> <li>Performing log file analysis to understand how Googlebot and other crawlers interact with websites and to improve crawl efficiency.</li> <li>Developing scripts, tooling and automation that make recurring analyses faster, more reliable and more scalable.</li> <li>Reviewing technical solutions, specifications and implementations from an SEO perspective before they go live.</li> <li>Working closely with developers and engineering teams to translate SEO recommendations into clear technical requirements and tickets.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>The technical expertise we are looking for</strong></h3> <p>For this role, we are looking for someone whose technical capabilities go well beyond using standard SEO tools.</p> <p><strong>You have a strong understanding of:</strong></p> <ul> <li>HTML, CSS and JavaScript, and can independently analyse source code and identify technical issues.</li> <li>HTTP and web architecture, including requests and responses, status codes, caching, redirects, headers and CDN behaviour.</li> <li>JavaScript SEO and the implications of client-side and server-side rendering for crawling, rendering and indexing.</li> <li>Technical concepts such as SSR, CSR, SSG, hydration and dynamic rendering.</li> <li>Crawling and indexing, and how search engines technically process websites.</li> <li>txt, XML sitemaps, canonical tags, meta robots, X-Robots-Tag and other crawling and indexing directives.</li> <li>Structured data and Schema.org.</li> <li>Core Web Vitals and web performance.</li> <li>International websites, hreflang and complex multi-market architectures.</li> <li>Website and platform migrations.</li> <li>Crawl budget and scalable website architectures.</li> </ul> <p>You do not need to be a software engineer in every area. However, we do expect you to be comfortable reading code, manipulating data, working with APIs and building scripts or technical solutions when needed.</p> <h3>What seniority means to us</h3> <p>Being senior means more than being able to independently deliver a technical SEO audit.</p> <p>We expect you to be able to break down complex technical problems where there is no obvious answer. You combine experience, data and technical knowledge to define your own investigative approach and develop solutions that can realistically scale within enterprise organisations.</p> <h3>You will also:</h3> <ul> <li>Proactively improve the way we work, using tooling and AI to increase efficiency, quality and impact.</li> <li>Make significant improvements to our SEO guidelines, workflows and processes.</li> <li>Develop innovative solutions to complex SEO challenges, including algorithm changes, large-scale site architecture, crawling and automation.</li> <li>Build frameworks, templates, scripts and automations that can be adopted across multiple clients and projects.</li> <li>Independently develop new approaches for challenges where no standard solution exists.</li> <li>Think beyond what needs to change and consider how solutions can be technically and organisationally implemented at scale.</li> <li>Help other SEO specialists grow their technical capabilities.</li> </ul> <p>Act as a senior technical sparring partner for our clients.</p> <h3><strong>What you'll need:</strong></h3> <ul> <li>10+ years of experience in Technical SEO, with a strong track record of solving complex technical SEO challenges for large-scale, international and/or enterprise websites.</li> <li>Currently based in the Netherlands and able to work from our WPP office in Amsterdam.</li> <li>Deep technical knowledge of how modern websites are built, crawled, rendered and indexed, including strong expertise in HTML, JavaScript, HTTP, web architecture and rendering technologies.</li> <li>Strong experience working with <strong>l</strong>arge and complex website architectures, including crawling and indexation, faceted navigation, internationalisation, migrations, internal linking and crawl budget optimisation.</li> <li>Experience with Python and/or JavaScript for scripting and automation is highly desirable, as is experience with SQL, BigQuery or comparable data environments.</li> <li>A proven ability to turn complex technical findings into clear, actionable recommendations for developers, product teams, architects and senior stakeholders.</li> <li>Experience developing scalable frameworks, tooling, templates or automations that can be applied across multiple clients or projects.</li> <li>An eager and proactive mindset, with a strong interest in exploring how AI, automation, emerging search technologies and GEO can improve both our work and our clients' performance.</li> <li>Fluent in English. Dutch is highly desirable.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>What we offer:</strong> </h3> <p>We offer a competitive salary, a vibrant and collaborative culture and ample opportunities for professional growth. You'll be part of a global network of talent, working on projects that truly make an impact. <br> <br><strong>Our compensation:</strong> </p> <ul> <li>A gross annual salary range of 80,000€ - 95,000€, based on experience level.</li> <li>Hybrid working flexibility.</li> <li>Access to learning platforms .</li> <li>Wellbeing initiatives including mental health support programs and wellness activities. </li> <li>Employee discounts and access to WPP/VML global benefits ecosystem. </li> <li>Participation in team events, agency gatherings and cross-discipline workshops. </li> <li>At WPP ES, we believe in investing in people who build long-term value for our clients and their customers. Your growth is part of our growth. </li> </ul> <p> </p><div class="content-conclusion"><h4><strong>About WPP</strong></h4> <p class="p1">WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands.
