title: Process Automation Engineer
description: Functieprofiel Als Process Automation Engineer speel je een cruciale rol in het hart van onze productieomgeving. Je bent verantwoordelijk voor het beheren, onderhouden en continu verbeteren van het procesautomatiseringslandschap (ISA‑niveaus 1, 2 en 3 – zowel hardware als software). Je borgt de betrouwbaarheid en beschikbaarheid van onze productieprocessen en vertaalt data en technologie naar slimme, praktische verbeteringen die de organisatie vooruithelpen. Dit is een hands‑on functie met veel impact, waarin je nauw samenwerkt met Operations, Production Support Engineering en externe technologiepartners. Bedrijfsomschrijving NX Filtration bevindt zich in een spannende groeifase, gedreven door een unieke en impactvolle technologie. Met onze missie “pure en betaalbare wateroplossingen voor iedereen” ontwikkelen en produceren wij geavanceerde holle‑vezelmembranen voor nano‑, ultra‑ en microfiltratie. Onze technologie verwijdert de kleinste verontreinigingen uit water, waaronder nanoplastics, organische stoffen, kleurstoffen, medicijnresten, bacteriën en virussen. Hiermee maken wij eenvoudige, efficiënte en duurzame oplossingen mogelijk voor waterzuivering, hergebruik van afvalwater en drinkwaterproductie wereldwijd. Door bij NX Filtration te werken, draag je direct bij aan het oplossen van mondiale uitdagingen op het gebied van waterkwaliteit en waterschaarste. Wat ga jij doen! In deze dynamische rol houd je je bezig met: Beheren, onderhouden en verder ontwikkelen van procesautomatiseringssystemen (ISA‑niveaus 1, 2 en 3) Continu verbeteren van het NX Production Data Platform Initiëren, uitwerken en implementeren van technische verbeteringen en procesoptimalisaties Ondersteunen van Operations bij automatiseringsincidenten, inclusief deelname aan de storingsdienst Zorgen voor een hoge beschikbaarheid en kwaliteit van productie‑ en QC‑data en actieve ondersteuning van data‑analyses Voorstellen van automatisering‑ en digitaliseringsprojecten en – na goedkeuring – deze voorbereiden en uitvoeren Adviseren van de organisatie over nieuwe technologische ontwikkelingen en toekomstbestendige oplossingen Actief bijdragen aan het versterken van cybersecurity binnen het OT‑domein Wat wij vragen! Jij bent een proactieve automatiseringsprofessional met een passie voor technologie en verbetering: Een afgeronde bachelor‑ of masteropleiding in Informatica, Elektrotechniek, Mechatronica of een vergelijkbare richting Minimaal 3 tot 5 jaar relevante werkervaring in procesautomatisering Hands‑on ervaring met Siemens Step7 / TIA Portal / WinCC Ervaring met ProLeiT Plant.iT Bij voorkeur ervaring met OPC UA en AVEVA PI De bereidheid om jezelf én de organisatie continu te blijven ontwikkelen Wat bieden wij jou! Werken bij NX Filtration biedt je de kans om samen met een gedreven en enthousiast team een belangrijke bijdrage te leveren aan de professionalisering en groei van de organisatie. Je werkt in een open en informele omgeving met zeer korte communicatielijnen, waarin eigen initiatief wordt gestimuleerd. Het betreft een zelfstandige functie binnen een snelgroeiende, dynamische organisatie in een internationale setting, waar je volop ruimte krijgt om jezelf te ontwikkelen – zowel persoonlijk als in je loopbaanambities. Daarnaast: In 2024 is een nieuwe fabriek gerealiseerd Alle processen zijn volledig geautomatiseerd met ProLeiT Volledige data‑integratie ten behoeve van diepgaande procesanalyses Mogelijkheden voor remote support Geïnteresseerd! Solliciteer dan snel via onze website. Wil je eerst meer informatie over de functie en organisatie? Mail dan naar Find Jobs in Netherlands on Arbeitnow

title: Product Manager
description: Role summary Bluerock TMS builds the autonomous orchestration platform that keeps global logistics moving — orchestrating complex, multi-modal transport networks for customers across fashion, food & beverage, manufacturing, healthcare, and more. Real complexity, at real scale, every single day. We're looking for a Product Manager who has actually lived inside logistics or TMS operations. Someone who can understand operations complexity and who is willing to take on this challenge and contribute hands on to build the next level of TMS. You'll own the products that turn that complexity into clarity, working shoulder-to-shoulder with engineering, sales, and implementation to make sure what we build actually gets adopted. Responsibilities Product vision, grounded in real user needs You dig past what customers ask for to find the problem underneath, and turn that into a direction for your area the company can rally behind. Market scoping and opportunity-spotting Scanning the logistics landscape, competitor moves, and customer signals to find where Bluerock should build next, not just what's already on the backlog. Logistics know-how turned into product decisions Planning, transport execution, freight, last-mile — decisions that hold up against how operations actually run, not just how they're described to you. The full lifecycle From first idea to adoption. You don't hand off and disappear. The connective tissue across the company When priorities compete or a customer escalation needs an answer fast, you're the one pulling the threads together. The team you’ll join You'll join an international product team with complementary skills and a shared passion for a good challenge, real, hands-on experience in logistics paired with genuine enthusiasm for technology. We don't settle for quick patches: we strive for quality, look for the sustainable solution over the easy one, and keep an eye on what next-level TMS should look like, not just what's in front of us today. Life at Bluerock We're a distributed team across the Netherlands, Italy, the US, and Canada that operates like one crew: local insight, global perspective. We're curious by default, self-driven without needing to be told twice, and genuinely joyful about solving hard logistics problems together. We're team-minded because the best answers rarely come from one person alone, and unapologetically reliable because our customers' supply chains don't get a “we'll fix it next sprint.” As one of us put it: at the end of the day, it's the people that make Bluerock. 5+ years in product or project management within logistics, supply chain, or TMS — hands-on TMS experience is required. Bachelor's degree in Project Management, Business Administration, Information Systems, Supply Chain/Logistics, or a related field required. A track record of delivering complex, high-stakes software implementations , on time and within budget. Genuine ease operating cross-functionally . You connect engineering, sales, implementation, and customers without waiting for permission. An appetite for ambiguity and change : a messy, fragmented workflow reads to you as an interesting problem. Nice to have: API integration experience (WMS, ERP, visibility providers, customs), fluency with Agile tooling (Jira, Asana, Rocketlane), and PMP/PRINCE2 certification. Excellent leadership and team management skills , with the ability to motivate and guide cross-functional teams. Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to manage customer relationships and stakeholder expectations effectively. Exceptional problem-solving and decision-making abilities, with a focus on delivering results in a fast-paced environment Our hiring process Hit the Apply button. Join a 30 minute video call in the Introduction Interview A couple of deeper interviews built to be a win-win, not an interrogation. An offer, and the start of your journey with Bluerock TMS. description: Ben jij dé Test Engineer met ambitie om geavanceerde windtunnel testen uit te voeren en onze experimentele testtechnieken verder te ontwikkelen? Ben je een teamspeler en een kartrekker, heb je een afgeronde HBO opleiding en ligt je interesse in de Lucht- en Ruimtevaarttechniek? Dan kijken wij uit naar jouw sollicitatie! Wat ga je doen? Als test engineer ben je verantwoordelijk voor de verwerking, validatie en presentatie van windtunneldata aan de klant. Je werkt daarbij vanaf de start van een project tot en met de aflevering van windtunnel testresultaten nauw samen met klanten en collega’s. Bij de voorbereiding en uitvoering van de test weet jij de diverse meetgegevens en data te verifiëren, verwerken en presenteren aan onze klanten, zodat zij deze vlot kunnen interpreteren. Je werkt hiervoor samen met technici operators en projectmanagers. Je ontwikkelt multidisciplinaire kennis en doet ervaring op met het volledige proces, van data-acquisitie en geavanceerde meettechnieken tot de uiteindelijke verwerking en analyse van de data. Kortom een uitdagende baan waarbij er ruimte is voor eigen inbreng en je veel verantwoordelijkheid krijgt. Je werkt primair op onze locatie in Marknesse, waar wij twee lage snelheidswindtunnels beheren. Op projectbasis ondersteun je ook onze windtunneltesten in Amsterdam. Wat breng je mee? • Een brede technische opleiding (HBO) met kennis en ervaring op vlak van aerodynamica, instrumentatie en dataverwerking • Kennis en praktische ervaring met data-analysesoftware, datavisualisatie en programmeren (bij voorkeur Fortran, Python) • Collegialiteit, resultaatgerichtheid, leervermogen • Je hebt de ambitie en potentie om je te ontwikkelen tot een gewaardeerd adviseur • Ervaring met het verwerken van meetgegevens tot gewenste grootheden • Scherp oog voor vragen van de klant en de doorvertaling naar passende oplossingen • Flexibiliteit om (op projectbasis) ook onze windtunneltesten in Amsterdam te ondersteunen • Uitstekende communicatieve vaardigheden in Nederlands en Engels, kennis van het Duits is een pré Wat bieden wij jou? Werken bij NLR, betekent werken in een nationale en internationale hightech omgeving. Samenwerken en betrokkenheid staan bij ons hoog in vaandel. Door jou vrijheid en eigen verantwoordelijkheid te geven, ben jij het best in staat om tot baanbrekende innovaties te komen. Wil jij jezelf vakinhoudelijk én op persoonlijk vlak ontwikkelen? Ook dat kan bij NLR als lerende organisatie, met daarnaast een opleidingsbudget, een mentor, interne coaches en goede contacten met mbo’s, hbo’s en universiteiten. Naast dit alles bieden wij jou: De kans om bij te dragen aan complexe en maatschappelijk relevante vraagstukken; Voldoende vakantie- en ATV-dagen (in totaal 45 bij fulltime dienstverband) voor een goede werk-privébalans; Een eindejaarsuitkering van 8%; Een tegemoetkoming in jouw zorgkosten; Extra betaald ouderschapsverlof; De mogelijkheid om jezelf te ontwikkelen met opleidingen en cursussen die passen bij jouw ambities. Jouw nieuwe werkomgeving De Duits-Nederlands Windtunnels (DNW) exploiteert windtunnels op vier verschillende locaties van het Nederlands Lucht- en Ruimtevaartcentrum (NLR) en van de Duitse zusterorganisatie DLR. In deze zeer geavanceerde installaties wordt hoog gekwalificeerd onderzoek verricht voor internationale opdrachtgevers, voornamelijk uit de luchtvaart en automotive sector. Wij werken aan projecten waarbij de aerodynamische, aero-akoestische en aero-elastische eigenschappen van vliegtuigen, helikopters, treinen en (vracht-) auto’s worden gesimuleerd en gemeten. De afdeling Projects and Customer Relation Management is verantwoordelijk voor de acquisitie en uitvoering van projecten in de windtunnels. Het team bestaat uit diverse R&D engineers en project engineers met expertise op het vlak van aerodynamica, aero-akoestiek, meettechnieken en mechanical engineering. Ook speelt de afdeling een belangrijke rol in de kennisontwikkeling en het business development proces van DNW. Het team opereert in en rond diverse windtunnels in de vestigingen Amsterdam en Marknesse. Wat betekent werken bij NLR? Koninklijke NLR is al ruim 100 jaar een kennisorganisatie met de wil en ambitie om te vernieuwen. Vanuit die drijfveer maken wij de wereld van lucht- en ruimtevaart veiliger, duurzamer, efficiënter en effectiever en staan wij voor baanbrekende innovaties. Bij ons werken meer dan 1000 gedreven professionals, van vliegtuigbouwkundigen tot psychologen en van wiskundigen tot applicatiedeskundigen. NLR staat voor een inclusieve en diverse organisatie waar iedereen zich welkom, veilig, gewaardeerd en gerespecteerd voelt. Wil jij meer weten? Mail met onze recruiter Danielle Kuijf; collega’s vertellen jou graag hoe het is om bij NLR te werken. Vergeet trouwens ook niet eens een kijkje op onze socials te nemen zoals ons YouTube kanaal . Solliciteren? Mooi, we zijn benieuwd naar jou! Stuur je motivatiebrief en CV via de ‘Solliciteren’ button. Een integriteitstest en het verkrijgen van een VOG zijn voorwaarden voor indiensttreding. title: Senior Machine Learning Engineer
description: Als Senior Machine Learning Engineer bij BigData Republic combineer je diepgaande technische expertise met consultancy. Je ontwikkelt niet alleen machine-learningoplossingen, maar brengt ze daadwerkelijk naar productie en adviseert klanten over architectuur, technologie en de beste aanpak om duurzame businesswaarde te realiseren. Voor deze senior positie zoeken we een ervaren professional met minimaal 6 jaar relevante werkervaring, waarvan minimaal 3 jaar hands-on ervaring met machine learning in professionele productieomgevingen. Wat ga je doen? Machine Learning Engineering bevindt zich bij BigData Republic op het snijvlak van Machine Learning, MLOps, Software Engineering, Data Engineering en Cloud Engineering. Je werkt in multidisciplinaire teams bij klanten aan end-to-end machine-learningoplossingen: van probleemdefinitie en architectuur tot ontwikkeling, deployment, monitoring en optimalisatie. Je; analyseert complexe business- en technische vraagstukken en vertaalt deze naar robuuste ML-oplossingen; adviseert klanten en stakeholders over machine learning, MLOps, architectuur en technische keuzes; ontwikkelt en productionaliseert machine-learningmodellen; ontwerpt schaalbare ML- en MLOps-architecturen; bouwt production-grade software rondom machine-learningoplossingen; werkt aan deployment, CI/CD, model serving, monitoring en observability; werkt samen met Data Scientists, Data Engineers, Software Engineers en Cloud Engineers; helpt klanten en collega's inhoudelijk naar een hoger niveau; draagt actief bij aan kennisdeling en thought leadership binnen BigData Republic. De technische uitdagingen variëren van machine-learningmodellen met directe businessimpact tot toepassingen rond deep learning, generative AI, Large Language Models (LLM's), predictive modelling, causal inference en reinforcement learning. Bij BigData Republic zien we een machine-learningmodel niet als het eindproduct. Een model levert pas waarde wanneer het betrouwbaar, schaalbaar en beheersbaar in productie draait. Daarom benaderen we ML-oplossingen als volwaardige softwareproducten. Technologieën waarmee we veel werken zijn onder andere; Python Airflow Apache Spark Kafka Docker Tensorflow Pytorch Kubernetes Terraform AWS/ Azur/ GCP en private-cloud omgevingen Welke technologie je inzet, hangt af van het vraagstuk. We zoeken daarom geen engineer die simpelweg zoveel mogelijk tools kent, maar een ervaren professional die begrijpt welke technische oplossing in welke situatie passend is en waarom. Je werkt aan complexe data-, AI- en machine-learningvraagstukken voor grote organisaties in verschillende sectoren. Tegelijkertijd ben je onderdeel van een klein, informeel en inhoudelijk gedreven team van ervaren Machine Learning Engineers, MLOps Engineers, Data Engineers en Data Scientists. Kennisdeling en thought leadership zijn fundamentele onderdelen van BigData Republic. We organiseren iedere vrijdag kennissessies op kantoor, schrijven inhoudelijke artikelen, organiseren meetups en bezoeken en spreken op conferenties. Je krijgt veel vrijheid om je eigen expertise verder te ontwikkelen en tegelijkertijd collega's en klanten verder te helpen. Dit is nadrukkelijk een senior consultancyrol. Om succesvol te kunnen zijn in deze functie zoeken we iemand die beschikt over: minimaal 6 jaar relevante professionele werkervaring binnen software engineering, data engineering, data science en/of machine learning; minimaal 3 jaar hands-on professionele ervaring met machine learning, waarbij je aantoonbaar ML-oplossingen naar productie hebt gebracht en beheerd, verbeterd of opgeschaald; ervaring met het zelfstandig analyseren van complexe technische vraagstukken en het adviseren van klanten en stakeholders over oplossingen, architectuur en technische keuzes; ruime professionele programmeerervaring met Python; gedegen kennis van software-engineeringprincipes en ervaring met het bouwen van production-grade oplossingen; ervaring met minimaal één grote cloudomgeving: AWS, Azure en/of GCP; ervaring met MLOps, waaronder deployment, CI/CD, monitoring, observability en schaalbaarheid; academisch werk- en denkniveau, bij voorkeur met een achtergrond in Data Science, Computer Science, Engineering of een vergelijkbaar vakgebied; uitstekende beheersing van het Nederlands (minimaal C1) en Engels, zowel mondeling als schriftelijk. Daarnaast is het van toegevoegde waarde als je ervaring hebt met: consultancy binnen complexe enterprise-omgevingen; solution architecture of technical leadership; Kubernetes en Terraform; Spark, Kafka en/of Airflow; TensorFlow en/of PyTorch; generative AI en Large Language Models (LLM's); deep learning, causal inference of reinforcement learning; Scala, Kotlin en/of SQL; open-sourceprojecten, meetups, conferenties of andere vormen van kennisdeling. We verwachten niet dat je met iedere technologie uit onze stack hebt gewerkt. De senioriteit van je ervaring, het daadwerkelijk in productie brengen van machine-learningoplossingen, je vermogen om klanten inhoudelijk te adviseren en je beheersing van het Nederlands zijn voor deze rol wel essentieel. Je bent technisch sterk, maar kijkt verder dan alleen de technologie. Je kunt complexe situaties doorgronden, alternatieven afwegen en uitleggen waarom een bepaalde oplossing wel of niet verstandig is. Je voelt je comfortabel in gesprekken met engineers, architecten en business stakeholders. Tegelijkertijd blijf je graag zelf bouwen. BigData Republic zoekt geen consultant die alleen vanaf de zijlijn adviseert: je combineert senior technisch advies met hands-on Machine Learning Engineering. title: Senior Corporate Tech Recruiter
description: Bouw mee aan recruitment voor een hoogwaardige tech consultancy Senior tech professionals vinden vraagt meer dan vacatures publiceren en sollicitaties beoordelen. De beste kandidaten zijn vaak niet actief op zoek. Je moet weten waar je ze vindt, hoe je ze benadert en hoe je ze enthousiast maakt voor een inhoudelijk gesprek. Bij Conflux zoeken we daarom een Senior Corporate Tech Recruiter die recruitment en sourcing beheerst. Iemand die zelfstandig de arbeidsmarkt benadert, hiring managers adviseert en verantwoordelijkheid neemt voor het volledige recruitmentproces. Conflux is een Nederlandse tech consultancy met gespecialiseerde expertise binnen onder andere Data & AI, Software Development, Cloud en Platform Engineering. Onze consultants werken aan complexe technische vraagstukken en behoren inhoudelijk tot de ervaren professionals binnen hun vakgebied. Dat betekent dat onze recruitment vraagstukken niet eenvoudig zijn. We zoeken onder andere Senior Data Engineers, Machine Learning Engineers, Java Developers, Kubernetes Engineers, Platform Engineers en Front-end Developers. Daarvoor zoeken we een recruiter die zijn of haar vak verstaat. Wat je gaat doen Je bent verantwoordelijk voor de werving van ervaren technische consultants binnen onder andere: Data Engineering & AI Machine Learning Java Development Kubernetes & Cloud Native Cloud & Platform Engineering Front-end Development Je beheert het recruitmentproces van arbeidsmarktanalyse en sourcing tot selectie en aanbieding. Concreet betekent dit dat je: actief technische professionals sourcet en benadert, onder andere via LinkedIn Recruiter en andere sourcingkanalen; zelfstandig searches en sourcingstrategieën ontwikkelt voor moeilijk vindbare doelgroepen; kandidaten screent op ervaring, technische context, motivatie en consultancy-fit; hiring managers adviseert over doelgroep, haalbaarheid, arbeidsmarkt, selectiecriteria en recruitmentaanpak; kandidaten gedurende het volledige proces begeleidt en zorgt voor een professionele en persoonlijke candidate experience; interview- en selectieprocessen bewaakt en waar nodig bijstuurt; talentpools opbouwt en relaties onderhoudt met relevante professionals; data en recruitmentinzichten gebruikt om keuzes en prioriteiten te onderbouwen; externe recruitmentpartners inzet wanneer dit aantoonbaar waarde toevoegt; kansen signaleert om recruitment slimmer, sneller en effectiever te organiseren. Ongeveer 85% van je tijd ben je bezig met recruitment en sourcing. De overige tijd gebruik je om recruitment verder te professionaliseren, bijvoorbeeld op het gebied van tooling, data, processen, arbeidsmarktcommunicatie, AI of nieuwe sourcingmethoden. Je bent daarmee niet alleen verantwoordelijk voor vacatures, maar mede-eigenaar van hoe recruitment binnen Conflux wordt uitgevoerd en ontwikkeld. We zoeken nadrukkelijk een ervaren tech recruiter die zelfstandig kan opereren in een markt waarin kandidaten schaars zijn en actief gevonden en overtuigd moeten worden. Dit breng je mee Minimaal 6 jaar professionele recruitmentervaring. Minimaal 4 jaar aantoonbare ervaring met IT- of tech recruitment. Ervaring met het zelfstandig werven van ervaren of senior technische professionals. Aantoonbare ervaring met active sourcing en direct search. Je weet hoe je een technische doelgroep analyseert en vertaalt naar een effectieve search- en benaderingsstrategie. Je kunt inhoudelijk voldoende meepraten over technische rollen en begrijpt het verschil tussen bijvoorbeeld software engineering, data engineering, machine learning, cloud en platform engineering. Je bent ervaren met LinkedIn Recruiter en weet dat goede sourcing verder gaat dan alleen LinkedIn. Je bent een stevige gesprekspartner voor hiring managers en durft recruitmentvraagstukken kritisch te benaderen. Je kunt zelfstandig prioriteiten bepalen en meerdere complexe vacatures tegelijkertijd managen. Je combineert snelheid met kwaliteit en houdt grip op voortgang en candidate experience. Je spreekt en schrijft professioneel Nederlands en Engels. Ervaring met recruitment binnen tech consultancy, IT-dienstverlening, detachering of een vergelijkbare kennisintensieve omgeving is van toegevoegde waarde. Wie jij bent Je hebt weinig dagelijkse aansturing nodig. Je ziet waar recruitment stagneert, onderzoekt waarom en komt met oplossingen. Je wacht niet alleen op sollicitanten, maar gaat zelf de markt in. Je bent nieuwsgierig naar nieuwe sourcingmethoden, tooling en technologie en experimenteert graag met manieren om moeilijk bereikbare kandidaten toch te vinden. Tegelijkertijd begrijp je dat recruitment uiteindelijk draait om mensen. Je bouwt relaties op, communiceert duidelijk en zorgt ervoor dat kandidaten ook bij een afwijzing een professionele ervaring hebben. Waarom Conflux? Je komt terecht in een organisatie waarin recruitment dicht op de business zit. De lijnen met hiring managers en directie zijn kort en er is ruimte om vanuit jouw expertise invloed uit te oefenen op hoe we recruitment organiseren. Je krijgt: veel zelfstandigheid en vertrouwen; directe invloed op recruitmentstrategie en sourcing; ruimte om nieuwe sourcingmethoden en tooling te introduceren; inhoudelijk sterke collega's binnen verschillende technische disciplines; korte lijnen met hiring managers en directie; ruimte om recruitmentprocessen daadwerkelijk te verbeteren. Wat we bieden Een salaris van €4.600 tot €5.900 bruto per maand op fulltime basis, afhankelijk van ervaring. Vakantiegeld ter hoogte van 8% Een bonusregeling op basis van persoonlijke en bedrijfsdoelstellingen. Een flexibel mobiliteitsbudget, inzetbaar voor bijvoorbeeld een elektrische auto, declaraties of bruto uitbetaling. Een maandelijkse pensioenbijdrage. Een dienstverband van minimaal 32 uur per week, met voorkeur voor 36 of 40 uur. Laptop en telefoon. Regelmatig gezamenlijke activiteiten en evenementen. Een hybride werkomgeving met kantoor in Utrecht. We werken flexibel, maar recruitment is bij Conflux nadrukkelijk een vak waarbij relaties belangrijk zijn. Daarom verwachten we dat je regelmatig op kantoor in Utrecht aanwezig bent om nauw samen te werken met hiring managers, consultants en collega's. Proces We maken graag kennis met je. Daarbij kijken we niet alleen of jij bij Conflux past, maar ook of Conflux aansluit bij de manier waarop jij recruitment wilt bedrijven. Je solliciteert met je cv. In het eerste gesprek maak je kennis met de recruiters met wie je gaat samenwerken. We bespreken daarbij nadrukkelijk je ervaring met tech recruitment, sourcing en stakeholdermanagement. In het tweede gesprek ontmoet je de directie en gaan we verder in op wederzijdse verwachtingen en jouw visie op recruitment. Zijn we daarna allebei enthousiast? Dan volgt een aanbieding en kun je samen met ons verder bouwen aan recruitment binnen Conflux. Find more English Speaking Jobs in Netherlands on Arbeitnow

VGB-screening) • Je kunt Schiphol 24/7 bereiken met het openbaar vervoer. title: Senior Software Engineer - MAAS
location: Home Based - Americas; Home based - EMEA
description: <p>Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office-based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.</p> <p>The company is founder-led, profitable, and growing.</p> <p>The Canonical MAAS team is responsible for delivering our <a href="https://maas.io/" target="_blank">Metal As A Service</a> hyperscale provisioning technology. Ubuntu strives to be the most scalable, cloud ready server distribution and MAAS is our platform to get it there. MAAS is a rapidly evolving software stack written in Python and Go, and we are looking for experienced software engineers who understand performance at scale, networking, storage and usability.</p> <p>Applicants should be passionate about the future of Ubuntu and be able to show technical leadership with a globally distributed team of engineers who share that passion. This position requires international travel several times a year.</p> <p><strong>This role entails</strong></p> <ul> <li>Develop MAAS core components and features to make MAAS the #1 bare metal cloud system.</li> <li>Shape the architecture of MAAS to make it simpler, faster and easier to use.</li> <li>Collaborate with other teams to ensure MAAS works well with other tools and is released on time.</li> <li>Contribute your improvements to our continuous integration environment, tests and practices, to maintain fast feedback and good test coverage.</li> <li>Contribute to documentation of current and existing features, making it world-class resource for Data Centre operators and users.</li> <li>Provide technical communication and collaboration with other teams where appropriate.</li> <li>Take personal ownership of problems and drive them to solutions.</li> <li><a href="https://canonical.com/careers/travel" target="_blank">Travel internationally</a> a few times a year to meet and collaborate with your and other teams. </li> </ul> <p><strong>What we are looking for in you</strong></p> <ul> <li>Passionate about open source software, Linux, and Data Centre automation</li> <li>Solid track record of professional software development experience in Python, Go for back-end roles, or TypeScript, React for front-end roles.</li> <li>Capacity to learn quickly about new systems and techniques</li> <li>Excellent logic, problem solving, and troubleshooting skills</li> <li>Strong English language communication skills - both written and verbal</li> <li>Experience with Linux server technologies, including but not limited to Virtualization (KVM), Containers (LXC), etc.</li> <li>You have a Bachelor’s or equivalent in Computer Science, STEM or similar degree</li> <li>Knowledge of network technologies, including PXE, DHCP, TFTP, DNS, NTP</li> <li>Some experience with Baseboard Management Controllers and Protocols (Redfish, IPMI, AMT and others)</li> <li>Strong experience with networking, storage technologies and Cloud hosting and infrastructure.</li> <li>Ideally, experience of large-scale physical server provisioning and automation, including rapid deployment, configuration, management and service orchestration.</li> <li>Familiarity with some of the open source development tools and methodologies used in creation of several Ubuntu projects (MAAS, Juju, Ubuntu Server, LXD, Ubuntu Core), such as Launchpad, Debian packaging tools (APT, dpkg) and snapcraft.</li> <li>An exceptional academic track record from both high school and preferably university.</li> <li>Willingness to travel up to 4 times a year for internal events</li> </ul> <h3><strong>What we offer colleagues</strong></h3> <p>We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognize outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus or commission. We provide all team members with additional benefits which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.</p> <ul> <li>Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person</li> <li>Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year</li> <li>Annual compensation review</li> <li>Recognition rewards</li> <li>Annual holiday leave</li> <li>Maternity and paternity leave</li> <li>Team Member Assistance Program & Wellness Platform</li> <li>Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues</li> <li>Priority Pass and travel upgrades for long-haul company events</li> </ul> <h3><strong>About Canonical</strong></h3> <p>Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open-source projects and the platform for AI, IoT, and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence; in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since our inception in 2004.​ Working here is a step into the future and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.</p> <p><strong>Canonical is an equal opportunity employer</strong></p> <p>We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products.<a href="https://canonical.com/careers/diversity/identity"> Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.</a></p> <p>#LI-remote</p>

title: Senior FinCrime Operations Manager
description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong><em>🚀 We’re on a mission to make money work for everyone.</em></strong></p> <p>We’re waving goodbye to the complicated and confusing ways of traditional banking.</p> <p>After starting as a prepaid card, our product offering has grown a lot in the last 10 years in the UK. As well as <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/personal">personal</a> and <a href="https://monzo.com/business-banking">business</a> bank accounts, we offer <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/joint-account">joint accounts</a>, <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/16-17">accounts for 16-17 year olds</a>, a <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/under-16s">free kids account</a> and <a href="https://monzo.com/flex">credit cards</a> in the UK, with more exciting things to come beyond. Our UK customers can also <a href="https://monzo.com/savings">save</a>, <a href="https://monzo.com/investments">invest </a>and <a href="https://monzo.com/pensions">combine their pensions</a> with us. </p> <p>With our hot coral cards and get-paid-early feature, combined with financial education on social media and our award winning customer service, we have a long history of creating magical moments for our customers!</p> <p>We’re not about selling products - we want to solve problems and change lives through Monzo ❤️</p> <hr> <p> </p></div><p><span style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif; font-size: 12pt;">📍Dublin | 💶 €76,500 - €95,500 + Incentive Awards tied to your performance + benefits | <a href="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=U62l09nB0M4">Hear from the team</a> ✨</span></p> <p><strong>⭐ Our FinCrime, Fraud and Dispute Operations team</strong></p> <p>Reporting to the EU Director of FinCrime, Fraud and Dispute Operations, we're looking for a Senior Financial Crime Ops Manager to join our fast-growing EU team here in Dublin. You will need to oversee our outsourced partners, holding them accountable for SLAs and performance. This position requires in-depth data analysis expertise and a strong commitment to data-driven decision making, alongside a solid understanding of day-to-day fincrime operations and deep knowledge of transaction monitoring, AML/CTF, screening, and onboarding rules and models implementation. You will work across different areas and products including our current and business accounts and partner with our group data science, data engineering, product, and technology teams.</p> <p><strong>🔑 You’ll play a key role by...</strong></p> <ul> <li>Driving strategic partners oversight: Ensuring that our outsourcing partners for FinCrime Operations are operating effectively.</li> <li>Monitoring our FinCrime metrics and driving action delivery with our product teams to address the trends.</li> <li>Combining hands-on execution with strategic thinking to align cross-functional teams with our FinCrime, AML/ CTF vision and strategy.</li> <li>Helping to build and oversee solutions with technology at the heart of our screening, onboarding and transaction monitoring mitigation strategies to cover the various typologies using automated alerts.</li> <li>Supporting the Director of FinCrime, Fraud and Disputes operations with producing Committee packs.</li> <li>Supporting and managing the oversight of change implementation, making prioritisation calls of those initiatives. </li> <li>Working closely with the second line of defence and our Money Laundering Reporting Officer (MLRO) to complete assurance activity, identification and remediation of any actions. </li> <li>Collaborating across the company to remove roadblocks and solve complex challenges relating to Monzo's EU expansion.</li> <li>Supporting 3rd line of defence with auditing activities. </li> <li>Being an excellent partner to our third party vendors, unblocking and empowering their teams for high delivery and high performance. </li> </ul> <p><strong>🤩 We’d love to hear from you if…</strong></p> <ul> <li>You excel at leveraging robust data insights and analytics to drive strategic decision-making.</li> <li>You are a problem solver who takes initiative to create a high impact for stakeholders.</li> <li>Excel at stakeholder management and coordination across multiple teams.</li> <li>You have previous experience of achieving results through 3rd party/outsourcing  management and you’re excited about working in a cross-functional team with engineers and data scientists to empower third party vendors' success.</li> <li>You have previous experience leading and managing FinCrime operations in payments or banking.</li> <li>You enjoy partnering with 3rd party vendors, data scientists, and second line of defence (2LOD) to proactively mitigate and respond to existing and emerging fraud trends.</li> <li>You understand the Financial crime,  money mulling risks of the various products and services operating in the fintech space.</li> <li>You champion the use of automated processes to find more efficient ways of working.</li> </ul> <p><strong>🙌 What’s in it for you</strong></p> <p>💶 A salary range of €76,500 - €95,500 + Incentive Awards tied to your performance</p> <p>📍This role will have a hybrid working model, based in our Dublin office 3 days a week. You will also travel to Monzo’s head office in London from time to time</p> <p>⏰ We offer flexible working hours and trust you to work enough hours to do your job well, and at times that suit you and your team</p> <p>🏝 Annual Leave - 34 days including public holidays (24 holiday days + 10 public holidays)</p> <p>📚€1,200 learning budget each year to use on books, training courses and conferences</p> <p>🏥 Private healthcare scheme</p> <p>💰Pension scheme: the minimum contribution is 4% and Monzo matches any additional contributions that you make up to a maximum of 6%</p> <p>💛 Wellbeing benefits: financial education, women’s and men’s health support, mental health benefits, including coaching and counselling</p> <p><strong>🌈 The application journey has 3 key steps</strong></p> <ol> <li>An introductory video call with a member of the Monzo Recruitment team</li> <li>An initial video call with the hiring manager</li> <li>A series of role specific, behavioural & leadership principles interviews</li> </ol> <p>This process should take around 3-4 weeks - your schedule is really important to us, so we promise to be as flexible as possible! We have some guidelines on using Artificial Intelligence (AI) to ace an application and interview at Monzo. <a href="https://monzo.com/blog/the-ultimate-guide-on-using-ai-to-ace-an-interview-at-monzo">You can read them here.</a></p> <p>We'll only close this role once we have enough applications for the next stage. Please submit your application as soon as possible to make sure you don't miss out.</p> <p>#LI-MOS1</p><div class="content-conclusion"><hr> <p><strong>Equal opportunities for everyone</strong></p> <p>Diversity and inclusion are a priority for us and we’re making sure we have lots of support for all of our people to grow at Monzo. At Monzo, we’re embracing diversity by fostering an inclusive environment for all people to do the best work of their lives with us. This is integral to our mission of making money work for everyone. You can read more in our <a href="https://monzo.com/blog/diversity-and-inclusion">blog</a>, 2026 <a href="https://monzo.com/blog/our-2026-diversity-and-inclusion-report" target="_blank">Diversity and Inclusion Report</a> and 2025 <a href="https://monzo.com/blog/gender-pay-gap-report-2025">Gender Pay Gap Report.</a></p> <p>We’re an equal opportunity employer. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to age, ethnicity, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, family or parental status, national origin, or veteran, neurodiversity or disability status.</p> <p>If you have a preferred name, please use it to apply. We don't need full or birth names at application stage 😊</p></div>

title: Software Quality Assurance Engineer - Linux, PC, IoT
description: <p>Canonical is a growing international software company that works with the open-source community to deliver Ubuntu, “the world’s best free software platform”. Working here is a step into the future and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.</p> <p><em>Canonical believes a diverse workforce enhances our ability to deliver world class software and services which meet the world’s computing needs. We are committed to ensuring equal employment opportunities to all qualified individuals. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, or veteran status.</em></p> <p> </p>

title: Senior Internal Controls Manager
description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong><em>🚀 We’re on a mission to make money work for everyone.</em></strong></p> <p>We’re waving goodbye to the complicated and confusing ways of traditional banking.</p> <p>After starting as a prepaid card, our product offering has grown a lot in the last 10 years in the UK. As well as <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/personal">personal</a> and <a href="https://monzo.com/business-banking">business</a> bank accounts, we offer <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/joint-account">joint accounts</a>, <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/16-17">accounts for 16-17 year olds</a>, a <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/under-16s">free kids account</a> and <a href="https://monzo.com/flex">credit cards</a> in the UK, with more exciting things to come beyond. Our UK customers can also <a href="https://monzo.com/savings">save</a>, <a href="https://monzo.com/investments">invest </a>and <a href="https://monzo.com/pensions">combine their pensions</a> with us. </p> <p>With our hot coral cards and get-paid-early feature, combined with financial education on social media and our award winning customer service, we have a long history of creating magical moments for our customers!</p> <p>We’re not about selling products - we want to solve problems and change lives through Monzo ❤️</p> <hr> <p> </p></div><p><span style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif; font-size: 12pt;">📍Dublin | 💶 €91,000 - €111,500 + Incentive Awards tied to your performance + benefits | <a href="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=U62l09nB0M4">Hear from the team</a> ✨</span></p> <p><span style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif; font-size: 12pt;"><strong>⭐ Our Finance team</strong></span></p> <p>We are looking for a Senior Internal Controls Manager to join the Finance team at Monzo Bank Europe DAC based in Dublin.</p> <p>You will help Finance build and maintain a strong risk and control environment as we develop and grow our business across European markets. You will test key Finance controls, review evidence, support regulatory reporting assurance, track remediation actions and help improve the way Finance manages risk.</p> <p>Working across Financial Control, Regulatory Reporting, Treasury, FP&A, Tax, Risk & Compliance and Internal Audit, you will bring your accounting expertise, strong attention to detail and a practical approach to controls. You will be comfortable challenging processes, writing clear findings and helping teams improve.</p> <p>This is a great role for someone from audit, financial control or risk assurance who wants to help build a high-quality and robust Finance control environment in a growing digital bank.</p> <p><strong>🔑 You’ll play a key role by...</strong></p> <ul> <li>Maintaining a robust and well-documented risk and control environment by improving documentation, evidence standards and control processes for the Finance team, and helping to ensure Finance-owned risks are aligned with MBEU’s risk appetite and the wider Enterprise Risk Management Framework.</li> <li>Designing, maintaining and enhancing Finance risk and control matrices for key processes.</li> <li>Performing regular control testing and review of evidence across Finance processes, including financial reporting, month-end close, balance sheet reconciliations, regulatory reporting, tax, treasury and capital/liquidity-related processes.</li> <li>Testing Finance controls and assessing design and operating effectiveness. Identifying control gaps, recommending enhancements, and embedding change by tracking remediation actions and progress.</li> <li>Leading and supporting Finance risk and control self-assessments, including evidence gathering, challenge and documentation.</li> <li>Preparing concise updates for Finance leadership on control testing results, open issues, remediation progress and emerging risks. Supporting risk assurance reporting to MBEU governance forums.</li> <li>Working with second-line Risk & Compliance teams on oversight reviews, assurance planning and risk reporting.</li> <li>Supporting Internal Audit and external audit requests relating to Finance controls.</li> </ul> <p><strong>🤩 We’d love to hear from you if…</strong></p> <ul> <li>Hold a recognised accounting qualification, or be close to qualification, such as ACA, ACCA, CIMA, CPA Ireland or equivalent.</li> <li>Have detailed experience in audit, financial control, risk assurance, internal controls or regulatory reporting.</li> <li>Have experience in Banking, fintech or financial services experience.</li> <li>Can demonstrate a strong understanding of accounting processes, balance sheet controls, reconciliations and financial reporting risks.</li> <li>Have experience testing or reviewing controls, including assessing design and operating effectiveness.</li> <li>Can demonstrate strong attention to detail and ability to challenge evidence, assumptions and process weaknesses.</li> <li>Have experience in documenting robust processes, risks, controls, issues and remediation plans clearly.</li> <li>Have good interpersonal and influencing skills, ability to engage across various internal functions to develop, get buy-in and deliver outcomes across teams</li> <li>Have the ability to confidently present data in a meaningful and effective way; understanding the needs of the end users and tailoring presentations to their requirements</li> <li>Have experience building strong trusted relationships with stakeholders at all levels</li> </ul> <p><strong>🙌 What’s in it for you</strong></p> <p>💶 A salary range of €91,000 - €111,500 + Incentive Awards tied to your performance</p> <p>📍This role will have a hybrid working model, based in our Dublin office 2 - 3 days a week. You will also travel to Monzo’s head office in London from time to time</p> <p>⏰ We offer flexible working hours and trust you to work enough hours to do your job well, and at times that suit you and your team</p> <p>🏝 Annual Leave - 34 days including public holidays (24 holiday days + 10 public holidays)</p> <p>📚€1,200 learning budget each year to use on books, training courses and conferences</p> <p>🏥 Private healthcare scheme</p> <p>💰Pension scheme: the minimum contribution is 4% and Monzo matches any additional contributions that you make up to a maximum of 6%</p> <p>💛 Wellbeing benefits: financial education, women’s and men’s health support, mental health benefits, including coaching and counselling</p> <p><strong>🌈 The application journey has 3 key steps</strong></p> <ol> <li>An introductory video call with a member of the Monzo Recruitment team</li> <li>An initial video call with the hiring manager</li> <li>A series of role specific, behavioural & leadership principles interviews</li> </ol> <p>This process should take around 3-4 weeks - your schedule is really important to us, so we promise to be as flexible as possible! We have some guidelines on using Artificial Intelligence (AI) to ace an application and interview at Monzo. <a href="https://monzo.com/blog/the-ultimate-guide-on-using-ai-to-ace-an-interview-at-monzo">You can read them here.</a></p> <p>We'll only close this role once we have enough applications for the next stage. Please submit your application as soon as possible to make sure you don't miss out.</p><div class="content-conclusion"><hr> <p><strong>Equal opportunities for everyone</strong></p> <p>Diversity and inclusion are a priority for us and we’re making sure we have lots of support for all of our people to grow at Monzo. At Monzo, we’re embracing diversity by fostering an inclusive environment for all people to do the best work of their lives with us. This is integral to our mission of making money work for everyone. You can read more in our <a href="https://monzo.com/blog/diversity-and-inclusion">blog</a>, 2026 <a href="https://monzo.com/blog/our-2026-diversity-and-inclusion-report" target="_blank">Diversity and Inclusion Report</a> and 2025 <a href="https://monzo.com/blog/gender-pay-gap-report-2025">Gender Pay Gap Report.</a></p> <p>We’re an equal opportunity employer. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to age, ethnicity, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, family or parental status, national origin, or veteran, neurodiversity or disability status.</p> <p>If you have a preferred name, please use it to apply. We don't need full or birth names at application stage 😊</p></div>

title: Technology and Operational Risk Senior Manager
description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong><em>🚀 We’re on a mission to make money work for everyone.</em></strong></p> <p>We’re waving goodbye to the complicated and confusing ways of traditional banking.</p> <p>After starting as a prepaid card, our product offering has grown a lot in the last 10 years in the UK. As well as <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/personal">personal</a> and <a href="https://monzo.com/business-banking">business</a> bank accounts, we offer <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/joint-account">joint accounts</a>, <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/16-17">accounts for 16-17 year olds</a>, a <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/under-16s">free kids account</a> and <a href="https://monzo.com/flex">credit cards</a> in the UK, with more exciting things to come beyond. Our UK customers can also <a href="https://monzo.com/savings">save</a>, <a href="https://monzo.com/investments">invest </a>and <a href="https://monzo.com/pensions">combine their pensions</a> with us. </p> <p>With our hot coral cards and get-paid-early feature, combined with financial education on social media and our award winning customer service, we have a long history of creating magical moments for our customers!</p> <p>We’re not about selling products - we want to solve problems and change lives through Monzo ❤️</p> <hr> <p> </p></div><p>📍Dublin, Ireland | 💰<strong>€92,000 - €116,000, Incentive Awards tied to your performance ➕ benefits</strong>|<a href="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=U62l09nB0M4"> Hear from the team</a> ✨</p> <p><strong>⭐ Our Risk team</strong></p> <p>We are looking for an <strong>Operational, Technology and Information Security Risk Senior Manager</strong> in the second line of defence to provide independent oversight, challenge and advisory support on the effectiveness of our operational, technology, resilience and information security risk management practices across the EU. </p> <p>You will be a key member of the second line risk management team and work closely with senior stakeholders across first line technology, information security and operational resilience, to ensure risks are proactively identified, assessed, monitored, and managed in line with Monzo's risk management framework and appetite.</p> <p>This role requires a proactive and strategic mindset, strong technology risk management expertise, and a deep understanding of operational resilience and digital banking operations. </p> <p>This role reports to the Director of Operational Risk, Monzo Europe.</p> <p>The role you are applying for is a Controlled Function within the meaning of the Central Bank Reform Act, 2010. For this role, appointment will be conditional on Monzo being fully satisfied that the appointee meets the requirements as set out in the Fitness and Probity Standards issued by the Central Bank of Ireland. As a CF, the role holder will be subject to Conduct Standards under the Central Bank of Ireland Individual Accountability Framework (IAF) and will be required to take reasonable steps to ensure that the relevant conduct standards are met.</p> <p> <strong>🔑 You’ll play a key role by...</strong></p> <ul> <li>Acting as the second line subject matter expert for operational risk, technology (ICT and security risk (including cyber)), and operational resilience.</li> <li>Reviewing and challenging the design and effectiveness of controls over key technology systems, digital infrastructure.</li> <li>Providing effective oversight and challenge of first line risk and control self-assessments (RCSA), incident management and reporting, issue remediation and risk mitigation processes.</li> <li>Providing second line input into our technology and security strategies and business continuity planning.</li> <li>Supporting the ongoing development and maintenance of our Operational Risk Management Framework (ORMF), policies, standards and associated ICT,  Security and Resilience policies and risk appetite metrics.</li> <li>Co-ordinating second line assurance reviews and risk deep dives into critical operational and technology areas, providing actionable recommendations and insights.</li> <li>Overseeing ongoing compliance with  the digital operational resilience act (DORA) in the EU and ensuring alignment  with applicable local regulatory standards.</li> <li>Preparing operational and technology risk reports and providing updates to relevant governance forums, including risk committees and senior management.</li> </ul> <p> <strong>🤩 We’d love to hear from you if…</strong></p> <ul> <li>You have 8+ years’ experience in operational risk, technology risk or related roles in financial services, ideally within a digital or challenger bank, or a pan-European firm. </li> <li>You have a deep knowledge of risk management practices, regulatory expectations, and industry standards related to operational risk, technology and operational resilience. (e.g. EBA Guidelines on ICT & Security Risk Management, DORA, Central Bank of Ireland Guidance on Operational Resilience, General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR), Payment Service Directive (PSD2/PSD3)).</li> <li>You have a strong understanding of digital banking technology, including cloud computing, cybersecurity, fintech integrations and data management.</li> <li>You have experience in evaluating and challenging risk and control environments, particularly in high-growth or fast-changing environments.</li> <li>You are an ambitious risk professional ready to leave the constraints of legacy firms behind. This role places you at the cutting edge of technology and operational risk, challenging you to define the governance needed for our next-generation platforms.</li> <li>You have strong analytical, problem-solving and project management skills.</li> <li>You have excellent stakeholder management and communication skills, with the ability to influence senior leadership. </li> <li>You have a proven ability to navigate complex stakeholder landscapes such as working with regulators/managing regulatory engagements.</li> </ul> <p>Not ticking every box? That’s totally okay! Studies show that women and people of colour might hesitate to apply unless they meet every single requirement. At Monzo, we’re dedicated to creating a diverse and welcoming team. If you’re passionate about this role and keen to learn and grow with us, we encourage you to apply— even if you don’t have everything that's listed just yet. Drop us your application, we’d love to hear from you!</p> <p><strong>🙌What’s in it for you</strong></p> <p>💰 A salary range of €92,000 - €116,000 ➕Incentive Awards tied to your performance.</p> <p>📍This role will have a hybrid working model, based in our Dublin office 2 - 3 days a week.</p> <p>⏰We offer flexible working hours and trust you to work enough hours to do your job well, and at times that suit you and your team. </p> <p>🏝 Annual Leave - 34 days including public holidays (24 holiday days + 10 public holidays)</p> <p>📚€1,200 learning budget each year to use on books, training courses and conferences.</p> <p>🏥Private healthcare scheme</p> <p>💰Pension scheme: the minimum contribution is 4% and Monzo matches any additional contributions that you make up to a maximum of 6%</p> <p>💛Wellbeing benefits: financial education, women’s and men’s health support, mental health benefits, including coaching and counselling</p> <p><strong>🌈 The application journey has 4 key steps</strong></p> <ul> <li>An introductory call with a member of the Monzo Recruitment team</li> <li>An initial call with the hiring manager</li> <li>A series of role specific and behavioural interviews</li> <li>A final call with Monzo Bank Europe's CRO</li> </ul> <p>This process should take around 3-4 weeks - your schedule is really important to us, so we promise to be as flexible as possible! </p> <p>We have some guidelines on using Artificial Intelligence (AI) to ace an application and interview at Monzo. <a href="https://monzo.com/blog/the-ultimate-guide-on-using-ai-to-ace-an-interview-at-monzo">You can read them here.</a></p> <p>We’ll only close this role once we have enough applications for the next stage. Please submit your application as soon as possible to make sure you don’t miss out. </p> <p>If you're successful in applying for this role, we'll work with you to find a start date. In some cases, there might be a delay in when you can be released from your current role so that we can make sure things continue to run smoothly. We’ll be sure to communicate this with you and keep you updated.</p> <p>#LI-ÉS1</p><div class="content-conclusion"><hr> <p><strong>Equal opportunities for everyone</strong></p> <p>Diversity and inclusion are a priority for us and we’re making sure we have lots of support for all of our people to grow at Monzo. At Monzo, we’re embracing diversity by fostering an inclusive environment for all people to do the best work of their lives with us. This is integral to our mission of making money work for everyone. You can read more in our <a href="https://monzo.com/blog/diversity-and-inclusion">blog</a>, 2026 <a href="https://monzo.com/blog/our-2026-diversity-and-inclusion-report" target="_blank">Diversity and Inclusion Report</a> and 2025 <a href="https://monzo.com/blog/gender-pay-gap-report-2025">Gender Pay Gap Report.</a></p> <p>We’re an equal opportunity employer. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to age, ethnicity, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, family or parental status, national origin, or veteran, neurodiversity or disability status.</p> <p>If you have a preferred name, please use it to apply. We don't need full or birth names at application stage 😊</p></div>

description: <p>Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.</p> <p>The company is founder led, profitable and growing.</p> <h3><strong>We are hiring an HR Generalist to support our growing team</strong> </h3> <p>With 1,200+ colleagues across 75​ ​countries, we require an HR function that thinks and acts globally.​ We're looking for an HR Generalist who will report into our Regional HR Manager who can help build our company as we go through continued growth plans. You will demonstrate a high work ethic and the personal confidence to set and defend high expectations of colleagues, counterparts and processes. We look to HR both to support our colleagues in their personal needs and development, and also to maintain consistently high standards across multiple teams, managers and directors.</p> <p> </p> <h3><strong>The role entails the individual to:</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Provide HR guidance to team members and managers, setting high expectations of behaviour and performance.</li> <li>Partner with line managers to provide employee relations advice on global policies and procedures.</li> <li>Ensure accuracy and timeliness in processing employee changes, joiners and leavers.</li> <li>Manage and drive benefit programs spanning either our EMEA (UK, Ireland, France, Germany and Spain) or AMER (US, Canada and Brazil) locations</li> <li>Liaise with our finance team on monthly payroll, projects and enquiries.</li> <li>Support the full life-cycle of HR including onboarding, benefit administration, and departure.</li> <li>Apply critical thinking to automate and reduce administrative tasks.</li> <li>Take a lead role in the management, continued development, and integration of our HR system.</li> <li>Act as a system expert and advocate for the global HR team.</li> <li>Produce data driven reports to inform and influence HR initiatives.</li> <li>Lead and participate in projects where you’ll see the impact of your work.</li> <li>Support internal resource groups to drive title: Mid-Market Outcomes Architect
description: WHO WE ARE Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion. Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work. ABOUT THE ROLE Notion is reimagining how customers adopt, expand, and realize value from software in an AI-native world. As an Outcomes Architect, you’ll be the build-beside partner who helps customers turn AI ambition into working systems inside Notion. You’ll own workflow adoption, value delivery, and renewal outcomes for a book of named accounts, with a focus on customers that are flat, at-risk, or need a stronger path to measurable impact. You’ll partner closely with Solutions Consultants on account strategy, expansion qualification, and planning, while directly shaping outcomes that strengthen customer partnerships and contribute to predictable revenue. If you’re someone who loves helping customers build workflows that solve real business problems—and you want to work at the intersection of AI, productivity, customer value, and revenue impact—this is the role. WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE - Drive workflow adoption and value realization for a book of named accounts ensuring your customers know how to deliver outcomes with Notion - Contribute directly to NRR with predictable renewal and expansion pipeline and proactive product adoption for your book of business - Partner closely with Solutions Consultants on strategy for expansion and renewal for shared accounts, including owning the opportunity for flat and at-risk renewals - Define and maintain mutual success plans that proactively guide customers through their AI Transformation and demonstrate ROI to executive-level stakeholders with periodic business reviews - Facilitate use-case consultations that guide customers through their continuous Solutions Design and identify new workflow opportunities that drive outcomes and increase value with Notion - Identify opportunities to engage Services for customers with complex or technical implementation needs and partner closely with the Services team throughout delivery to ensure successful outcomes and value delivered - Learn Notion’s product and the broader AI ecosystem inside and out so you can be best suited help customers navigate new ways of working and build durable systems in Notion as the underlying system - Help build and deliver OA programs that generate customer and business outcomes across Notion’s install base SKILLS YOU'LL NEED TO BRING - 5+ years of experience driving customer adoption, value realization, renewals, or expansion within a B2B software environment - Strong customer-facing discovery instincts, with the ability to understand business problems, map workflows, and translate goals into practical implementation plans - Technical fluency and presence as a trusted advisor—while you won't be building for your customers, you should be capable of co-design, configuring, and troubleshooting Notion workspaces and workflows - Commercial awareness and the ability to partner with account owners on renewal risk, expansion potential, and account strategy - Ability to design and help customers build workflows that drive usage based consumption, connecting adoption patterns to measurable commercial outcomes - Strong program and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to manage success plans, timelines, risks, and customer commitments across a book of accounts - You operate with agency, urgency, and customer empathy, bringing structure to ambiguous problems and helping teams move from ideas to working systems - You’re obsessed with AI, constantly building with the newest tools and learning new ways of working - Native level Japanese, business level English NICE TO HAVES - Prior experience in customer success, solutions consulting, implementation, technical account management, or post-sales strategy for productivity, collaboration, or workflow software - Experience working with flat, at-risk, or complex renewal accounts and helping customers return to a clear value path - Experience partnering in a shared account ownership model with sales, solutions, support, or implementation teams - Experience designing repeatable customer programs, playbooks, or interventions that improve retention, expansion, and adoption at scale By clicking “Submit Application”, I understand and agree that Notion and its affiliates and subsidiaries will collect and process my information in accordance with Notion’s Global Recruiting Privacy Policy. https://dev.notion.so/Notion-Global-Recruiting-Privacy-Policy-a3ce416456924276a59de91bca740028?pvs=21 #LI-Onsite A NOTE ON AI You don’t need deep AI expertise for every role, but we do expect every Notino to be intellectually curious, drawn to tinkering and discovery, and excited to use AI as a real collaborator in their work. For some roles, AI fluency is a core requirement — when that’s the case, we'll say so explicitly in the qualifications. People who thrive here don’t treat AI as a novelty. They use it to think better, and make their work easier for others to build on. EQUAL OPPORTUNITY & ACCOMMODATIONS We hire talented people from a wide range of backgrounds. If you’re excited about this role but don’t meet every bullet, we still encourage you to apply. Notion is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of any legally protected characteristic. Consistent with applicable law, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records. Notion provides reasonable accommodations during the application process; if you need one, please let your recruiter know. Notion is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate in hiring or any employment decision based on race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), marital status, ancestry, physical or mental disability, genetic information, veteran status, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, or other applicable legally protected characteristic. Notion considers qualified applicants with criminal histories, consistent with applicable federal, state and local law. Notion is also committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities and disabled veterans in our job application procedures. If you need assistance or an accommodation due to a disability, please let your recruiter know.

title: Organisational Development Associate
location: Home Based - Americas; Home based - EMEA
description: <p>Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.</p> <p>The company is founder led, profitable and growing.</p> <p>Canonical builds the open-source software that runs the world’s clouds, devices and AI, and we hold our managers to a high standard. Our Talent Development team exists to make leaders and managers at Canonical genuinely excellent. We define what great management looks like here, and we put that standard into the hands of managers and leaders across the company.</p> <p>The Organisational Development Associate is where our most driven early-career people begin. From day one you work with real teams and take on real change, coached hard by senior practitioners on a fast path toward running this work yourself. This is not a support or back-office role, and it is not generalist HR. We hire for potential, drive and coachability over a polished CV, and we back the people we hire to move fast. </p> <p>Applying to this role will enter you into our People Track for consideration across roles in the function.</p> <p><strong>Location</strong>: These are remote based positions, available across EMEA and the Americas.</p> <h3><strong>The role entails</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Being embedded inside a real team: see how it works day to day, and surface what is and isn't working.</li> <li>Running the diagnostics on a team's health and management effectiveness (engagement, 360, direct feedback), and turning the evidence into a clear, honest read.</li> <li>Owning an improvement end to end: a concrete change to how a team works that you design, drive and land, with a senior practitioner alongside you.</li> <li>Supporting managers in delivering effective 360 performance feedback to individuals and helping them turn it into two or three real commitments they follow through on.</li> <li>Helping build the playbook: the standards, tools and shared language the whole function runs on. You are building the system others use, not producing filler.</li> <li>Learning coaching and organisational development directly from senior practitioners, on a fast, visible path to running this work yourself.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>What we are looking for in you</strong></h3> <ul> <li>A track record of leading and organising early. You have run things, built things, won people over and made change happen, in a startup, a student society, the military, a team, anywhere. People around you already see you as a driver.</li> <li>A deliberate pull toward developing people and organisations. You chose this field on purpose, with a real grounding in organisational or industrial psychology, behavioural science or a comparable basis. It is not a fallback.</li> <li>Drive and eagerness to learn. You have your own ideas and the confidence to challenge, and you are hungry to be coached and to grow fast.</li> <li>The presence to sit across from experienced people and talk about change with confidence. </li> <li>An exceptional academic track record from high school and university.</li> <li>Up to around two years of experience since graduating.</li> <li>Business level written and spoken English.</li> <li>Organised, accurate, confident, authentic, results-oriented, and enthusiastic.</li> <li>Sincere personal motivation aligned with our mission.</li> <li>Willingness to travel up to 4 times a year for internal events. </li> </ul> <p>In addition we expect that you will match our values, by being:</p> <ul> <li>Precise, taking care to deliver correctness and clarity.</li> <li>Reliable, delivering high quality work that builds trust and confidence.</li> <li>Accessible, collaborating to build products and systems that are usable.</li> <li>Adroit, blending enthusiasm, knowledge, adaptability, style and character.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>Nice-to-have skills</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Any exposure to people, organisational, coaching or consulting work, through study, an internship or a first job.</li> <li>A genuine interest in the craft of management and organisations, not just the subject matter.</li> <li>Comfort working with data.</li> </ul> <h3>What we offer colleagues</h3> <p>We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognise outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus. We provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.</p> <ul> <li>Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person.</li> <li>Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year.</li> <li>Annual compensation review.</li> <li>Recognition rewards.</li> <li>Annual holiday leave.</li> <li>Maternity and paternity leave.</li> <li>Employee Assistance Programme.</li> <li>Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues.</li> <li>Priority Pass, and travel upgrades for long haul company events.</li> </ul> <h3>About Canonical</h3> <p>Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open source projects and the platform for AI, IoT and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence - in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since its inception in 2004.​ Working here is a step into the future, and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.</p> <p>Canonical is an equal opportunity employer</p> <p>We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products.<a href="https://canonical.com/careers/diversity/identity"> Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.</a></p> <p>#LI-remote</p>

France is a Tier 1 region in Notion’s country-first EMEA model, with significant room to scale into a standalone, high-growth business. Notion is shifting from a traditional sales model toward a builder-led model with fewer handoffs, stronger technical fluency, and more direct ownership of customer outcomes. As General Manager, France, you will be the second-line leader responsible for overall revenue outcomes, regional GTM strategy, and the operating model for the French business. You will lead through frontline managers, teams of Business Development Representatives, Solutions Consultants and Outcomes Architects as well as partner cross functionally with Professional Services, Channel Partnerships and RevOps. This is a hands-on builder-leader role for an AI-native, country-first GTM model. You will bring Notion’s new GTM model to life in France: moving from a segment-first motion to a country-first, AI-native operating system where teams help customers diagnose problems, design agentic workflows, and build real systems with Notion AI. This role sits on the EMEA Leadership Team and reports to the General Manager, EMEA. This role will be based in Paris. Make agentic transformation central to the French GTM motion: help customers identify high-value workflows, build and deploy Notion Agents, automate cross-functional work, and measure outcomes from AI adoption. - Partner tightly with Solutions Consultants, Outcomes Architects, Forward Deployed Architects/Engineers, Professional Services, Marketing and Channel to reduce handoffs and deliver faster, more durable customer value. - Build “sell with” partner motions in France, including partner-sourced pipeline, co-sell plays, enablement, AI/agentic solution packages, and joint account planning. - Establish Notion as a visible force in the French ecosystem through executive dinners, field events, startup and community engagement, partner activations, and customer advocacy. - Create a talent destination in France by hiring builder-oriented leaders and ICs, raising the craft bar, and developing the next generation of AI-native GTM talent. - Drive operational excellence across forecasting, pipeline quality, territory planning, inspection cadence, performance management, and cross-functional execution.
